tei:div.tei:p: (46)༄krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

mdo spe/ sgomi (46)0112 'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 3dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 2gnyis pa/ yang dag par spro bar bya ba'i le'u/ 13gsum pa/ rigs yongs su dag pa'i le'u/ 22bzhi pa/ chos snang ba'i sgo'i le'u/ 44lnga pa/ bskyod par brtsams pa'i le'u/ 57drug pa/ lhums su 'jug pa'i le'u/ 76bdun pa/ bltam pa'i le'u/ 101brgyad pa/ lha khang du khyer ba'i le'u/ 150dgu pa/ rgyan gyi le'u/ 154bcu pa/ yi ge bstan pa'i le'u/ 157bcu gcig pa/ zhing pa'i grong gi le'u/ 164bcu gnyis pa/ sgyu rtsal bstan pa'i le'u/ 1711

bcu gsum pa/ bskul ba'i le'u/ 197bcu bzhi pa/ mi lam gyi le'u/ 228bco lnga pa/ mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u/ 240bcu drug pa/ gzugs can snying po 'ongs pa'i le'u/ 282bcu bdun pa/ dka' ba spyad pa'i le'u/ 289bco brgyad pa/ rna ran dza na'i le'u/ 311bcu dgu pa/ byang chub kyi snying por bzhud pa'i le'u/ ldan nyi shu pa/ byang chub kyi snying por bkod pa'i le'u/ 346nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ bdud btul ba'i le'u/ 456nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i le'u/ 400nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ mngon par bstod pa'i le'u/ 417nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ ga gon dang bzang po'i le'u/ 4 0nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ bskul ba'i le'u/ 455nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i le'u/ 468nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ mjug sdud pa'i le'u/ 518rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dra na ṭī la dang / mu ni bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lo ba bad de ye shes ldes bsgyur cing zhus /ta/na nā kā /sar chad kyis kyang bcos nas bsdur mchad/(527) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(587)011 'phags pa 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 588rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo rnyi dang /mu chen gyi pho ba ban de ye shes ldes nus te

bsdur mchan/(65) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(6/dri la phab/0114 'phags pa 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul ba'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 655rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī len dra bo dhe dang / dzi na mi tra dang / mu chen gyi spo ba bad de ye shes ldes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(693) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(697)0115 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 698rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dang / nu chen gyi bo ba bad de ye shes lde dang bad de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing nus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(745) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(75 )0116 de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 754bsdur mchan/(758) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(758)

ci ci 77 po (4podzi ji (1ho rdo rmetsha ldemacho — —— ri ri ci — ————— —— —ri rte ba rdolto tsha rko——ra sko sna ci 'u stardzi tsho 7 4chos sna tsha ri 6 / shā — — mi shī1 —— 23 ——433 4 rdzo sgroswārdo ༷shā )ji dzā /spra khu 〉rtso tho cabak+ṣe 3) dzogashā wi 2 nga rdo zhe / mebo /ga 1 — 'os ——————ri —— — — cho snang na cha ༷byu ji tshe sa/rton—— 4 1 1kho /mi phyed rdo rje'i stobs rdzogs pa// /rdo rje snying pos rab tu 'joms/ /

—— nga rte — — ——lha/ / — ——tsho /3rnye 44 51— mo ri sa gyu the rdo tshaX ri ge —blo 〈 ༷stuX rnag4 4 ca ge zhu ( ri ( ༷༄dze——ris — cigasu ma —— — 7 ri po —— —de gu tsho /mi sgo 4 7 47tsho tsho du/sa tsha367—— 7 4— 5ge ༅tho—— — dzo nga tre chosgru dhe ci 6)snyi / pa sa shā 〉 ri phro shā — gi sgyu zhe lo — —— ri rī kho /thar mchog 'dod pa 'jo ba yi/ /'od ldan rin chen 'od 'phro ba/ /

khog /'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄tshogi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya la li ta bistukhur nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa rgya cher ②rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ dge slong khri nyis stong gi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po la 'di lta ste/tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi rgya dang / tshe dang ldan pa rta thul dang / tshe dang ldan pa rlangs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa ming chen dang / tshe dang ldan pa bzang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa grags sbyin dang / tshe dang ldan pa dri ma med dang /tshe dang ldan pa lag bzangs dang / tshe dang ldan pa gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag dang / tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyasasnyi'od srung dang / tshe 46—3

dang ldan pa chu klung 'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa ga mtsha3)'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa med galasagyi bu chen po dang /tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa kā ca'i bu chen po dang /tshe dang ldan pa ka pi na chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa gsus po che dang / tshe dang ldan pa skul byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' byed dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'ug pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa nam gru dang / tshe dang ldan pa seng ldeng nags pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa don yod rgyal po dang / tshe dang ldan pa pha rol tu 'gro ba chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ba kusnyil dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo dang / tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin dang / tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang /de dag la sogs56)pa dge slong khri nyis stong dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sum khri nyis stongasathams cad kyang skye ba gcig gis thogs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad las nges par skyes pa/byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa thams cad kyis rnam par rtse ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzungasashethams cad thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spobs pa thams cad thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam thams cad shin tu yongs su rdzogs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i so so yang dag par rig pa thams cad rtogs par khong du chud pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad la dbang thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang thams cad thob pa/byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa thams cad la zhugs pa/ byang chub sems 46—4

dpa'i sa thams cad rab tu rdzogs pa sha stag ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po seng ge'i tog dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don grub blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa rab tu zhi ba'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus rtag par sbyor dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje cher⑥semasalgenang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sum khri nyis stong dang yang thabs cig go/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen po na/ 'khor bzhi dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i sras dang / rgyal po'i blon po chen po dang / chags 'og gi rgyal phran dang /rgyal po'i zhabasashe'abring ba dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang / blon po dang / 'khor gyi mi dang / grong khyer pa dang / yul gyi mi dang / mu stegs can dang / dge sbyong dang /bram ze dang / dpyodasapa pa dang / kun tu rgyu sna tshogs kyis rim gror dbyas/bla mar byas/ bste stang du byas/ mchod pa byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang myang ba dag gebasod cing mang ba dang / na bza' dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun gyi gsos sman dang / yo byad rung ba brnyes shing / bcom ldan 'das ni brnyes pa dam pa dang / grags pa dam pa brnyes kyang pad ma la chus mi gos pa ltar thams cad du 46—5

ma chags ma gos par bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi grags pa dang / sgra dang snyan pa ni 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes ①bya bar 'jig rten du mngon par grags par gyur to/ /de ni spyan lnga dang ldan pa ste/ 'jig rten 'di dang 'jig rten pha rol lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pakhri tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgum lha dang mir bcas pa dag /rang gis mngon par mkhyen pas mngon du mdzad nas nye bar bsgrubs te rab tu ston to/ /de thog mar dge ba / bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su dkar ba'i chos ston te/ tshangs pa'i spyod pa yang dag par ston to/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis nam gyi gung thun la/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyan bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas kyi rgyan bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu / skad cig de nyid la bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug gi gtsug tor gyi gseb nas/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas rjes su dran par bya ba la chags pa med pa'i ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer byung ste/ des gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i gnas thams cad snang bar byas nas lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa lha'i bu tshad med pa dag yang dag par bskul to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer gyi 46—6

tshogs de las bskulanyeba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang byung ngo / /ye shes 'od ldan mun bcom 'od mdzad pa/ /'od bzang gzi brjid dam pa dri med pa//sku lus rab zhi thugs dge zhi ba po/ /shākya'i seng ge thub dang phrad par gyis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mthu chen dag pa ste/ /chos kyi mnga' bdag kun mkhyen thub pa'i dbang / /mi dang lhas mchod lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /chos la rang byung mnga' dbang mdzad la rton②/ /gang zhig gdul dka'ikhusems la mnga' mdzad de/ /gang zhig bdud kyi rnyikyilas grol ba'i thugs/ /de 'dir mthong thos don med ma yin gyis/ /rnam grol mthar phyin zhi ba'i drung du deng 3/ /mtshungs med chos la snang bar gyur pa ste/ /mun sel tshul bzang ston par rab mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas spyod zhi mkhyen pa dpag med pa/ /de yi drung du dad pa mchog gis dengashe/ /de ni sman pa'i rgyal po bdud rtsi gtong / /de ni smra ba dpa' bo tshogs ngan 'joms/ /de ni chos kyi rtsa lag don dam mkhas/ /de ni 'dren pa bla med lam ston pa'o/ /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de dag sngon gyi sangs rgyas rjes su dran par bya ba la chags pa med pa'i ye shes snang ba'i 'od zer des phog cing tshigs su bcad pa rnam pa de lta bu de dag gis kyang bskul ma thag tu rab tu zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus bskal pa grangs med tshad med bgrang ba las shin tu 'das pa dag las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams rjes su dran zhing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa gang yin pa dag dang /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gang yin pa dag dang / chos bstan pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang rjes su dran par gyur to/ /de nas de'i nub mo mi nyal tsam 46—7

na gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu dbang phyug ces bya ba dang / dbang phyug chen po dang /nyu dga' bo dang / shin tu dga' bo dang / tsan dan dang /mchod byas dang / rab zhi dang / dul ba rab zhi dbang phyug la sogs pa de dag dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu gzhan shin tu mang po kha dog 'phags shing shin tu 'phags pasnyedang ldan pa dag gis/ lha'i snang bas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad snang bar byas te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas kyang gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgya cherasarol pa zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs mdo sde shin tu rgyas pa chen po bsdus pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bstan pa/ dga' ldan gyi pho brang dam pa nas 'bab pa dang /ched du dgongs te lhums su 'jug pa'i rnam par rol pa dang / mngal gyi gnas kyi khyad par kun tu bstan pa/ rigs bzang por skye ba'ishesa'i mthu kun du bstan pa/ byis pa'i spyod pa thams cad las yon tan gyi khyad par gyis shin tu 'da' ba bstan pa/ 'jig rten pa'i bzo'i gnas dang / las kyi gnas dang / yi ge dang / grangs dang / lag rtsis dang / rtsis dang / ral gri'i thabs dang / 'phong dang / stobs dang / gyad kyi 'dzin stangs rnams sems can thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa kun du bstan pa/ btsun mo'i 'khor dang / yul gyi longs spyod dang / yongs su spyod pa kun tu bstan pa / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad kyi rgyu 'thun pas yongs su grub 46—8

pa'i 'bras bu brnyes7pa yongs su brjod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par rol pa dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'jig pa bstan pa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad ma mchis pa nges par bstan pa/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis sngon chad gsungs pa mchis te/ 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das pad ma'i bla ma dang / chos kyi tog dang / mar me mdzad dang / yon tan gyi tog dang /yon tan 'byung gnas dang / 'od zer chen po dang / drang srong lha dang /dpal gyi gzi brjid dang / bden pa'i tog dang / rdo rje mkhregs dang /thams cad zil gyis gnon dang / gser mdog dang / shin tu mthor gshegs dang / byisaru'i rgya mtsho dang / me tog gi tog dang / gzugs bzang dang / spyan bzang dang / drang srong sbed dang / dmag tshogs las rgyal dang / mtho ba dang / me tog rgyas pa dang / mdzod spu gzi brjid dang /shin tu rgyas dang / 'od zer bzang po dang / bkra shis ldan dang / blta na bzang dang / seng ge'i gzi brjid chen po dang / blo gros brtan pas byin dang / sos na'i spos dri dang / bden pa'i chosashegrags rgya chen dang / 'od ldan dang / skar rgyal dang / 'jig rten mdzes dang / 'od rgya chen dang /rin chen grags dang / drag shul gzi brjid dang / rin chen gzi brjid dang / tshangs pa'i gzi brjid dang / sgra snyan dang / me tog bzang posredang /ri rab me tog dang / rab tu yid 'ong dbyangs dang / dge ba tshul bzangs dang / rab tu 'dzum pa'i spyan dang / yon tan phung po dang / 'brug sgra dang / kha dog mdzes dang / tshe'i gzi brjid dngas/ dom bag glang po'i 46—9

'gros dang / 'jig rten mngon par smon dang / dgra las rgyal dang / yang dag mchod dang / rnam par gzigs dang / gtsug tor can dang / thams cad skyob chodang / 'khor ba 'jigashedang / gser thub dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis kyang sngon chad gsungs pa lags na/ de bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba dang / skye bo phal po che'i don dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don du 'gyur ba dang —/ sman pa dang bde bar 'gyur ba dang / theg pa chen po 'di'ang brjod pa dang / pas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar gcadashepa dang / bdud thams cad zil gyis mnan rji pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bstan pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi brtson 'grus brtsam pa bskyed pa dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi gcad ④pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs pa yang tsokun tu bstan pa'i slad du da ⑦bstan du gsol zhes gsol pa dang —/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu de dag dang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba'i phyir cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas lha'i bu de dag kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas tshim zhing mgu la yi durangs shing rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / a ga ru'i phye ma dang / me tog man dā ra ba ( dag gis kyang mngon par gtor te/ de nyid 46wa 10

du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nub mo de'i nam nangs ①pa dang / rtsig⑧ma'i sdum bu'i 'khor gyi khyams ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas/bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis tsayongs su bskor cing ④nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyisakhumadun gyis bltas te/ gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mdang 'dir nga'i drung du gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu dbang phyug ces bya ba dang / dbang phyug chen po dang dga' bo dang /shin tu dga' bo dang / tsan dan dang / mchod byas dang / rab zhi dang /dul ba rab zhi dbang phyug la sogs pa de dag dang gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu gzhan shin tu mang po zhes bya ba nas/ de nyid du mi snang bar gyur ces bya ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin du gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / nyan thos chen po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgya cher rol pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs legs par bstan du gsol/ de ni skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang /'jig rten la thugs brtse bar mdzad pa dang / skye bo phal po che dang / lha dang mi rnams dang / da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi don dang / sman pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro zhes gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang nyan thos chen po de dag dang / lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba'i phyir cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de la 'di skad ces 46—11

bya ste/ dge slong dag kye nga ni mdang7sum 'dir/ /gnas pa bzang pos bde bar gnas gyur cing / /nyon mongs med par rab tu gnas gyur la/ /rtse gcig sems su mnyam par bzhag drung du/ /rdzu 'phrul che zhing kha dog bza nga ldan la/ /dri med dpal 'bar lha yi bu lhags nas/ /dpal gyis rgyal byed tshal 'di snang byas te/ /dga' bas nga yi gan du mngon par lhags/ /dbang phyug dbang phyug chen po tsan dan dang / /dga' bo rab tu sems zhi mchod byas dang dzha/ /shin tu dga' bo zhi ba lha yi bu/ /bye ba lha mang de dang de dag rnams②// nga yi gzhabs la phyag 'tshal bskoratswabyas te/ /nga yi mdun du 'dir ni 'khod par gyur/ /sor mo bcu yisakethal sbyar gus bcas par/ /de dag 'dir ni nga la gsol ba btab⑥/ /'jig rten kun la sman pa'i don slad du/ /rgyal ba kun gyis sngon chad gang gsungs pa/ /shin tu rgyas mdo gleng gzhi chen po 'di//thub pa 'dod chags bsal bas de ring yang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kun bzungakhubazhed pas/ /phas kyi rgol dang bdud rnams 'dul mdzad la/ /theg pa chen po mchog 'di rab gsung zhing / /thub pa de slad legs par bshad du gsol/ /37yi tshogs kyis gsol ba de snang phyir/ /mi gsung gyur pas gnang ba mdzad pas na/ /thams cad tshim zhing rab dga' mgu gyur nas/ /dga' ba thob pas me tog sil ma gtor/ /de phyir dge slong shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo/ /'jig rten kun la phan pa'i don gyi phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis sngon bshad pa/ /gleng gzhi chen po khyed kun 'dir nyon cig /gleng gzhi'i ⑪le'u ste dang po'o// //46—12

dge slong dag de la chos kyi rnam grangs shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba de gang zhe na/ dge slong dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas mchog na gnas pa/ mchod par bya bas mchod pa/dbang bskur ba thob pa/ lha brgya stong gis bstod cing bkur te brjod cing bsngags0pa/ bsam pa thob pa/ smon lam gyis yang dag par 'phags pa/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par thob pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi mig shin tu rgyas shing yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang / blo gros dang / rtogs pa dang / khrel yod pa dang / dga' ba 'bar ba'i blo rlabs po che dang ldan pa/ sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / thabs la mkhas pa chen po'i dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa/ tshangs pa'i lam byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyomasashechen po la mkhas pa/ mngon par shes pa dang / rig pa chen pos sgrib pa med cing chags pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba mngon du gyur pa/ dran pa nye bar gzhagashepa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad shin tu yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar phyin pa/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos lus legs par brgyan pa/ yun ring por rjes su 'brang ba dang ldan pa/ ji skad du smras pa de ltar byed pas logasnyipa med pa'i tshig gi lamasnyeyang dag par smra ba/ drang zhing ma yo la/ gya gyu med pa'i yid thogs pa med pa dang ldan pa/46—13

nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang / dregs pa dang / 'jigs pa dang / zhum pa thams cad med paX// sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dpag tu med pa la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang pos ngor blta zhing blta ba'i bzhin dang ldan pa/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug chen po dang /'jig rten skyong ba dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang ske/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / srin po rnams kyis mngon par dga' bar bya ba'i grags pa dang ldan pa/ tshig thams cad rab tu phye ste bstanam pa la thogs pa med pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa larka'ajug pa'i shes pa la mkhas pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa gzung ba la dran pa'i snod 'khrul pa med pa dang / gzungs mtha' yas mu med pa rab tu thob pa/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs mkhas pa'i chos rin po che dang / bsod nams kyis yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i chos kyi gru chen po'i ded dpon chen po/ chu bo bzhi'i pha rol tu 'gro ba'i bsam pa can/ bdud dang phyir rgol ba bcom pa/ pas kyi ⑤rgol ba thams cad shin tu tshar bcad pa/g.yul ngo'i thog ma la rab tu 'dug pa/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra'i tshogs 'jomasakyipa / ye shes mchog gi rdo rje'i mtshon sra ba dang ldan pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rtsa ba las snying rje chen po'i chu ba ༅lhag pa'i bsam pas skyes pa zab cing brtan pa dang ske/ brtson 'grus kyi chos kyi chus mngon par brlan pa/ thabs mkhas pa'i 46—14

snying po dang ldan pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag dang / bsam gtan gyi ze0)ba can/ ting nge 'dzin gyi zesa'abru dang ldan pa/ yon tan gyi tshogs rgya chen po'i mtsho las skyes pa/ nga rgyal dang dregs pa'i gdung ba ③med pa'i zla bas dri mas med pa'i 'dab ma rgyas pa/ tshul khrims dang / thos pa dang / bag yod pa'i bsungasagi ngad phyogs bcur thogs pa med par ldang ba/ 'jig rten na shes pa'i du thu bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis ma gos pa/ skyes bu chen po'i pad ma/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyisamatshogs kyi dri zhim po 'byung ba/shes rab dang ye shes kyi nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis mig shin tu rnam par dag pa'i pad ma 'dab ma brgya pa rgyas pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi mchog tu mgyogs pa'i shugs dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i sder mo dang mche ba shin tu rno ba/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi'i so drang bsnyer ba/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis shin tu bsdus pa'i mgo dang ldan pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yan lag bcu gnyis 'khong du chud pas rim gyis 'phags pa'i lus dang ldan pa/byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu7rtsa bdun yang dag par yongs su rdzogs pas ral pa can du byas shing / rig pa dang / ye shes kyi ze tshab can/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi kha gdangs pa/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong shin tu rnam par dag pa'i mig dang ldan pa/ bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i ri sul gyi phug na gnas pa/spyod lam bzhi dang / 'dul ba'i nags tshal dang / nags 'dab nas skyes pa'i lus dang ldan pa/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / nye ba'i stobs dang ldan pa/ skye ba dang 'jig pa'i 'jigs pa dang spu g.yo ba med pa/46—15

rtsal la zhum pa med pa/ mu stegs can gyi bong bu dang ri dgasalgemang po'i tshogs rab tu 'joms pa/ bdag med par sgra brjod pa'i seng ge'i nga ro chen po sgrog pa/ skyes bu seng geX/ rnam par grol ba dang / bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor las shes rab kyi 'od dang / 'od zer gyis mu stegs byed srin bu me khyer gyi tshogs 'od med par byed pa/ ma rig pa'i mun pa mun nag gi ling tog dang rab rib med par byed pa/ stobs dang brtson 'grus 'bar ba lha dang mi'i nang du bsod nams kyi gzi brjid kyi gzi dang ldan pa skyes bu chen po'ishenyi ma/ nag po'i phyogs med pa/ dkar po'i phyogs yongs su rdzogs pa/blta na sdug cing yid du 'ong bas mig gi dbang po la thogs pa med pa/ lhaphubargya stong gi skar ma'i tshogasasnyikyis shin tu brgyan pa/ bsam gtan dang /rnam par thar pa dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor can/ byang chub kyi yan lag gi bde bas zla ba'i 'od zer du gyur pa/ mi dang lha mkhas pa'i me tog ku mu da kha 'byed pa skyes bu chen po zla ba/ 'khor gyi gling bzhir song ba/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi rin po che dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad la sems mnyam par sbyor ba/ blo dpyad thogs pa med pa/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam gyi dka' thub dang brtul zhugs shin tu phun sum tshogs shing rab tu rdzogs pas khyad par du bogs dbyung bar bya ba'i bsam pa can/ chos kyi rgyal po'i chos kyi 'khor lo rin po che mchog dam pa thogs pa med par bskor ba/ 'khor los sgyurashiba'i rigs kyi rgyud du byung ba/ chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zab cing gting dpag dka' ba/ chos rin po che thams cad kyis rab tu gang ba/ thos pas mi ngoms pas yangs shing rgya che la 46—16

mtha' yas pa'i ye shes dang tshul khrims kyi tshod las mi 'da' ba/ blo rgya mtsho dang sa ltar rgya che ba'i mchog tu gyur pa/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang mnyam pa'i sems su gyur pa/ ri rab ltar brtan zhing mi g.yo latubaskyodaro par mi nus pa'i yid dang ldan pa/ rjes su chags pa dang khong khro ba med pa/ nam mkha'i dkyil ltar dri ma med cing yangs la 'dra ba med par rgya che ba'i blo dang ldan pa/lhag pa'i bsam pa shin tu yongs su dag pa/ sbyin pa legs par byin pa/sngon sbyor ba legs par byas pa/ lhag pa'i bya ba legs par byas pa/ bden pa'i rgyan gyis legs par brgyan pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su btsal ba/ gos par bya ba bsgosalgepa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba nges par byas pa/ bskal pa grangs med pa bdun du dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs pa/sbyin pa rnam pa bdun byin pa/ bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po lnga shin tu bsten pa/ legs par spyad pa lus kyisarnam gsum/ ngag gi〈rnam bzhi/ yid kyi rnam gsum spyad par gyur pa/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bsten pa dang ldan pa/yang dag pa'i sbyor ba yan lag bzhi bcu dang ldan pa bston par gyur pa/ yang dag pa'i smon lam yan lag bzhi bcu dang ldan pa'i smon lam btab pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa yan lag bzhi bcu dang ldan pa la zhugs pa/ yang dag pa'i rnam par thar pa yan lag bzhi bcu dang ldan pa/ yongs su rdzogs par byas pa/yang dag pa'i mos pa yan lag bzhi bcu dang ldan pa drang por byas pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu'i rjes su rab tu byung ba/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong lnga bcu rtsa lnga la sbyin pa phul bar gyur pa/ rang sangs rgyas bye ba brgya phrag phyed dang bzhi la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ sems can 46—17

tshad med 〉grangs med pa dag mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam du btsud par gyur pa/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa/ tshe gcig gis thogs pa/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa na gnas pa lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar po zhes bya ba/ lha'i tshogs rnams kyis 'di ni 'di nas shi 'phos nas mi'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ring po mi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes der shin tu mchod pa/ gzhal med khangakeganas sum khri nyis stong laphurab tu gnas pa/ stegs bu dang / ba gam dang /rta babs dang / skar khung dang / bsil khang dang / khang pa brtsegs pa dang / khyams kyis legs par brgyan pa/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan sgreng ba/ rin po che'i dril bu g.yer kha'i dra ba'i bla re bres pa/ me tog man dā nga ra ba dang / man dra 3skar ba chen po dag chal par bkram pa/ lha'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong glu dbyangs len pa/ me togashes ti muka ta ku dang —/ tsam pa ka dang / skya snar dang / sa brtol dang / btang bzungakhudang —/ btang bzung chen po dang / mya ngan 'tshang dang / n+ya gro dha dang /tin du ka dang / ā tsho sa na dang / dong ku'i me tog dang / shing keshes ra dang —/ ta ma la dang / sā tshal dang / rin po che'i shing sngon pa chen pos brgyan pa/ gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa/ gzhi mnyam zhing bkod pas mdzes par byas pa/ me tog snang 'od dang / mā bili ka dang / sna ma'i me tog dang / bār shi dka dang / ta ra ni dang / ba li dang / ko ta ra ni dang / mchog tu dri zhim dang / dha nus ka pari dang / lha'i sna ma'i me tog dang / ud pa 46—18

la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / dri rab tu zhim pa'i bla re0)chen po phyogs phyogs su bres pa/ bya 'dab spen dang / ne tso dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug dang / ngang pa dang / rma bya dang /ngur pa dang / ku na la dang / ka la ping ka dang / shang shang te'u5 kyil sogs pa bya sna tshogs sgra snyan pa 'byin pa/ lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis mig mngon du phyogs te blta zhing ltad mor bya ba/ chos rgya che ba chen po yang dag par brjod ⑤pas 'dod pa la dga' ba'i shugs kyis rtso)nyon mongs pa thams cad gcod pa/ nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang / dregs pa dang / khro ba dang /tha ba dang / khong khro ba med par gyur pa/ dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang /mchog tu dga' ba dang / dran pa rgya che zhing gsal ba skye ba'i gzhal med khang chen po de na bde bar gnas shing chos kyi yang dag pa'i gtam byung ba dang /sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs brgyad khri bzhi stong po'i sgra de dag las byang chub sems dpa'i 0sngon gyi las dge ⑧ba'i tshogs kyis yang dag par bskul 17ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung ngo / /bsod nams rgya chen tshogs mnga' dran rtogs dang / /blo gros mtha' yas shes rab 'od mdzad pa/ /mtshungs med stobs mnga' sku 7rtsal rgya che ba/ /mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan dgongs par mdzod/ /rgya chen dri ma med pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /dri ma gsum spangs rgyags dang skyon zhi ba/ /dge ba dri med rnam par dag pa'i thugs/ /sngon chad ji ltar sbyin spyad dgongs par mdzod/ /zhi gnas tshul khrims brtul zhugs bzod pa dang / /dul dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab stobs/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams spyad pa/ /spyod rigs cher byung dgongs mdzod dgongs par 46—19

mdzod/ /sems can rnams la thugs brtse mdzad gyur cing / /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig khyod mi)kyis mchod/ /dgongs mdzod dgongs par mdzod cig grags mtha' yas / /de dus lags kyis btang snyoms ma mdzad cig /rga shi nyon mongs 'jigasamadzad rdul bral ba/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dri za dang / /lha min dbangashepo dag kyang sdod lags kyis9/ /'chi 'pho'i tshul mkhyen 'pho ba bstan par mdzod/ /bskal pa stong du dka' ba spyad gyur kyang / /rgya mtsho chu yis ji bzhin mi ngoms kyisal/ /ngoms pa khyod kyi thugs dam dge ba ste/ /yun ring skom nyen skye bo tshim par mdzod/ /smad pa med pa'i grags pa mnga' ba khyod/ /chos la dgyes parashekhyod dgyes 'dod mi dgyes/ /'on kyang dri ma med pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten dag la thugs brtse mdzod/ /lha rnams bye ba khyod las chos thos pas/ /ngoms par 'gyur ba ma lags 'on gyis kyang / /dal dang mi ldan gyur pa'i ngan song du/ /gnas par gyur pa dag la gzigs su gsol/ /dri ma med pa'i spyan mnga' phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten dag gi sangs rgyas gzigs /)gyur cing / /de dag rnams la chos gsan chos mchog de/ /'jig rten dag la rnam par dbye ba mdzod/ /dpal ldan khyod bokyi bsod nams dpal gyis ni/ /dga' ldan pho brang shin tu mdzes mod kyi/ /'on kyang thugs rje thugs dang ldan pas na/ /'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan du ni char pa phob/ /brtul zhugs grub pa byang chub reg ces te/ /'dod pa'i khams las rab tu 'das pa yi/ /gzugs kyi khams na lha rnams gang 'khod pa/ /du ma thams cad mngon par rab tu dga'/ /mgon po khyod kyis bdud kyi las rnams bcom/ /khyod gzhan mu stegs can rnams pham mdzad 46—20

de/ /khyod ni byang chub phyag mthil bzhag dang 'dra/ /de dus lags kyis 3 btang snyoms ma mdzad cig /nyon mongs rab tu 'bar ba'i 'jig rten la/ /dpa' bo khyod kyis sprin ltar khyab mdzad de/ /bdud rtsi'i char pa mngon par rab tu phob/ /lha mi rnams kyikhunyon mongs zhi bar mdzod/ /khyod ni sman pa khamasakhul mkhas pa ste/ /yun ring nad pa sman pas bor ba yi sems can rnam thar gsum gyi sbyar sman gyis/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i bde la myur du khod/ /seng ge'i nga ro thos par ma gyur pas/ /wa rnams 'jigs pa med par sgra sgrog gisabya/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i sgra ni rab sgrogs7te/ /mu stegs can gzhan wa rnams skrag0par mdzod/ /sa yi dkyil na stobs dang brtson 'grus kyi/ /stobs ldan phyag na shes rab sgron ma bsnams/ /phyag mthil dam pas sa la brdab mdzod de/ /'di rnams khyod kyis rab tu pham par mdzod/ /gang dag khyod la lhung bzed 'bul ba yi/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po sdod cing mchis/ /khyod bltamakhugang dag len par 'gyur ba yi/ /brgya byin tshangs pa khrag khrig sdod cing mchis/ /blo gros bzang po rigs chen rigs ldan pa/ /gang la gnas nas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /spyod pa ston gyur dam pa'isherigs skyes pasasti/ /rigs kyi nang na btsun pa'i rigs la gzigs/ /snod gyur gang du nor bu rin po che/ /bzhag na dpal dang ldan par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen lta bur dri med thugs/ /'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan du ni char pa phob/ /glu dbyangs sgra las rnam pa 'di lta yi/ /tshigs su bcad pa mang po byung gyur nas/ /'di ni dus lags 7btang snyoms ma mdzad ces/ /snying rje'i yid dang ldan la skul bar byed/ /yang dag par spro bar bya ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //48—21

dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dus de lta bus yang dag par bskul ba dang / gzhal med khang chen po de nas byung ste/ chos kyis mtho ba zhes bya ba'i khang bzangs chen po gang du byang chub sems dpa' 'duganyecing dga' ldan gyi lha rnams la chos ston pa der byang chub sems dpa' zhugs so/ /zhugs nas kyang seng ge'i khri chos bzang po zhes bya ba la 'dug go/ /de nas lha'i bu gang dag byang chub sems dpa' dang skal ba ②mnyam pa theg pa mtshungs pa la zhugs pa de dag kyang khang bzangs de nyid du zhugs so/ /gang yang byang chub sems dpa' phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang spyod pa 'dra ba dag dang / lha'i bu de dag kyang lha'i bu mo'i tshogs rnams bsal cing lha'i bu phal rnams kyang bsal nas lhag pa'i bsam pa 'thun pa'i 'khor can du byas te/ 'khor bye ba phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad brgyad dang / khang bzangs der zhugs nas so so ci rigs par rang rang gi seng ge'i khri la 'khod par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' lo bcu gnyis na ma'i mngal du 'jug par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba de'i tshe gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu dag 'dzam bu'i gling du lhags nas/ lha'i kha dog mi snang bar byas te/ bram ze'i cha byad du bsgyur nas/ bram ze rnams rig byed slob tu 'dzud de/ gang zhig rnam pa 'di lta bur mngal du zhugs par gyur na/ de ni skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de dag dang ldan na rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur gyi/ gsum du 'gyur ba med de/ de gal te khyim na gnas na ni 'khor spos sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rnam par rgyal ba chos dang ldan pa/ chos kyi 46—22

rgyal po rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de'i rin po che sna bdun ni 'di lta ste/ 'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / blon po rin po che dang bdun mi)no/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor lo rin po che rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan par 'gyur zhe na/ 'di la rgyal poshergyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i gso sbyong gi nyi ma tshes bcwa sne lnga la mgo khrus byas te/ dbu zungs su gnas shing steng gi khyams na bud med kyi tshogs kyis kun nas bskor cing 'dug pa'i tshe/ shar phyogs nas lha'i 'khor lo rin po che rtsibs stong yod pa/ mu khyud dang ldan pa/ lte ba dang bcas pa/thams cad gser las grub pa/ mgar bas ma byas pa/ 'phang du shing ta 5ril bdun tsam nas 'byung ste/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/lha'i 'khor lo rin po che de mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis thos pa rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba gso sbyong gi nyi ma tshes bcwa lnga la mgo khrus byas te/ dbu zungs su gnas shing steng gi khyams na bud med kyi tshogs kyis kun nas bskor cing 'dug pa'i tshe/ shar phyogs nas lha'i 'khor lo rin po che byung bar gyur na/ de ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes thos te/ bdag gi drung du lha'i 'khor lo rin po che 'ongs pa las na/ bdag kyang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yin du nges so snyam ste/ de nas rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba de bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ lag pa g.yas pas lha'i 'khor lo rin po che de skor༄zhing 'di skad du btsun pa lha'i 'khor lo rin po che chos kyis skor 746—23

cig /chos ma yin pas ni ma yin no zhes bya ba'i tshig smras pa dang / de nas lha'i 'khor lo rin po che de rgyal po rgyal rigs ①gyi bo nas dbang bskur ②bas bskor bas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' las shar phyogs su legs par 'gro ste/rgyal po 'khor los sgyur ba yang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang lhan cig rjes su 'gro'o/ /sa'i phyogs gang du lha'i la'akhor lo rin po che de gnas par 'gyur ba ④der rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba de yang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang lhan cig tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas shar phyogs kyi khams kyi rgyal po gang yin pa de dag dngul gyi snod ni gser phyes bkang ste thogs/ gser gyi snod ni dngul sil mas bkang ste thogs nas/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bsna0zhing 'di skad du lha 'dir legs par gshegs so/ /lha tshur gshegs su gsol/ lha'i chab srid ni shin tu rgyas shing 'byor la bde ste/lo legs shing nyams dgyes la skye bo mang po dang / mis gtams pa lags na⑦/lha nyid kyi yul du byon nasashebazhugs su gsol/ de skad ces smras pa dngashe/rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas khams kyi rgyal po de dag la 'di skad du khyed rang rang gi rgyal srid dag chos kyis gyis shig /chos ma yin pas ni ma yin no/ /khyed srog chags ma gsod cig /ma byin par ma len cigazha /'dod pa la log par g.yem par ma byed cig /brdzun du ma smra shigaci /phra ma ma zer cig /ngag rtsub po ma smra shigs /tshig kyal pa ma smra shigadzo /brnab sems can du ma gyur cis /gnod sems can du ma gyur cis /log par lta bar ma gyur cig kye /srog gcod pa la byams par ma gyur cigatso /log par lta ba can gyi bar la byams par ma gyur cigs /nga'i yul du chos ma 46—24

yin pa 'byungatud re/ chos ma yin par spyod pa la byams par ma byed cig ces bsgoshenas/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas de ltar shar phyogs su rnam par rgyal bar byed do/ /shar phyogs su rnam par rgyal bar byas nas/shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la 'gro'o/ /shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la song nas/ shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho las rgal lo/ /rgal nas kyang lho phyogs su nam mkha' lakhung 'phrul gyis legs par 'gro ste/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang lhan cig tu 'gro'o/ /snga ma bzhin du lho phyogs su rnam par rgyal bar byed do/ /lho phyogs su ji lta ba de bzhin du nub phyogs dang /byang phyogs su rnam par rgyal bar byed do/ /byang phyogs su rnam par rgyal bar byas nas byang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la 'gro'o/ /byang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la song nas/byang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho las7rgal lo/ /rgal nas kyang nam mkha' la0rdzu 'phrul gyis rgyal po'i pho brang du legs par 'ongs nas btsun mo'i 'khor gyi sgo'i steng du nyams pa med par gnas te/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba ni 'khor lo rin po che rnam pa de lta bu dang ldan pa yin no/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po glang po rin po che rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ 'di la rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i glang po rin po che snga ma bzhin du 'byung ste/ thams cad thal kur7gyur pa/ yan lag bdun shin tu gnas pa/gtsug gser gyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi rgyal mtshan dang ldan pa/ gser gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i chos can te/ 'di ltar glang po'i rgyal po byang chub ces bya ba'o/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang 46—25

bskur ba glang po rin po hu che de brtag par 'dod par gyur pa de'ikhutshe/ nyi ma shar kur glang po rin po che de la zhon te sa chen po 'di rgya mtsho'i mtha' skor dang bcas pa/ rgya mtsho'i mur thug pa dang bcas pa kun tu bskor te/ rgyal po'i pho brang du 'ongs nas khye'u sus kyi dga' ba myong bar byed de/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po glang po rin po che rnam pa de lta bu dang ldan pa yin no/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rta rin po che rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ 'di la rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rta rin po che snga ma bzhin du 'byung ste/ thams cad sngon por gyur pa/ mgo gnag pa/ rngog ma lcang 1lor 'dug pa/ zhon na gus par byed pang/ gser gyi rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa/gser gyi rgyan dang ldan pa/ gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa / nam mkha' la55'gro ba/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i chos can te/ 'di ltar rta'i rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can zhes bya ba'o/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba/ rta rin po che brtag par 'dod par gyur pa de'i tshe nyi ma shar kur byurta rin po che de la zhon nas sa chen po 'di rgya mtsho'i mtha' skor dang bcas pa rgya mtsho'i mur thug pa dang bcas pa kun tu bskor te/ phyir rgyal po'i pho brang du 'khor nas khye'u sus kyi bde ba myong bar byed de/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni rta rin po che rnam pa de lta bu dang ldan pa yin no/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po nor bu rin po che rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa yin zhe na/'di la rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i nor bu'i rin po che snga ma bzhin du 'byung ste/ thams cad du sngo ba/ be+e drur+ya'i narang bzhin/ zur brgyad du 'dug pa/ shin tu sbyangs pa 3'byung ste/ nor bu rin po che de'i 'od 46—26

kyis btsun mo'i 'khor thams cad kyang snang /bas khyab ②par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur gyib nor bu rin po che de brtag par 'dod par gyur pa de'i tshe/ mtshan mo nam gyi gungaphan la mun pa mun gnagarnyu gi nang du nor bu rin po che de rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ skyedam༅mos tshal gyi sa bzang po blta ba'i phyir song na/ nor bu rin po che de'i 'od kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa thams cad dpag tshad kho ra khor yug tu snang bas gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /nor bu rin po che'i 'khor na gnas pa'i mi de dag kyang snang ba des gsal bar gyur pa dang /gcig gis gcig mthong / gcig gis5shegacig shes nas gcig la gcig 'di skad smra ste/ bzhin bzangs dag longs/ las kyi mtha' dag byos shig /tshong 'dus dag khrom/ nyi ma shar te nyin mor shes so zhes zer te/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba de nor bu rin po che rnam pa de lta bu dang ldan pa yin no/ /rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba / bud med rin po che rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ 'di la rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i bud med rin po che snga ma bzhin du 'byung ste/ tshul dang 'thun pa rgyal rigs su skyes pa ha cang yang mi ring bca/ ha cang yang mi thung ba/ha cang yang mi sbom pa/ ha cang yang mi skem pa/ ha cang yang mi dkar ba/ha cang yang mi gnagal pa/ gzugs mdzes pa/ tshul du shis pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ de'i spu'i khung thams cad nas tsan dan gyi dri 'byung ba/ kha nas ud 8pa la'i ngad ldang ba/ ka tsa lin da'i7gos ltar reg na bde ba/ de grang ba'i dus na ni lus la reg na dro 46—27

ba/ dro ba'i dus na lus la reg na bsil ba ste/ de 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ma gtogs par gzhan la yid kyis kyang 'dod chags su mi byed na/ lus kyis lta ci smos te/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni bud med rin po che rnam pa de lta bu dang ldan pa yin no/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po khyim bdag rin po che rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ 'di la rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi ponyenas dbang bskur ba'i/ khyim bdag rin po che snga ma bzhin du 'byung ste/mkhas pa/ gsal ba/ yid gzhungs pa/ lha'i mig dang ldan pa 'byung ngo / /de rin lha'i mig des dpag tshad kho ra khor yug tu bdag po dang bcas pa'i gter dag kyang mthong / bdag po med pa'i gter dag kyang mthong ste/ de bdag po med pa'i gter gang yin pa de dag gis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i nor gyi dgos pa byed de/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni khyim bdag rin po che rnam pa de lta bu dang ldan pa yin no/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po blon po rin po che rnam pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ 'di la 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i blon po rin po che snga ma bzhin du 'byung ste/ mkhas shing gsal la yid gzhungs pa'o/ /de 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po des bsamasashepa tsam gyis bsko bar bya ba'i dpung rnams sko'o/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni blon po rin po che rnam pa de lta bu dang ldan pa yin te/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni rin po che sna bdun de dag dang ldan pa yin no/ /de la bu stong 'byung ste/ dpa' ba/rtul phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms pa sha stag ste/ des rgya mtsho la thug pa'i sa chen po ma lus pa gnod par sngo ba med cing 'tshe ba med pa 'di nyid chad pa med cing mtshon gyis bda' ba 46—28

med la chos kyis legs par phab ste gnas so/ /gal te khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur te/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags spangs pa/'dren pa gzhan gyi dringanyemi 'jog pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rig byed 'don du 'dzud do/ /de bzhin du lha'i bu gzhan dag kyang 'dzam bu'i gling du lhags shing / rang sangs rgyas dag la skul ma 'debs te/'phags pa dag da ste lo bcu gnyis na byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su 'jug gisasnyesangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di borakhucig ces zer ro/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po na mjug ma sgyur ba zhes bya ba'i ri la rang sangs rgyas glang po zhes bya ba 'dug pas sgra de thos nas rdo ba'i steng du 'jim pa0la bya ba de bzhin du 'dug ste/ nam mkha' la shing ta la bdun srid du gyen du 'phags so/ /gyen du 'phags nas kyang me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs te sgron ma bzhin du mya ngan las 'das so/ /de'i mkhris pa dang / bad kun dang / chu rgyus dang / rus pa dang / sha dang / khrag tu gyur pa gang yin pa de dag0thams cad ni mes yongs su zad par gyur te/ ring bsrel 'ba' zhigashes la lhags nas/ rkang rjes de dag ni da dung yang drang srong gi rjes zhes grag ste yod do/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe yul bā rā ṇa sī'i ri dgas kyi nags drang srong lhung ⑧ba na rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya 'khod pa ⑨de dag gis kyang sgra de thos nas/ nam mkha' la shing ta la bdun srid du gyen du 'phags nas/ me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs te/ sgron ma bzhin du yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de dag gi mkhris pa dang / bad kun dang / chu rgyus dang / rus pa dang / sha dang / khrag tu gyur pa gang yin pa de dgatsothams 46—29

cad ni mes yongs su zad par gyur te/ ring bsrel 'ba' zhigashes la lhags so / /de ltar 'dir drang srong rnams lhung ngo zhes de phyin chad drang srong lhung ba zhes bya ba yang drang srong lhung ba drang srong lhung ba zhes ming du chags parashegyur to / /mi 'jigs pa byin pa'i ri dgas dag kyang de na gnas pas de phyin chad ri dgas kyi nags zhes bya ba yang ri dgas kyi nags ri dgas kyi nags zhes ming du rnyigyurasngo to/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa na sni'adug pa ni rnam par blta ba chen po bzhi la rnam par lta0ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dus la rnam par lta ba dang / gling la rnam par lta ba dang / yul la rnam par lta ba dang / rigs la rnam par lta ba'o⑦/ /dge slong dag ci'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dus rnam par blta ba la rnam par lta zhe na / byang chub sems dpa' nipo)thog ma'i dus sems can 'du ba'i tshe ma'i mngal du mi 'jug gi/ gang gi tshe 'jig rten gsal bar kun nas gnas par gyur te/ skye ba snang bar gyur/ rga ba snang bar gyur/ na ba snang bar gyur/'chi ba snang bar gyur pa de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' ma'i mngal du 'jug go/ /dge slong dag ci'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' gling rnam par blta ba la rnam par lta zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni mtha' 'khob tsho kyi gling du mi skye/ shar gyi lus 'phags por mi skye/ nub kyi ba lang spyod du mi skye/ byang gi sgra mi snyan du mi skye'idzi/ lho'i 'dzam bu gling nyid du skye'o/ /dge slong dag ci'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' yul rnam par blta ba la rnam par lta zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni mtha' 'khob kyi yul gang na mi rnams dbang po rtul zhing blun la lug ltar lkugs 17pa'i rang bzhin can legs par bstan pa dang / nyes par bstan 46—30

pa'i don shes par bya ba'i skal ba med pa dag yod pa dag tu mi skye'i/ byang chub sems dpa' ni yul gyi dbus nyid du skye'o/ /dge slong dag ci'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rigs rnam par blta ba la rnam par lta zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni rigs dma' ba gdol7pa'i rigs sam/ snyig tshim mkhan gyisarigs sam/ shing rta mkhan gyi rigs sam/ g.yung rigs su mi skye'i/ bram ze'i rigs sam/ rgyal rigs kho na ste/ rigs gnyis su skye'ong)/ /de la gang gi tshe bram ze'i rigs btsun par bya ba de'i tshe bram ze'i rigs su skye'orin / /gang gi tshe rgyal rigs btsun par bya ba de'i tshe rgyal rigs su skye ste/ dge slong dag da5ge ltar ni rgyal rigs btsun par bya bas/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rgyal rigs su skye ste/ dge slong dag don gyi dbang de la brten nas/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa na gnas pa rnam par blta ba chen po bzhi la rnam par lta ste/ de ltar bltas nas cang mi zer bar gyur to// //'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po gnyis pa/ dge slong dag de ltar lha'i bu de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag gcig la gcig 'di skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' rigs rin po che ni ji lta bu zhig tu skye bar 'gyur/ yum ni ji lta bu zhig gi lhums su 'jug par 'gyur zhes 'dri'o/ /de la la la 8)na re yul tham ga dhā tshan lus 'phags kyi rigs 'di 'byor cing rgyasam/tshel lo legs pa dang / bde ba dang ldan pa yin te/de ni byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa'i gnas su rung ngo zhes zer ro/ /la la na re de ni tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar de ni ma'i rgyud kyis dag pa yang ma yin/ pha'i rgyud kyis dag pa yang ma 46—31

yin la/ bsod nams chung ngus byung gi/ bsod nams rgya chen pos mngon par byung ba ma yin zhing rgod la mi brten te mi gnas pa yin la/ yul de yang nye 'khor gsog mas gang ba/ skyed mos tshal dang / mtsho dang / mtshe'u dag kyang mi mang la ri brags7ltar mtha' 'khob kyi gnas su gyur pa ste/ de'i phyir de ni tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin no zhes zer ro/ /la la na re ko sa la'i rigs 'di 'khor mang zhing bzhon pa mang la nor che ba ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa'i gnas su rung ngo zhes zer ro/ /la la na re de yang tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar kokhus la'i rigs ni gdol pa'i rigs las shi 'phos nas skyes pa yin te/ pha dang mas dag pa yang ma yin la/ dma' ba la mos pa stelta rigs mtho bar yang mi bya/ nor dang rin po che'i gter yang tshad med par phun sum tshogs pa ma yin te/ de'i phyir de ni0tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin no zhes zer ro la la na re rgyal po bad sa'i rigs 'di 'byor cing rgyas la/ lo legs pa dang /bde ba dang ldan pa yin te/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums7su 'jug pa'i gnas su rung ngo zhes zer ro/ /la la na re de yang de'i tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar rgyal po bad sa'i rigs ni phal pa ste/ gtum la gzi brjid 'bar ba yang ma yin zhing / skyes pa gzhan las skye ba grub pa/ pha ma nyid kyi gzi brjid kyi las kyis grub pa ma yin la/de'i rgyal po yang chad par smra ba ste/ de'i phyir de yang tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin no zhes zer ro/ /la la na re grong khyer chen po yangs pa can 'di ni 'byor cing rgyas la/ lo legs 7pa dang / bde ba dang ldan pa yin te/ nyams dga' la 46—32

skye bo mang po dang mis kun tu gang ba/ stegs bu dang / ba gam dang / rta babs dang / skar khung dang / bsil khang dang / khang pa brtsegs pa dang / khang bzangs dag gis legs par brgyan pa ste/ me tog gi ra ba dang /nags tshal gyi phreng ba me tog kun tu rgyas pa dang ldan pa yin la lha'i pho brang dang 'dra ba yin te/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums ①su 'jug pa'i gnas su rung ngo zhes zer ro/ /la la na re de yang tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag la ni phan tshun du rigs par smra ba med do//chos spyod pa med do/ /gong ma dang bar ma dang rgan pa dang / gtso bo dag la yang rim gror bya ba med cing / re re zhing yang 'di snyam du bdag ni rgyal po'o/ /bdag ni rgyal po'o snyam du sems pas slob mar khas len pa med cing chos khas len pa med pa ste/ de'i phyir de'ang tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin no zhes zer ro/ /la la na re grong khyer 'phags rgyal na rab snang gi rigs 'di ni dpung che zhing bzhon pa mang ba/ pha rol gyi g.yul ngor rgyal ba 'thobalgepa yin te/ desani byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa'i gnas su rung ngo zhes zer ro//la la na re de yang tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag ni khro zhing gtum la brlang zhing gzu lums can rgod pa ste/ las yod par blta ba'angasam yin pas/ de'i phyir de yang byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa'i gnas kyi 'os ma yin no zhes zer ro/ /la la na re grong khyer bcom brlag 'di 'byor cing rgyas la lo legs pa dang bde ba dang ne+eldan pa/ skye bo mang po dang mis kun tu gang ba yin pas/ rgyal po lag bzangs sde dpa' ba'i bdag po'i rgyal po'i pho brang de ni byang chub sems dpa' 46—33

yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa'i gnas su rung ngo zhes zer ro/ /la la na re de yang tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar rgyal po de ni log par lta ba'i rigs kyi rgyud du skyes pa ste/ mi rgod dang 'dra ba'i rgyal po yin pas byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa ni log par lta ba'i rigs su skye bar mi rigs te/ de'i phyir de yang tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin no zhes zer ro la la na re grong khyer hasti na pu ra 'di'i rgyal po ni skya0)bseng gi bu'i rigs kyi rgyud las skyes pa/ dpa' zhing rtul gyiphod pa dang ldan pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs phun sum tshogs pa gzhan gyi sde 'joms pa ste/ rigs de ni byang chub sems dpa' de yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa'i gnas kyi 'os yin no zhes zer ro /la la na re de yang tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar skya gebaseng gi bu'i rigs su skyes pa dag gis ni rigs kyi rgyud rnam par 'khrugs par byas te/ g.yul ngor brtan pa la ni chos kyi bu zhes zer/ 'jigs sde la ni rlung gi bu zhes zer/ srid sgrub la ni dbang po'i bu zhes zer/ rigs med dang lhar bcas la ni tha skar gyi bu zhes zer te/ de'i phyir rigs de yang byang chub sems dpa' de dulhums su 'jug pa'i gnas kyi thos ma yin no zhes zer ro/ /la la na re grong khyer bcom brlag 'di ni shin tu yang nyams dga' zhing phan tshun 'byor gyi steng du'agergyal po bzang po'i bshesakyi gnyen bzhugs pa'i sa yang yin la/ rgyal po de yang glang po dang / rta dang / shing rta dang /dpung bu chung dang / dpung gi tshogs mang po dang ldan pa/ gser dang /dngul dang / nor bu dang / mu 7tig dang / be+e drur+ya dang / dung dang /man 8shel dang / byi spu ru dang / sa le sbram dang / nor dang / yo byad shin 46—34

tu mang ba/ rgyal po dang blon po thams cad kyi nyu)zil gyis mi non pa'i stobs dang / pha rol gnon pa dang ldan pa/ mdza' ba dang ldan zhing chos la dga' ba ste/ rigs de ni byang chub sems dpa' de yum gyi lhums lasu 'jug pa'i gnas su rung ngo zhes zer ro/ /la la na re de yang tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po bzang po'i bshes gnyen yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa de yod med kyi/ de ni shin tu rgas pas bu skyed pa'i mthu yang med la/bu'ang mang bas de'i phyir rigs de yang byang chub sems dpa' de yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa'i gnas kyi 'os ma yin no zhes zer ro/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang lha de dag gis 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul chen po bcu drug po thams cad na/ rgyal po'i rigs mthon po mthon po chagang ji snyed cig yod pa/de dag thams cad la bltas na thams cad kyang nyes pa dang bcas par mthong ste/de dag de ltar sems pa'i yid la byed pa'i tshe/ lha'i bu ye shes tog gi pa rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa theg pa chen po 'di la nges par gyur pa zhig yod pa des byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang / lha'i 'khor chen po yod pa de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po dag tshur shog /byang chub sems dpa' de nyid kyi drung du dong ste/ rigs rin po che yon tan ji lta bur phun sum tshogs pa zhig tu srid pa tha ma pa'i byang chub sems dpa' skye bar 'gyur ba dri'o zhes smras pa dang / legs so zhes te/ de dag thams cad kyang thal mo sbyar nas byang chub sems dpa'i drung du phyin te dris pa/ skyes bu dam pa rigs rin po che yon tan phun sum tshogs pa ji lta bu 3zhig tu byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa skye bar 'gyur/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'as 7byang 46—35

chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po dang / lha'i tshogs chen po de dag la rnam par bltas te 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po dag byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa gang du skye bar 'gyur ba'i rigs de ni rnam pa drug cu rtsa bzhi phun sum tshogs pa yin te/ drug cu rtsa bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rigs de ni btsun pa yin/ rigs de ni kun gyis mngon par shes pa yin/ rigs de ni phran tshegs med cing gnod par byed pa med pa yin/ rigs de ni rgyud phun sum tshogs pa yin/ rigs de ni cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa yin/ rigs de ni skyes bu zung phun sum tshogs pa yin/ rigs de ni sngon gyi skyes bu zung phun sum tshogs pa yin/ rigs de ni btsun pa'i skyes bu zung phun sum tshogs pa yin/ rigs de ni kun gyis mngon par shes pa'i skyes bu zung phun sum tshogs pa yin/ rigs de ni dbang che bar grags pa'i skyes bu zung phun sum tshogs pa yin/ rigs de ni skyes pa mang bsheyin/ rigs de ni bud med mang ba yin/rigs de ni 'jigs pa med pa yin/ rigs de ni dman pa med cing zhum pa med pa yin/ rigs de ni brkam pa med pa yin/ rigs de ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ rigs de ni shes rab dang ldan pa yin/ rigs de ni blon pos blta zhing longs spyod la spyod pa yin/ rigs de ni bzo don yod pas bshams shing longs spyod la spyod pa yin/ rigs de ni mdza' ba brtan pa yin/rigs de ni dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa'i srog chags kyi srog la lta ba yin/rigs de ni byas pa gzo ba dang ldan pa yin/ rigs de ni brtul zhugs shes pa yin / rigs de ni 'dun pas mi 'gro ba yin/ rigs de ni zhe snang gis mi 'gro ba yin/ rigs de ni gti mug gis mi 'gro ba yin/ rigs de ni 46—36

'jigs pas mi 'gro ba yin/ rigs de ni kha na ma tho bas 'jigs pa yin/rigs de ni gti mug la mi gnas pa yin/ rigs de ni lag sbabs che ba yin/rigs de ni bya ba la mos pa yin/ rigs de ni gtong ba la mos pa yin/rigs de ni sbyin pa la mos pa yin/ rigs de ni zho sha shes pa yin/ rigs de ni rtsal brtan pa yin/ rigs de ni mthu rtsal dang ldan pa yin/ rigs de ni rtsal mchogashedang ldan pa yin/ rigs de ni drang srong mchod pa yin/ rigs de ni lha mchod pa yin/ rigs de ni mchod rten mchod papha yin/ rigs de ni mtshun rjed pa yin/ rigs de ni khon du 'dzin pa med pa yin/ rigs de ni phyogs bcur sgra grags pa yin/ rigs de ni 'khor chen po dang ldan pa yin/rigs de ni 'khor mi phyed pa dang ldan pa yin/ rigs de ni bla na med pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa yin/ rigs de ni rigs kyi nang na gtso bor bya ba yin/rigs de ni rigs la dbang thob pa yin/ rigs de ni dbang che bar grags pa yin/ rigs de ni phar 'dzin pa yin/ rigs de ni mar 'dzin pa yin/rigs de ni dge sbyong du 'dzin pa yin/ rigs de ni bram zer 'dzin pa yin/rigs de ni nor dang 'bru'i bang mdzod mang ba yin/ rigs de ni dbyig dang /gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e drur+ya dang / dung dang /man shel dang / byisaru dang / sa le sbram dang / dngul dang / rdzas dang /yo byad mang ba yin/ rigs de ni glang po chekhudang / rta dang / rnga mo dang /ba lang dang / lug shin tu mang ba yin/ rigs de ni bran pho dang / bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba shin tu mang ba yin/ rigs de ni thub par dka' ba yin/ rigs de ni don thams cad grub pa yin/ rigs 46—37

de ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs kyi rgyud du skyes pa yin/ rigs de ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i grogs kyis bskyed pa yin/ rigs de ni byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su rigs btsun par skyes pa yin/ rigs de ni 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ dge sbyong dang bram ze'i skye dgu0)dang bcas pa'i nang na rigs las smos pa'i skyon gyis7kha na ma tho ba thams cad dang bral ba ste/ grogs po dag gang du byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rigs de ni rnam pa drug cu rtsa bzhi po de dag dang ldan pa yin no/ /grogs po dag srid pa tha ma pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bud med gang gi mngal du 'jug par 'gyur ba'i bud med de ni yon tan gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa yin te/ sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa ni kun gyis mngon par shes pa'i bud med kyi mngal du 'jug go/ /kun gyisashemangon par rig pa dang /spyod pa la glags mi thod pa dang / rigs phun sum tshogs pa dang / cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang / ming phun sum tshogs pa dang / chu zheng phun sum tshogs pa dang / snganabacad ma btsas pa dang —/ tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa dang / gtong ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ske/ bzhin 'dzum pa dang / 'thun par 'dzin pa dang / gsal ba dang /dul ba dang / 'jigs pa med pa dang / mang du thos pa dang / mkhas pa dang ske/ sgyu med pa dang / g.yo med pa dang / mi khro ba dang / phrag dog med pa dang / ser sna med pa dang / mi rgod pa dang / mi g.yeng ba dang / ca co med pa dang / bzod cing des pa dang ldan pa dang / ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod 46—38

pa dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug gi shas chung ba dang /bud med kyi skyon dang bral ba dang / khyim thab kyi brtul zhugs dang ldan pa dang /yon tan thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i bud med kyi mngal du byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa 'jug go/ /grogs 3po dag byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa bud med gang gi mngal du 'jug pa'i bud med de ni yon tan gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po de dag dang ldan pa yin no/ /grogs po dag byang chub sems dpa' ni zla ba mar gyi ngo la ma'i mngal du mi 'jug gi/ byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa ni zla ba yar gyi tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya ste rgyas pa la skar ma rgyal dang ldan pa'i tshe/ ma gso sbyong blangs pa'i mngal du 'jug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / lha'i bu de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' las rigs yongs su dag pa dang / ma yongs su dag pa'i rnam pa de lta bu de dag thos nas 'di snyam du sems te/ skyes bu dam pa 'dis kyirnam pa ji snyed du bstan pa de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i rigs de gang zhig la gyiyod snyam du sems so/ /de ltar sems shing yid la byed pa la zhugs pa na de dag 'di snyam du sems te④/ shākya'i grong khyer 'di 'byor cing rgyas la bde zhing lo legs pa dang ldan te/ nyams dga' zhing skye bo mang po dang mis gang ba yin la/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma yang ma'i rgyud kyis dag pa/ pa'i rgyud kyis dag pa/tsha chung ma dag pa dang ldan pa/ las kyi mtha' la nyon mongs pa med pa/ dpe byad bzang ba/ shin tu mdzangs 4pa/ bsod nams kyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/grags pa chen po'i rigs su skyes pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs kyi rgyud du skyes pa/ nor dang / gter dang / rin po che dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa/46—39

las yod par lta ba/ sdig pa'i lta ba med pa/ shākya'i yul kun na yang rgyal po de gcig pur zad de/ tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang / blon po dang /'khor gyi mi thams cad kyis rim gror bya zhing mchod pa/ mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ ha cang yang mi rgan ha cang yang mi gzhon7zhing gzugs mdzes la yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ bzo shes pa/ dus shes pa/ bdag shes pa/ chos shes pa/ sems canasashes pa/ 'jig rten shes pa/ mtshan shes pa/ chos kyi rgyal po chos kyis rjes su ston pa'o/ /ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po de ni sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa rnams kyi gnas te/ gang dag der skyes par gyur pa de dag kyang de dang skal ba 'dra ba dag go/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ma de la lha mo sgyu 'phrul zhes bya ba shākya'i bdag po shin tu legs par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i bu mo zhig yod pa'ang phyug cingakhugazhon zhing dar la bab pa'i gzugs phun sum tshogs pa sngan chad ma btsas pa/ bu dang bu mo med pa/gzugs mdzes pa/ bu don la bris pa ltar blta na sdug pa/ lha'i bu mo ltar rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bud med kyi skyon rnams dang bral ba/ bden par smra ba/ mi drag pa/ mi brlangs pa⑤/ mi gcor ba/ kha na ma tho ba med pa/ gyo mo'i sgra lta bu med pa/ ca co med pa/ 'jam zhing snyan la yid du 'ong bar smra ba/ mi des pa dang / khong khro ba dang / nga rgyal dang / dregs pa dang / rgyags pa dang / khro ba med pa/ phrag dog med pa/ dus su smra ba/gtong ba phun sum tshogs pa/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ khyos chog par 'dzin pa/ khyim thab kyi brtul zhugs can/ skyes pa gzhan la bsam pa'i yin la bya ba dang bral ba/ mgo dang / rna ba dang / sna gnas su phebs pa/ bung ba'i 46—40

mchog gi kha dog lta bu'i skra dang ldan pa/ dpral ba legs pa/ smin0tshugs legs pa/ khro gnyer med pa/ bzhin 'dzum pa/ gsong por smra ba/ 'jam zhing snyan pa'i tshig dang ldan pa/ 'thun par 'dzin pa/ drang ba/ gya gyusamed pa/ sgyu med pa/ g.yo med pa/ khrel yod cing ngo tsha shes pa/ mi rgod pa/mi g.yeng ba/ kha ngan mi smra ba/ 'chal pa'i tshig med pa/ 'dod chags dang /zhe snang dang / gti mug gi shas chung ba/ ngang des shing bzod pa dang ldan pa/rkang lag dang / mig dang / blo shin tu bsrungs pa/ rkang lag shin tu 'jam pa/ ka tsa lin da'ikhugos ltar reg na bde ba/ pad ma gzhon nu'i 'dab ma ltar mig shin tu rnam par dag pa/ sna dbyibs legs shing mdog sdug pa/yan lag shin tu brtan pa/ 'ja'i dbyibs ltar shin tu 'dud pa/ yan lag dang / nying lag shin tu 'byes pa/ yan lag la smad du med pa/ mchu tham pa ltar dmar ba/ blta na mdzes pa/ mgul rim bzhin du 'dug pa/ rgyan dam pa dang ldan pa/ sna ma'i me tog dang bār shi ka ltar so shin tu rnam par dag pa/ phrag pa legs par byin gyis 'tsham pa/ rim gyis legs par grub pa'i dpung pa dang ldan pa/ rked pa gzhu'i chang zungs ltar phra ba/ gzhogs nyams pa med pa/ lte ba khung zab pa/ sta zur 'jam zhing yangs la skum zhing brtan par grub pa/ rdo rje ltar mkhregs shing mtshungs pa med pa'i lus dang ldan pa/ glang po'i sna ltar mnyam zhing legs pa'i brla dang ldan pa/ byin pa ri dgas e na ya'i lta bu/ lag pa dang rkang pa'i mthil rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar 'dug pa/'gro ba'i mig tu sdug pa mig gi dbang po nyams pa med pa/ yid du 'ong zhing blta na sdug pa/ bud med rin po che'i gzugs las kyang khyad par du 'phags 48—41

pa mtshungs pa med pa/ sgyu 'phrul sprul pa lta bu'i gzugs su 'dug pa①/ sgyu 'phrul ②zhes ming gi brdar btags pa/ sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa/ dga' tshal gyi lha'i bu mo lta bu zhig rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na 'dug pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i yum du tshul dang 'thun gyis gang byang chub sems dpas rigs dag pa bstan pa de ni shākya'i rigs nyid la snang gi gzhan la ni ma yin no/ /de la 'di0skad ces bya ste/ dag pa'i sems can chos mtho khang bzangs na/ /chos bzang seng ge'i khri la rab tu 'dug /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen ldan pa dang / /skal ba mnyam pa'i lha rnams drang srong 'khor//de na 'dug cing de ni 'di snyam sems/ /rigs gang rnam dag rab tu shes dang ldan / /byang chub sems dpa' skye dang tshul 'thun gang / /pha ma gang zhig dag pa'i dngos dang ldan/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'di kun tu rnam bltas na/ /rgyal rigs rgyal rgyud che ba gang yin pa/ /kun kyang skyon dang bcas par rjes bsams pa nas/ /shākya'i rigs ni skyon dang bral bar mthong / /zas gtsang rgyal po'i rigs nang rigs dang ldan/ /mi dbang rgyud ninernam dag cho rigs can / /'byor cing rgyas la 'khrug pa med pa ste/ /skye bo dam pa chos ldan rim gro can/ /ser skyar brjod pa'i grong khyer sems can gzhan/ /kun kyang bsam pa rab dag chos dang ldan/ /skyed mos kun dga' gzhal med khang gis brgyan/ /skye ba'i sar ni ser skyar brjod par gemadzes/ /kun kyang tshan chen stobs dang ldan pa ste/ /glang po gnyis sam gsum gyi stobs kyang bdog /'phong rtsal bslab pa'i pha rol mthar phyin kyang / /srog gi don du gzhan la gnod mi byed/ /zas gtsang rgyal po'i bud med dben pa ste/ /bud med dam pa stong gi mchog tu 46—42

phyin/ /yid du 'ong ba ༅sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i gzugs/ /de yi ming yang lha moshesgyu 'phrul te/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs 'chang lha yi bu mo bzhin/ /'byis pa'i lus ldan yan lag dri med sdug /lha dang mi rnams gang yang rung ba dag /sgyu 'phrul mthong na gang ngoms de med kyang / /'dod chags zhen med sdang bas zhe snang med/ /de ni 'jam snyan drang ba'i ngag dang ldan/ /mi brlang mi rtsub shin tu des pa ste/ /de ni bzhin 'dzum khro gnyer rab tu spangs/ /ngo tsha khrel yod chos spyod ldan pa ste/ /nga rgyal med cing ma khengs rgod pa med/ /phrag dog med cing sgyu dang g.yo med de/ /gtong la dga' zhing rtag tu byams sems ldan/ /las yod blta zhing log pa'i sbyor ba spangs/ /bden la gnas shing lus dang yid rab bsdams/ /sa la gang yod bud med skyon mang tshogs/ /de dag thams cad de la yod ma yin/ / mi yisa'ajig rten dri za'i 'jig rten nam/ /lha yi 'jig rten dag na bud med gzhanani/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul mtshungs med ga la lhag /drang srong chen po'i mar ni de 'os te/ /tshe rabs79lnga brgya kho nar tshang bar yang / /de ni byang chub sems dpa'i mar gyur to/ /de dang der ni yab kyang zas gtsang ste/ /de phyir yon tan ldan pa ma yi 'os/ /dka' thub can ltar de ni brtul zhugs gnas/ /brtul zhugs rjes spyod rtag par chos kyang spyod/ /rgyal pos gnang ste mchog sbyin thob pas na/ /'dod pa ma spyad zla ba sum cu gnyis/ /gang gi phyogs na de 'dug 'greng ba 'am/ /nyal zhing 'gro bar gyur pa'iphuganas dag kyang / /de yi las dge gzhol ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /shin tu snang bar 'od kyis gsal bar gyur/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams gang yang rung / /'dod chags sems kyis blta bar nus pa med/ /spyod lam rnams su 46—43

'phags pa'i yon tan ldan/ /de la kun kyang ma dang bu mor lta/ /sgyu 'phrul lha mo'i dge ba'i las kyi rgyus/ /rgyal po'i srid ni rab yangs rnam par 'phel/ /khams kyi rgyal po'ang 'jug par mi byed cing / /rgyal po'i grags dang brjod pa rnam par 'phel/ /de ltar sgyu 'phrul snod du 'thun gyur cing / /de ltar sems can dam pa mchog mdzes pas/ /de gnyis yon tan mchog dang ldan pas na/ /'di ni bur 'gyur de ni ma yi 'os/ /lha mo yon tan mchog dang ldan pa ste/ /glang po'i nyakhri yi stobs bdog ma gtogs par/ /'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan 'di nashe mi mchog de / /'dzin par nus pa'i bud med gang yang med/ /de skad che ba'i lha yi bu rnams dang / /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab rgya chen dag /shākya'i rigs rnams dga' bar mdzad pa yi/ /yum du legs ldan sgyu 'phrul 'gyur zhes zer/ /rigs yongs su dag pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' ༅skye ba'i rigs la rnam par bltas nas/ dga' ldan gyi gnas kyi gzhal med khang chen po chu(nodang rgyar dpag tshad drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa gang du byang chub sems dpa' 'dug ste/dga' ldan gyi lha rnams la chos ston pa rgyal mtshan mthon po zhes bya ba yod de/byang chub sems dpa' de gzhal med khang chen po der song nas phyin pa dang /dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad la smras pa/ khyed rnams 'dir 'du bar gyis shig /'chi 0'pho ba'i rnam par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i chos rjes su dran pa chos ri rjes su bstan pa tha ma'i chos mnyan pa byang chub sems dpa' las nyon cig /de skad kyi tshig thos nas/ dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad 46—44

lha'i bu mo'i tshogs dang bcas te/ gzhal med khang chen po der 'dus so/ /der byang chub sems dpas /'khor gyi khyams gling bzhi pa chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshad tsam du yangs par byin gyis brlabs par gyur nas/ de de tsam du bzang zhing lade tsam du blta na sdug la/ de tsam du rgyan gyis rgyas shing de tsam du yid du 'ong bar gyur pa des 'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu thams cad rang rang gi khyim gyi bkod pa la dur khrod lta bu'i 'du shes skyes par gyur to/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' rang gi bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa'i rgyu 'thun pas riyongs su brgyan pa'i seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che du mas rtsa ba spras pa/ lha'i ras bcos bu'i stan du ma bting ba/ lha'i spos zhim po du mas bsgos pa/ bdug spos dam pa mchog tu bya ba du mas bdugs pa/lha'i me tog kha dog 4)du ma'i dgram 5pa bkram pa/ nor bu rin po che'i 'od brgya stong du ma 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can/ nor bu rin po che du ma'i dra bas phyogayogs pa/ rin po che'i dril bu g.yer ku'i 7dra ba du ma'i /sgra 'byung bas mngon par dga' ba dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i dril bu brgya stong du ma mngon par dkrol ba'i sgra dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i dra ba brgya stong du mas yongs su gsal bar gyur pa/ rin po che'i gdugs brgya stong du mas kun nas bkab pa/dar brgya stong du ma lngarab tu spyangs 11pa/ dar gyi phreng ba lda ldi brgya stong du mas shin tu brgyan pa/ lha'i bu mo brgya stong du mas glu blangs/ gar byas/ rol mo byas pa/ yon tan brgya stong du ma kun tu brjod pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba brgya stong du mas rjes su bsrungs pa/ brgya byin brgya stong du mas phyag byas pa/tshangs pa brgya stong du mas rab tu btud pa/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag 46wa 45

khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bzung ba/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma mtha' yas pas dgongs pa/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dpag tu med par pha rol tu phyin pa tshogs su byas pa'i bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa'i rgyu 'thun pa las byung ba de lta bu la 'dug go/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i khri chen po yon tan de lta 〉bu dang ldan pa la 'dug nas lha'i 'khor chen po de dag la smras pa/ grogs po dag byang chub sems dpa'i lus bsod nams brgya'i mtshan gyis legs par brgyan pa la ltos/shar dang / lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / 'og dang / steng dang /phyogs bcu kun na byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa na 'khod cing thams cad kyang srid pa tha ma pa ri la mngon du phyogs pa/ lha'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba 'chi 'pho'i rnam pas lha rnams dga' bar byed pa'i chos snang ba'i sgo yang dag par ston pa/ tshad med grangs med bgrang ba las 'das pa dag la ltos/ de nas lha'i 'khor de thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyis rlabs dkyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag mthong bar gyur te/ mthong bar gyur nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad du 'di ltar bdag cag gis bltas pa tsam gyis byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyed cig mthong ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyi rlabs ༷bsam gyis mi khyab pa geste/ legs so zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas yang lha'i 'khor chen po de dag la bos nas 'di skad ces smras te/ grogs po dag de bas na byang chub sems dpa' de dag lha'i bu de dag la gang ston pa 'chi 'pho'i rnam pas lha 46—46

rnams dga' bar byed pa'i chos snang ba'i sgo nyon cig /grogs po dag chos snang ba'i sgo brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpas 'chi 'pho'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ lha'i 'khor la gdon mi za bar yang dag par bstan par bya ba ste/brgya rtsa brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ grogs po dag dad pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste bsam pa mi phyed par 'gyur ro/ /dang ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste sems rnyog pa can dang bar 'gyur ro/ /mchog tu dga' ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/lus shin tu sbyangs par 'gyur ro/ /dga' ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ sems rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /lus kyi sdom pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ lus kyi nyes pa 37rnam pa gsum yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /ngag gi sdom pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ ngag gi nyes pa bzhi yongs su spong bar 'gyur ro/ /yid kyi sdom pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ 5brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang /log par lta ba spong bar 'gyur /ro/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ sangs rgyas mthong ba rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /chos rjes su dran pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ chos bstan pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun rjes su dran pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ skyon med par 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /gtong ba rjes su dran pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ rdzas thams cad rab tu spong bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims rjes su dran pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/smon lam yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /lha rjes su dran pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste / sems rgya chen por 'gyur ro/ /byams pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po thams cad zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /snying rje ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ rnam par 'tshe ba med pa 4lhur 46—47

len par 'gyur ro/ /dga' ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ mi dga' ba thams cad sel bar 'gyur ro/ /btang snyoms ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ 'dod pa la smod par 'gyur ro/ /mi rtag par so sor rtog pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/'dod pa dang / gzugs yod pa dang / gzugs med pa'i 'dod chags las yang dag par 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /sdug bsngal du so sor rtog pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ smon lam kun tu chad par 'gyur ro/ /bdag med par so sor rtog pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ bdag la mngon par zhen pa med par 'gyur ro//zhi bar so sor rtog pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ rjes su chags pa ①'bar ba med par 'gyur ro/ /ngo tsha shes pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ nang nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /khrel yod pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ phyi rol nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro / /bden pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ lha dang mi rnams du mi slu bar 'gyur ro//yang dag pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ bdag la slu ba med par 'gyur ro/ /chos spyad pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ chos la rton par 'gyur ro/ /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ ngan song gsum las yang dag par 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /byas pa gzo ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pa rnams chud mi za bar 'gyur ro/ /byas pa rig pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/gzhan la brnyas pa med par 'gyur ro/ /bdag shes pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/bdag la stod (pa med par 'gyur ro/ /sems can shes pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste / gzhan la smod pa med par 'gyur ro/ /chos shes pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/chos kyi rjes su 'thun pa'i chos la nan tan byed par 'gyur ro/ /dus shes pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ mthong ba don yod par 'gyur ro/ /nga rgyal bcom pa ni 46—48

chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhe 'gras pa med pa'i sems ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ bdag dang gzhan rjes su srung bar 'gyur ro/ /khonanyedu mi 'dzin pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ 'gyod pa med par 'gyur ro/ /mos pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ the tshom 5med par lhur len par 'gyur ro/ /mi sdug par so sor rtog pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ 'dod pa la rnam par rtog pa spong bar 'gyur ro/ /gnod sems med pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ gnod sems kyi rnam par rtog pa spong bar 'gyur ro/ /gti mug med pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ mi shes pa rnam par sel bar 'gyur ro/ /chos don du gnyer ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ don la rton par 'gyur ro/ /chos 'dod pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ chos snang ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /thos pa tshol ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ tshul bzhin du chos la so sor rtog par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa'i sbyor ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ yang dag par nan tan byed par 'gyur ro/ /ming dang gzugs yongs su shes pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/chags pa thams cad las yang dag par 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyur lta ba yang dag par 'joms pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ rig pa dang rnam par grol ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /rjes su chags pa dang khong khro ba spong ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/mtho bar sems pa med cing dma' bar sems pa med par 'gyur ro/ /phung po la mkhas pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ sdug bsngal yongs su shes par 'gyur ro/ /khams mnyam pa nyid ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste / kun 'byung ba spong bar 'gyur ro / /skye mched gsal bub ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ lam sgom par 'gyur ro/ /mi skye ba'i bzod pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ 'gog pa mngon du byed par 'gyur 46—49

ro / /lus la song ba'i dran pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ lus dben par 'gyur ro / /tshor ba la song ba'i dran pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ tshor ba thams cad rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ /sems la song ba'i dran pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/sems la sgyu ma lta bur so sor rtog par 'gyur ro/ /chos la song ba'i dran pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ rab rib dang bral ba'i ye shes su 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa'i spong ba bzhi ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ mi dge ba'i chos thams cad spong ba dang dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ lus dang sems yang bar 'gyur ro/ /dad pa'i dbang po ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ gzhan gyi dring0)mi 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ shin tu rtogs pa'i ye shes dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/las legs par byas par 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ sems rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ mngon sum gyi ye shes su 'gyur ro/ /dad pa'i stobs ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ bdud kyi stobs las yang dag par 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa'i stobs ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ mi 'phrogs par 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad spong bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi stobs ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ mi thul skabar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/chos ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes par 'gyur ro/ /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang 46—50
