bsod nams chen po bltamanya/ /shin tu legs pa'i zhabs ldan bdag cag mthong bar 'tshal/ /gang gi 'gro ba gang dang sbyor ba gang cir 'gyur/ /mtshan bzang mtshan gyi cho ga dag ni bdag cag 'tshal/ /de bas rgyal po'i dam pa mi dgyes spang bar mdzod/ /sna tshogs mtshan gyisakemin lag brgyan pa blta bar 'tshal/ /rgyal po bud med tshogs kyis bskor ba de rab dga'/ /gzhon nu me yi 'od ltar 'bar ba pang du blangs/ /lha mchog gtsug phud 'phyang ba dag ni nye bar bsnyen/ /thog ma sgor byung stong gsum 'di dag kun tu g.yos/ /lha mchog de dag 'dren pa'i zhabs dang sen mo ni/ /zangs mdog dri med rnam dag gzi brjid ldan mthong nas/ /gtsug pud du'aphyang ba de dag myur du langs par gyur/ /dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'di 'dra'i mtshan dang 'di 'drar lta ba dpal can dang / /'di bu'adra'i bsod nams gzi brjid spyi gtsug mi mthong dang / /mdzod spu nas ni rgya chen 'od 'byung 'di 'dra las/ /bdud rnams pham mdzad byang chub brnyes 'gyur gdon mi 'tshal/ /mun sel nyon mongs bral ba'i yon tan brtags nas su/ /yang dag yon tan ji ltar don mthong de la bstod/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi dang nyon mongs dgra bsal ba'i/ /sems can rin chen 'di ni ring por mi thogs 'byung / /yongs rtog 'dod chags yul gyi gtsub du mas bskyed pa yi/ /rnam gsum mes ni srid gsum kun 'bar yongs gdungs par/ /dpal 0khyod chos kyi smin gyis stong gsum bkang nas ni/ /'chi med char gyis nyon mongs gdung ba zhi mdzad 'gyur/ /byams pa'i gsung mnga' thugs rje ldan pa 'jam pa'i gsung / /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs yid 'ong gsung du sgrog mdzad pa/ /stong 46—149

gsum kun tu go zhing 'gro ba gor 'gyur ba/ /bcom ldan khyod kyis sangs rgyas gsung chen myur du sgrogs37/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags bcings bying srid pa'i rtser gnas pa/ /mu stegs can gyi tshogs ngan log par lta ba bcom/ /khyod kyi rgyu la brten dang stong ba'i chos thos nas/ /seng gis wa tshogs bzhin du de dag 'byer bar 'gyur/ /nyon mongs chen po'i du ba ma rig bsgribs bsalasate/ /kun tu byung ba skye bo nges par snang byed pa'i/ /ye shes 'od 'phro shes rab 'od rig gzigs pa yis/ /'gro ba kun gyi mun pa chen po bsal bar gsol/ /gang du sems can dag pa rmad byung 'di 'dra byung / /lha dang mi rnams kyis ni rnyed pa rgya chen thob/ /rnam par rtogs par mdzad pa'i sems can rin chen 'dis / /ngan song lam bcad lha yi lam ni gtodasapar 'gyur/ /ser skya'i gnas su lha yi me tog char phab nas/ /bskor ba byas te gus par bstod pa byas nas ni/ sangs rgyas sangs rgyas legs zhes de dag tshig rjod7cing / /lha tshogs gede dag tshul du shes par mkha' ༅las dong / /bltam ⑦pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'ol// //dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' gang gi nub mo btsas pa de nyid kyistso)nub mo rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag gi rigs shing sā skyal chen po lta bu rnams su bu mo nyi khri btsas tsho/nyapar gyur te/ de dag thams cad kyang de dag gi pha ma rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' la rim gro bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir phul lo/ /rgyal po zas gtsang mas kyang bu mo nyi khri byang chub sems dpa' la rim gro bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir phul lo/ /46—150

mdza' bshes dang / blon po dang / nye du dang / snag gi gnyen mtshams dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' la rim gro bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bu mo nyi khri phul lo/ /blon po'i 'khor rnams kyis kyang 3 byang chub sems dpa' la rim gro dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bu mo nyi khri phul lo/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe shākya'i7rgan rabs rgan rabs rnams 'dus nas/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/gzhon nu 'di ni lha khang du bkur bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu de ltar bkur ba legs kyisal de bas na grong khyer ni brgyan par gyis shig /srang dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo ngu dang / tshong 'dus ri5 dag ni mdzes par gyis shig /bkra mi shis pa skur po dang / zhar ba dang / 'on pa dang / lkugasakyi pa dang / dbyibs mi mdzes pa dang nadabang po ma tshang ba rnams ni sol cig /bkra shis pa phya rnams kyang sogs shig /bsod nams kyi rnga ni rdungs shig /bkra shis kyi dril ni dkrol cig /grong khyer dam pa'i sgo ni rgyan gyis legs par spud cig /rol mo sil snyan dang pheg brdab ⑨pa shin tu yid du 'ong ba dag ni long 8zhing rdobs shig /khams kyi rgyal po thams cad ni sogs shig /tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang / blon po dang / sgo ba dang / 'khor gyi mi dag ni gcig tu sdus /1shig /bu mo'i shing rta ni shoms shig /bum pa gang ba rnams ni snyen cig /bram ze kha ton pa rnams ni sdus shig /lha khang rnams ni shin tu brgyan par gyis shig /dge slong dag de nas rgyal pos ji skad bsgo ba de bzhin du thams cad sbyar ba dang / de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma rang gi khyim du song nas skye dgu'i /2bdag mo chen mo go'u ta sī 8la 46—151

bos te 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu lha khang du bkur gyis0rgyan gyis legs par brgyan par gyis shig /legs so zhes skye dgu'i ②bdag mo chen mo go'u ta sbribashede ltar mnyan te/ gzhon nu rgyanasagyis brgyan to/ /de nas gzhon nu de rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i tshe/ bzhin 'dzum zhing khro gnyer med pas shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i tshig gis sru mo la smras pa/ ma bdag gang du bkur/ smras pa/ bu lha khang du bkur ro/ /de nas gzhon nus bzhin 'dzum ste bgad nas sru mo la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bdag btsas de tshe stong gsum 'di ni g.yos par gyur/ /brgya byin tshangs pa lha min lto 'phye chen po dang / /nyi zla de bzhin rnam thos bu dang gzhon nu yang / /spyi bosasherkang pa gnyis la gtugs te phyag 'tshal na/ /de ring ma yis0gang du bdag bkur bgyi ba yi/ /lha gzhan bdag gi gong na 'phags pa gang zhig mchisanya/ /lha rnams kun las bdag 'phags lha yi lha lags te/ /bdag 'dra'i lha yang ma mchis gong ma ga la mchis//'on kyang 'jig rten rjes bsnyagakhutsam du bdag mchi'o/ /bdag gi rnam 'phrul skye bos mthong na dgarashe'agyur zhing / /rim gro bkur ste shin tu che bar bgyid 'gyur la/ /lha mis 'di ni lha yi lha zhes rig par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag de ltar grong khyer du gzhon nu'i shing rta bshams te rgyan gyis brgyan nas/ bkra shes thams cad bshams te rgyal po zas gtsang mas gzhon nu pang du blangs nas/bram ze dang / grong rdal pa dang / tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang /blon po dang / khams kyi rgyal po dang / sgo ba dang / 'khor gyi mi dang /mdza' bshes dang / nye dus bskor te/ srang dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo medang / tshong 'dus rgyan tshad med pas brgyan pa dag nas bdug 46—152

spos dri zhim pos ni bdugs/ me tog sil ma ni gtor/ rta dang glang po che dang / shing rta dang / rkang thang gi bun long ni cher gyur/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan ni bsgreng / sil snyan sna tshogs kyi sgra ni phyung ste/ song bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe lha brgya stong dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i shing rta drangs te/ lha'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas nam mkha'i dkyil nas7me tog gi char phab ste/ sil snyan gyi ④sgra 'byin par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de ltarasargyal po zas gtsang mas rgyal po'i bkod pa chen po dang / rgyal po'i phun sum tshogs pa chen po dang / rgyal po'i byin chen pos gzhon nu de khyer te lha khang du phyin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas lha khang der rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthil bzhag pa dang / de nas lha'i gzugs sems med pa de dag 'di lta ste/gu lang dang / skem byed dang / lus ngan dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang /rnam thos kyi bu dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa'i gzugs thams cad kyang rang rang gi gnas nas langs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe lha dang mi brgya stong ni kye ma a la la zhes bya ba dang / ca co dang / ga zha'i sgra brgya stong mang po 'byin par gyur to/ /ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po dam pa de thams cad kyang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /lha'i me tog gi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha'i sil snyan brgya stong du ma dag kyang ma dkrol bar sgra 'byin par gyur to/ /lha gang dag gi gzugs gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang rang rang gi gzugs bstan nas/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smra bar gyur to/ /ri rgyal ri mchog ri rab nam yang yungs kur 'bru la phyag mi 'tshal/ /rgya mtsho klu rje 46—153

gnas ni nam yang ba rjes chu la phyag mi 'tshal/ /nyi zla 'od byed srin bu me khyer 'od byed de la phyag mi 'tshal/ /bsod nams shes rab rigs byung legs ldan lha rnams gang la'ang phyag mi bzhes/ /yungs 'bru ba rjes chu dang srin bu me khyer 'dra bar gyur pa ni/ /stong gsum 'di na lha mi gang yang rung ste nga rgyal gnas pa lags/ /ri rab rgya mtsho nyi zla 'dra ba 'jig rten rang byung dam pa ste/ /de la 'jig rten phyag 'tshal ba ni mtho ris mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /byang chub sems dpa' lha khang du zhugs pa de bstan pa'i tshe/ lha'i bu brgya stong phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur to// /dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa' lha khang du khyer ba'i tshe btang snyoms su bzhag pa'i rkyen ni de yin/ rgyu ni de yin no/ /lha khang du khyer ba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //dge slong dag de nas bram ze mdun na 'don 'char po zhes bya ba 'char 'gro'i pha/ bram ze lnga brgya tsam gyis bskor te/ skar ma me bzhi 'das nas nag pa la bab pa'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i drung du phyin nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ da ni gzhon nu'i rgyan mdzad pa'i rigs so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ legs kyis byed du chug shig② /de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / shākya lnga brgya tsam gyis/ rgyan gyi rnam pa lnga brgya tsam byed du bcug ste/ 'di ltar lag pa'i rgyan dag dang / rkang pa'i rgyan dag dang / mgo'i rgyan dag dang / mgul gyi rgyan dag dang / sor gdub dag dang / rna rgyan dag dang / dpung rgyan dag dang / gser gyi ska rags 46—154

dag dang gser skud dag dang / dril bu g.yer0)ka'i dra ba dag dang / rin po che'i dra ba dag dang / lham rin po ches spras pa dag dang / do shal rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dag dang / gdu bu rgyan can dag dang / mgul gdub dag dang / cod pan dag kyang byed du bcug ste zin nas/ skar ma rgyal dang ldan pa'i tshe/ shākya de dag rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i drung du dong nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha gzhon nu brgyan midu gsol/ rgyal pos smras pa/khyed kyis gzhon nu la brgyan pa dang / mchod pa byas pas chog gisabya/ ngas gzhon nu'i rgyan thams cad byed du bcug go/ /smras pa/ bdag cag gi rgyan 'di dag gzhon nu'i sku la gdugs mtshan bdun zhig gdags su ge gsol/ de ltar gnang na bdag cag gis sug las bgyis pa yang don mchis par 'gyur ro//de'i tshe nam langs te nyi ma shar ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' skyed mos tshal bkod pa dri ma med pa zhes bya ba der zhugs so/ /de'i tshe skye dgu'i snubadag mo chen mo go'u ta gris7byang chub sems dpa' pang du blangs so/ /bud med brgyad khris kyang byang chub sems dpa' bsupo ste gdong du lta zhing 'khod par gyur to/ /bu mo stong phrag bcus byang chub sems dpa' bsu 7ste/ gdong du lta zhing 'khod par gyur to/ /shākya stong phrag bcus byang chub sems dpa' bsum/rteste gdong du lta zhing 'khod par gyur to/ /bram ze lnga stong yang lhags nas byang chub sems dpa'i gdong du lta zhing 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas shākya'i rgyal po bzang po zhes bya bas rgyanasaji snyed cig byas pa de dag byang chub sems dpa'i lus la btags te/ de dag lus la btags ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi 'od kyis mog mog por gyur nas lam mumer ma gyur/ lhan der ma gyur/46—155

lhang nger ma gyur te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi gan du snag tsa'i ①yug bzhag na lam mer mi rung / lhan ner mi rung / lhang nger mi rung ngo / /de bzhin du rgyan de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi 'od kyis phog na lamasamer mi rung / lhan ner mi rung / lhang nger mi rung ngo / /de bzhin du rgyan gyi rnam pa gang dang gang byang chub sems dpa'i lus lasabatags pa de dang de dag mog mog por gyur te/ 'di lta ste dper na/'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi gan du snag tsa'i0yus bzhag pa bzhin no/ /de'i tshe skyed mos tshal gyi lha mo dri ma med pa zhes bya ba 'dug pa des lus chen po bstan nas mdun ge du 'dug ste/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang shākya'i tshogs de dag la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ stong gsum sa 'di grong khyer grong rdal bcas 'u pa kun/ /gal te gser gyis gang khyab dri med mdzes gyur kyang / /'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gzegs gcig gis zil rlag ste/ /gser gzhan dag ni dpal dang bral zhing gsal mi 'gyur/ /sa 'di mtha' dag 'dzam bu'i gling nigi gser khebs kyang / /'dren pa dpal rgyas spu khung 'od phyung zil gyis non/ /mi snang mi gsal mi mdzes 'od kyang nyams gyur cing / /bde gshegs skyob pa'i drung na snag tsatubazhin du 'gyur/ /yon tan brgyas gang 'di ni rang gi gzi yis brgyan/ /de ni rgyan gyis mdzes min shin tu dri med sku/ /nyi zla'i 'od dang skar ma nor bu me dag dang / /brgya byin tshangs pa'i 'od kyang dpa' stug :lhamadun mi gsal/ /gang sku sngon gyi dge ba'i 'bras bus mtshan spras pa/ /de la gzhan gyis byas pa'i rgyan phal ci zhig dgos/ /rgyan rnams phrol 'or mi mkhas mkhas mdzad ma gtse shig/2 /blo gros mchog mdzad 'di ni bcos ma'i 46—156

rgyan mi bzhed/ /'dun pa de⑥ni rgyal khab sras dang lhan cig btsas/ /dri med rab tu mdzes pa'i rgyan rnams 'bangasasnyede stsol/ /shākya'i rigs ninyergya chen mchog tu 'gyur snyam nas/ /shākya dag ni yid dga' mgu zhing ngo mtshar gyur/ /lha mo des de skad ces smras nas/ lha'i me tog dag gis byang chub sems dpa' de la mngon par gtor te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /rgyan gyi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //dge slong dag de ltar gzhon nu de ya zad skyes pa dang / bkra shis brgya stong byas nas khye'u stong phrag bcu dang / bu mo stong phrag bcus yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te yi ge'i grwarab 'jug par byas so/ /bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / myang bas gang ba'i shing rta stong phrag bcu dang / gser dngul dang / dbyig gis gang ba'i shing rta stong phrag bcu drangs te/ ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po'i srang dang / grong bar dang / tshong 'dus0kyi phyogs gang yin pa dag tu gtorasheto/ /mngon par byin no/ /sil snyan 'bum phrag brgyad kyi sgra yang phyung zhing me tog gi char chen po yang mngon par bab po/ /stegs bu dang / sgo khang dang / rta babs dang / skar khung dang / bsil khang dang /khang pa brtsegs pa dang / khang bzangs dag gi steng nas/ bu mo brgya stong rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa dag /byang chub sems dpa' la lta zhing me tog dag 'thor bar gyur to/ /lha'i bu mo stong phrag brgyad ni rgyan rnams kyis lhug lhug por brgyan te/ rin po che bzang byed thogs nas lam 'phyag cing byang chub sems dpa'i mdun nas 'dong bar gyur to/ /lha dang / klu dang /48—157

gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po rnams kyang lus phyed phyung zhing nam mkha'i dkyil nas me tog dang / dar gyi lda ldi bre0bar gyur to/ /shākya'i tshogs thams cad kyang rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i⑧mdun du bdar nas byang chub sems dpa'i mdun nas 'dong dubar gyur te/ bkod pa'i rnam pa 'di lta bu 'dis byang chub sems dpa' yi ge'i grwar zhugs par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'aphuyi ge'i gyur zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas gyis pa'i slob dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen zhes bya bas byang chub sems dpa'i dpal dang gzi brjid ma bzod de/khas7bub tu skyelar+sā to/ /de ltar 'gyel ⑦ba dang dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha'i bu yan lag bzang po zhes bya bas mthong nas/ lag pa g.yas pas bteg ste bslang ngo / /bslangs5shenas kyang de nam mkha'i dkyil na 'dug ste/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang skye bo phal po che de dag la tshigs su bcadashede smras pa/ mi yi 'jig rten 'di na bstan bcos gang yod pa/ /grangs dang yi ge rtsis dang khams kyi rgyud dag dang / /'jig rten bzo yi sbyor ba tshad med mang po dag /bskal pa bye mang sngon chad 'dis tshani de dag bslabs()/ /'on kyang skye bo'i rjes su 'thun pa tsam mdzad de/ /byis pa mang po theg pa mchog la min mdzad dang / /sems can khrag khrig gzhan yang 'chi78med dgod pa'i phyir/ /shin tu lobs pa'ang bslab phyir yi ge'i grwar zhugs so/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i bden bzhi lam gyi tshul mkhyen cing / /rgyu la brten nas ji ltar 'byung ba de la'ang mkhas/ /ji ltar 'dus byas 'gags zad bsil 'gyur de tshul yang / /mkhyen na yi ge'i bstan bcos tsam lta cis mi mkhyen/ /'jig rten gsum na 'di yi slob dpon 46—158

gong na med/ /lha dang mir bcas nang na 'di nyid gtso bo ste/ /bskal pa bye mang sngon chad gang la 'dis bslabs ༅pa'i/ /yi ge de dag ming yang khyed kyis shes mi 'gyur/ /'gro ba rnams kyi sems rgyud sna tshogs gang 'byung ba/ /skad cig gcig gis sems can dag pa 'dis mkhyen te/ /gzugs med bltar7mi snang ba'i tshul yang rab mkhas na/ /yi ge gzugs yod bltar snang dag lta smosasheci dgos/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / lha'i bu des byang chub sems dpa' la lha'i me tog mang pos gtor te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas ma ma dang bran mo'i 'khor bkod de/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma la sogs pa shākya gzhan ni phyir dong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' tsan dan sbrul ⑤gyi snying po las byas pa'i yi ge'i ⑥shing lha'i tshon gyis byugs ⑦pa/ gser gyi yang mig gis btags pa/ mtha' ma nor bu rin po ches kun nas brgyan pa thogs te/slob dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye mkhan pos bdag la yi ge gang zhig bslab/ tshangs pa'i yi ge'am/ kha ro ste'i yi ge'am/pad ma'i snying po'i yi ge'am/ ang ga'i yi ge'am/ mang ga'i yi ge'am/ ༷yul ma ga d+ma'i yi ge'am/ bkra shis pa'i yi ge'am/ sor mo pa'i yi ge'am/sha ka ni'i yi ge'am/ ya ba na'i〈7yi ge'am/ bag le ba'i yi ge'am/ pa ru sha'i yi ge'am/ 'gro lding ba'i yi ge'am/ ki ra ta'i yi ge'am/ lho phyogs pa'i yi ge'am/ drag shul can gyi yi ge'am/ grangs kyi yi ge'am/ spyi'u tshugs pa'i yi ge'am/ rjes su 'thun pa'i yi ge'am/ bru sha'i yi ge'am/ ka sha'i yi ge'am/ rgya'i yi ge'am/ phu na'i yi ge'am/ hu na'i yi ge'am/ yi ge 'bring dang / rgyas par bri ba'i yi ge'am/ rgyal gyi yi ge'am/ lha'i yi 46—159

ge'am/ klu'i yi ge'am/ gnod sbyin gyi yi ge'am/ dri za'i yi ge'am/mi'am ci'i yi ge'am/ sto 'phye chen po'i yi ge'am/ lha ma yin gyi yi ge'am/nam mkha' lding gi yi ge'am/ ri dgas kyi 'khor lo ba'i yi ge'am/ khu skad shes pa'i yi ge'am/ sa bla'i lha'i yi ge'am/ bar snang gi lha'i yi ge'am/nub kyi ba glang spyod kyi yi ge'am/ byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi yi ge'am/ shar gyi lus 'phags po'i yi ge'am/ gdegashepa'i yi go'am/ gzhag pa'i yi ge'am/bsnan pa'i yi ge'am/ rgya mtsho'i yi ge'am/ rdo rje'i yi ge'am/ spring yig dang / lan gyi yi ge'am/ rnam 'thor gyi yi ge'am/ rings med kyi yi ge'am/bstan bcos bskor ba'i yi ge'am/ rtsis bskor ba'i yi ge'am/ gdeg⑧pa bskor ba'i yi ge'am/ gzhag pa bskor ba'i yi ge'am/ rkang pas bris pa'isheyi ge'am/ tshig lan lan gnyis su gdab pa'i tshig gi mtshams kyi yi ge'am/tshig gi mtshams bcur brgyud pa'i bar gyi yi ge'am/ bla thabs su bsnan pa'i yi ge'am/ sgra thams cad kun tu sdud pa'i yi ge'am/ rig pa dang 'thun pa'i yi ge'am/ rnam par 'dres pa'i yi ge'am/ drang srong gi⑧dka' thub spyad pa'i yi ge'am/ lha'i nges pa'i yi ge'am/ sa blta ba'i yi ge'am/ nam mkha' blta ba'i yi ge'am/ sman thams cad kyi rgyu 'thun pa'i yi ge'am/ snying po thams cad kun tu sdud pa'i yi ge'amakha 'byung po thams cad kyi sgra sdud pa'i yi ge'am/ kye slob dpon yi ge drug cu rtsa bzhi po de dag gi nang nas bdag la gang bslab/ de nas byis pa'i slob dpon kun gyisabashes gnyen ngo mtshar du gyur nas bzhin gyi 'dzum phyung ste/ nga rgyal dang / dregs pa dang / rgyags pa med par byas nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sems can dag pa ngo 46—160

mtshar che/ /bstan bcos kun las bslabs0gyur kyang / /'jig rten 'jig rten rjes bsnyagasaphyir/ /yi ge'i grwar ni byon par gyur/ /yi ge gang gi ming dag kyang / /bdag gisakhushes par ma gyur pa/ /de la 'di la byang gyur kyang //yi ge slob pa'i grwar byon to/ /'di yi zhal ni mthong mod kyi/ /spyi gtsug 'phags pa bltar mi snang / /yi ge'i shes rab mthar phyin na/ /bdag gis 'di go ji ltar bslab/ /lha yi lha chen lha0'di ni/ /lha rnams kun gyi mchog mkhas pa/ /khyad par 'phags shing mnyam pa med/ /'jig rten gang zag do zla med/ /bdag kyang 'di nyid mthu yis na/ /shes rab thabs kyi khyad par gyis/ /'jig rten kun kyi dpung gnyen po/ /lobs pa 'di ni bslab par bya/ /dge slong dag de ltar byis pa stong phrag bcu po de dag byang chub sems dpa' dang lhan cig tu yi ge slob pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis byis pa de dag yi ge'i phyi mo slob cing gang gi tshe/ a zhes brjod pa de'i tshe/ 'du byed thams cad mi rtag pa'i sgra byung ngo / /ā zhes brjod pa dang bdag med pa'i sgra byung ngo / /i zhes brjod pa dang dbang po shin tu yangs pa'i sgra byung ngo / /zhi zhes brjod pa dang 'gro ba ni yams kyi nad mang ba zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /u zhes brjod pa dang 'gro ba ni 'tshe ba mang ngo0zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /u zhes brjod pa dang 'gro ba ni dma' ba'o zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /e zhes brjod pa dang / nyes pa ni btsal ba las byung ngo zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /i zhes brjod pa dang 'phags pa'i lam ni dge'o zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /o zhes brjod pa dang chu bo las rgal ba'i sgra byung ngo / /au zhes brjod pa dang rdzubasnyepa'i sgra byung ngo / /67zhes brjod pa dang bdag gi ba mi 'byung zhes bya ba'i sgra 46—161

byung ngo / /aḥzhes brjod pa dang nub pa zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /ka zhes brjod pa dang las kyi rnam par smin pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /kha zhes brjod pa dang chos thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /ga zhes brjod pa dang chos zab ces bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /gha zhes brjod pa dang ma rig pa dang / gti mug gi mun pa dang ling thog stug po bsal zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /nga zhes brjod pa dang yan lag rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /tsa zhes brjod pa dang 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i sgra byung ngo / /tsha zhes brjod pa dang 'dod pa'i 'dod chags spang ba'inyesgra byung ngo / /dza ②zhes brjod pa dang rga shi las yang dag par 'das pa'i sgra byung ngo / /dzha zhes brjod pa dang 'chi byed kyi rgyal mtshan can gyi dpung tshar bcad ③pa'i sgra byung ngo / /nya zhes brjod pa dang shes par byed pa'i sgra byung ngo / /ṭa zhes brjod pa dang lam shin tu chad pa'i sgra byung ngo / /ṭha zhes brjod pa dang dri ba bzhag pa'i sgra byung ngo / /ḍa5gezhes brjod pa dang dkrugs ma dang bdud tshar bcad ⑤pa'i sgra byung ngo / /nye zhes brjod pa dang yul mi gtsang ba'i sgra byung ngo ske/ /ṇa zhes brjod pa dang nyon mongs pa ni phra ba zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /ta zhes brjod pa dang de bzhin nyid ni 'dres pa med ces bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /tha zhes brjod pa dang mthu stobs dang shugs dang mi 'jigs pa'i sgra byung ngo / /da zhes brjod pa dang sbyin pa dang / dul ba dang / yang dag par sdom pa dang / nges pa'i sgra byung ngo / /dha zhes brjod pa dang 'phags pa rnams kyi nor ni rnam pa bdun no zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /na zhes brjod pa dang ming dang gzugs5)yongs su shes par bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /pa zhes brjod pa dang don 46—162

dam pa'i sgra byung ngo / /pha zhes brjod pa dang 'bras bu rnyed pa mngon du bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /ba zhes brjod pa dang bcings pa las rnam par thar pa'i sgra byung ngo / /bha zhes brjod pa dang srid pa 'jigs7pa'i sgra byung ngo / /ma zhes brjod pa dang nga rgyal dang rgyags pa zhi bar bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /ya zhes brjod pa dang chos ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs par bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /ra zhes brjod pa dang dga' ba la dga' ba med pa'i〈 nidon dam par dga' ba zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /la zhes brjod pa dang 'khri shing chad pa'i sgra byung ngo / /wa zhes brjod pa dang theg pa mchog gi sgra byung ngo / /sha zhes brjod pa dang zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gisasgra byung ngo / /ṣa zhes brjod pa dang skye mched drug gzhom zhing mngon par shes pa drug dang ye shes thob pa'i sgra byung ngo / /sa zhes brjod pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /ha zhes brjod pa dang nyon mongs pa bcom zhing 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sgra byung ngo / /k+ṣa zhes brjod pa dang yi ge'i mthar phyin te/ chos thams cad brjod du med pa'o zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /de ltar byis pa de dag yi ge'i phyi mo slob pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i mthus de dag la sogs pa chos kyi sgo brgya stong grangs med pa byung bar gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' yi ge'i grwa na ⑤'dug pa'i tshe byis pa sum khri nyis stong rim gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lobs ⑥par gyur kyang yi ge'i gyur 'jug pa'i rgyu ni de yin no/ /rkyen ni de yin no/ /yi ge bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //46—163

dge slong dag gzhon nu de de bas kyang ya zad skyes nas dus gzhan zhig na gzhon nu de gzhon nu gzhan dag dang zhang blon gyi bu dag dang lhan cig tu zhing pa'i grong lta zhing dong ste/ grong bltas nas zhing blas kyi mtha'i skyed mos tshal zhig tu phyin to/ /de na byang chub sems dpa' gcig pu gnyis su med par pha zad 'khyam zhing song song ba dang / 'dzam bu'i shing sngon pa mdzes pa blta na sdug pa zhig mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de'i grib ma la skyil mo krungasabacas te 'dug go/ /'dug nas byang chub sems dpa'akhusems rtse gcig pa rnyed de rnyed nas kyang sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams las dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rtog pa dang dpyod pa dang bral zhing nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas rtog pa med pa/ dpyod pa med pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang bral bas btang snyoms la gnas shing dran pa dang shes bzhin can yin te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la/ 'phags pa rnams kyis gang de dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la gnas pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba med pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs te snga ⑤nas sdug bsngal yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang /yid mi bde ba yang nub pas bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal yang ma yin pa btang snyoms dang dran pa yongs su dag pa bsam gtan bzhi pa bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de'i tshe phyi rol gyi drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga yod pa rdzu 'phrul 46—164

dang ldan pa nam mkha' las dong7ba lnga zhig lho phyogs nas byang phyogs logs su dong dong ba las de dag tshal stug po de'i steng du phyin pa dang / phyir phul ba ltar 'dongakhum nus nas/ de dag mi dga' zhing ba spu g.yos te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /bdag cag 'di na ri rab nor bu rdo rje brtsegs ri shin tu rngams stug pa yang thal byung ste/ /glang po a mra'i shing rlon yal gas gzings pa mang po bcom nas 'gro bzhin dong dong la/ /bdag cag 'di na lha yi khyim na'angasathogs med gnod sbyin dri za'i khyim steng nam mkhar gnas gnas na/ /tshal stugashe'adir phyin0nas ni sgyid lug gyur pa su yi mthu zhig gis na rdzu 'phrul stobs bzlog gyur/ /de nas tshal stug po de na lha mo zhig gnas pa des drang srong de dag la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ rgyal po'i gtso bo'i rigs byung shākya'i rgyal sras nyi ma shar ba lta bur rab tu snang ba'i 'od/ /'jig rten gtso bo mkhas pa zla zhal pad ma rgyas pa'i snying po'i kha dog lta bur rab mdzes pa/ /lha dang klu dbang gnod sbyin dri zas mchod pa de ni bsam gtan dgongs shing tshal stug 'di na bzhugs/ /srid pa bye ba brgya dag tu ni bsod nams spel ba de yi mthu yis rdzu 'phrul stobs bzlog go/ /de nas de dag gis 'og logs su bltas pa dang / gzhon nu zhig dpal dang gzi brjid kyis 'bar ba mthong nas 'di dag 'di snyam du su zhig 'di ltar gnas/ nor gyi bdag po rnam thos kyi bu'am cig⑧ma yin nam/ 'on te 'dod pa'i dbang po bdud lta'am/ yang na sto 'phye chen po'ishedabang po'am/ 'on te dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'am/ yang na gu lang ngam/ grul bum gyi bdag po'am/ 'on te spro ba chen po dang ldan pa nag po'am/ 'on te lha'i bu zla ba'am/ 'on te 'od zer stong dang ldan pa'i 46—165

nyi ma'am/ 'on te 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po zhig yin nam/ su zhig snyam mo / /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang smras so/ /gzhon nu 'di ni rnam thos bu yi gzugs las 'phags par gsal bar snang bas na/ /'di ni sgra gcanatuyin nam 'on te rdo rje 'chang gitsha gzugs sam nyi zla'i gzugs/ /'dod mchog dbang po'i gzugs sam gu lang gzugs sam 'on te nag po'i gzugs yin nam/ /yang na 'di ni dpal ldan yan lag mtshan spras0sdig med sangs rgyas 'gyur ba zhig /de nas tshal gyi lha mo des drang srong de dag la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ rnam thos bu dang mig stong bdog bul dpal ni gang yod gyur pa dang //'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang lha min dbang lasnyedapal ni gang yod dang / /mi mjed bdag po tshangs dang gza' rnams la yang dpal ni gang yod pa/ /dpal de shākya'i sras po 'di drung phyin na gang gi char mi phod/ /de nas drang srong de dag gis lha mo de'i tshig thos nas sa la babs pa dang / de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' mi g.yo ba'i lus kyis bsam gtan byed cing / me'i phung po ltar 'bar ba mthong nas/ de dag byang chub sems dpa' la sems shing tshigs su bcad pas 3)bstod de/ de la gcig gis smras pa/ 'jig rten nyon mongs mes gdungs pa/ /mtsho 'di rab tu byung gyur te/ /gang gis 'jig rten sim 'gyur ba'i/ /chos de 'di yis brnyes par 'gyurag/ /yang gcig gis smras pa/mi shes rab rib 'jig rten du/ /sgron ma 'di ni rab tu byung / /gang gis 'gro ba snang 'gyur ba'i/ /chos de 'di yis brnyes par 'gyur/ /yang gcig gis smras pa/ mya ngan rgya mtsho 'dal 8ba la/ /gru yi dam pa 'di byung ste/ /gang gis 'gro ba sgrol 'gyur ba'i/ /chos de 'di yis brnyes par 'gyur/ /46—166

yang gcig gis smras pa/ nyon mongs 'ching bas bcings pa la/ /'grol bar mdzad pa 'di byung ste/ /gang gis 'gro ba 'grol 'gyur ba'i/ /chos de 'di yis brnyes par 'gyur/ /yang gcig gis smras pa/ rga dang nad kyis gzir ba la/ /sman pa dam pa 'di byung ste/ /gang gis rga shi thar bya ba'i/ /chos de 'di yis brnyes par 'gyur/ /de nas drang srong de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' la tshigs su bcad pa de dag gis bstod de/ lan gsum bskor ba byas nas nam mkha' las dong ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang ma yang byang chub sems dpa' mi mthong zhing byang chub sems dpa' med pas mi dga' ste/ des smras pa/gzhon nu de mi snang na gar song / de'i tshe skye bo phal po che 37gzhon nu tshol du dong dong ba dang / de'i tshe blon po gcig cig gis byang chub sems dpa' 'dzam bu'i shing gi grib ma la skyil mo krung 5bcas te bsam gtan byed cing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /des de'i tshe shing thams cad kyi grib ma ni ciyol na/'dzam bu'i shing gi grib ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i 4lus mi gtong bar 'dug par mthong nas ngo mtshar du gyur te/ tshim zhing mgu la yi 3rangs nas rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas rings shing myur ba myur ba'i gzugs kyis/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i thad du phyin te tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rgyal po gzhon nu de la gzigs/ /'dzam bu'i shing grib bsam gtan mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa ji bzhin du/ /gzi brjid dpal gyis yirab tu mdzes/ /zhugs shing gang gi grib ma la/ /mtshan rab mnga' ba de bzhugs pa'i/ /grib ma des ni de mum btang / /skyes mchog bsam gtan mdzad la sgrib/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'dzam bu'i shing ljon pa ga la ba 46—167

der song ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa' dpal dang gzi brjid kyis 'bar ba de mthong ba dang / tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /ri yi spo la me 'bar 'dra ba ste/ /zla ba skar ma'i tshogs nang 'dug 'dra zhing / /gzi brjid sgron 'dra bsam gtan byed mthong na/ /nga yi7lus 'di shin tu 'dar bar gyur/ /de skad ces smras nas/ des byang chub sems dpa'i rkang pa la phyag byas te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /thub pa gang tshe bltamasapa dang / /gang tshe 'od ldan bsam gtan mdzad/ /'dren pa 'di ltar lan gnyis su/ /mgon po khyod zhabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'i tshe byis pa khre'u7thogs pa dag ca co'i sgra 'byin par gyur nas/ de dag la blon po dag gis sgra ma che sgra ma che zhes byas pa dang / de dag ci zhig nongs zhes zer ro/ /blon po dag gis smras pa/rgyal po'i sras don thams cad grub pa dge ba'i mtshan bzang po mchog dam pa dang ldan zhing 'od 'dom gang ba mnga' ba 'di ri dultar mi g.yo zhing bsam gtan mdzad pa'i tshe/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yol te song yang / shing gi grib ma de ma yol zhing sgrib par gnas so/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ dpyidakhu'adas dbyar gyi dus bab dbyar zla ra ba la/ me tog rgyas shing me tog yal gas khebs gyur te/ /khrung khrung rma bya ne0tso ri skegs skad 'byin pa/ /shākya'i bu dag phal cher mngon du 'dong bar gyur/ /'dun pa can gyis smras pa/ gzhon nu nags tshal dag ni gzigs pa mdzad slad du/ /byis pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor te gshegs pa'i rigs/ /bram ze lta bur khyim na bzhugs pas ci zhig bgyi/ /bdag cag rnams ni bu mo'i tshogs rnams sgron du mchi/ /nyi ma'i gung la sems can rnam par dag pa de/ /byis pa lnga brgya dag gis bskor nas lhan 46—168

cig tu/ /yab la ma gsol yum la ma gsol ma tshor bar/ /de ni byung nas zhing pa rnams kyi grong du song / /rgyal po dam pa'i zhing pa dag gi grong de na/ /'dzam bu'i sdong chen yal ga mang po rgyas yod pa/ /gzhon nus mthong na7nyam thag sdug bsngal phog gyur te/ /'dus byas ci rung sdug bsngal mang zhes snying rje byed/ /dul ba'i sems dang ldan pa 'dzam bu'i grib mar song / /bsnyedag bsdus te bdag gis gding ba bting nas ni/ /skyil mo krung 'dug drang por lus bsrangakhubasam gtan bzhi/ /dge ba dag la byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan byed/ /drang srong lnga zhig nam mkha'i dkyil nas dong dong na/ /'dzam bu'i shing gi steng du phyin nas 'dong ma nus/ /de dag thogs nasakhung rgyal dregs pa spang bya zhing / /de dag thams cad 'thun par lhan cig lta bar byed/ /bdag cag ri mchog ri rab de bzhin 'khorapo)yug dag /thal phyung thags thogs med par shugs kyis dong dong na/ /bdag cag de ring 'dzam bu'i shing ljon 'di las ni/ /'da' bar ma nus 'di la rgyu rkyen ci zhig yod/ /babs te sa steng0'dug nas 'dzam bu'i shing drung na/ /shākya'i bu pho byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid can/ /'dzam glingasnyegaser gyi 'od 'phro('dra ba 'od zer ldan/ / skyil mo krung bcas bsam gtan byed pa de tshe mthong / /de dag rmad gyur spyi bor sor bcu thal sbyar te/ /thal mo sbyar ba rkang par gtugs nas phyag 'tshal lo9/ /'gro ba shin tu bde mdzad legs par bltam pa legs/ /myur du rnam sangs rgyas te bdud rtsir sems can thul/ /sdong po mchog ni pad ma 'dra ba'i spyan la 'dud/ /gdugs yol gyur kyang grib mas bde bar gshegs mi gtong / /lha rnams stong phrag mang po gnas pa thal sbyar nas/ /des par 46wa 169

byas pa de yi rkang par phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zas gtsang rgyal po bdag gi khyim na yongs tshol ①zhing / /nga'i bu gzhon nu de ni gang du song zhesashemed/ /sru mos smras pa bdag gis btsal kyang ma rnyed na/ /gzhon nu de ni gar bzhud rgyal pos rma mibar gsol/ /zas gtsang rgyal pos nyung rum dag la rings par masaphyi / /nga yi gzhon nu 'di nas byung bar la las mthong ngam zhes/ /sgo ba rnams dang de bzhin nang mi kun la'ang rmas ri/ /lha cig khyod gson mchog de zhing pa'i grong du bzhud/ /de ni rings par shākya rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /byung nas dpal zhugs gyur pa'i zhing pa'i grong du bltas/ /ji ltar nyi ma bye ba khrag khrig shar ba ltar / /de ltar dpal gyis 'bar zhing phan byed 'dug pa mthong / /cod pan ral gri ④lham dag pha zad phog phud de(snyen/ /mgo bor sor bcu thal mo sbyar nas phyag kyang 'tshal/ /drang srong bdag nyid chen po legs par yang dag smra/ /gzhon nu byang chub don du mngon par 'byung du nges/ /rab tu dad lha brgya phrag bcu gnyis tshang ba dang / /de bzhin shākya lnga brgya nye bar 'ongs pa dang / /bde gshegs yon tan rgya mtsho ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul mthong / /bsam pa brtanashepas rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems kyang skyed/ /des ni stong gsum ma lus sa rnams rab bskyod nas/ /dran dang shes bzhin ting nge 'dzin las langs gyur te / /mdog bzang ldan pas yab la tshangs pa'i tshig brjod pa/ /yab cig zhing blas thong la gzhan las tshol tshim mdzad/ /gal te gser zhig 'tshal na'ang bdag gis gser char dbab/ /de ste na bza' 'tshal na'ang bdag gis na bza' dbul/ /'on te 'bru zhig 'tshal na'ang bdag gis 'bru char dbab/ /mi dbang khyod kyis 'gro ba kun la yang dag sbyor/ /yab dang de bzhin skye bo 'khor 46wa 170

la bstan byas nas/ /skad cig de la de slar grong khyer mchog tu zhugs/ /'gro dang 'thun pa tsam du grong khyer der gnas kyi/ /sems can rnam dag mngon par 'byung ba'i yid dang ldan/ /zhing ba'i grong gi le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bdun pa/ dge slong dag de ltar gzhon nu de de bas kyang ya zad skyes pa dang / dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po zas gtsang ma shākya'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu 'dun sa na 'dug 'dug pa de'i tshe/ shākya rgan rabs rgan rabs kha cig gis rgyal po zas gtsang ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa 'di ni bram ze ltas mkhan rnams dang / blo nges pa dang ldan pa'i lha mang pos 'di skad du bstan te/ gzhon nu 'di gal te mngon par byung bar gyur na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /ji 33ste mngon par ma byung na ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan zhing rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de'i rin po che sna bdun ni 'di dag ste/ 'di ltar 'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang /rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang /khyim bdag rin po che dang / blon po rin po che dang bdun no/ /de la bu dpa' ba/ rtul phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ gzhan gyi sde rab tu 'joms pa stong tshang ba tsho 'byung ngo / /de gnod par bya ba dang /mtshon cha med par chos dang 'thun pas sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di las mngon par 46—171

rgyal bar byas te/ gcig pu gnas par 'gyur ro zhes mchi na/ de'i slad dushegazhon nu de'i btsun mo blang bar bgyi'o/ /de ltar mdzad dang bud med kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te/ dgyesalgepa la longs spyod cing mngon par 'byung bar yang mi 'gyur te/ de ltar gyur pasnyedang bdag cag gi 'khor los sgyur ba'i gdung yang mi 'chas/ khams kyi rgyal po thams cad kyis kyang mi snyan par mi brjod cing rim gror bgyi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas smras pa/ gal te de ltar bya na de'i phyir gzhon nu'i tshul dang 'thun pa'i bu mo gang zhig yod khyed kyis ltos shig /de'i tshe shākya lnga brgya tsam so so nas 'di skad du bdag gi bu mo ni gzhon nu'i tshul dang 'thun no/ /bdag gi bu mo ni gzhon nu'i tshul dang 'thun no zhes zer ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu de ni shin tu phul che ba yin gyisas/ gzhon nu nyid la khyod bu mo gang 'dod ces dri bar bya'o zhes/ de dag kun kyang 'dus te/ gzhon nu la dngos po de brjod do/ /gzhon nus smras pa/ da ste dgung bdun na 'di'i lan gsan par gsol/de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du bsams te / 'dod pa'i skyon ni bdag gis mtha' yas rig / thab mo khon bcas mya ngan sdug bsngal rtsa/ /'jigs byed dug gi0 lo ma 'dra ba ste/ /me dang 'dra zhing ral gri'isheso dang 'dra/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bdag 'dod ma yin te/ /bdag ni bud med tshogs dang mdzes ma yin/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin bde bas zhi sems su/ /bdag ni mi smra nags tshal gnas par bya/ /yang des brtags nas thabs mkhas pa mngon du byas te/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la bltas nas/snying rje chen po bskyed de/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /46—172

'dam dang lcag rtsig khrod nas pad ma rnam par 'phel/ /mi rnams gang ba'i nang na rgyal po mchod pa 'thob/ /gang tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'khor mchog thob gyur pa/ /de tshe sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'chi med 'dul/ /sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa gang byung ba/ /de dag kun gyis btsun mo sras dang slas7kyang bsten/ /'on kyang 'dod pas chags med bsam gtan bde ma nyams/ /bdag kyang de dag yon tan rjes su bslab par bya/ /gang la spyod lam yon tan bden pa'i tshig med pa/ /bud med phal pa gang yang bdag gi tshul 'thun min/ /gang zhig bdag gi sems ni mngon par dga' byed cing / /bag yod gzugs dang na tshod rus rigs dag pa 'os/ /des ni yon tan tshigs su bcad de yi ger bris/ /'di 'dra'i bu mo mchis na bdag la bka' ཿ75 cig /skye bo phal pa ma bsdams bdag la mkho ma lags/ /yon tan brjod pa 'di ldanakhumachis na bdag stsol cig /dar cing gzugs bzang ldan yang gzugs kyi dregs dang bral/ /phu nu ma la byams ltar byams pa'i sems ldanakhuzhing / /gtong la dga' ste dge sbyong bram ze sbyin tshul can/ /de 'dra'i bu mo mchis na yab kyis bdag stsol cig /gang la nga rgyal khengs dang zhe snang ma mchis shing / /g.yo dang phrag dog sgyu spangs drang ba'i ngang tshul can/ /rmi lam na yang skyes pa gzhan la chags dang bral/ /bdag gi khyos ni chog 'tshal rtag sdom bag mchis la/ /rgyags pa ma mchis mi g.yeng zung thub tshul 'chang zhing / /nga rgyal ma mchis 'gying dang bral bas bran⑧me bzhin/ /sgra dri ro la ma chags chang la ma chags te/ /'dod bral brnab sems ma mchis rang gi nor gyis 'tshal/ /bden la gnas shing mi 'phyar g.yeng ba ma lags pa/ /ngo tsha'i 46—173

gos 'tshal rgod hudang khengs pa ma mchis gnas②/ /lha dang bkra shis ma chags rtag tu chos la brtson/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi dngos po rab dag pa/ /gnyid dang rmugs pa mi mngakhung rgyal glen bral zhing / /rtog dang ldan la legs pa'i las rnams rtag spyod de/ /gyos sgyug gnyis la'ang ston pa bzhin gyi rim gror ldan/ /bran dang bran mo kun la'ang bdag bzhin byams srel ba/ /smad 'tshong bzhin du bstan bcos cho ga 'tshal cing mkhas/ /slad kyis nyal zhing sngon du mal nas ldang bgyid pa/ /byams pas rjes snyegs ma bzhin tshul 'chos ma mchis pa/ /de 'dra'i bud med mchis na yab kyis bdag stsol cig /dge slong dag de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas tshigs su bcad pa de dudag thos nas/mdun na 'don la smras pa/ bram ze chen po khyod ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por song la/ khyim thams cad du'ang song ste/ bu mo dag ltos la gang la yang rung ste yon tan de lta bu dag yod na/ rgyal rigs kyi bu mo yang rung /bram ze'i bu mo yang rung / rje'u rigs kyi bu mo yang rung / dmangasasnyerigs kyi bu mo yang rung gisayi/ bu mo de dag 'dir 'on cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gzhon nu 'di ni rigs don du gnyer ba ma yin rus don du gnyer ba ma yin gyi/ gzhon nu 'di ni yon tan don du gnyer ba yin no/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang smras so/ /rgyal rigs bram ze'i bu mo dang / /rje'u rigs dmangs rigs de bzhin te/ /su la yon tan 'di yod pa'i/ /bu mo de ni 'dir 'on cig /nga yi bu 'di rigs dag dang / /rus la ngo mtshar 'dzin ma yin/ /yon tan bden pa chos kyi rnams/ /de la 'di yi yid dga' 'o/ /dge slong dag de nas bram ze mdun na 'don des tshigs su bcad pa yi ger 46—174

bris pa de khyer te/ ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por song nas/ khyim nas khyim du yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i bu mo lta zhing tshol ②du song song ba las/ yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i bu mo ma mthong ste/ de nas rim gyis shākya lag na be con can gyi khyim du phyin nas/ des bltas na/ bu mo gzugs mdzes shing blta na sdug la yid du 'ong ba/ mdog bzang posargyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ ha cang yang mi ring ba/ ha cang yang mi thung ba/ ha cang yang mi sbom pa/ ha cang yang mi skem pa/ ha cang yang mi dkar ba/ ha cang yang mi gnag pa/ gzodasam dar la bab pa/ bud med rin po che ltar snang ba zhig mthong ba dang / bu mo des bram ze mdun na 'don de'i rkang pa gnyis nas bzung ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze chen po khyod la dgos pa ci zhig mchis/bram ze mdunasan 'don gyis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ zas gtsang sras po gzugs ni mchog tu mdzes gyur cing / /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan yon tan gzi brjid can/ /de yis bud med rnams kyi yon tan yi ger bris/ /su la yon tan 'di yod de yi chung mar 'os/ /zhes smras te/ des de la yi ge de byin no/ /de nas bu mo des tshigs su bcad pa'i yi ge de bklagasasnyenas/bzhin 'dzum pa bstan te/ bram ze mdun na 'don de la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bram ze yon tan 'di dag bdag la kun tshang gisakhya/ /des pa'i gzugs can de ni bdag gi khyim thab bo/ /gal te gzhon nu bzhed na phyi bsholakhum mdzad gsungs/ /brgya la skye bo phal dang bzhugs par 'gyur yang gda'/ /de nas bram ze mdun na 'don de/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i drung du song ste don de brjod rga/ /rgyal po chen po bdag gis gzhon nu'i tshul dang 'thun pa'i bu 46—175

mo mthong ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa/ su la de lta bu zhig yod/ smras pa/ lha shākya lag na be con can la bu mo de lta bu zhig mchis so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'di snyam du sems te/ gzhon nu de ni shin tu phul che zhing bzang ba la mos pa yin la/ bud med dag ni phal cher yon tan med pa dag kyang /bdag la yon tan yod par khas7len gyis②/ bdag gis yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad dag cig byas te/ gzhon nu ②'di bu mo thams cad la sbyin pa byed du gzhug go/ /bu mo de dag gi nang nas gang la gzhon nu mig mngon par chags par gyur pa de/ gzhon nu la sbyin par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas yid du thong ba'i yo byad gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che sna tshogs las byed du bcug nas ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por dril gyi sgra bsgrags te/ deng nas zhag bdun na kun gyis kyang gzhon nu mthong bar 'gyur te/ yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad dag kyang bu mo dag la sbyin pa byed kyis/ bu mo thams cad kyang 'dun khang du shog shigasheces bsgo'o/ /dge slong dag de nas zhag bdun lon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'dun 0khang du song ste/seng ge'i khri la 'dug go/ /de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang mas bya ra ba dag bkod nas/ gzhon nu 'di bu mo gang la mig chags pa de nga la gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /dge slong dag de nas ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po de na bu mo gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad 'dun khang ga la ba de dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang na ⑦ba der byang chub sems dpa' blta ba dang yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad blangs pa'isaphyir der dong ngo / /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpas bu mo ji ltar 'ongs pa de dag la yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad rnams byin no/ /46—176

de nas bu mo de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i dpal dang gzi brjid ma bzod nas/ yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad de dag blangs shing myur ba myur bar phyir dong ngo / /de nas shākya lag na be con can gyi bu mo sa 'tsho ma zhes bya ba/ bran mo'i tshogs kyis bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ 'dun khang ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / mig mi 'dzums7par byang chub sems dpa' la lta7zhing phyogs gcig tu 'dug par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpas yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad de dag byin zin par gyur pa de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i drung du 'ongs nas 'dzum dmul te byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu bdag gis khyod la nongs pa ci zhig bgyis na/ bdag la de ltar dngan snang mdzad/ smras pa/ ngas ni khyod la dngan snang byas pa'ang medakhun/ khyod ni shin tu 'phyis te 'ongs so zhes smras nas des sor gdub srang brgya stong du ma ri ba phud de de la byin no/ /bu mo des smras pa/ gzhon nu khyod la bdag gis 'di lta zhig 'tshal ba 'os sam/smras pa/ 'o na rgyan gzhan dang gzhan dag yod pa 'di dag kyang khyod khyerabacig /des smras pa/ gzhon nu bdag ni rgyan ma mchis par bgyid pa ma lags kyi/ rgyan dang ldan par bgyid pa lags so/ /zhes smras nas bu mo de song ngo /de nas bya ra bar bkod pa'i mi de dag rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i drung du song nas/lo rgyus de dag smos te smras pa/ lha shākya lag na be con can gyi bu mo sa 'tsho ma zhes bgyi ba de la gzhon nu spyan chags par gyur la chung zad cig tu bka' mchid kyang bgyis so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas tshig de thos nas shākya lag na be con can gyi gan du bram ze mdun na 'donasapho nyar btang ste/ khyod kyi bu mo 46—177

zhig yod pa de nga'i gzhon nu la byin cig ces spring07ngo / /lag na be con can gyis smras pa/ 'phags pa gzhon nu de ni pho brang na skyid de bar 'khrungs pa lags la/ bdag cag gi rigs kyi chos ni 'di lta bu lags te/ sgyu rtsal shes pa la bu mo gtong gi/ sgyu rtsal mi shes pa la mi gtong ba lags na/ gzhon nu de ni sgyu rtsal shes pa yang ma lags la/ ral gri'i thabs dang / 'phongasnyedang /stobs dang / gyad kyi 'dzin stangs kyi tshul shes pa yang ma lags na/ bdag gis sgyu rtsal shes pa ma lags pa la bu mo ji ltar gtangasnyi/ tshig de rgyal po la bzlas pa dang / de nas rgyal po 'di snyam du sems te/ nga la des 'di dang lan gnyis su bsngos te/ gang gi tshe ngas shākya gzhon nu dag /gzhon nu'i rim gro byed du ci'i phyir mi 'ong zhes byas pa de'i tshe yang / ci nged lug gi rim gro byed du 'ong ngam zhes zer las/ nga'ang gye'adi skad zer ro snyam du sems shing 'dug par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang gtam de thos nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma ga la ba der song ste phyin nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci nongs te de ltar zhal zung gnag par bzhugs / rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu de dri bas ci zhig bya/ gzhon nus smras pa/ lha de ni bka' mi stsal du mi rung ngo zhes lan gsum gyi bar du byang chub sems dpas rgyal po zas gtsang ma la dris pa dang ske/ de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas byang chub sems dpa' la dngos po de dag brjod do/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ lha grong khyer 'di na bdag dang sgyu rtsal )gyis 'gran 9par nus pa 'ga' mchis sam/ de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas bgad blonas/ byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu khyod kyis sgyu rtsal byu nyabastan par nus sam/ smras pa/ lha de ni bdag gis 46—178

legs par rngo thog goX/ /de bas na sgyu rtsal ⑧'tshal ba rnams kun kyang bsog setu gsol/ de dag gi mdun du bdag gis/ sgyu rtsal gi bstan par bgyi'o/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas ser ca)skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por dril gyi sgra bsgrags te/ deng du nas zhag bdun na gzhon nu rang gi sgyu rtsal ston gyis/der7sgyu rtsal shes pa thams cad shog shig 7ces bsgo'o/ /de nas zhag bdun lon pa dang / shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya tsam tshogs par gyur to/ /de nas shākya lag na be con can gyi bu mo sa 'tsho ma rgyal ba'i ru mtshon du bzhag ste/ 'dir ral gri'i〈/)thabs dang 'phong 8dang / stobs dang / gyad kyi 'dzin stangs kyis su rgyal ba de ni 'di khyer cig ces dam bcas nas/ de'i tshe thams cad kyi thog ma la gzhon nu lha sbyin grong khyer nas byung ngo / /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i bzhon par glang po dkar po bong shin tu che ba zhig grong khyer du khrid pa gzhon nu lha sbyin gyis mthong nas phrag dog dang / shākya'i nga rgyal dang / stobs kyi nga rgyal gyis dregs nas/ des glang po de lag pa g.yon pas sna nas bzung ste/lag pa g.yas pas thal mo lan cig bsnun pas bsad par gyur to/ /de'i 'og tu gzhon nu mdzes dga' bo byung ba dang / des glang po chen po de grong khyer gyi sgor bsad pa mthong nas/ sus bsad ces dris pa dang / smras pa/ lha sbyin gyis bsad do/ /smras pa/ lha sbyin gyis de ni ma legs pa zhig byas so zhes/des glang po de'i mjug 'am nas bzung ste/ grong khyer gyi sgo nas gud du bor ro//de'i 'og tu byang chub sems dpa' shing rta la zhon te byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpas7glang po de ltar bsad pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang sus bsad ces dris pa dang / smras pa/ lha sbyin gyis bsad do/ /smras pa/ lha 46—179

sbyin gyis de ni ma legs pa zhig byas so/ /grong khyer 'di'i sgo nas sus bor zhes dris pa dang smras pa/ mdzes dga' bos bor ro/ /smras pa/ mdzes dga' bos de ltar byas pa yang legs na/ sems can 'di ni lus chen po dang ldan pa ste/ rul na grong khyer thams cad dri mi zhim pas gang bar 'gyur ro zhes nas/de nas byang chub sems dpas shing rta la 'dug bzhin du rkang pa ya0gcigashes la brkyang ste/ rkang pa'i mthe bos glang po de blangs te/ ra ba bdun rim dang 'obs bdun rim 'das nas grong khyer gyi phyi rol rgyang grags gcig tsam du 'phangs so/ /glang po de phyogs gang du lhung ba'i phyogs de shongashechen po zhig tu gyur nas/ da ltar glang po'i shongasazhes bya ba yin no/ /de'i tshe lha dang mi brgya stong mang po e ma a la dul zhes zer zhing ca co dang ga zha'i 0sgra brgya stong 'byin la/ gos kyi g.yabashemo 'byin par gyurasheto/ /nam mkha'i dkyil nas lha'i bu dag gis kyang tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /glang po'i dbang po bdo ba bzhin bzhud pa/ /zhabs kyi mthe pos glang po'i dbang po blangs/ /ra ba bdun dang 'obs bdun yongs 'das nas/ /grong khyer 'di yi phyi rol rgyang ring 'phangs/ /mkhyen pa mchog mnga' 'dis ni gdon mi zar/ /nga rgyal stobs kyis mtho ba'i lus can rnams/ /'khor ba'i grong nas phyi rol rgyang ring du/ /shes rab stobs kyis 'dis ni 'phen par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag de nas shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya tsam grong khyer nas 'thon 8nas/ sa'i phyogs gang du shākya gzhon nu dag sgyu rtsal ston pa der dong ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang /shākya rgan rabs 8rgan rabs dag dang / skye bo phal po che dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' dang / shākya gzhon nu gzhan dag gi sgyu rtsal gyi khyad par mthong 46—180

bar 'dod de sa'i phyogs der dong ngo / /de nas thog mar shākya gzhon nu yi ge mkhas shing yi ge'i cho ga shes pa de dag dang / byang chub sems dpar7yi ge 'gran to/ /de'i tshe shākya de dag gis slob dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen dpang du bzhag ste/ gzhon nu 'di dag gi nang nas/ yi ge 'bru'am/ yi ge'i sna grangs kyi mthar phyin pas khyad par du 'phags pa gang yin khyod kyis bye brag phye shig /de nas slob dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen byang chub sems dpa' yi ge la mkhas pasamangon du mthong bas bzhin 'dzum pa bstan te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /mi yi 'jig rten lha yi 'jig rten nam/ /lha min 'jig rten dri za'i 'jig rten nam/ /'jig rten kun gyi yi ge ji snyed gang / /de la sems can dag pa 'dis mthar phyin/ /mi yi zla ba 'di yis gang mkhyen pa'i/ /yi ge dag dang yi ge'i sna grangs kyi/ /ming yang khyed dang ngas ni yong mi shes/ /'di la mngon sum ngas shes 'di rgyal 'gyur/ /shākya rnams kyis smras pa/gzhon nu 'di yi ge'i shes pa la khyad par du 'phags pa lta'ang bya'aphags par chug ste/ gzhon nu 'di grangs kyis shes pa la khyad par ci yod 'gran par bya'o//de nas shākya srid sgrub ces bya ba rtsis pa chen po byed pa bgrang ba dang / rtsis kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhig yod pa de dpang du bzhag ste/ gzhon nu 'di dag gi nang nas grangs kyi shes pa la khyad par du gang 'phags khyod kyis stos shig ces byas te/de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpas bani rtsis mgo photsho /shākya gzhon nu gcig gis ni brtsis pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' la slebasashepar ma nus so/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu dang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu 46—181

dang / brgya nas/ shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya'i bar gyis dus gcig tu brtsis kyang byang chub sems dpa' la ma slebs so9/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas smras pa / khyed kyis ni rtsis mgo phog shigami /kho bos ni brtsi'o/ /de'i tshe shākya gzhon nu gcig gis rtsis mgo phog na/ byang chub sems dpas rtsis kyi chodakyipa la ma slebs sog )/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu dang / bzhi bcu dang /lnga bcu dang / brgya nas shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya'i bar gyis dus gcig tu rtsis mgo phog kyang byang chub sems dpas rtsis kyi chod pa la ma slebs jotsho/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'di la brtsad de yang ci rung gisabya/ khyed thams cad gcig tu 'dus te rtsis mgo phog shig 3tshodang / kho bos brtsi'o/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu lnga brgyas tshig gcig tu brjod pas snga phyi med par rtsis mgo phog na/byang chub sems dpas rmongs pa med par brtsis te/ de ltar shākya gzhon nu de dag thams cad ni phug thug par gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' la ni thug pa'i mtha' med par gyur to/ /de nas rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub ngo mtshar du gyur te tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /legs pa'i blo mnga' 'di dris na/ /mkhyen pa shin tu myur ba ste/ /shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya tsam/ /kun kyang rtsis kyi lam la thug /de yi shes rab 'di 'dra ste/ /ye shes blo gros dran ldan yang / /rtsis kyi mkhyen pa rgya mtsho de/ /da dung sbyong zhing slob pa mdzad/ /de nas shākya'i tshogs thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur te / shin tu rmad du byung bar sems shing /de'i tshe thams cad mgrin gcig tu tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye don grub gzhon nu khyod ni rgyal lo rgyal lo zhes thams cad stan las langs te/ thal mo 46—182

sbyar nas byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal te rgyal po zas gtsang ma la 'di skad ces smras ①so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod la sras de ltar dris pa la spobs pa myur zhing mgyogs la/ yang zhing shugs dang ldan pa can mnga' ba ni brnyes pa legs par brnyes so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas byang chub sems dpa' lasa'adi skad ces smras so/ /bu rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub grangs kyi shes pa la mkhas pa dang / rtsis kyi lugs 'gran nus sam/ smras pa/ lha rngo thog goskye/ /smras pa 'o na rtsis shig /de nas rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub kyis byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu khyod bye ba las brgyar gong du bsgres pa zhes bgyi ba'i rtsis kyi lugs mkhyen tam/ smras pa/ shes so/ /smras pa/ 'o na bye ba las brgyar gong du bsgres pa'i rtsis kyi lugs la ji ltar rjes su 'jug par bgyi/ byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ bye ba phrag brgya na ther 'bum zhes bya'o/ /ther 'bum phrag brgya na khrag khrig ces bya'o/ /khrag khrig phrag brgya na gtams pa zhes bya'o/ /gtams pa phrag brgya na dkrigs pa zhes bya'o/ /dkrigs pa phrag brgya na mi 'khrugs pa 3zhes bya'o/ /mi 'khrugs pa 5phrag brgya na khyad phyin ces bya'o/ /khyad phyin phrag brgya na phang steng zhes bya'o/ /phang steng phrag brgya na mang 'dzin gces bya'o/ /mang 'dzin phrag brgya na glang po'i stobs zhes bya'o/ /glang po'i stobs phrag brgya na ngogs 'thob naces bya'o/ /ngogs 'thob duphrag brgya na rnam par gzhag pa gdags pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam par gzhag pa gdags pa phrag brgya na rgyu rig ces bya'o/ /rgyu rig phrag brgya na lag sbyin zhes bya'o/ /lag sbyin phrag brgya na rgyu dbang zhes bya'o/ /rgyu dbang phrag brgya na rdzogs thob ces bya'o/ /rdzogs thob phrag brgya na bgrang rtogs zhes bya'o/ /46—183

bgrang rtogs phrag brgya na sgrib pa zhes bya'o/ /sgrib pa phrag brgya na stobs zhes bya'o/ /stobs phrag brgya na kun stobs zhes bya'o/ /kun stobasasaphrag brgya na rnam par brda shes ldan zhes bya'o/ /rnam par brda shes ldan phrag brgya na brda shes kun zhes bya'o/ /brda shes kun phrag brgya na rnam 'byung zhes bya'o/ /rnam 'byung phrag brgya na de'i mtshan nyid ces bya ste/ 'di ltar de'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i rtsis kyis ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab brtsi ba'i gzhir byas kyang chod par rung ngo / / de yisayang gong na rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i nor bu zhes bya ba'i grangs yod de/ grangs des ni gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed brtsi ba'i gzhir byas kyang chod par rung ngo / /de'i yang gong na rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo nges par sgrogs pa zhes bya ba'i grangs yod do/ /de'i yang gong na den 'dren gdags pa zhes bya ba'i grangs yod do/ /de'i yang gong na gtan la 'bebs pa zhes bya ba'i grangs yod do/ /de'i yang gong na gcod rtogs7zhes bya ba'i grangs yod do/ /de'i yang gong na gcod rtogs ldan zhes bya ba'i grangs yod do/ /de'i yang gong na thams cad rnam par 'byis pa zhes bya ba'i grangs yod de/ grangs des ni gang hā'i klung bcu'i bye ma brtsi ba'i gzhir byas kyang chod par rung ngo / /de'i yang gong nasasnying po mchog ces bya ba'i grangs yod de/ grangs des ni gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag brgya'i bye ma dang mnyam pa brtsi ba'i gzhir byas kyang chod par rung ngo / /de'i yang gong na rdul phra rab la 'jug pa'i rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i grangs yod de/ grangs de la ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam par gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / chos thams cad la dbang bskur ba mngon du gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogs par sems 46—184

can gyi ris na grangs de shes pa ni nga dang gzhan yang nga dang 'dra ba srid pa tha ma par gyur pa khyim gyi gnas nas mngon par ma byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogs pashegang yang med do/ /srid sgrub kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu rdul phra rab la 'jug pa'i rjes su song ba'i grangs la ji ltar rjes su 'jug par bgyi/ byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ rdul phra rab7kyi rdul bdun la ni rdul phra mo gcig go/ /rdul phra mo bdun la ni rdul7chung ngu gcig go/ /rdul chung ngu bdun la ni nyi zer gyi rdul gcig go/ /nyi zer gyi rdul bdun la ni ri bong rdul gcig go/ /ri bong rdul bdun la ni lug rdul gcig go/ /lug rdul bdun la ni glang rdul gcig go/ /glang rdul bdun la ni sro ma gcig go/ /sro ma bdun la ni yungs 'bru gcig go/ /yungs 'bru bdun la ni nas gcig go/ /nas bdun la ni sor gcig go/ /sor bcu gnyis la ni mtho gang ngo / /mtho do la ni khru gang ngo / /khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo / /gzhu stong la ni yul ma ga d+ma'i0rgyang grags gcig go/ /rgyang grags bzhi la ni dpag tshad gcig go/ /de la khyed kyis nang nas dpag tshad la rdul phra rab de lta bu du yod susasheshes/ srid sgrub kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu bdag nyid kyang de la mgo rmongs na gzhan blo chung ngu dang ldan pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de bas na gzhon nus dpag tshad la rdul phra rab de lta bu du mchis bshad du gsol/ byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ de la dpag tshad la ni rdul phra rab0mi 'khrugs khrag khrig gcig dang / bye ba khrag khrigashe'abum phrag sum cu dang / bye ba drug cu phrag brgya dang / bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / 'bum phrag lnga dang / khri nyis stong yod de/ dpag tshad la ni rdul phra rab de snyed cig yod do/ /de ltar 'jug pa des 'dzam bu'i gling 'di la ni 46—185

dpag tshad bdun stong yod do/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod la ni dpag tshad brgyad stong yod do/ /shar gyi lus 'phags la ni dpag tshad dgunyestong yod do/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan la ni dpag tshad khri yod de/ de ltar 'jug pa des gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di la sogs pa gling bzhi pa chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya dang / rgya mtsho chen polabye ba phrag brgyashedang / 'khor yug dang 'khor ④lug chen po bye ba phrag brgya dang / ri'i rgyal po ri rab bye ba phrag brgya dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha bye ba phrag brgya dang / sum cu rtsa gsum bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'thab bral bye ba phrag brgya dang / dga' ldan bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'phrul dga' bye ba phrag brgya dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshangs ris bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na ge'adon bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshangs 'khor bye ba phrag brgya dang /tshangs chen bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'od chung bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshad med 'od bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'od gsal bye ba phrag brgya dang / dge chung bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshad med dge bye ba phrag brgya dang / dge rgyas bye ba phrag brgya dang ske/ sprin med bye ba phrag brgya dang / bsod nams skyes bye ba phrag brgya dang /'bras bu chelabye ba phrag brgya dang / sems can 'du shes med pa bye ba phrag brgya dang / mi che ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / mi gdung ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / gya nom snang bye ba phrag brgya dang / shin tu mthong bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'og min gyi lha'i ris bye ba phrag brgya la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig ces bya ste/ yangs shing rgya che ba dzode la dpag tshad du yod pa dang /dpag tshad brgya phrag du yod pa dang / dpag tshad stong phrag du yod pa dang /46wa 186

dpag tshad bye ba phrag du yod pa dang / dpag tshad ther 'bum phrag du yod pa dang / dpag tshad khrag khrig phrag du yod pa dang / de bzhin du sbyar te/dpag tshad snying po dam pa'i rtsis kyi bar du thug pa ①la rdul phra rab de lta bu du yod ces bya ba'i rtsis de ni grangs dang bgrang ba las 'das pa ste/ de ni grangs med pa zhes bya'o/ /de bas kyang shin tu grangs med pa de snyed kyi rdul phra rab ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na yod do/ /byang chub sems dpas rtsis kyi le'u 'de bstan pa'i tshe/ rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub dang /shākya'i tshogs thams cad kyang tshim zhing mgu la yi tri rangs te ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba thob nas/ de dag thams cad kyang gos re re zhig bzhag ste gos dang rgyan lhag ma gzhan byang chub sems dpa' la yon du phul lo/ /de nas rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ / 'di ltar nyabye ba brgya na ther 'bum de bzhin du/ /khrag khrig dang ni gtams pa'i rgyudasnyedang de bzhin du/ /dkrigs0pa mi 'khrugs bdag gi shes thug de gong min/ /mtshungs pa med kyi mkhyen pa rtsis la de bas lhag /yang kye shākya dag /stong gsum dag gi rdul dang rtswa dang nags tshal dang / /sman dang chu yi thigs pa ji snyed yod pa yang / /hung ⑦zhes bya ba gcig la 'di yis rtsi nus na/ /lnga brgya tsam dag gi lta ngo mtshar ci zhig che/ /de nas lha dang mi brgya stong dag /e ma a la la zhes zer zhing ca co dang / ga zha'i sgra brgya stong 'byin par gyur to/ /nam mkha'i dkyil nas lha'i bu dag gis kyang tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag brjod do0 / /dus gsum sems can ma lus ji snyed gang yod pa'i/ /sems dang sems byung 'du shes rnam par rtog pa dag /mchog dang tha ma de bzhin rgya chung 46—187

yangs pa dag /thams cad sems kyi 'gyur ba gcig gis rab tu mkhyen/ /dge slong dag de ltar shākya gzhon nu de dag thams cad zil gyis non par gyur te/byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig khyad par du 'phags par gyur to/ /de'i rjes la mchongs7pa dang / rkyal dudang / bangasal sogs pa thams cad la'ang byang chub sems dpa' nyid khyad par du 'phags par gyur nas/ nam mkha'i dkyil nas lha'i bu dag gis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /brtul zhugs dka' thub sdom pa'i yon tan dang / /bskal pa bye bar bzod dul byams stobs kyis/ /lus dang sems ni ci nas yang mdzad pas/ /de yi shugs kyi khyad par mnyan du )par gyis/ /sems can mchog 'di grong khyer 'di na bzhugs parasakhyed kyis mthong / /'on kyang 'di ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du/ /skad cig gcig la rin chen gser dang mchod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /rgyal ba dpag tu med pa dag la mchod pa mdzad du bzhud/ /'on kyang rdzu 'phrul de 'dra brnyes pa de/ /byon tam bzhud par khyed kyis yong mi shes/ /ji tsam zhugs zhes de la ci zhig bskyed/ /'di ni mtshungs pa med kyis ༅rim gro skyed/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de gcig pu khyad par du 'phags par gyur to/ /de nas shākya de dag gis smras pa/ gzhon nu 'di la stobs kyi khyad par ci yod pa'ang sad par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya po de dag kyang dus gcig tu so so nas stobs 'gyed par gyur te/ shākya gzhon nu sum cu rtsa gnyis shig 'tshogs nas byang chub sems dpa' la brgal ba ltar chas te 'khod do/ /de'i nang nas dga' bo dang / kun dga' bo gnyis kyis byang chub sems dpa' 46—188

la stobs brgal ba'i phyir drung du phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lag gis reg ma thag tu de gnyis gas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang gzi brjid ma bzod de sa la skyel7to/ /de'i 'og tu shākya gzhon nu lha sbyinakhung rgyal can mthu snyems pa ②de stobs kyi nga rgyal dang shākya'i nga rgyal gyis ༷snyems la/byang chub sems dpa' la sngosazhing thams cad dang ldan pa'i ltad mo pa'i dkyil 'khor la bskor te/ bsgyings nas byang chub sems dpa' la stobs brgal to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ④ma brtabs ⑧shing mi rings par stangs bzang por gzhon nu lha sbyin lag pa g.yas pas bteg ste bsad pa'i blos ma yin gyi nga rgyal bcag pa'i phyir byams pa'i sems kyis nam mkha' las bskor bskor te sa'i steng du bor yang de'i lus la gnod par gyur pa med do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ de lta bu tsho/— gnod par 'gyur bas chog gis thams cad gcig tu 'dus te brgal bar gyis shig /de nas de dag thams cad nga rgyal gyis rlom zhing byang chub sems dpa' la rub par gyur to/ /de nas de dag byang chub sems dpa' la reg ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i dpal dang gzi brjid dang lus kyi mthu ma bzod de/ byang chub sems dpas reg pa tsam gyis sa la 'gyel bar gyur to/ /de nas lha dang mi brgya stong de dag e ma a la la zhes zer zhing / ca co dang ga zha'i sgra brgya stong phyung ngo / /nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod pa'i lha'i bu dag gis kyang me tog gi char chen po mngon par phab ste/dbyangs gcig tu tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag gyad chen stobs po che 'dra la/ / cig car skyes bu'i mchog la rub 'gyur kyang / /reg pa tsam gyis sa la 'gyel bar 46—189

'gyur/ /lhun po ri rab rdo rje'i 'khor7yug dang / /phyogs bcu dag na ri gzhan gang yod pa/ /lag pas mnyes shing zeg med phyer rlogashen/ /mi lus snying po med pa mtshar ci che/ /'di ni shing dbang mchog drung sdang ba'i gyad/ /dpung bcas bdud rnams rgyal mtshan sder bcas pa/ /nag po'i rtsa lag byams pa'i stobs kyis 'joms/ /bla med byang chub zhi bar 'tshang yang rgya/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de gcig pu khyad par du 'phags par gyur to/ /de nas shākya lag na be con can gyis shākya gzhon nu ③de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di dag ni sad kyang zin/ mthong yang zin gyis da ni 'phong zhig bstanasapar gyis shig (6de'i tshe kun dga' bos rgyang grags gnyis kyi pha rol tu lcags kyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs ri so/ /de'i 'og tu lha sbyin gyis rgyang grags bzhi'i pha rol tu lcags kyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugasasheso/ /de'i 'og tu mdzes dga' bos rgyang grags drug gi pha rol tu lcags kyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs nyuso/ /de'i 'og tu shākya lag na be con can gyis rgyang grags brgyad kyi pha rol tu lcags kyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs 37so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas rgyang grags bcu'i pha rol tu lcags kyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs te/ de'i drung du shing ta /snyel bdun dngar nas de'i pha rol tu lcags kyi phag rgod gekyi gzugs 'khrul 'khor du byas pa gcig btsugs so/ /de nas kun dga' bos rgyang grags gnyis kyi pha rol na tsharnga'i 'ben ⑩'dug pa la 'phangs na5)phog par gyur te/ de phan chod /6kyi la phog par ma nus so/ /lha sbyin gyis rgyang grags bzhi'i pha rol na rnga'i 'ben 'dug pa la 'phangs na du rtophog par gyur te/de phan chad kyi la phog par ma nus so/ /mdzes dga' bos rgyang grags drug gi pha 46—190

rol na rnga'i 'ben 'dug pa la 'phangs na7phog par gyur te/ de phan chad kyi la phog par ma nus so/ /lag na be con can gyis rgyang grags brgyad ②kyi pha rol na rnga'i 'ben 'dug pa la 'phangs na phog par gyur te/ thal byung du phyin nas de phan chad kyi la phog par ma nus so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' la gzhu gang dang gang byin pa de dag la la ni gzhu rgyud chad/ la la ni chag nas byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ grong khyer 'di na gzhu gzhan la la bdag gis bdungaphubazod pa'am/ lus kyi stobs dang mthu bzod pa mchis sam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu yod do/ /gzhon nus50smras pa/ lha de lta bu gang na mchis/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu khyod kyi mes rdzi)seng ge'i za tho'agram zhes bya ba byung ste/ de'i gnamasaru da ltar lha khang na spos dang phreng bas mchod de/ de ni sus kyang bdung bar yang mi nus na/ dgang bar lta smos kyang ci dgos pa zhig yod do/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ lha de blang du gsol/ sad par bgyi'o/ /de nas gzhu de blangs te 'ongs pa dang / shākya gzhon nu thams cad kyis nan tan gyi mchog gis bsgrims kyang gzhu de bdung tsho/stobar yang ma nus na dgang bar lta smos kyang ci dgos te ma nus so/ /de nas gzhu de shākya lag na be con can gyis lus kyi mthu stobs thams cad phyung ste/ gzhu de bdung 8bar brgal na ma bdungs so/ /de nas gzhu de byang chub sems dpa' la byin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas tshigazhu de blangs te stan las ma langs par skyil mo krung 7phyed bcas te/ lag pa g.yon pas bzung nas lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo gcig gis bdungs so/ /gzhu de de ltar bdungs 7pa'i tshe ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po thams cad du sgra mngon par grag 3 par gyur to/ /gong khyer gyi mi 46—191

thams cad kyang skrag skraganyepor gyur te/ gcig la gcig 'dri zhing 'di ltar ci'i sgra zhig ces zer ro/ /de la la la ②na re gzhon nu don grub kyis mes kyi gnam ru bdungs nas de'i sgra byung ba niphu'adi yin no zhes zer ro/ /de nas lha dang mi brgya stong dag e ma a la la zhes zer zhing ca co dang ga zha'i sgra brgya stong 'byin par gyur to/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod pa'i lha'i bu dag gis kyang / rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / skye bo'i tshogs phal po che de dag la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gdan las ma bzhengs brtsal0ba ma mchis su/ /thub pas gnam ru 'di 'dra bdungasakhu pa las/ /gdon7mi 'tshal bar dgongs pa rdzogs gyur te/ /bdud kyi sde bcom myur du thub par byos/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpas mda' blangs nas gzhu de dang sbyar te bkang nas 'phangasam/snyepa'i mthu stobs kyis kun dga' bo'i 'ben du rnga btsugs pa dang /lha sbyin gyi 'ben du rnga btsugs pa dang / mdzes dga' po'i 'ben du rnga btsugs pa dang / lag na be con can gyi 'ben du rnga btsugs pa de dag thams cad las thal nas rgyang grags ze bcu'i pha rol tu bdag gi 'ben lcags kyi rnga btsugs nyepa dang / shing ta la bdun dngar ba dang / phag rgod kyi gzugs 'khrul 'khor du byas pa las kyang thal te mda' de sa la zug nas mi snang bar nub par gyur to/ /sa phyogs gang du mda' de zug ste nub pa'i sa phyogs der khron pa lta bu'i khung zhig byung nas da ltar yang mda'i khron pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /de'i tshe lha dang mi brgya stong dag /e ma a la la zhes zer zhing ca co dang ga zha'i sgra brgya stong 'byin par gyur to/ /shākya'i tshogs de dag thams cad kyang ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba thob ste/ kye ngo mtshar to/ /'dis ni 46—192

bslabs kyang ma bslabs par rtsal gyi shes pa de lta bu dang ldan spru ni ngo mtshar che'o0zhes zer ro/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod pa'i lha'i bu dag gis kyang rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / skye bo'ikhutshogs phal po che de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /de ltar ngo mtshar yang ci che ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni sa yisasnying po sngon gyi sangs rgyas gdan la bzhugs④/ /zhi gnas gnamasnyen thogs shing stong pa bdag med mda' rnams kyis/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams bcom ste lta ba'i dra ba dral nas su/ /byang chub dam pa zhi ba rdul med mya ngan med pa 'thobadu/ /de skad ces smras nas/ lha'i bu de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' la lha'i me tog dag gis mngon par gtor te dong ngo / /de bzhin du mchongs ⑦pa dang / yi ge dang / lag rtsis dang / rtsis dang / grangs dang / gyad kyi 'dzin stangs dang / rgyang nas phog pa dang / bang dang / tshar dang / rgyalashedang / 'phong dpyad dang / glang po che'i gnyar zhon7pa dang / rta rtsal dang /shing rta'i thabs dang / mda' gzhu'i thabs dang / brtan pa dang / mthu dang / ca dpa' ba dang / 'gyed tsho/rnyastobs dang / lcags kyus sgyur thabs dang /zhags pa'i thabs dang / mdun du bsnur7ba dang / phyir bsdur ba dang /bzur ba dang / 'dzin stangs dang / gom stabs78dang / thor tshugs dang /gcad pa dang / dral ba dang / dbug pa dang / gzhig pa dang / gsheg pa dang / mi 'chor bar 'phog pa dang / gnad du 'phog pa dang / sgra grag par 'phog pa dang zha tshabs mche ba dang / cho lo'i rtsed mo dang / snyan dngags sbyar ba dang / lam dang / ri mo dang / gzugs dang / gzugs kyi las dang / thabs kyi dpyad dang / me'i las dang / rol mo'i dbyangs sgra 46—193

dang —/ gar dang / glu dang / yi ge klag pa'i mig 'or dang / gtam dang /bzhadarkyagad dang / rtsed mo dang / bro dang / sgeg pa dang / phreng bsnyebargyu ba dang / rlung yab g.yobartso pa dang / nor bu tshon gyis bsgyur ba dang / gos tshon gyis bsgyur ba dang / mig 'phrul gyi cho ga dang / rmi lam gyi dpyad dang /bya'i skad dang / bud med kyi mtshan dang / skyes pa'i mtshan dang / glang po che'i mtshan dang / rta'i mtshan dang / ba lang gi mtshan dang / ra'i mtshan dang / lug gi mtshan dang / khyi'i mtshan dang / shes gsal dang / sgra nges par sbyor ba dang / nga ro sgyur ④ba dang / sngon gyi rabs dang / sngon byung ba dang / rig byed dang / lung bstan pa dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / yi ge lci yang dang / tshig bsdebaswo pa dang / mchod sbyin gyi cho ga dang / skar ma'i lugs dang / grangs can gyi lugs dang / rnal 'byor gyi lugs dang / las kyi tshogs dang / bye brag pa'i lugs dang / nor gyi rig pa dang / phur bu'i lugs dang / chu'i lugs dang / lha ma yin gyi lugs dang / bya dang ri dgas kyi skad dang / gtan tshigs kyi rig pa dang / rgya skyegs kyi 'khrul 'khor dang / spra tshil gyi las dang / 'drub shur dang / brko bzhog0dang /lor nom dra ba dang / spos sbyar nib la sogs pa'i sgyu rtsal 'jig rten pa dang lha'i dang mi'i las 'das pa thams cad la'ang byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhigashekhyad par du 'phags par gyur to/ /de'i tshemosashākya lag na be con can gyis rang gi bu mo sa 'tsho nyi ma/ byang chub sems dpa' la phul lo/ /rgyal po zas gtsang mas kyang / de rim gyis bag mar blangs te byang chub sems dpa' la phul lo/ /de na byang chub sems dpas 'jig rten dang 'thun pa tsam du bya ba'i phyir bud 46wa 194

med brgyad khri bzhi stong gi nang du 'dug ste/ dga' zhing rtse la yongs su spyod pa4ston to/ /bud med brgyad khri bzhi stong de dag thams cad kyi nang nas/ shākya'i bu mo sa 'tshosam btsun mo'i mchog tu dbang bskur bar gyur to/ /de na〈 dashākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma gyos sgyug gam nang mi gang mthong yang rung ste/ gdong mi sbed do/ /de dag kyang de la bag sar mo ni zhum zhum por 'dug pa'i rigs na/'di ni rtag tu ma g.yogs so zhes 'phya smod cing mi snyan par zer ro/ /de'i tshe shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho mas gtam bde thos nas nang mi rnams kyi mdun du 'dug ste/tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'dug dang 'greng 3༄dang 'chagashepa la/ /'phags pa dag ni ma g.yogs mdzes/ /nor bu rin chen 'od gsal ba/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mor gsal na mdzes/ /'phags pa 'gro na'ang mdzes pa ste/ /'ong na'ang de bzhin mdzes pa yin/ /'greng ba 'am nyi de bzhin 'dug pa dang //thams cad du yang 'phags pa mdzes/ /'phags pa smra na'ang mdzes pa ste/ /mi smrar 'dug kyang de bzhin mdzes/ /dper na ka la ping ka ni/ /mthong dang sgra thos de bzhin no/ /ku sha'i gos ni gyon pa dang / /gos ngan gyon77dang lus rid pa/ /de ni rang gi gzi yis 'amadzes/ /yon tan ldan pa yon tan brgyan//gang la sdig pa med gyur pa/ /'phags pa kun tu dge ba yin/ /byis pa sdig pa byed pa ni/ /ji snyed brgyan kyang mdzes ma yin/ /gang dag snying la sdig pa yod cing tshig 'jam pa/ /de dag dug gi bum par bdud rtsi blugs pa bzhin/ /brag gi ser ga rtsub pa lta bur nang yang rtsub/ /de 'dra de dag sbrul gyi kha la nyug pa bzhin/ /des pa de dag gan du kun 'ong kun phyag 'tshal/ /'bab stegs thams cad lta bur 'gro ba kun gyi gsos/ /'phags pa dag ni rtag tu 'o zhos 46—195

bkang bum 'dra/ /bdag nyid dag pa de 'dra mthong na bkra shis dge/ /gang dag sdig pa'i grogs po yun ring yongs spong zhing / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po ches ni yongs bzung la/ /sdig pa rnam spong sangs rgyas chos la mngon chags pa/ /de lta bu dag mthong ba bkra shis 'bras bu yod/ /gang dag lus bsdams lus kyi skyon rnams rab bsdams dang / /gang dag tshig bsdams rtag tu tshig 'chal med gyur la/ /dbang po sbas shing shin tu bsdams la yid dang ba/ /de lta bu dag gdong g.yogs tetuni ci zhig bya/ /gal te lus la gos ni stong gis g.yogs gyur kyang / /gang dag sems bshus ngo tsha med cing khrel med dang //gang dag 'di 'dra'ikhuyon tan med cing bden tshig med/ /de dag sgron mo bas kyang sgrenasamor 'jig rten rgyu/ /gang zhig sems sbas rtag tu dbang po bsdams gyur cing / /bdag gi khyos chog sems can gzhan la mi sems pa/ /de 'dra ba dag nyi zla bzhin du ma g.yogs snang / /de 'dra ba dag gdong g.yogs te7ni ci zhig bya/ /gzhan yang drang srong bdag nyid che dang gzhan sems blo mkhas dang / /de bzhin lha tshogs dag gis kho mo'i bsam pa dang / /kho mo'i tshul khrims yon tan sdom dang bag yod mkhyen/ /de lta bas na kho mos gdong bkab ci zhig dgos/ /dge slong dag rgyal po zas gtsang mas shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma'i spobs pa dang tsobastan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnam pa 'di lta bu 'di thos so/ /thos nas kyang tshim zhing mgu la yi0 rangs te rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas/ ras bcos su7bzang po rin po che du mas spras pa zung gcig dang / mu tig gi do shal srang bye ba brgya stong ri ba dang /mu tig dmar po bzang pos spras pa'i gser gyi phreng bas shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma 46—196

la bkab nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod rga/ /kho bo'i bu ni yon tan ci 'dras brgyan pa dang / /mna' ma rang gi yon tan ji ltar rab smra ba/ /sems can dag pa de gnyis phrad par gyur pa ni/ /mar dang mar gyi nying khukhuji ltar 'dra ba bzhin/ /sgyu rtsal bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po brgyad pa/ dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na 'dug pa na/ gang dag byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las byed pa la spro bar gyur pa/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang /brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba du ma de dag rang rang gi dga' ba'i sgra 'byin cing lhags par gyur to/ /de la dge slong dag dus gzhan zhig na lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po dang /brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba mang po dag 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ ma la skyes bu dam pa 'di btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du ha cang yun ring du thogs par gyur na sems can gang dag 'dis yun ring po nas bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi po sbyin pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang / don spyadasnyig dang / don 'thun pas yongs su smin par byas pa dang / gang dag 'dis byang chub thob nas/ chos bstan pa shes par 'gyur ba chos kyi snod du gyur pa'i sems can de dag med par gyur nas/ phyis byang chub sems dpa' mngon par 46—197
