dang / rab rib dang / ling tog dang / rtog pa thams cad bsal nas shes rab kyi mig rnam par sbyang ngo zhes bya ba sngon gyi smon lam gyi tshig gnyis pa 'di mngon du gyur to/ /kye ma'o bdag gis 'jig rten nga rgyal gyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba/ ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa la mngon par zhen pa/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa dang ldan pa'i yid can/ 'du shes dang / sems dang / lta ba phyin ci log gis phyin ci log0)tu gyur pa bzung ba ngan pas zin pa la 'phags pa'i lam bstan te/ nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal bsnyal ②bar bya'o zhes bya ba sngon gyi smon lam gyi tshig gsum pa 'di mngon du gyur to/ /kye ma'o bdag gis 'jig rten rnam par ma zhi ba/ thags 'khrugs pa lta bur gyur pa/ dru gukhu'adzings pa lta bur gyur pa/ 'ong ba dang 'gro bar gyur pa/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol dang / 'jig rten pha rol nas 'jig rten 'dir kun tu rgyug cing 'khor la 'khor ba las mi ldog pa mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bur gyur pa la nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i shes rab kyis chog par byed pa'i chos kyang bstan to zhes bya ba sngon gyi smon lam gyi tshig bzhi po 'di mngon du gyur te/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi tshig bzhi po de dag mngon du gyur to/ /skad cig de la lha'i bu chos spyod dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis btsun mo'i 'khor mi sdug par bsgyur te/ mi sdug par gnas pa dang / smad pa'i gzugs su bstan nas nam mkha' la 'khod de/ byang chub sems dpa' la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ de nas lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul che rnams kyis/ /pad ma rgyas pa yangs pa'i spyan la smras/ /dur khrod dbus 'dir bzhugs par gyur lags na/ /khyod ni ji ltar dgyes bsheskye bar 'gyur/ /lha yi dbang phyug rnams kyis de bskul nas/ /46—247

yud tsam btsun mo'i 'khor la lta zhing rtog /bltas nas smad par gyur pa de dag mthong / /dur khrod gnas par gyur pa bden snyam byed/ /byang chub sems dpas thams cad dang ldan pa'i bud med kyi tshogs la rnam par bltas pa dang / kha cig ni gos lhung bar gyur/ kha cig ni skra zhig /kha cig ni rgyan brul/ kha cig ni cod pan lhung / kha cig ni phrag pa mi sdug par gyur/ kha cig ni lus rnam par 'khrugs/ kha cig ni bzhin mi sdug par gnas/ kha cig ni mig gyur/ kha cig ni kha chu zag /kha cig ni sdur/ kha cig ni lud pa lu/kha cig ni rgodanyu/ kha cig ni brdolas/ kha cig ni so 'khrig /kha cig ni bzhin mdog gyurang sku/ kha cig ni gzugs mi sdug par gyur te/ lag pa ring por gyur/ kha cig ni rkang pa phral/ kha cig ni mgo phyung / kha cig ni mgo g.yogs/ kha cig ni bzhin gyi dbyibs gyur/ kha cig ni lus ma rungs parasnyigyur/ kha cig ni lus sgren mor gyur/ kha cig ni lus bskums shing thar/ kha cig ni rdza rnga la 'khyud nas lus gan rkyal du 'gyel/ kha cig ni pi bang dang rgyud gsum pa'i steng du lag pa brkyang / kha cig ni gling bu la sos 'debs/kha cig ni rol mo'i cha byad kim pa la dang / na ku la dang / kharasnyeba'i sil khrol dang / leg la 'dzin/ kha cig ni mig 'dzums shingashe'abyed la 'gyur/kha cig ni kha gdangs par gyur te/ de ltar sa la mi sdug par gnas par gyur pa'i btsun mo'i 'khor la lta zhing byang chub sems dpa' dur khrod kyi 'du shes skyed do/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ 'jig rten mgon des de mthong yid byung ste/ /snying rjes shugs phyung nas ni 'di skad smras/ /e ma skye dgu dag ni sdug bsngal gyur/ /srin mo'i tshogs la dga' ba ji ltar rnyed/ /'dod pa'i 46—248

yon tan yod min yon tan 'dzin/ /gti mug mun pas rab bsgribs blo gros ngan/ /dper na bya ni bya rgyar chud7pa bzhin/ /nam yang 'byung ba rnyed par 'gyur ma yin// //'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bcu pa/de nas byang chub sems dpasakyichos snang ba'i sgo 'dis yang btsun mo'i 'khor la rtog cing snying rje chen po'i smre bas sems can gyi phyir smre ste/ 'di na byis pa de dag ni gsod pa ste/ bsadakyipa'i gnas su gsadakyipar bya ba gsod pa dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni chags pa ste/ ngan skyugs kyis sa gang ba'i snod ri mo can rnams la mi mkhas pa chags pa dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni 'bying ba ste/ glang po che chur bying ba dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni btsas pa ste/ btsonakhura'i nang gi btson btsas pa dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni mngon par dga' ba ste/ phag mi gtsang ba la dga' ba dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag⑧ni chags pa ste/khyi keng rus la chags pa dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni rab tu lhung ba ste/ phye ma leb mar me'i me lcer lhung ba dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni thogs pa ste/ spre'u rnyong la thogs pa dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni yongs su bzung ba ste/ nya rgyas zin pa dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni yongs su gtubs ⑨pa ste/ sha 'tshong gi gnas kyi lug dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni btsugs pa ste sdig (7pa byed pa gsal shing gi rtse mo la btsugs pa dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni 'dam du 'byingashezhing thogs pa ste/ glang po che rgan po 'dam du song ba dang 46—249

mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni phongs pa⑥ste/ rgya mtsho chen por gru'i snam bu zhig pa dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni rab tu lhung ba ste/dmus long g.yang sa chen por lhung ba dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni yongs su zad par 'gyur ba ste/ sa'i steng gi mtshams su song ba'i chu dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni du ba 'thul ba ste/ bskal pa zad pa'i sa chen po dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni 'khor ba ste/ rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo'i shugs dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni 'brog rtsol ba ste/ dmus long ri la phyin pa dang ②mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni btags shing 'khor ba ste/ khyi stong shegis btags pa dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni nyis pa ste/ dpyid kyi rtswa dang nags tshal dang mtshungs so/ /'di na byis pa de dag ni yongs su nyams pa ste/ zla bsamar gyi ngo'i zla ba dang mtshungs so/ /'di dag ni byis pa rnams la zasab ste/ klu la nam mkha' lding dang mtshungs so/ /'di dag ni byis pa rnams la 'cha' ba ste/ gru bo che la chu srin chen po dang mtshungs so/ /'di dag ni byis pa rnams la 'joms pa ste/'dron po la chom po mang po dang mtshungs so/ /'di dag ni byis pa rnams la 'jig pa ste/ shing sāphanyel la rlung mar 7chen po dang mtshungs so/ /'di dag ni byis pa rnams la gsod tshipa ste/ skye bo la sprul mig gdug pa dang mtshungs so/ /byis pa rnams ni (storo myang ba'i 'du shes kyis chod pa ste/ ral gri'i so sbrang rtsis bskus pas chod pa bzhin no/ /'di dag ni byis pa rnams khyer ba ste/ shing gi phung po chu bo'i chus khyer ba dang mtshungs so/ /'di dag ni byis pa rnams la rtsed tshapa ste/ gyis pa chung ngu rang gi gcin rtug la rtse ba dang mtshungs so/ /46—250

'di dag ni byis pa rnams kun tu sgyur ba ste/ glang po che la lcags kyu dang mtshungs so/ /'di dag ni byis pa rnams la slu ba ste/ g.yon can gyis byis pa'i rang bzhin can dag brid pa bzhin no/ /'di dag0)ni byis pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba zad par byed pa ste/ rgyanakhupo la dga' ba'i nor dang mtshungasaphuso/ /'di dag gis byis pa rnams 'chos pa ste/ srin mo rnams kyis tshong pa 'chos pa dang mtshungs so/ /byang chub sems dpas0rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag gis btsun mo'i 'khor la yongs su brtag pa byas nas/ lus la mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes rnam par sgom/ mi 'thun pa'i 'du shes nye bar sgrub/smad pa'i 'du shes skyed/ rang gi lus la yang de dang 'dra bar rnam par sgom/lus kyi nyes dmigs yang dag par mthong / lus la lus su mngon par zhen pa las skyod/ sdug pa'i 'du shes rnam par 'jig /mi sdug pa'i 'du shes 'jug par byed/ 'og gi rkang pa'i mthil nas steng gi klad na pa man chad mi gtsang ba las byung ba dang / mi gtsang ba las gyur pa dang / rtag tu mi gtsang ba zag par mthong ngo / /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang smras so/ /lus kyi zhing las skyes shing sred pa'i chu las byung ba 'jig tshogs ming du btags⑥/ /mchi ma rngul dang mchil mas brlan la gcin gyis bsgyur cing khrag gi thigs pas gang / /zhag dang rnag dang sgang ba dang ni klad rgyas dag dang sdig pa rnams kyis gang / /rtag tu ngan skyugs tsho ༄zag cing kun kyang dri ma rnam pa sna tshogs tha dad pa/ / pags pa tho)so dang skra dang spu yis bsgyur cing pags pas g.yogs la spu dang ldan/ /rgyu ma mchin pa mtsher pa chu ser kha chu 'di dag bsags pa nyam51chung ba/ /rkang dang chu rgyus dag gis thel te 'khrul 'khor 'dra zhing sha 46—251

yis mdzes par byas/ /sna tshogs nad kyis gang zhing mya ngan khyab la bkres dang skom pas kun tu nyen/ /skye ba po dag lus ni bu ga mang zhing 'chi dang rga ba'i gnas gyur pa/ /mthong nas mkhas pa su zhig rang gi lus latudagra dang mtshungs par sems mi 'gyur/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' lus la lus su song ba'i dran pas gnas par gyur to/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis lha'i bu chos spyod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po don grub 'di ni btsun mo'i 'khor la rnam par lta zhing 'dzum yang ston/ /sems ni mi dga' mig ni phyir zhing lta na phyi sholarka byed dam ci/ /yang na 'di ni rgya mtsho'i zabs dang mtshungs te 'di tshad gzung bar mi nus so/ /yang na chags pa med pa 'di yul rnams la yid7chags par ni byami 'gyur grang / /lha rnams kyis bskul ba yi yishedam brjed57par ma gyur grang / /lha'i bu chos spyod kyis smras pa/de skad smra ci dgos/ 'di sngon byang chub kyi phyir spyod pa na yang mngon par 'byung ba dang / gtong ba la rnam pa de lta bur chags pa med par gyur pa de khyed la mngon sum du gyur pa yin na/ da srid pa tha ma pa la gnas pa chags par mi 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpa' nges par byas pa/ yid byung bar gyur pa/ blo brtul ba/ tshul du shis shing rings thabs med par skyil mo krung bshig ste/ glu dbyangs len pa'i khang bzangs na shar phyogs su lta zhing 'dug nas lag pa g.yas pas rin po che'i dra ba smad de khang bzangs kyi7steng du song nas sor mo bcu thal mo sbyar te/ sangs rgyas thams cad bsams〈rinas sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal te/ nam mkha'i dkyil du bltas pa dang des mthong ba/ nam mkha'i dkyil na lha'i dbang 46—252

po mig stong dang ldan pa lha brgya stong gis bskor cing / me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / me tog gi rna rgyan dang / rin po che'i do shal gyi chun po thogs te/ lus btud nas byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi yang gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / klu'i tshogs kyis bskor cing go cha sra ba bgos/ ya lad bgos tesmyo ral gri dang / mda' gzhu dang / mdung thung dang / mtshon rtse gnyis pa dang / rtse gsum pa lag na thogs shing tshul du shis par nor bu'i cod pan dang / gtsug phud 'phyang bar byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis kyang glokhugayas g.yosaphun 'dug par mthong ngo / /skar ma'i bdag po rgyal yang nam byedakyin shar bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang byang chub sems dpas 'dun pasnyel smras pa/ nga yi bkra shis 'di ni don kun grub/ /do mod gdon mi za bar don grub kyitso/ /'dun pa phyi shol ma byed la gor du/ /rta rgyal rgyan gyis brgyan pa'angasnyeng la byin/ /de nas 'dun pas0tshig de thos nas/yid mi dga' zhing 'di skad ces smras so/ /smin ma ring zhing pad ma'i 'dab 8ma rgyas 'dra'i spyan mnga' mi yi seng ge ston ma'i zla ba nya ba lta bu dang / /me tog ku mu da dang zla ba dang ni dga' ba'i pad ma'i rdzing bu sar /1par 'jam pa'i pad ma rgyas 'dra'i zhal/ /sbyangs pa'i gser dang nyi ma shar ma thag dang zla ba dri med gzi dang mar blugs me yi 'od 'phro nor bu glog 'od 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can//glang po rgyags pa 'gying ba'i 8glang po'i stobs can ba lang khyu mchog ri dgas 46—253

rgyal dang ngang pa'i stabs can stabs mdzes shin tu zhabs legs gang du bzhud/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'dun pa gang gi don du nga yis sngon chad lag pa rkang pa mig dang de bzhin mgo dang lus btang zhing / /chung ma dang ni phangs pa'i rgyal srid nor gser gos dang rin chen gang ba'i shing rta glang po ①rlung mgyogs shugs ldan rta pho rtsal mchog geldan pa btang / /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang nas tshul khrims ngas bsrungs bzod pa yongs bsgoms brtson 'grus stobs dang bsam gtan shes rab dag /de lta mod kyi byang chub zhi ba shis pa thob nas rga shi'i rgya mor chud pa'i sems can nga miyis yongs su dgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /'dun pas smras pa/ jo jo khyod bltamasam thag tu blta ba'i phyir bram ze ltas mkhan rnams la bstan na/ de dag gis khyodasargyal po zas gtsang ma'i spyan sngar lha khyod kyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan ces bdag gis thos so/ /smras pa/ ji lta bur 'gyur/ smras pa gzhon nu 'di ni bsod nams brgya mtshan ldan/ /khyod kyi bu btsas bsod nams gzi brjid can / /de ni gling bzhi'i dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur/ /nor bdun dang ni rab tu ldan par 'gyur/ /gal te 'jig rten sdug bsngal bltas nas ni/ /btsun mo'i 'khor spangs mngon par byung 'gyur na/ /byang chub rga shi med pa'i gnas thob ste/ /chos kyi chu yis skye dgusho'u'adi tshim byed/ /jo jo lung bstan pa 'di ni mchis te/ 'di ma mchis pa ni dzo ma lags mod kyi ri bye'on kyang phan par 'tshal ba bdag gi khyatshig gsan par gsol/ smras pa/ ci zhig /smras pa/lha cig tshagang gi don du 'di na kha cig brtul zhugs dang dka' thub rnam pa du ma rtsom ste/ ri dgas kyi pags /stopa dang / ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / rtswa dang 46—254

shing shun gyon pa dang / sen mo dang / skra0)dang / ag tsomatshu ciring por 'jog pa dang / lus la gdung ba dang / yongs su gdung ba rnam pa du ma spro bar bgyid de/ bdag cag ji ltar lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa 'thob 2par 'gyur zhes brtul zhugs dang dka' thub drag po rtsom mo/ /jo jo phun sum tshogs pa de ni khyod kyis brnyes lags te/ rgyal srid 'byor cing rgyas la bde zhing lo legs te/ nyams dga' zhing mi dang skye bo mang pos gang ba 'di dang /skyed mos tshal dam pa mchog me tog dang 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/bya'i tshogs sna tshogs sgra skad yid du 'ong ba 'byin pa 'di dag dang / rdzing me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar pos mdzes par gyur pa/ ngang pa dang / rma bya dang / khu byug dang / ngur pa dang / khrung khrung dang / ngang skya sgra skad 'byin pa/ shing a mra gedang / mya ngan 'tshangasnyedang / tsam pa ka dang / ku ra ba ka dang / ke sa ra la sogs pa shing me tog chags pa sna tshogs kyis 'gram 'khor ba/ rin po che'i shing sna tshogs kyi phreng gis legs par brgyan pa/ mig mangs ris su bkod pa/rin po che sna tshogs kyi stegs bus bskor ba/ rin po che'i dra ba bres pa/ dus ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su spyad gepa/ dgun dang / dbyar dang / ston dang /dpyid gnas bde ba rnams dang / khang bzangs chen po chos dang chos bzang dang / bde ba dang / mya ngan bral ba 3)la sogs pa rnam par rgyal ba'i khang pa lta bu ston ku'i sprin 'dra ba/ gangs tirtso9༄se lta bu stegs bu dang / sgo gang dang /rta babs dang / skar trikhung dang / bsil khang dang / khang pa brtsegs pa dang / khyams kyis legs par brgyan pa/ rin po che'i dril bu g.yer rka'i dra 46wa 255

ba sgra 'byung ba 'di dag dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dang rol mo'i cha byad rgyud gcig pa dang / pi bangatudang / kharakhurnga dang / gling bu dang / kharasheba'i sil khrol dang / pheg dang / kim pa la dang / na ku la dang / sgra snyan dang / rdza rnga dang / pa ṭa0ha dang / glu dang / gar dang / rol mo'i dbyangs sgra dang / glu dbyangs sbyar ba legs par bslabs0pa dgod pa dang /'jo ba dang / rtse ba dang / dga' ba dang / tshul du shis pa dang / spyod pa mdzes pa 'di dang ni ldan la/ lha khyod kyang dar ni ma yol te0 / gzhon pa thor bu dar la bab pa/ lus 'jam pa/ lang tsho la bab pa/ dbu spa gnagashepa/ 'dod pa la ma rol ba lags kyisame/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i bdag po mig stong dang ldan pa lha'i bdag po lta bur re shig0)dgyes par rol la/ slad kyis bgres nas mngon par 'byung bar mdzod cig /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang smras so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum 'jig rten lha dbang ltar/ /dgyes pa'i cho ga mkhyen pa dgyes par rol/ /slad kyis bgres par gyur nas brtul zhugs dang / /dka' thub dag ni yang dag brtsam par mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'dun pa mi dgos te/ 'dod pa 'di dag ni mi rtag pa/ mi brtan pa/ther zug ma yin pa/ 'gyur ba'i chos can/ myur du 'gro ba/ g.yo ba/ ri gzaramatsho/nyapo'i chu'i shugs dang 'dra ba/ zil pa'i thigs pa ltar ring du mi gnas pa/ lag pa bcangs 8pa stongs pas byis pa brid pa ltar snying po med pa/ chu shing gi snying po ltar mthu med pa/ snod 6so ma btang 8ba ltar mthar 'jig pa/ston ku'i sprin ltar skad cig byung nas med par 'gyur ba/ nam mkha'i glog ltar ring du mi gnas pa/ dug dang bcas pa'i snod ltar 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal can/46—256

'khri7shing ma lukhuta ltar mi bde ba 'byin pa/ byisalgepa'i blo can rnams kyis 'dod par bya ba/ chu'i chu bur lta bur myur du 'gyur ba'i chos can/ mig rgyu ltar 'du shes phyin ci log las byung ba/ sgyu ma ltar sems phyin ci log gis rnam par bsgrubs pa/ rmi lam ltar lta ba phyin ci log gis yongs su zin pa/ rgya mtsho dgang dka'akhub ltar ngoms nimi shes par byed pa/ tshwa chu ltar skom par byed pa/ sbrul gyi mgo ltar reg par bya dka' ba/ g.yang sa chen po ltar mkhas pa rnams kyis yongs su spangs pa/ shes rab can rnams kyis 'jigs pa dang bcas pa dang / rtsod pa dang bcas pa dang / nyes pa dang bcas pa dang /skyon dang bcas par shes nas rnam par spangs pa/ rig pa rnams kyis smad pa/'phags pa rnams kyis bshungs pa pya/ mkhas pa rnams kyis ma bsngags pa/ mi mkhas pa rnams kyis yongs su bzung ba/ byis pa rnams kyis bstenas pa yin no/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang smras so/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis sbrul gyi mgo bzhin spangs/ /ngan skyugs snod bzhin mi gtsang rnam par spangs/ /'dun pa dge ba thams cad 'jig /tsho)byed par/ /'dod pa shes nas nga ni dga' mi skye/ /de'i tshe 'dun pa zug rngus zug pa bzhin du skad phyung ste/ ngu zhing de nas mig nas mchi ma zag la/ sdug bsngal 8bzhin tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha cig gang gi don du 'di na kha cig brtul zhugs rnam pa mang po rtsom ste ri dgas pags5 pa 'chang / /skra dang sen mo ag tsom skyering du 'jog cing de bzhin shing shun gyon la yan lag skams shing brtul zhugs gnas/ /sre da dang ni ldam ldum dag dang drus ma she'abras za kha cig spyi'u tshugs 'dug dang ba lang brtul zhugs gnas/ /ji ltar bdag cag 'gro ba'i gtso bo khyad 'phags 46—257

'khor los sgyur ba mchog dang de bzhin 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /brgya byin rdo rje 'chang dang 'thab bral lha dbang 'phrul bar 'gyur snyam tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bsam gtan bde ba 'dod/ /mi yi dam pa khyod kyi rgyal srid 'di ni shin tu 'byor cing rab tu rgyas la shin tu lo legs pa/ /de bzhin kun dga'i ra ba dag dang skyed mos tshal dang khang bzangs mthon po rnam par rgyal ba'i khang pa mtshungs/ /bud med 'di dag rnams kyang pi bangashedang ni gling bu dag dang glu dang rol mo'i dbyangs sgra len cing mchis/ /dga' bar bgyid dang gar dang glu dbyangs sbyar ba shin tu bslabs pa 'di dag spyod cing des pa ma bzhud cig /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'dun pa nyon cig 'dod pa'i rgyus ni sngon gyi tshe rabs dag na bcings dang btsas dang bdegs dang bsdigs pa sdug bsngal brgya dag ngas ni bzod byas 'dus byas rnams la nga yis yid byung byas ma gyur/ /sngon chad bag med dbang du song zhing gti mug dkrugs la lta ba'i dra bas dkrigs ④shing mun gyur chos 'di mi shes pa las byung ste bdag tu 'du shes 'dzin dang tshor ba po las 'das/ /dngos po 'di dag thams cad g.yo zhing 'gyur la mi rtag sprin dang mtshungs shing glog dang 'dra ste zil pa'i thigs pa 'dra zhing gsob gsog snying po med la bdag yod ma yin stong par gyur pa ste/ /nga yi yid ni yul la chags pa med kyis〈pe'adun pa rta rgyal dam pa bsngags ldan nga byin ngas sngon bsams ༅pa'i bkra shis rdzogs kyis thams cad zil gnon chos kun dbang phyug chos rgyal thub par 'gyur/ /'dun pas smras pa/ pad ma 'dab ma rgyas pa 'dra ba'i mig ldan zhing / /do shal nor bu rin chen sna tshogs rnams kyis brgyan / /mkha' la sprin tshogs dag las byung ba'i glog ⑦'dra ba/ /mal na rnam 46—258

par mdzes pa 'di la mi gzigs sam/ /pi ldir7dang ni khar mirnga dag dang sgra snyan dang / /rdza rnga dag dang gling bu glu dbyangs len pa dang / /bya bang rma bya ka la ping ka sgra 'byin pa/ /mi 'am ci yi khyim 'dra 'di yang dorasalags sam/ /su ma na dang ud pa la dang pār shi skyika /tsam pa ka dang dri mchog phreng ba me tog brgyus⑤/ /dus kyi a ga〈peru mchog bdug pas rab bdugs dang / /byug pa dam pa de dag la yang mi gzigs sam/ /shin tu dri bda' dri ldan ro bro gya nom dang / /skyu rum dag dang bshos gtsang0shin tu legs sbyar dang / /skyems kyi ro yang kha ra bcas paralorab sbyar ba/ /'di la'ang mi gzigs par ni lha khyod gang du bzhud/ /grang ba'i dus na byug pa dro ba dam pa dang / /tsha ba'i dus na tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po dang / /ka shi pa yi na 7bza' bzang po mang po dang / /de dag la yang mi gzigs lha khyod gang du bzhud/ /lha yul dag na lha rnams dag ni ci 'dra /nyabar/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po 'di dag rab 'byor pa/ /dga' zhing bde dang ldan la dgyes par rol mdzod de/ /de nas shākya'i dam pa nags tshal bzhud par mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpas ⑫smras pa/ 'dun pa ngas ni bskal pa mtha' yas dpag tu med par gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg dang mi dang lha yi 'dod pa rnam pas sna tshogs spyad kyang ngoms par gyur pa med/ /rgyal po'i sras mchog gyur te dbang phyug byas shing gang tshe gling bzhi dag tu 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur nas rin chen sna bdun ldan zhing bud med dag gitshatshanang na 'dug pa dang / /sum cu rtsa gsum dbang dang 'thab bral rab kyi lha dbang byas shing de dag nas ni shi 'phos 'dir tri'ongs sprul pa'i lha yi nang na yid 'ong dpal ldan dam pa nga yis sngon chad spyad/ /46—259

lha yi gnas su dbang sgyur bdud kyi dbang po byas shing 'dod pa 'byor pa mchog la spyad kyang ngoms ma gyur na da ci dman pa 'di la bsten pas nga ngoms 'gyur ram de ni gnas min no/ /gzhan yang 'dun pa nga ni sdug bsngal mya ngan dgon pa'i 'khor bar gnas pa nyon mongs gdug pas dkrugs shing nyam ngas rtag tu khyer te mgon med skyabs med cing / /gti mug ma rig mun pa dag na rga dang na dang 'chi ①ba'i 'jigs pa dag gis nyen la skye ba'i sdug bsngal dgra ②yis kun tu gnod cing rnam par gnod pa'i 'gro ba 'di bltas nas/ /ngas 'dir chos kyi gru bzang gtong dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs bzod pa brtson 'grus stobs can dag gi shing tshogs bsogs7te sbyar nas lhag pa'i bsam pa snying po ldan pa rdo rje lta bus brtan por gzungs btab sbyar/ /gru der nga nyid zhugs0nas bdag nyid rgal te bdag gis 'gro ba mtha' yas pa dag 'khor ba'i chu bo 'da' ༅bar che ba khro ba'i dba' rlabs ldan pa 'dod chags 'dzin khri glong ⑦'khyil dgra yis rnam par dkrugs pa rgal bar dka'aphulas bsgral7lo snyam ste nga sems de 'dra'o/ /de phyir srid 'tsho 3rnyedagrar bcas lta ba'i 'dzin khri dang / /nyon mongs srin po yod pa 'di las bdag rgal te/ /bdag nyid rgal bar gyur nas 'gro ba mtha' yas pa/ /rga med shi med zhi ba'i thang la dgod par bya/ /de'i tshe 'dun pa de bas kyang rab tu ngu zhing 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha de ltar nges par mdzad dam/ byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'dun pa nga yis nges par byas pa nyon/ /sems can dgrol phyir phan par bya phyir brtson/ /mi g.yo las kyang mi g.yo gnod pa med/ /ri rgyal lhun po lta bur brtan mi g.yo/ /'dun pas smras pa/ jo jo'i nges pa ci 'dra ba zhig lags/ byang chub sems 46—260

dpas smras pa/ rdo rje'i gnam lcags dgra sta mdung thung mda' char dang / /lcags bskol glog gi tshogs ltar rab tu 'bar ba dang / /ri rtse kun tu 'bar ba mgo steng rab 'bab kyang / /nga ni khyim la 'dod pa'i0phyir yang mi skyed do/ /de'i tshe lha'i bu nam mkha' la 'khod pa dag gis ca co dang ga zha'i sgra brgya stong phyung ste/ me tog gi char yang phab nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /yul rnams la ni yid kyang ma chags shing / /sems can dag pa snying rje snying brtser ldan/ /blo gros mchog ldan rgyal gyur rgyal gyur cig /mgon po 'gro la mi 'jigs sbyin mdzad pa/ /mkha' la rdul gnag⑧du ba mjug ringasasnyedag /mi chags bzhin du skyes mchog thugs mi chags/ /dri med yul gyi bde bas mi gos te/ /chu las pad ma ji ltar 'phags pa bzhin/ /dge slong dag de nas lha'i bu zhi ba'i blo gros dang / lha'i bu rtse ba bkod pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i nges pa rig nas ser skya'i gnas kyi gong khyer chen po'i skyes pa dang /bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad gnyid kyis log par byas so/ /sgra thams cad kyang mi grag par byas so/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpas grong khyer gyi skye bo thams cad gnyid kyis log par rig /nam gyi gungakyil bab par rig /skar ma'i bdag po rgyal dang ldan par rig /da kho na mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la bab par rig nas 'dun pa la ⑦smras pa/'dun pa dang skyo bar ma byed par rta bsngags 40ldan legs par brgyan te ma thogs par nga la byin/ byang chub sems dpas tshig de skad smras ma thag tu/de nas skad cig de nyid la rgyal po chen po bzhis/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshig thos nas/ rang rang gi gnas nas byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' 1)la 46—261

mchod pa'i las kyi phyir rang rang gi bkod pas rings pa rings par yang ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por 'ongs so/ /de na dri za'i bdag po rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung ni dri za bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag dang lhan cig tu sil snyan dang glu dbyangs sna tshogs len cing shar phyogs nas 'ongs par gyur te/ 'ongs nas kyang ser skya'i 1)gnas kyi grong khyer chen po la bskor ba byas te/ji ltar 'ongs pa'i shar phyogs nyid du gnas nas byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug go/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po ni grul bum mu tig gi do shal sna tshogs lag na 'phyang ba/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs thogs pa/ spos chu sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag dang lhan cig tu lho phyogs nas 'ongs par gyur te/ 'ongs nas kyang ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po la bskor ba byas te/ ji ltar 'ongs pa'i lho phyogs nyid du gnas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug go//rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang ni klu mu tig gi do shal sna tshogs lag na 'phyang ba/nor bu rin po che sna tshogs thogs pa/ spos kyi phye ma dang me tog gi char gyi sprin kun nas slong ba'i rlung dal zhing dri zhim pa sna tshogs gtong ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag dang lhan cig tu nub phyogs nas 'ongs par gyur te/'ongs nas kyang ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po la bskor ba byas te/ ji ltar 'ongs pa'i nub phyogs nyid du gnas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug go/ /rgyal po chen po lus ngan ni gnod sbyin nor bu rin po che skar ma'i 'od zer thogs pa/ lag na mar me thogs pa/ sgron ma 'bar ba lag na thogs pa/ mda' gzhu dang / ral gri dang / mdung thung dang /46—262

mtshon rtse gnyis pa dang / rtse gsum pa dang / 'khor lo dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / 'phang mdung la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa/ go cha dang ya lad sra ba bgos pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag dang lhan cig tu byang phyogs nas 'ongs par gyur te/ 'ongs nas kyang ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po la bskor ba byas te/ ji ltar 'ongs pa'i byang phyogs nyid du gnas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug go/ /lha'i dbang po brgyanyebyin yang sum du cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha/ lha'i me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / me tog gis rna rgyan dang / rgyan thogs pa rnams dang / lhan cig tu 'ongs par gyur te/ 'ongs nas kyang ser skya'i ④gnas kyi grong khyer chen po la bskor ba byas te/ ji ltar 'ongs pa'i steng gi bar snang la 'khor dang bcas te/ byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug go/ /dge slong dag de ltar 'dun pas byang chub sems dpa'i tshig thos nas/ mig mchi mas gang zhing byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /jo jo khyod ni dus mkhyen pa/ tshod mkhyen pa/ ran pa mkhyen pa lags na/ da ltar ni bzhud pa'i dus dang tshod ma lags na/ ci'i slad du bka' de skad stsal/byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'dun pa da ni dus la bab po/ /smras pa/jo jo gang gi dus la bab/ byang chub sems dpas nismras pa/ sems can rnams kyi don ni tshol ba na/ /byang chub rga shi med pa'i gnas thob nas/ /'gro ba dgrol zhes nga yis yun ring nas/ /smon lam btab pa de yi dus la bab/ /'di la 'di ni chos nyid de/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /sa bla ba dang bar 46—263

snang de bzhin skyong / /lha dbang brgya byin rang gi phyogs dang bcas/ /'thab bral lha dang dga' ldan 'phrul dga' dang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha rnams brtson par gyur/ /klu rgyal chu lha dang ni gzi can dang / /ma dros pa dang de bzhin rgya mtsho yang / /mi mchog mngon par byung ba'i dus bab pas/ /de dag rnams kyang mchod phyir brtson par gyur/ /gang dag gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul rab zhi spyad/ /de dag rnams kyang ①'jig rten gsum mchod pa/ /mi mchog de la mchod phyir mngon par brtson/ /sngon spyad spyod tshe grogs por gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyogs bcur lhags pa yang / /rgyal ba mngon par 'byung ba lta byed cing / /rjes su 'thun pas mchod pa bya snyam byed/ /gsang ba'i bdag po bdag nyid chen po de/ /rdo rje 'bar thogs nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas/ /lus la gokhubagos stobs brtson rtsal dang ldan/ /gsang ba lag na rdo rje 'bar ba thogs/ /lha'i bu nyi ma zla ba de gnyis kyang / /g.yas dang g.yon na rab tu gnas par gyur/ /sor mo bcu yi thal mo sbyar byas te/ /mngon par 'byung la rjes su rtog par byed/ /skar ma rgyal de 'khor dang bcas pa yang / /rang gi lus ni rgya chen sprul byas te/ /mi yi dam pa de yi mdun 'dug nas/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sgra ni rab 'byin te/ /skar ma rgyal ldan bzhud pa'i dus la bab/ /do mod khyod dge bkra shis thams cad grub/ /bdag kyang khyod dang thabs cig mchi bar bgyi / /'dod chags sel ba bar chad 'byungasami 'gyur/ /lha'i bu yang dag bskulasnyipos bskul byas pa/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus 'phags pa myur du bzhengs/ /sdug bsngal nyen pa'i sems can thams cad sgrol/ /da ni mngon 46—264

par 'byung ba'i dus la bab/ /lha rnams bye ba stong phrag mang po yang yid 'ong me tog char pa 'bebs shing lhags/ /de ni skyil mo krung bcas mchog la 'dug① /lha yis bskor cing mdzes la gzi brjid 'bar/ /grong khyer na ni skyes pa bud med khye'u dang bu mo gang yod pa/ /de dag thams cad yid ngal gyur nas nyal te spyod lam rnams las nyams/ /rta dang glang po ba lang ne tshokhukhung khrung rma bya ri skegs rnams/ /de dag rnams kyang yid ngal myur du nyal te de dag gzugs mi mthong / /shākya'i bu gang rdo rje sra ba mtshon cha rtse gnyis thogs bkod dang / /glang chen rta dang shing rta rta babs mchog drung bkod pa de dag nyal/ /rgyal po rgyal bu rgyal po'i skye bo kun kyang gnyid kyis log par gyur/ /bud med tshogs rnams gnyid log gos bral gcer bur gyur kyang yangasam tshor/ /de ni tshangs dbyangs yid du 'ong tshig ka la ping ku'i༄sgra dbyangs kyis/ /nam phyed 'das te nam gyi gungasnyel bab nas 'dun pa de la smras/ /'dun pa rta pho bsngags ldan bzang po legs brgyan legs par nga la byin/ /gal te nga la byams par sems na bgegs ma byed par myur du byin/ /'dun pas tshig thos mchi mas mig gang rang gi jo bo de la smras/ /sems can kha lo sgyur mchog gar bzhud bcibs pas ci zhig bgyi/ /dus mkhyen cing ni tshod mkhyen chos spyod gang du'ang gshegs pa'i dus ma lags/ /khyod kyi sgo bkum gtan pa dam stsal su yang chab sgo 'byed mi 'gyur/ /brgya byin gyi ni yid kyi ⑥sems pa'i dbang gis sgo yang bye bar gyur/ /'dun pas de 'dra mthong nas dga' zhing sdug bsngal de ni mchi ma 'khor/ /kyi hud bdag grogs su yod ji ltar bya zhing phyogs ni gar brgyug0snyam/ /gzi brjid ldan pas drag shul can gyi tshig smras brgya byin 'ba' 46—265

zhig0)thos/ /yan lag bzhi ldan dpung dang bcas pa 'di yang 'di na ci zhig byed/ /rgyal po rgyal bu〈rgyal po'i skye bo de〈kyedag rnams kyis 'di ma tshor/ /bud med tshogs kyang gnyid log lha rnams kyis ni grags ldan gnyid log byas/ /kyi hud 'di yis sngon chad bsams gepa'i smon lam thams cad grub gyur cig /lha stong bye ba de dag dga' ba'i yid kyis 'dun pa de la smras/ /'dun pa rta mchog bsngags ldan legs par phul cig 'dren pa skyo mi ④bya/ /lha dang lha min dag gis rnga dung rdza rnga rol mo khrag khrig byas/ /'on kyang lhas bsnyal ba yi grong khyer mchog 'di sad par yong ma gyur/ /'dun pa bar snang dri ma med la lha yi 'od rab mdzes la ltos/ /khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' bye ba mang po mchod phyir gang lhags stos/ /bde sogs rimakhyim thab brgya byin dpung bskor sgo na mdzes par 'dug pa dang / /lha dang lha min mi 'am ci tshogs gang dag mchod phyir lhags la stos/ /'dun pa des kyang lha tshig de thos bsngags ldan rta pho de la smras/ /sems can kha lo sgyur mchog 'di bzhud khyod ni rta skad sgrogs shingaposhog /de yis dbyar gyi kha dog can de mig pa gser gyis brgyan byas nas/ /yid mi dga' bzhin yon tan rgya mtsho mnga' ba'i bcibs par dbul ba byas/ /mtshan mchog mnga' zhing phan mdzad khyod kyi chibs 'di rigs bzang dge ba lags/ /khyod kyis sngon chad gang bgos lha smon lam de grub gyur cig gshegs su gsol / /gang dag bgegs bgyid zhi bar gyur cig dgongs pa'i brtul zhugs grub gyur cig /'gro ba kun la bde dang mtho ris pa dang zhi ba sbyin gyur cig /de ni gang tshe mal nas langs tshe sa 'di thams cad rnam drug g.yos/ /rta rgyal dam pa zla ba nya ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba de la zhon/ /skyong ba'i lag pa rnam 46—266

dag pad ma dri med 'dra bas rta mchog bteg6) /brgya byin tshangs pa de gnyis de yi mdun na lam ni 'di zhes ston/ /de yis gsal ba dri ma med pa'i 'od btang sa rnams snang bas gsal/ /de tshe ngan song kun zhi sems can bde ldan nyon mongs gnod pa med/ /me tog char bab sil snyan bye ba sgra byung lha dang lha min bstod/ /thams cad dga' rigudang ldan nas grong khyer mchog la bskor ba byas te dong / /skyes bu chen po song bas grong khyer dam pa'i lha yang yid ni dman par gyur nas 'ongs/ /mdun du 'dug nas snying rjer ri ngu ba'i yid ldan de yis pad ma 'dra ba'i bzhin la smras/ /khyod bral sgron mor mi mdzes cas 'di grong khyer thams cad mun pas kun tu dkrugs par gyur/ /do med khyod kyis khab 'di spangs na bdag la dga' bde bgyid pa 'di na ge'aga' ma mchis/ /slan chad bya tshogs rnams kyis sgra phyidag dang / /grags pa mtha' yas khyod ni sad bgyid pa'i/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyi gling bum snyan pa dang / /bkra shis sgra dang glu sgra thos mi 'gyur/ /nyon mongs bcom pa khyod ni gshegs gyur na/ /gdugs mtshan khyod la mchod pa bgyid pa yi/ /lha dang grub tshogs slan chad mthong mi 'gyur/ /lha yi dri yang slan chad snom mi 'gyur/ /phrengar ba btags nas zhag lon gyur pa ltar/ /khyod kyis do mod pho brang de bzhin spangs/ /khyod bzhud slan chad gzi brjid dpal ma mchis/ /gar la lta ba bzhin du bdag la gda'/ /grong khyer kun gyi byin dang stobs phrogs te / /'di ni dgon pa 'dra zhing mdzes ma lags/ /gang gis sa 'dir tsha'akhor lo stobs can du/ /lung bstan drang srong tshig ni deng brdzun gyur/rmo/ /bsod nams sdong po chen po khyod byung na/ /sa 'dir shākya'i stobs ni stobs ma mchis/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 46—267

'khorashe'adir gdung yang 'chad/ /shākya'i tshogs 'di bsam pa rab tu nyams/ /dri med dri bral khyod ni gar bzhud par/ /bdag kyang khyod dang lhan cig mchi bar bgyi/ /'on kyang thugs brtse thugs rje bskyed nas ni/ /khyod kyis pho brang 'di la gzigs su gsol/ /blo gros ldan pa khyim la bltas nas ni/ /snyan pa'i nga ros 'di skad tshig smras te/ /skye 'chi mthar 'byin ma thob bar du ni/ /nga yis ser skya'i grong khyer 'jug mi bya/ /rga shi med pa'i gnas mchog 'chi med pa//byang chub dam pa nga yis ma thob par/ /nga ni ser skya'i gnas su mngon phyogs te/ /'greng 'dug nyal dang 'chag parakhumi bya'o/ /gang tshe 'gro ba'i gtso bo pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de byung zhing / /de ni mkha' las 'gro ba'i tshe/ /lha yi bu mo rnams kyis bstod/ /'di ni sbyin pa'ikhuganas chen yin/ /'di ni bsod nams zhing chen yin/ /'di ni bsod nams 'dod pa'i zhing / /'chi med 'bras bu sbyin mdzad pa/ /sems can rnams la thugs rje bas/ /'di yis bskal pa bye mang du/ /sbyin dang dul dang sdom pa yis/ /'dis ni byang chub yang dag bsgrubs/ /'di yi tshul khrims yongs su dag /brtul zhugs bzang zhing spyod ma nyams/ /'dod pa dag dang longs spyod rnams/ /don du mi gnyer tshul khrims srung / /sems can yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /'di ni rtag tu bzod pa gsung / /yan lag nying lag gcad gyur kyang / /khro ba mi mnga' sdang mi mnga'/ /'di ni rtag tu brtson 'grus ldan/ /bskal pa bye b.rakhuskyo mi mnga'/ /'di yis byang chub yang dag bsgrubs/ /mchod sbyin dag ni bye ba mdzad/ /'di rtag bsam gtan bsam gtan pa/ /thugs ni zhi zhing rab tu zhi/ /nyon mongs thams cad bsregs nas ni/ /sems can bye ba 'grol 46—268

bar 'gyur/ /'di ni shes rab chags mi mnga'/ /rtog dang rnam par rtog ldan las/ /grol zhing thugs ni rnam grol te/ /rang byung ba yi rgyal bar 'gyur//'di ni rtag tu byams thugs ldan/ /thugs rje yi ni pha rol byon/ /dga' dang btang snyoms bsam gtan pa/ /tshangs pa'i lam gyi cho ga mkhyen/ /'di ni shin tu lha yi lha/ /lha rnams kyis ni mchod pa'i 'os/ /thugs dge dag cing dri ma bral/ /yon tan khrag khrig pha rol byon/ /'jigs pas nyen pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /mig med rnams kyi sgron ma ste/ /gnod pa rnams kyi skyabs kyang lags/ /ring0nas na ba'i sman pa lags/ /rgyal po dam pa chos kyi rgyal/ /dbang po lta bur spyan stong mnga'/ /tshangs pa lta bur rang byung gyur/ /lus dang sems ni rab sbyangs pa②/ /brtan zhing shes rab rab tu mang / /dpa' zhing thugs ni 'dod chags bral/ /nyon mongs 'joms pas dpa' bo ste/ /ma rgyal dgra las rgyal ba lags/ /seng ge lta bur bsnyengasalgepa spangs/ /glang po lta bur rab dul thugs/ /khyu mchog lta bur tshogs kyi gtso/ /bzod de 'khrug pa rab tu spangs/ /zla ba lta bur rab tu gsal/ /nyi ma lta bur snang ba mdzad/ /sgron ma lta bur gsal mdzad pa/ /skar ma lta bur mun pa bral/ /pad ma lta bur chags mi mnga'/ /me tog lta bur khrims dri gda'abya/ /ston pa lhun po ltar mi g.yo/ /dog sa lta bur gsos su gyur/ /rin chen 'byung gnas ltar mi 'khrugs/ /'di ni phung po'i bdud las rgyal/ /'di ni 'chi bdag bdud las rgyal/ /'di ni lha yi bdud kyang bcom/ /'di ni ded dpon chen po ste/ /lam ngan dag na gnas rnams la/ /yan lag brgyad pa lam gyi mchog /ring por mi thogs ston par 'gyur/ /rga shi nyon mongs 'jomasalgepa po/ /mun pa 46—269

rab rib rnam par grol/ /sa dang lha yul grags pa yi/ /rang byung rgyal bar byon pa lags/ /skyes bu mchog gi gzugs mnga' ba/ /dpag tu med la bstod pas bstod/ /khyod la bstod pa'i bsod nams des/ /smra ba'i seng ge 'dra bar shog /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' mngon par byung nas shākya'i yul dang / kau ༅ta'i yul dang / gyad yul las 'das te me ne ya'i yul gyi grong rdal rjes su dpag pa zhes bya ba nas dpag tshad drug tu byang chub sems dpa' phyin pa dang nam nangs par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rta bsngags ldan las babs te sa la 'dug nas/ lha dang / klu dang dzha/ gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i tshogs chen po slar bkye'odu/ /slar bkye nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ rgyan 'di dag dang rta bsngags ldan yang 'dun pa'i lag tu gtad de slar gtang gyengo snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas 'dun pa la bos te 'di skad ces smras so/ /'dun pa khyod song la rgyan 'di dag dang rta bsngags ldan khyer te slar log shig4 /sa phyogs gang nas 'dun pa slar log pa der mchod rten brtsigs te/ deng sang du yang mchod rten de la du 'dun pa slar log pa'i mchod rten zhes grags pa yin no/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ ji ltar na gtsug phud kyang yod la rab tu byung ba zhes bya bar yang 'gyur snyam nas des ral gris (phyogatsug phud bcad de bar snang la bor ba dang / de sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i phyir blangs te/ deng sang du yang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams gtsug phud kyi dus ston byed do/ /der mchod rten yang byas te/ deng sang phya46—270

mchod rten deshegatsugarwagyisad blangs pa'i mchod brten zhes ming du chags so/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ rab tu byung yang gos ka shi pa gyon pa ji ltar7rung gis gal te nags tshal gyi gnas nas tshul dang 'thun pa'i gos shig rnyed na ni legs ri so snyam du bsamasalgepa dang / de nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' la ngur thig dgos par gyur to snyam mo/ /de na lha'i bu gcig cig lha'i gzugs mi mngon par byas te/ rngon pa'i gzugs lta bus gos ngur smrigasku bgos nas byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du phyin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gal te grogs po khyod kyis gos ngur smrig rnams kho bo la byin na/ kho bo'i gos ka shi pa 'di rnams kyang khyod la sbyin no/ /des smras pa/gos 'di dag kyang khyod la mdzes la/ 'o ni 3)rnams kyang kho bo la mdzes so/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ kho bos khyod la bslang ngo / /de nas lha'i bu rngon pa'i gzugs lta bu des gos ngur smrig rnams byang chub sems dpa' la byin te/ gos ka shi pa rnams kyang blangs so/ /de nas lha'i bu des mos pa bskyed de lag pa gnyi gas 7gos de dag blangs nas spyi bo la bzhag ste/ de dag la mchod pa dang bkur smyo/nyaste bya ba'i phyir de nyid nas lha'i 'jig rten du song ngo / /de yang 'dun pas mthong bar gyur nas des mchod rten brtsigs te/ deng sang du yang mchod rten de ngur smrig blangs pa zhes ming du chags so/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpas gtsug phud bcad nas/ gos ngur smrig rnams bgos pa de'i tshe/ lha'i bu brgya stong dag lha dga' zhing mgu la tshim zhing yi parangs te/mchog tu rab tu dga' nas/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te/ kye grogs 46—271

po dag gzhon nu don grub rab tu byung ngo / / kye grogs po dag gzhon nu don grub rab tu byung ngo / 9)de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur te/sems can skye ba'i chos can grangs med pa dag skye ba las yongs su 'grol bar 'gyur ba nas/ rga ba dang / 'chi ba dang / na ba dang / mya ngan dang /smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang /'khrug pa dag las sems can rnams yongs su bkrol te/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu bsgral nas/ bde ba 'jigs pa med pa/ mya ngan med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ zhi ba/ rdul dang bral ba/ /'chi ba med pa'i chos kyi dbyings la 'god par 'gyur ro zhes nas/ a la la zhes bya ba dang / ca co dang ga zha'i sgra skad phyung bar gyur to/ /sgra de yang gcig nas gcig tu brgyudakhunas 'og min gyi gnas kyi bar du grag⑧par gyur to/ /de nas btsun mo'i 'khor rnams kyis gzhon nu ma mthong nas/ dpyid dang dgun dang dbyar gnas pa'i khang bzangs rnams dang / khri rnams dang / khyim rnams su tsholasnyizhing gang gi tshe ma rnyedas pa de'i tshe gcig tu 'dus nas/ bya ku rabar mo bzhin du ngud mo 'thon par gyur to/ /de na bud med kha cig ni shin tu mya ngan gyis nyam thag nas/ kha cig ni0)kyi hud bu zhes 'dzer cing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni kyi hud ming po zhes 'dzer cing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni kyi hud khyim thab ces 'dzer to/ /kha cig ni rjeshebo zhes 'dzer to/ /kha cig ni sdug pa'i tshig sna tshogs smra'o/ /kha cig ni lus deb 7cing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni mgo 'bal lo/ /kha cig ni gcig gi gdong du gcig lta zhing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni mig bsgyur cing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni lag pa brla 46—272

la debanyecing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni brang rdung zhing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni lag pa dpung par debakhucing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni mgor rdung zhing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni mgo la sa 'thor zhing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni skra 'jig cing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni skra 'bal zhing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni lag pa bstod de bsgreng nas cho ngeshe'adon to/ /kha cig ni ri dgas mo dug mdas phog pa bzhin du glo bur du rgyug cing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni gdong gos kyis g.yogs shing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni chu shing rlung mar gyis bskyod pa bzhin du lus 'khyor zhing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni sa la snyelasate ma shi tsam du gyur to/ /kha cig ni nya chu nas bton pa bzhin du sa la 'gre ldog cing ngu'o/ /kha cig ni shing rtsa nas phyung ba bzhin du blor0bur du sa la snyel ⑦nas ngu'o/ /sgra de yang rgyal pos thos nas shākya rnams la smras pa/ ci'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor na sgra chen po 'di grag /shākya rnams kyis shes nas smras pa/ rgyal po chen po gzhon nu btsun mo'i 'khor na mi gda' zhes gda'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ myur du grong khyer gyi sgo rnams chod la nang du gzhon nu tshol cig /de dag gis phyi nang du btsal kyang ma rnyed nas skye dgu'i gyibadag mo chen mo go ta sbri smre sngagasalo7'don te/ sa la 'gre ldog cing rgyal po zas gtsang ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po bdag bu dang myur du sprad du gsol/ de nas rgyal pos phyogs bzhir pho nya rta pa bkye gho/ khyed deng la gzhon nu ma rnyed kyi bar du slar ma ldog shigazha /mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan rnams kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' ni bkra shis kyi chab sgo nas mngon par 'byung ngo / /zhes lung bstan nas de dag bkra shis kyi sgor dong ba dang / lam gyi bar zhig na me tog gi char 'bab par mthong ngo / /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ gzhon nu ni lam 'di nas 46—273

byung ngo snyam nas de dag cung zad cig pha zad du song ba dang / lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa'i gos ka shi pa7rnams mgo la thogs te 'gro ba de mthong nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te②/ 'di dag ni gzhon nu'i gos ka shi pa rnams yin na / gos 'di dag gi phyir 'dis gzhon nu bsad de 'di dag khyer bar ma gyur tam snyam mo/ /de nas yang de dag gis de'i phyi bzhin du 'dun pa7rta bsngags ldan dang rgyan rnams thogs te 'ong ba mthong ngo / /de nas de dag phan tshun du smras pa/ kye 'dun pa rta bsngags ldan khrid de 'ong gis ④de la ma dris kyi bar du hur 'dums ma byed cig ces smras nas/ de dag gis 'dun pa la dris pa/kye 'dun pa gos ka shi pa 'di dag gi phyiphyir mi 'dis gzhon nu bkrongs par ma gyur grang / 'dun pas smras pa/ de lta ni ma yin te 'dis kyang gzhon nu la gos ngur smrig rnams phul lo/ /gzhon nus kyang na bza' ka shi pa 'di rnams 'di la byin no/ /de nas lha'i bu des de dag mchod pa'i phyir gos de rnams lag pa gnyi gas spyi bo la thogs te/ de nyid nas lha'i 'jig rten du song ngo de dag gis yang 'dun pa la dris pa/ 'di la ji snyam du sems/ kho bo cag shākya gzhon nu zlog tu dong na nus sam/ des smras pa mi nus so/ /gzhon nu ni brtson 'grus dzinodang brtul ba brtan pa yin te⑦/ nga bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs mkhu rgyas kyi bar du ngasheser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por mi 'jug go zhes de 7skad gsung bas phyir mi ldog ste/ gzhon nus ji skad gsungs pa de de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhon nu ni brtson 'grus dang brtul ba brtan pas slar mi ldog go//de nas 'dun pa rta bsngags 11ldan dang rgyan rnams khyer te btsun mo'i 'khor gyi 46—274

nang du phyin to/ /de nas ring ba zhig lon pa dang / rgyan de dag shākya gzhon nu bzang po dang / ming chen dang / ma 'gags pas bteg rtso)pa dang / sred med kyi bu chen po ltar mkhregs pa dang / sred med kyi bu phyed ③ltar mkhregs pa'i rgyan de rnams de dag gis ma thegashego/ /gang gi tshe de dag gang gis kyang theg par ma nus pa de'i tshe/ skye dgu'i chabadag mo chen mo go ta mā 'dirabasnyam du sems te/ bdagashegis ji srid du rgyan 'di dag mthong ba de srid du bdag gi snying la mya ngan du 'gyur gyisas)/ bdag gis rgyan 'di dag rdzing du dor tho ro snyam mo/ /de nas skye dgu'i tshabadag mo chen mo go ta sbris〈nyergyan de dag rdzing du bor te/ deng sang du yang rgyan gyi rdzing zhes ming du chags so/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gang tshe byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa dpa' bo byung / /de tshe ser skya'i grong khyer ba dag mtha' dag sad/ /kun gyi snying la gzhon nu mal na nyal snyam sems/ /mgu zhing rab tu dga' nas phan tshun tshig kyang smra/ /sa 'tsho ma dang de bzhin btsun mo'i 'khor rnams sad/ /mal du ltas man byang chub sems dpa' ma mthong nas/ /kyi hud bdag bslus byang chub sems dpa' gar bzhud ces/ /rgyal po'i khyim du dud mo'i sgra yang byung bar gyur/ /rgyal pos sgra de thos nas sa la sgyel 'gyur te/ /e ma nga yi bu gcig pa zhes ngud mo phyung / /de nas de la bum pa'i chu blugs khrus byas nas/ /shākya mang po dag gis de ni dbugs kyang phyung / /sa 'tsho ma yang mal nas sa la lhung bar gyur/ /skra rnams 'bal zhing rgyan rnams dag kyang bkrol bar gyur/ /sdug pa kun dang bral ba ring por mi thogs shes/ /'dren pas bdag la sngon gsungs kye ma legs par gsungs/ /gzugs ni gzugs bzang shin tu dri med yan lag spras//46—275

gsal zhing rnam dag 'gro ba rnams kyi yid 'ong sdug /dpal yon ldan pa bsngags pa lha mis mchod pa'i 'os/ /bdag ni mal du bor te khyod ni gang du bzhud/ /yon tan mnga' ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ma mthong bar/ /skom yang mi 'tshal rgyags pa rnams kyis rgyags mi bgyi/ /sa la nyal zhing ral pa rnams kyang thogs par bgyi/ /khrus bgyi spangs te brtul zhugs dka' thub spyad par bgyi/ /skyed mos tshal kun lo ma me tog 'bras ma mchis/ /rnam dag se mo do yang mun rdul phyag daratu'adra/ /mi mchog dam pa khyod kyis spangs par gang gyur pa'i/ /grong khyer khyim rnams mdzes pa ma lags 'brog dang mtshungs/ /kyi hud glu dbyangs rab tu snyan pa'i sgra skad can/ /kyi hud lhug lhug ga⑧yi rgyan thogs btsun mo'i 'khor/ /kyi hud gser gyi dra bas khyab pa'i bar snang yang / /yon tan ldan dang bral bas phyin chad mi blta'o༅/ /sru mo de yang shin tu sdug bsngal thob gyur cing / /shākya'i bu mo ma ngu shigasaces dbugs kyang 'byin/ /nga ni 'jig rten dag na rga shi mthar byed ces/ /mi mchog dam pa des ni sngon yang smras pa yin/ /drang srong chen po dge ba stong dag spyad pa de/ /nam byed nas ni dpag tshad drug tu song gyur nas/ /'dun pa de la rta mchog dang ni rgyan rnams gtad/ /'dun pa 'di dag khyer la ser skya'i gong song shigazha /yab dang yum dag la yang nga yi tshig gis ni/ /gzhon nu song gis slar zhing thugs ngan ma mdzad cig /byang chub sangs rgyas nas ni slar 'dir mchi bar bgyi / /chos rnams gsan5nyenas thugs kyang zhi bar 'gyur zhes smos/ /'dun pa ngu 4)bzhin 'dren pa la ni slar smras pa/ /'dun pa legs ldan byang chub sems dpa' gar khrid ces/ /mi mchog gnyen gyi tshogs rnams bdag la deg 46—276

'gyur gyis①/ /bdag la nus pa ma mchis stobs dang mthu ma mchis/ /byang chub sems dpas7slar smras 'dun pa ma 'jigs shig /nga yi gnyen gyi tshogs rnams dga' bar gyur nas ni/ /khyod la ston pa'i 'du shes rtag tu bsgom ligyur te/ /nga la byams pa bzhin du khyod la'ang byams par 'gyur/ /'dun pa rta mchog dang ni rgyan rnams khyer nas su/ /mi mchog dam pa de yi skyed mos tshal du phyin/ /skyed mos tshal gyi srungs byam dga' ba'i shugs skyes nas/ /kun tu dga' ba'i sgra ni shākya rnams la smras/ /gzhon nu 'di yi rta mchog dang ni 'dun pa yang / /skyed mos tshal du phyin gyis thugs ngan ma mdzad cig /rgyal pos de skad thos nas shākyas bskor nas ni/ /rab tu dga' ba'i shugs skyes skyed mos tshal du phyin/ /sa 'tshos byang chub sems dpa' blo gros brtan rig nas/ /tshig de la ni yid ma ches te dgar ma gyur/ /gzhon nu byang chub ma thob bar du phyir 'dir yang / /byon cing ldog par 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma yin/ /rgyal pos0rta mchog dang ni 'dun pa de mthong nas/ /ngud mo btab ste sa yi steng du 'gyel bar gyur/ /kyi hud nga'i bu glu dang5)rol mo sgra dbyangs 7mkhas/ /rgyal srid thams cad bor te khyod ni gang du song / /'dun pa khyod kyis nga la 'dir ni legs par smos/ /byang chub sems dpa' gar song sbyor ba ci 'dra zhig /sgo ni su yis phye zhing gang gis khrid par gyur/ /lha tshogs rnams kyis de la mchod pa ji ltar byas/ /'dun pas smras pa rgyal po'i dbang po bdag la gson / /dgung byed grong khyer byis pa rgan po gnyid log nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs bdag la 'di skad du/ /'dun pa rta rgyal nga la myur du byin zhes gsung / /bdag gis skyes pa'i tshogs dang bud med tshogs 46—277

kyang bslang / /de dag log cing rab tu log pas tshig ma thos/ /bdag ni ngu zhing bdag gis chibs kyi rgyal po phul/ /phan pa mdzad pa gang du dgyes par gshegs zhes bgyis/ /brgya byin gyis ni 'khrul 'khor ldan pa'i chab sgo phye/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhis ni chibs kyi rkang lag btegazhu) /dpa' bo bcibs nas stong gsum lam rnams rab tu g.yos/ /nam mkha' shin tu yangs pa 'di las gshegs gyur te/ /'od ni rab tu btang bas mun pa mun nag bsalas/ /me tog bab cing sil snyan brgya dag sgra yang byung / /lha dang de bzhin lha yi bu mo rnams kyis bstodas/ /nam mkha' las ni lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor te gshegs / /'dun pa rta mchog dang ni rgyan rnams khyer nas su/ /de ni ngu zhing btsun mo'i 'khor du phyin pa dang / /sa 'tshos 'dun pa de dang rta mchog mthong gyur nas/ /rab tu brgyal gebar gyur te sa yi steng du sgyelas/ /bud med tshogs mang thams cad rab tu brtson par ni/ /chu dag blangs shing shākya'i bu mo 'khrulobar byed/ /mya ngan rnyed pas 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur du 'ong / /phangs pa gnyis dang bral bar 'gyur du 'ong snyam byed bu/ /shākya'i bu mo sdug bsngal gyur pa mthu bskyed nas/ /rta yi rgyal po rta mchog de yi mgul nas 'jus/ /sngon chad dga' bas rtse ba dag kyang dran byas nas/ /mya ngan gyur cing sna tshogs tshig kyang rab tu smra/ /kyi hud bdag gi dga' skyed kyi hud bdag gi mi mchog dri med zla ba'i zhal mnga' ba/ /kyi hud bdag gi gzugs mchog gzugs can kyi hud bdag gi mtshan mchog dri med gzi brjid ldan/ /kyi hud bdag gi yan lag ma smad legs par 'khrungs pa rim gyis 'phags pa mnyam med pa/ /kyi hud bdag gi yon tan mchog ldan lha mis mchod pa thugs rje chen po mchog ldan pa/ /kyi 46—278

hud bdag gi stobs ldan sred med bu yi mthu dang ldan pa dgra yi tshogs bcom pa/ /kyi0hud bdag gi shin tu 'jam dbyangs ka la thang ga'i sgra skad tshangs dbyangs snyan ldan pa/ /kyi hud bdag gi⑧gags pa mtha' yas bsod nams brgyas 'phags bsod nams rgya chen mnga' ba po/ /kyi hud bdag gi bsngags snupa mtha' yas yon tan tshogs brgyan drang srong tshogs rnams dga' mdzad pa/ /kyi hud bdag gi nags mchog bung ba sgra 'byin lum bi ni der bltam pa legs bltam pa/ /kyi hud bdag gi sgra grags lha mi rnams kyis mngon par mchod pa'i ye shes sdong po che/ /kyi hud bdag gi ro bro dam pa tham pa'i sgros can pad ma'i spyan mnga' gser mdog 'dra/ /kyi hud bdag gi shin tu rnam dag tshems ldan ba zho ba mo lta bu'i tshems ldan pa/ /kyi hud bdag gi shangs legs smin legs smin mtshams bar na dri med mdzod spu gnas pa po/ /kyi hud bdag gi dpung mgo rab zlum gzhu 'dra'i rked pa e de'i zhudabyin pa rked pa skum/ /kyi hud bdag gi glang po'i sna 'dra brla ldan phyag zhabs rnam dag mdzes pa'i sen mo can//de yi rgyan rnams 'di dag bsod nams dag gis byas pa rgyal po rab tu dga' byed pa/ /kyi hud bdag gi glu dang dbyangs sgra dam pa me tog byug pa bzang po'i phyodus bzang ba/ /kyi hud bdag gi me tog spos rnams glu len dag dang btsun mo'i 'khor ni dga' byed pa/ /kyi hud bsngags ldan legs skyes nga yi khyim thab grogs po yin na khyod kyis gang du khrid/ /kyi hud 'dun pa tsho tshosnying rje med pa mi yi dam pa bzhud tshe sgron cing slong ma phod/ /do mod grong khyer dam pa 'di nas mi yi kha lo sgyur ba thugs rje ldan gshegs te/ /phan pa mdzad pa 'di ni gshegs zhes skabs der tshig gcig tsam zhig ci yi phyir ma smras/ /phan pa mdzad pa ji 46—279

ltar gshegs shing rgyal po'i pho brang 'di nas su yi phyung ba byas/ /gang gi ②phyogs gshegs nags tshal gel ba'i lha mo de yi grogs su gyur pa dpal yon ldan//'dun pa kho mo shin tu sdug bsngal gter bstan nas ni mig phyung 'dra bas mig byin cig /'dun pa rgyal ba kun gyis pha dang ma dag mchod pa'i 'os zhes rtag tu bsngags mdzad na/ /de dag rnams kyang spangs te byung na bud med 'dod pa'i dga' ba 'di lta smos ci dgos/ /kyi hud sdug pa rnams dang bral ba gar la lta 3ba'i rang bzhin 'dra ste rtag ma yin/ /byis pa 'du shes kyis bzung lta ba phyin ci log pas skye dang 'chi 'pho gnas par gyur/ /de yis sngon chad rga shi ldan pa'i 'dus 7byas dag la grogs po 'ga' yang med ces bstan/ /khyod kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs nas shing mchog drung du byang chub dam pa mchog thob gyurasku / /rdul med byang chub sangs rgyas nas ni grong khyer dam pa 'dir ni slar yang gshegs su gsol/ /'dun pa de 0yang mchog tu yid mi dga' zhing sa 'tsho 7ma yi tshig ni thos gyur nas/ /de ni nga ro 'thon cing tshig tu smras pa sa 'tsho ma khyod bdag tshig legs par gson/ /nam gyi gung thun bud med tshogs rnams thams cad rab tu gnyid ⑩kyis log ste dben gyur pa/ /de yi tshe na bsod nams brgyas 'phags de yis bdag la bsngags ldan nga la byin zhes gsung / /de skad tshig thos nas ni de ma thag tu bdag gis khyod ni gzims mal gzims la bltas/ /de tshe khyod kyi sdug pa 'di ni gshegs kyis sa 'tsho bzhengasapha zhes sgra skad chen po phyung / /lha yis tshig de bkag par gyur pas bud med rnams las 'ga' tsam zhig kyang sad ma gyur/ /bdag ni rab tu ngu zhing rta yi rgyal po brgyan /)pa bgyis nas mi mchog de la phul/ /bsngags ldan 46—280

drag shul can gyi gzi ldan sgra byung7)de yi sgra ni rgyang grags tsam tu grags/ /'on kyang lha yis gnyid kyis log⑧par bgyis pas grong khyer pa las 'ga' yang sad ma gyur/ /gser dang dngul dang nor bu rnams kyis g.yogs pa'i sa la bsngags ldan rkang lag rab tu brdabs/ /de las snyan dang 'jigs dang mdzes pa'i sgra byung 'on kyang mi las 'ga' tsam sad ma gyur/ /de yi bar skabs skar ma rgyal dang ldan gyur zla ba skar ma dag kyang mkha' la gnas/ /mkha' las lha rnams bye ba thal mo sbyar te btud nas phyag kyang rab tu 'tshal/ /gnod sbyin srin po tshogs rnams nye bar gnas shing 'jig rten skyong ba rdzu 'phrul che ldan bzhis/ /pad ma'i ze ba lta bur rnam dag dri med lag pas bsngags ldan gyi ni rkang lag bteg /bsod nams gzi brjid brgyas 'phags de yang ku mu da dang par sha lta bu de la bcibs/ /sa ni rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos shing sangs rgyas zhing rnams dri med 'od kyis khyab/ /bde sogasakhukhyim thabasrebargya byin lha yi gtso bo nyid kyis de tshe chab sgo dbye ba bgyis/ /de ni bye ba khrag khrig lha yis mdun du bdar te lha dang klu yis mchod nas gshegs/ /bsngags ldan gyis ni 'du shes tsam gyis de na 'jig rten mgon po mkha' las bkur bar shes/ /lha dang lha ma yin tshogs dbang por bcas pa de dag bcibs te bde bar gshegs pa gshegs/ /lha yisabu mo glu dbyangs mkhas pa rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan rab brjod cing / /de dag bsngags7ldan la yang stobs 'thud57byed cing snyan la yid du 'ong ba'i sgra yang 'byin/ /bsngags ldan 'jig rten 'dren pa myur ba myur bar khyer la skyo ba mi dga' ma skyed cig /'jig rten mgon po mnyes par byas na khyod la 'jigs dang ngan song ngan 'gro med par 'gyur/ /46—281

lha rnams re re zhing yang bdag la 'jig rten mgon po bcibs par mngon du dga' bar gyurakyi / /yul sa 'di na bye ba lha yi rkang pa dag gis non par ma gyur cung zad med/ /bsngags ldan nam mkha'i skabs na sna tshogs spras shing mdzes pa'i lam gnas rin chen stegs bu ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dag gis brgyan cing lha yi bdug pa snying po mchog bdugs 'di la ltos/ /bsngags ldan dge ba'i las 'dis sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas shin tu legs par sprul pa der/ /lha yi bu mos bskor cing mdun gyis bltas la lha yi 'dod pa'i dga' bas dga' bar gyis②/ /legs pa sa 'tsho ma khyod phyir zhing ma bshums dgyes par mdzodasacing mchog tu dgyes par mdzod/ /mi mchog byang chub brnyes nas lha yis byamadun du bdar ba ring por 5mi thogs gzigs par 'gyur/ /sa 'tsho ⑥mi rnams gang dag legs pa'i las bgyis de dag rtag tu bshums par bgyi ma lags/ /de ni bsod nams gzi brjid brgyas 'phags lags kyisashedagyes par mdzod la bshum mo ma mdzad cig /rgyal po mngon par byung7ba de na lha dang mis mchod pa yi bkod pa gang lags pa/ /bkod pa de ni sa 'tsho bdag gis dgung bdun bar du brjod kyang rdzogs par brjod mi nus/ /khyod kyis 'gro la phan mdzad pa la bsnyen bkur mdzad pas brnyes mchog bsam gyis mi khyab brnyes / /bdag gis bsams min khyod kyang mi yi dam pa de ni ci 'dra de 'drar 'gyur snyam bgyid/ /mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u ste bcwa lnga pa'o// //'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bcu gcig pa/ dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyi rlabs 46—282

kyis 'dun pas rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ༅7ma dang /btsun mo'i 'khor thams cad dang / shākya'i tshogs thams cad kyi mya ngan bsang ba'i gtam smras so/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpas lha'i bu rngon pa'i gzugs lta bu la gos ka shi pa rnams byin nas de la gos ngur smrig rnams blangs te/ 'jig rten dang 'thun par bya ba dang / sems can la snying brtse ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid rab tu byung ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bram ze'i ②rigs ldan gyi gnas ga la ba der song ba dang / des byang chub sems dpa' gnas par bya ba dang / zas spyol 'gronasadu bos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bram ze pad ma'i gnas su song ba dang / des kyang byang chub sems dpa' gnas par bya ba dang /zas la 'gronabadu bos so/ /de nas bram ze'i 57drang srong nam gru'i gnas su song ba dang / des kyang de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' 'gron ri du bos so/ /de bzhin du gdul ba'i be con can gyi bu 'od ldan gyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' 'gronam )du bos te/ dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rim gyis grong khyer chen po yangs pa can du phyin to/ /de'i tshe sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur khyanyan thos kyi dge 'dun chen po dang / slob ma sum brgya dang lhan cig tu/ grong khyer yangs pa can du gnas bcas shing gnas te/ de slob ma dag la ci'ang 7med pa'i skye mched kyi brtul zhugs dang 'thun pa'i chos ston pa des byang chub sems dpa' rgyang ring po nas 'ong ba /lhamathong nas ngo mtshar du gyur te slob ma rnams la smras pa/ kye 'di'i gzugs la ltos shig /de dag gis smras pa/ de bzhin du de la blta bar bgyis te 'di ni ya tshamatshan che'o/ /dge slong 46—283

dag de nas nga sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur ga la ba der song ste/ sgyu0rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur khyod las bdag gis tshangs par spyad pa spyod do/ /des smras pa/ gyesago ta mkhudad pa'i rigs kyi bus gang la spyad na tshegs chung ngus kun shes pa thob par 'gyur ba'i chos bstan pa de lta bu la spyod cig /dge slong dag ngas 'di snyam du sems te/ nga la mos pa yang yod/ nga la brtson 'grus kyang yod/dran pa yang yod/ ting nge 'dzin kyang yod/ shes rab kyang yod kyis/ chos de nyid thob par bya ba dang / mngon du bya ba'i phyir bdag gcig pu bag yod pa dang / brtun pa dang dben par gnas par bya'o snyam nas/ dge slong dag de nas nga gcig pu bag yod pa dang / brtun pa dang / dben par gnas nas / tshegs chung ngus chos de khong du chud cing mngon du gyur rkyo/ /dge slong dag de nas nga sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur ga la ba der song ste/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye ring 'phur khyod kyis chos 'di tsam zhig khong du chud cing mngon du gyur tam/ des smras pa/ kye go ta ma de de bzhin no/ /ngas smras pa/kye kho bos kyang chos de mngon du byas shing khong du chud do/ /des smras pa/ kye go ta ma de bas na chos gang kho bos shes pa de khyod kyis shes la gang khyod kyis shes pa de yang kho bos shes te/ de bas na bdag cag gnyi gas slob ma'i tshogs 'di la bstan to/ /dge slong dag de nas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur gyis nga la mchod pa dam pas mchod de/ nga slob ma rnams la yang don 'thun par byed du bcug go/ /dge slong dag ngas 'di snyam du bsams te④/ ring 'phur gyishechos 'di ni nges par 'byung ba ma yin te/ de byed pa yang dag par sdug 46—284

bsngal zad par nges par 'byung07ba ma yin gyis②/ bdag gis de las lhag pa zhigashebatsal zhing spyad do snyam mo/ /dge slong dag de nas nga ji srid dga' ba'i bar du grong khyer yangs pa can du gnas nas/ yul ma ga sgyurasayul rgyu zhing yul ma ga d+ma'i 0rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po ga la ba der song ste/ri'i rgyal po skya bo ga la ba der song nas/ ri'i rgyal po skya bo de'i ngos la nga gcig pu gnyis su med cing grogs med par lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas bsrungs shing gnas so/ /de nas nga nang par sham thabs dang chos gos bgos/ lhung bzedakyithogs te chu dron can gyi sgo nas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por 'gro ba dang / ldog pa dang / mdun du lta ba dang / g.yas g.yon du lta ba dang / bskum pa dang brkyang ba mdzes pa dang / snam sbyar dang /thang ba dang / lhung bzed〈kyedang / chos gos 'dzin pa mdzes pa dang /dbang po ma g.yengs pa dang / sprul pa bzhin du yid phyi rol tu ma byung ba dang / 'bru mar gyis gang ba'i snod thogs pa bzhin gnya' shing gang tsam du lta zhing bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi mi rnams kyis nga5nyamathong nas ngo mtshar du gyur te/ ci 'di tshangs pa yin nam/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nas/ 'on te rnam thos kyi bu'am/ 'on te ri'i lha 'ga' zhig yin nam snyam mo/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ de nas gzi brjidamatshamatha' yas dri med ldan/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid rab byung ste/ /sems ni zhi zhing spyod lam rab dul bar/ /ri yi rgyal po skyapha7bo'i ngos la gnas/ /byang chub sems dpas nam nangs 8shes nas ni/ /mchog tu blta na mdzes par sham thabs bgos/ /lhung bzed thogs te dma' ba'i yid kyis su/ /de ni 46—285

rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms zhugs/ /gser gyi sa le sbram bzhin rab dul la//sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi go bgos pa/ /skyes pa'i tshogs dang bud med kyis mthong na/ /su yang lta bas ngomasatsha3 par mi 'gyur ro/ /srang dag rin chen gos dang 'brus kyang brgyan/ /gang gi mthus ni grong khyer kun mdzes pa'i /sngon chad ma mthong sems can 'di su zhes/ /skye bo sel cingasade yi phyi bzhin 'brang / /bud med stong dag khang pa'i steng 'dug cing / /de bzhin sgo dang de bzhin skar khung dang / /srang dag bkang ste khyim ni stong byas nas/ /de dag las gzhan med par mi mchog lta/ /skyes bu mchog gi gzugs la lta gyiba'i tshe /nyo dang 'tshong 7ba dag kyang mi byed cing / /chang dad can yangashechang ni mi 'thung la/ /khyim dang srang na 'dug par mi dga'o/ /rings par mi zhig rgyal po'i khab song ste/ /de dga' rgyal po gzugs can snying po la/ /grong 'dir tshangs pa bdag nyid bsod snyoms spyod/ /lha khyod brnyes pa dam pa brnyes zhes zer / /kha cig brgya byin lha yi rgyal zhes zer/ /gzhan dag 'thabs bral lha yi bu zhes zer/ /de bzhin yongs su dga' ldan 'phrul dga'aphudang / /gzhan dag rab 'phrul lha yi bu zhes zer/ /kha cig nyi ma zla ba de bzhin du/ /sgra gcan stobs ldan thags bzangs 9ris zhes zer/ /kha cig dag ni tshig kyang 'di skad du/ /ri rgyal skya la 'dug pa 'di yin zer/ /rgyal pos tshig ni de dag thos gyur nas/ /yid ni mchog tu dga' zhing skar khung 'dug /shin tu sbyangs pa'i gser ltar dpal 'bar ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems can mchog mthong ngo / /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos mi de la/ /bsod snyoms 7byin la gar song ltos shes bsgo/ /ri yi mchog la de ni song mthong nas/ /kha 46—286

cig ri yi ngos la de mchis smras/ /gzugs can snying pos nam nangs zhes nas ni/ /mi dbang skye bo mang pos yongs bskor te/ /ri yi rgyal po skya 〉〉bo'i drung du song / /ri de dpal ni rab tu 'bar bar (snyemathong / /bzhon pa las ni babs te rkang gis song / /ji ltar lhun po bzhin du mi g.yo zhing / /rtswa —bting steng na skyil mo krung ④'dug pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu gus pas mthong bla/ /rgyal pos rkang par mgo bos phyag byas te/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dag gi gtam byas nas/ /khyod la rgyal srid kun gyi phyed sbyin gyis4// /'dod pa'i yon tan 'di spyod ma 'phyan smras/ /byang chub sems dpas 'jam po'i tshig smras pa/ /sa yi bdag po yun rings /tshe srungs shig /kho bos rgyal srid sdug pa bor nas su/ /re ba med par zhi phyir rab tu byung / /gzhon nu thor bu dar la bab dang ldan/ /lus kyi kha dog mdzes shing shugs ldan na/ /nor mang dag dang bud med tshogs bzhes te/ /bdag gi rgyal srid 'dir bzhugs 'dod pa spyod/ /ma ga d+ma'i shirgyal pos byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ bdags rikhyod mthong bas mchog tu dga'/ /bdag gi rgyal srid kun gyi grogs mdzod cig /bdag ni khyod la mnga' 'bul 'dod pa spyod/ /nags tshal stong pa dag tu ma bzhugs shig /slan chad sa gnas rtswa steng ma bzhugs shig /khyod kyi sku 7ni mchog tu rab tu gzhon/ /bdag gi rgyal srid 'dir bzhugs 'dod pa spyod/ /byang chub sems dpas 'jam zhing gya gyu med/ /dga' 'gyur phan zhing snying brtse'i tshig smras pa/ /rgyal po khyod ni rtag tu bkra shis gyur/nya/ /kho bo 'dod pa'i yon tan mi 'dod do/ /'dod pa dug 'dra nyes pa mtha' yas ldan/ /sems can dmyal 8dang yi dgas dud 'gror ltung / /mkhas pas smad cing 46—287

'dod pasatu'aphags ma yin/ /kho bos ngar snabs rul pa bzhin du bor/ /'dod pa shing gi 'bras bu bzhin du ltung ②/ /ji ltar sprin dang char pasnyebazhin du 'gro/ /mi brtan 'gyur la ji ltar rlung bzhin 'gro/ /dge ba thams cad rnam par 'thor zhing slu/ /de bzhin 'dod pa mi rnyed phyir yang gdung / /rnyed du zin kyang chog par 'dzin mi 'gyur/ /gang tshe dbang med ma rung rab gyur pa//de tshe 'dod pa sdug bsngal drag chen bskyed/ /rgyal po lha yi 'dod pa gang yinasadang / /mi yi 'dod pa bzang po gang yin pa'i/ /'dod pa thams cad mi gcig gis thob kyang / /de la chog pa med de yang tshol0lo/ /rgyal po gang dag zhi zhing dul gyur pa/ /'phags pa zag med chos kyis 'du shes gang / /shes rab mkhas pas chog pa de legs chog /'dod pa'i yon tan chog pa cung zad med/ /rgyal po 'dod pa dag la bsten byas shing / /sngan chad 'dus byas pa yi mtha' ma med/ /ji ltar mi dag lan tshwa'i chu 'thungs0bzhin/ /'dod pa bsten na phyir zhing sred pa 'phel/ /rgyal po lus la yangasheltos de mi brtan/ /snying po med de sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor bzhin/ /bu ga dgu yi sgo nas rtag tu 'dzag /rgyal po kho bo 'dod pa'i 'dod chags medakyi/ /kho bos 'dod pa mang dang de bzhin du/ /blta na sdug pa'i bud med stong bor dze+e/ /mchog zhi byang chub dam pa thob 'dod nas/ /kho bo srid pa mi dga' nges par 'byung / / ma ga dhā yi rgyal pos der smras pa/ /7dge slong phyogs ni gang dang gang nas byon/ /gang du khyod skyes yab yum gang na bzhugs/ /rgyal rigs lags sam bram ze'am rgyal po lags/ /dge slong khur gyi 'du shes med na gsungs/ / byang chub sems dpas de la 'di skad smras/ /8rgyal po shākya rnams kyi ser skya'i grong / /46—288

mchog tu 'byor cing rgyas pa thos gyur tam/ /kho po'i0pha yi ming ni zas gtsang yin/ /yon tan 'dod pas kho bo der rab byung / / ma ga dhā yi rgyal pos 'di skad smras/ ṣikhyod mthong legs par mthong ste legs pa lags/ /gang las mikhyod skyes bdag kyang de'i slob ma/ /'dod chags bral ba 'dod par spyan drangs pa/ /thugs nas bdag la bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ /gang tshe khyod kyis byang chub brnyes gyur tshe/ /chos rjes bdag la chos kyi bgo bsha' mdzod/ /rang byung bdag gi yul na bzhugs pa ni/ /bdag gis mchog tu rnyed pa rab rnyed do//de nas kyang ni rkang par phyag byas te④/ /rgyal pos shin tu gus par bskor na byas nas/ /mi dbang rang gi skye bos yongs bskor te/ /slar yang rgyal po'i khab tu zhugs par gyur/ /'jig rten mgon po ma ga d+ma57yi grong zhugs te/ /ji srid 'dod par zhi ba'i yid kyis 'dug /lha dang mi rnams kyi ni don byas nas/ /mi dbang rna ran dza muna'i chu 'gram song / /gzugs can snying po 'ongs pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu drug pa'o// //dge slong dag yang de'i tshe rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por gnas bcas nas slob ma'i tshogs chen po slob ma bdun brgya dang lhan cig tu gnas te/ de de dag la 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi brtul zhugs dang 'thun pa'i chos ston to/ /dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa' rangs7byed kyi bu lhag spyod tshogs dang ldan pa tshogs can/ tshogs kyi slob dpon/ grags pa mngon par 'dod pa/ skye bo mang pos mchod pa/ mkhas pa/ kun gyis shes pa 1)mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/46—289

rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod 'di tshogs dang ldan pa/ tshogs can/ tshogs kyi slob dpon/ grags pa7mngon par 'dod pa/ skye bo mang pos mchod pa/mkhas pa kun gyis shes pa yin dmi/ gal te bdag de'i drung du song ste/brtul zhugs dang dka' thub ma brtsams na ni/ 'di bdag la khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'du shes kyang mi skyed la/ mngon sum gyi shes pas kyang shes par mi 'gyur ba dang / 'dus byas zag pa dang bcas pa nye bar len pa dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan gyidang / ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa dag kyang sun phyung bar ma gyur gyisage/ gang gis na de la bsam gtan gyi spyod yul dag dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i dmigs pa dag mngon sum du 'gyur ba dang /'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin dag kyang 'byung ba ma yin par bstan par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i thabs shig bstan par bya'am/ bdag rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyi drung du song ste/ bdag gi pa ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan gyi khyad par bstan pa'i phyir de'i slob mar khas blangs la/ 'dus byas kyi ting nge 'dzin snying po med par bstan par bya'am snyam mo/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpasardzogadon de'i dbang du byas te/ rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod ga la ba der song nas phyin pa dang / rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po khyod kyi ston pa ni su zhig /sus chos bstan pa kun shes/ de skad ces smras pa dang / rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyis ༅byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po kho bo la ston pa gang yang med de/ 'on kyang kho bo rang gis 'di yang dag par khong du chud do/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa / khyod kyis ci khong du chud/ smras pa/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye 46—290

mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa'i lam mo/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/bdag gis khyod las ting nge 'dzin gyi lam gyi gdams ngag dang rjes 〉su bstan〈gepa thob par 'tshal lo/ /smras pa/ de ltar bya'o zhes bya ba chanas gdams ca ngag byin pa'i bar du'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyogs gcig tu song ste skyilasamo krung bcas nas 'dug go/ /'dug ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams kyi khyad par dang / ye shes kyi khyad par dang / sngon spyad tsho sgyupa legs par spyad pa'i 'bras bu'i khyad par dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la 'dris pa'i khyad par dang / de sems la dbang sgyur ba'i phyir bsam gtan la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa brgya stong thams cad brnam pa dang bcas/ bye brag dang bcas par mngon sum du gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dran pa dang shes bzhin du stan nyu)las langs te/ rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod ga la ba der song nas phyin pa dang / rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi lam las gong na gzhan 'ga' zhig yod dam/ des smras pa'i/ med do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ lhag spyod 'ba' zhig 37la dad pa yod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ shes rab yod pa ma yin gyi/ bdag la yang dad pa dang /snye/ brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab yod do snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas rangs byed kyi tshabu lhag spyod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po khyod gang du nges par byung ba'i chos de kho bos kyang khong du chud do / /des smras pa / de bas na 'dong khyod dang kho bos tshogs 'di dag la 846—291

rjes su bslab bo zhes byang chub sems dpa' don 'thun pa dang / slob dpon gyi gnas su bzhag go/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ grogs po lam 'di ni yid 'byung bar 'gyur ba ma yin/ 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ba ma yin/ 'gog par 'gyur ba ma yin/ nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ba ma yin/mngon par shes par 'gyur ba ma yin/ rdzogs par byang chub par 'gyur ba ma yin/ dge sbyong nyid du 'gyur ba ma yin/ mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpas lhag spyod slob ma dang bcas pa 'dun par byas nas/ de tsam gyis chog go zhes bya ba nas chog par byas te song ba'i bar du'o/ /de'i tshe lnga sde bzang po rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyodanyelas tshangs par spyad pa spyod pa de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag gis 'di'i phyir yun ring por btsal gru cing brtson par byas kyang mtha' dang mu khong du chud par ma nus kyi/ dge sbyong go ta mas tshegs chung ngus khong du chud cing mngon du byas la de de yang mi 'dod cing / de las gong du tshol ba las the tshomasamed par de ni 'jig rten gyi ston par 'gyur ro/ /gang des mngon du byed par 'gyur ba de bdag cag la yang 'ged ④par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de0ltar dpyad nas lnga sde sbyo gebazang pos hurangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyi drung nas dong ste/byang chub sems dpa'i phyi bzhin 'brang ngo / /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' ji srid dga' ba'i bar du rgyal po'i khab tu gnas nas lnga sde bzang po dang lhan cig tu yul ma ga sgyur7yul rgyu zhing song song ngo / /yang de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab dang / ri ga lha'i bar na tshogs gzhan dag cig dus ston byed de / tshogs de dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' lnga sde bzang po dang lhan 46—292

cig tu gnas par0bya ba dang / zas la 'gron⑧du bos so/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpa' yul ma ga sgyur0yul rgyu zhing yul ma ga d+ma'i geri ga āsnyeg la ba der song ste/ der phyin par gyur to/ /ri ga lnga'i rtse mo der byang chub sems dpas spong ba'i phyir gnas te/ de der gnas pa'i tshe/ sngon ma thos pa dang / sngon mi shes pa'i dpe gsum mngon du gyur to/ /gsum gang zhe na/ dge sbyong dang bram ze gang la la 'dod pa dag las lus dben par mi gnas 'dod pa dag las sems dben par mi gnas shing / de dag gi 'dod pa la dga' ba dang / 'dod pa la chags pa dang / 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / 'dod pa la brkamanyepa dang / 'dod pa la yongs su gdung ba dang /'dod pa la zhen pa gang yin pa de ni nye bar zhi ba ma yin la/ de dag bdag nyid kyis gnod pa7byed cing lus la gdung bar byed pas/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po mi bzad pa tsha ba myong ste/ 'on kyang de dag mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa/ 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du byed mi nus so/ /'di lta ste dper na skyes 31bu zhig me 'dod la shing rlon pa'i gtsub stan dang / shing rlon pa'i gtsub shing thogs la chur bcug ste gtsubs na des me phyin par mi nus so/ /de bzhin du dge sbyong dang / bram ze de dag 'dod pa rnams las lus dben par mi gnas/mi 'dod pa rnams las sems dben par mi gnas dze+e/ de dag nyunyegi 'dod pa la dga' ba dang / 'dod pa la sred pa dang / 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / 'dod pa la brkam 3/pa dang / 'dod pa la yongs su gdung ba dang / 'dod pa la brgyal ba dang /'dod pa la zhen pa gang yin pa de ni nye bar zhi ba ma yin gyi/ de dag bdag 46—293

nyid kyis gnod par byed cing / lus la gdung bar byed pas/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po mi bzad 0)pa tsha ba myong mod kyi 'on kyang de dag mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du byed mi nus so snyam ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' la dpesamangon du gyur pa dang po'o/ /yang de 'di snyam du sems te/ gang dge sbyong dang / bram ze 'di dag 'dod pa rnams las lus dang sems dben par gnas kyang / de dag gi 'dod pa la dga' ba zhes bya ba nas me tshol ba zhes bya ba'i bar du thams cad snga ma bzhin du sbyar te/ des shing rlon pa'i gtsub stan thogs la thang la bzhag ste/shing rlon pa'i gtsub shing gis gtsubs na des me phyin ③par mi nus so/ /de bzhin du gang dge sbyong dang bram ze 'di dag ces bya ba nas thams cad snga ma bzhin du sbyar te/ mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du bya bar mi nus so snyam stetsho/ 'di ni sngon ma thos shing mi shes pa'i dpe mngon du gyur pa gnyis pa'o/ /gzhan yang gang dge sbyong dang / bram ze 'di dag 'dod pa rnams las lus dang sems dben par gnas shing / de dag gi 'dod pa la dga' ba zhes bya ba nas/ thams cad de bzhin du sbyar te de dag gi de ni nye bar zhi ba yin te/ de dag bdag nyid kyis gnod pa mibyed cing lus la gdung bar byed pas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po mi bzad pa myong mod kyi 'on kyang de dag mi'i chos bla ma las namachog tu gyur pa/'phags pa ye shes mngon du mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du bya bar nus so/ /'di lta ste dper na skyes dbu zhig me 'dod cing 'od 'dod pa dang / 'od tshol7bar gyur la/ des shing skam po'i gtsub tshistan dang / gtsub shing thogs shing 46—294

thang la bzhag ste gtsubs na①/ des me dbyungakheb dang 'od 'bar bar mibyed nus so/ /de bzhin du gang dge sbyong dang bram ze 'di dag ces bya ba nas/tshor ba myong zhes bya ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin te/ 'on kyang desami'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du bya bar nus so snyam ste/ 'di ni sngon ma thos shing sngon mi shes pa'i dpe gsum pa'o/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpa' de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag kyang da ltar 'dod pa rnams las lus dben par gnas/ 'dod pa rnams las sems dben par gnas la/ bdag gi 'dod pa la dga' ba zhes bya ba nas thams cad snga ma bzhin du sbyar te/ bdag gi de yang nye bar zhi ba yin la bdag nyid kyis gnod par ④byas shing lus la gdung bar byed pas sdug bsngal zhes bya ba nas tshor ba myong zhes bya ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin du sbyar te/ 'on kyang bdag mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du bya bar nus so snyam mo/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' ji srid dga' ba'i bar du ga lnga'i rir ga yā'ishertse mo la gnas te/rkang gis yul rgyu zhing sde dpon gyi grong lteng gergyas ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / de na klung ne+e ran dza spun chu gsal ba 'bab stegs bde ba/ shing dang shing gel pa mdzes pa dag gis brgyan pa nye 'khor na spyod yul gyi grong yod pa mthong ste/ de la byang chub sems dpa' yid shin tu dga' bar gyur nas 'di snyam du sems te/ e ma'o sa phyogs 'di ni mnyam shing nyams dga' ba/ nang du yang dag 'jog dang 'thun pa ste/ rigs kyi bu spong ba don du gnyer ba la ni 'dis chog go/ /bdag kyang spong ba don du gnyer ba yin gyis07bdag 'di 46—295
