nyid du gnas par bya'o snyam mo/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag ni 'dzam bu'i0gling 'dir snyigs ma lnga'i dus la bab cingasnyesems can rnams dman pa la mos pa dang / mu stegs can gyi sdes gang ba dang / lta ba sna tshogs la zhugs pa dang / lus la ril por 'dzin pa la zhen pa'i tshe 'ongs te/ blun po dag gdung bsasheyongs su gdung ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis dag pa tshol zhing ston pa 'di lta ste/ sngags spyod pa dang lag pa la ldag pa dang / mi slong ba dang / mi smra ba dang / rtsa ba du ma za ba dang / sha dang nya mi za ba dang / dbyar mi 'byung ba dang / chang dang / phub ma dang / chu yongs su spangs pa dang / khyim gcig dang / gsum dang / lnga dang bdun nas zas len pa dang / rtsa ba dang / 'bras bu dang / nya rtsibasasnyidang / rtswa ku sha dang / lo ma dang / ba lang gi lci ba dang / ba'i gcin0dang / 'o thug dang / zho dang / mar dang / bu ram dang / ma brtags pa za zhing 'thung ba dang / bya ngang pa dang / phug ron gyis zos te bor ba bkrus te za ba dang / grong dang dgon pas 'tsho ba dang / ba lang gi brtul zhugs dang / ri dgas dang / khyi dang / phag dang / spre'u dang / glang po che'i brtul zhugs dang / 'greng ba dang / mishesmra ba dang / dpa' bo'i tshul du 'dug pa dang / kham gcig za ba dang / kham7bdun gyi bar du za ba dang /zas lan gcig za ba dang / nyin zhag gcig za ba rnyedang / bzhi dang lnga dang drug gi skabs skabs su za ba dang / zla ba phyed dang / zla ba gcig za bar byed pa dang / zla ba la lta ba dang / bya rgod dang / lug pa'i gshog pa thogs pa dang / shing leb dang / rtswa mun dza dang / zar ma'i shun pa 46—296

dang / rtswa drar banyedang / gres mim dang / rnga bal gyi la ba dang / ra bal gyi la ba dang / skra'i la ba dang / ko lpags gyon pa dang / gos gsher ba dang / stegs bu'i steng dang / chu'i nang na nyal ba dang / thal ba dang /rdo dang / gyo mo dang / shing leb dang / tsher ma dang / rtswa dang / gtun shing gi steng du nyal ba dang / mgo thur du bstan pa dang / tsog tsog por 'dug pa dang / thang la nyal ba dang / gos gcig dang / gos gnyis dang /gsum dang bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug dang / bdun dang / gos mang po srel ba dang / gcer burasa'adug pa dang / 'khru ba dang / mi 'khru ba'i cho ga can dang / spa dang / sen mo dang / ag tsom0ring por 'jog pa dang /ral pa'i thorashetshugs 'chang ba dang / rgya shug dang / til dang / 'bras 'bru gcig za ba dang / thal ba dang / snag tsa dang / me tog spyad spyad pa dang rdul 'thul ba dang / rdul nag po dang / phyag dar dang / rdzab kyis lus la skud pa dang / ba spu dang / mi'i thod pa dang / skra dang / sen mo dang / tshal bu'i smad g.yogs dang / rdzab dang / keng rus thogs pa dang /chu dron po dang / 'bras kyi khu ba du —la bar btsags7pa dang / khrud ma 'thung ba dang / mdag ma dang / tshon rtsi dang / gos5)bur smrig dang / khar ba gsum dang / mgo 'dreg pa dang / ril ba dang / mi'i thod pa dang /khri'i zur shing 'chang bas blun po rnams dag par khong du chud do/ /du ba rngub pa dang / me rngub pa dang / nyi ma la lta ba dang / gdung ba lnga byed pa dang /rkang pa gcig dang / lag pa gcig bstod pa dang / rkang pa gcig btsugs pa dang / gnas gcig na 'dug pas dka' thub la sogs pa dang / phub ma 46—297

la sogs pa dang / mdag ma /bsregs pa dang / bum pa bsregs pa dang /rdo bsregs pa dang / me 'bar bar 'jug pa dang / zas mi za ba dang / mya ngan⑧dang / 'bab stegs su song ste shi bas sdug pa'i 'gro ba tsholasalo rab bsngags 4zhes bya ba dang / gzhi mi 'grib pa zhes bya ba dang / gzhi srung zhes bya ba dang / gzhi tshugs zhes bya ba dang / smon lam dang / bstod pa dang /sbyin sregashedang / dbab pa dang / sngags kyi bzlas brjod dang / klag pa 'dzin cing byed pas dag par khong du chud do/ /bdag dag par sems shing de dag la rten ⑦te/ 'di lta ste tshangs pa dang / dbang po dang / gu lang dang /khyab 'jug dang / lha mo dang / gzhon nu dang / ma mo dang / ka t+ya'i〈bu dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / rnam thos kyi bu dang / chu lha dang / nor can gyi bu dang / tha skar gyi bu dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang ske/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / grul bum dang / yi dgas dang ske/ 'khor dang / tshogs dang / mtshun dang / sha za dang / lha'i drang srong dang / rgyal po'i drang srong dang / tshangs pa'i drang srong dag la phyag 'tshal zhing de dag la snying por 'du shes so/ /sa dang / chu dang / me dang /rlung dang / nam mkha' la yang rten1/ ri dang / ri bul dang / klung dang /chu mig dang / mtsho dang / mtshe'u dang / rdzing dang / rgya mtsho dang / lteng ka dang / khron pa dang / rdzing bu dang /7 shing dang / shing gel pa dang /'khri shing dang / rtswa dang / sdong dum dang / lhas dang / dur khrod dang /bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dang / srang dag la yang rtenal to/ /khang pa dang /46wa 298

ka ba dang / rdo ba0)dang / tho ba dang / ral gri dang / gzhu dang / dgra sta dang / mda' dang / mdung thung dang / rtse gsum pa dag la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /zho dang / mar dang / yungs kur ②dang / nas dang / shing bal gyi phreng ba dang / rtswa drar ba dang / nor bu dang / gser dang /dngul la sogs pa la bkra shis par 'dzin te/ gzhan mu stegs can 'di dag 'khor bas 'jigs skrag nas rnam pa de lta bu dag byed cing rten 4to/ /'di na kha cig bdag cagashegi mtho ris dang thar pa yang 'di lta bu dag las 'grub po snyam du sems te/ de ltar log pa'i lam du song bas skyabs ma yin pa la skyabs su 'du shes shing / bkra shis ma yin pa la bkra shis par 'du shes la/ dag pa ma yin pa la dag par sems kyis bdag gis ci nas kyang pas kyi nyargol ba thams cad tshar bcad par 'gyur ba dang / sems can las dang bya ba chud zos pa rnams kyi las dang bya ba chud mi za ba bstan par bya ba dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha bsam gtan spyod yul pa rnams la bsam gtan gyi khyad par bstan pas 'dun par byed pa de lta bu'i brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub kyi khyad par brtsam mo snyam mo/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpas de snyam du bsams nas lo drug tu brtul sazhugs dang dka' thub shin tu drag po shin tu spyad par dka' ba/ shin tu bya bar 97dka' ba'i dka' ba spyad par brtsams so/ /ci'i phyir dka' ba spyad pa zhes bya zhe na/ de ni spyad par dka' ba ste/de bas na dka' brtso spyad pa zhes bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa gang bsam gtan mkha' khyab la snyoms par zhugs pa ma gtogs par sems can gyi ris na mi'am mi ma yin pa sus kyang dka' ba spyad pa de lta bu spyod par nus 46—299

pa med do/ /ci'i phyir mkha' khyab ces bya zhe7na/ de dang po nyid du bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba nye bar 'gog kun tu 'gog ste/ bsam gtan de ni rtog pa med/ rnam par rtog pa med/ g.yo ba med/ sems pa med/ 'gyur ba med cing thams cad du rjes su song ba/ thams cad la mi rten⑧pa ste/ bsam gtan de la sngon slob pa'am/mi slob pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas sam/ spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sus kyang snyoms par ma zhugs so/ /mkha' zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' ste/khyab par mi byed pa byed pasamed pa/ rnam par mi 'thor ba ste/ des thams cad khyab par byed pas na/ bsam gtan de nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de bas na mkha' khyab ces bya'o/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten pasnyernams la ngo mtshar yang dag par bstan par bya ba dang / mu stegs can rnams kyi rgyags pa gzhil ba dang / phas kyisargol ba rnams tshar gcod pa dang / lha rnams 'dun par bya ba dang / sems can chad pa dang /rtag par smra bzhu/ las dang bya ba chud zos pa rnams las dang bya ba la gzud pa dang / bsod nams kyi 'bras bu brjod pa dang / ye shes kyi 'bras bu yang dag par bstan pa dang / bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnam par dbye ba dang /lus kyi stobs dang / mthu yang dag par bstan pa dang / sems kyi dpa' ba yang dag par bskyed pa'i phyir/ byi dor ma byas pa'i sa tha mal pa la skyil mo krung bcas te 'dug go/ /'dug nas rang gi lus sems kyis tshar bcad cing gzir to / /dge slong dag de nas nga dgun gyi tshes0)brgyad pa'i nub mo de ltar lus tshar bcad cing gzir bas/ mchan khung nas kyang rngul byung ste zags/ dpral 46—300

ba nas kyang rngul byung ste zags nas sa la lhung ste zil par chags nas dro zhing rlangs pa⑥byung ngo / /'di lta ste dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas skyes bu shin tu nyam chung ba zhig mgrin ③pa nas bzung ste btsir ba de bzhin du dge slong dag lus 'di sems kyis tshar bcad cing gzir na mchan khung nas kyang rngul byung zhing zags/ dpral ba nas kyangasardul byung zhing zags nas sa la lhung ste/zil par chags nas dro zhing rlangs pa byung ④ngo / /dge slong dag de nas ngas 'di snyam du sems te⑤/ bdag gis rtso)bsam gtan mkha' khyab la bsam gtan du bya'o snyam nas/ dge slong dag de nas ngas bsam gtan mkha' khyab la bsam gtan du byas pa dang / kha dang sna nas dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba 'gags par gyur te⑦/ rna ba'i bu ga gnyis nas sgra drag po chen po byung ngo / /'di lta ste dper na/ spud pa bus pa'i tshe sgra drag po dang / sgra chen po byung ba de bzhin du dge slong dag kha dang sna nas dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba 'gags par gyur pa dang / rna ba'i bu ga gnyis nas sgra drag po dang / sgra chen po byung ngo / /dge slong dag de nas ngas 'di snyam du bsams te ⑧yang bdag gis bsam gtan mkha' khyab la bsam gtan du 3)bya'o snyam pa dang / de nas nga'i kha dang sna dang rna ba 'gags par gyur to/ /de dag 'gags pa dang / rlung gong du mgo'i thod pa la gnod par gyur to/ /dge slong dag 'di lta ste dper na skyes bu zhig gis mdung thung rtul pos mgo'i thod pa la btab /nyapa de bzhin du dge slong dag kha dang sna dang rna ba'i dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba 'gags pa dang gong du mgo'i thod pa la gnod par gyur to/ /der lha'i bu gcig cogis byang chub sems dpa' na ba de mthong nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye trima'o kyi hud 46—301

gzhon nu don grubatu'adi 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /gzhan zhig gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di 'chi ba'i dus byas pa ma yin gyi dgra bcom pa bsam gtan la gnas pa rnams kyi tshul ni de lta bu'o⑧zhes smras nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /mi yi dbang po shākya'i sras po 'di/ /brnag pa ma rdzogs don kyang ma mdzad cing / /'jig rten gsum po sdug bsngal mgon med par/ /mdzad nas dgon⑧'dir grongs par mi 'gyur grang / /kyi hud sems can snying po thugs dam brtan/ /mgon pos sngan chad bdag cag dga' ldan du/ /dam chos mchod sbyin la ni 'gron du bos/ /sems can dag khyod dam bcas de ga re/ /de nas lha de sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i nang du song ste lha mo sgyu 'phrul la gzhon nu ni 'chi ba'i dus byas so zhes don de brjod do/ /de nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul lha'i bu mo'i tshogs kyis bskor nas/ nam phyed tsam na klung rna ran dza na'i 'gram ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ba dang —/ des byang chub sems dpa' lus skams shing 'chi ba'i dus byas pa dang 'dra ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas mchi mas brnangasanyeshing dus nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /lum bi ni zhes bya ba'i tshal du nga bu btsas pa'i tshe/ /seng ge bzhin du 'dzin pa med par gom bdun khyod nyid song ske/ /phyogs bzhir bltas shing 'di ni nga yi skye ba tha ma zhes/ /khyod kyis tshig snyan smras pa de yang khyod la yong ma rdzogs/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas 'gyur zhes drang srong nag pos bstan pa yi/ /de yi lung bstan pa yang nyams la mi rtag des ma mthong / /bus ni yid dga' 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal yang ma myong la//byang chub kyang ni rjes su ma thob tshul 8du shi bar gyur/ /bu phyir su la bsgrub 46—302

phyir sdug bsngal su yi gan du mdud/ /bdag gi bu gcig cung zad gson pa'i srog ni su yis sbyin/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ shin tu snying rje bar ni ngu byed cing / /spa yang bshig la mdzes pa rnams bor ba/ /shin tu bu yi smre sngags 'don byed la/ /sa steng 'dug cing 'greng ba 'di su zhig /lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyis smras pa/ /bdag gis 1)zla ba bcu bar du/ /rdo rje 'dra ba mngal du bcangs/ /bu de'i ma ni7bdag yin te/ /rab tu sdug bsngal rnam par rjeX/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ma'i dbugs 'byin cing smras pa/ bu la byams pa khyod kyi ngal ba0'bras bu yod par byasage/ ma 'jigs shig /sangs rgyas par bya ba'i phyir yongs su btang ba ni don yod pa ste/ drang srong nag pos4)bstan pa yang mngon du gsal bar bya'o/ /mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa yang mngon du gsal bar bya'o/ /sa ni rnam brgyar 'thor bar 'gyur yang srid/ /rin chen rtse mo lhun po chur 'phyo srid/ /nyi zla skar tshogs sa la lhungaku'agyur srid/ /so so'i skye bo yin yang nga mi 'phro/ /de phyir 'di la mya ngan khyod ma byed/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub sangs rgyas mthong / /lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyis thos ma thag tu rab turwarnyadaga' ste ba spu g.yos nas byang chub sems dpa' la me tog man rā ra bas gtor te/ lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ lha'i sil snyan dkrol zhing / rang gi gnas ga la ba der song ngo / dge slong dag ngas 'di snyam du bsams dze+e/ dge sbyong dang bram ze gang dag kha cig zas chung ngus dag par sems pa yod kyis/ ngas kyang zas chung ngu la nan tan bya'o snyam mo/ /dge slong dag ngas mngon par shes te/ zas su rgya shug 'bru gcig77bu kho na ste gnyis su med par zos so/ /dge slong dag khyed kyi blo 'di snyam du 46—303

de'i tshe'iturgya shug che ba snyam du sems par gyur na de ltar mi blta ste de'i che'ilgergya shug kyang 'di nyid tsam mo/ /dge slong dag ngas zas sukhurgya shug 'bru gcig pu kho na ste gnyis su med pa zos pas lus shin tu nyam chung zhing rid par gyur to/ /dge slong dag 'di lta ste dper na ldum ༅bu a si ta ku'i tshigs pa dang /ka li ma'i tshigs pa ci 'dra bar nga'i yan lag dang nying lag rnams kyang de 'dra bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na srog chags kur ka ta ku'i rtsib logs ci 'dra b.rarnyunga'i rtsib logs kyang de 'dra bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na bzhon pa'i bres khang ngam/ glang po'i bres khang rnying pa ngos gnyis zhigs〈kyepa ni gdung rten gyi bar snang zhing mngon no/ /de bzhin du nga'i rtsib logs gnyis ka nas lus kyi nang snang zhing mngon no/ /'di lta ste dper na lan bur blas pa ni mthon dman dang mnyam pa dang mi mnyam par gyur to/ /de bzhin du nga'i sgal tshigs kyang mthon dman dang mnyam pa dang mi mnyam par gyur to13/ /'di lta ste dper na ku ba kha bo tsho/megazhon nur bcad pa ni rnyis pa dang / kun tu rnyis pa dang rtsum rtsum por 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du nga'i mgo yang rnyis pa dang kun tu rnyis ༅pa dang rtsum rtsum por gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na sos ku'i zla ba tha ma la khron pa'i skar ma dma' bar song ste tshegs chen pos snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du nga'i mig gi 'bras bu yang khung du song ste tshegs chen pos tsosnang bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na nga'i 8rkang pa'am rnga mo'i rkang pa ci 'dra bar nga'i mchan khung dang lto dang brang la sogs pa yang des 'dra bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag de nas nga gang gi tshe lag pas lto ba tsho/3la byug go snyam na skal tshigs nyid la reg go/ /ldang ngo snyam nas langs na yang de bzhin du skur por gyur te 'gyel 46wa 304

to/ /sha thang ste langs nas rdul gyis lus yoganyepa lag pas phyis pa dang / ba spu rul ba thams cad lus las lhags so/ /gang sngon nga kha dog mdzes shing 'jam par gyur pa de yang 'di ltar bdag nyid spong ba rtsub por btang bas med par gyur to/ /nga'i spyod yul gyi grongakun gnas pa'i skye bo nyen kor (ri ba rnams kyang nga la 'di ltar/ e ma'o dge sbyong go ta ma ni gnagasnyigo/ /e ma'o dge sbyong gi ta ma ni sngo bsangs so/ /e ma'o dge sbyong go ta ma nishenya mang kulo ra'i mdog 'dra'o/ /sngon 'di'i mdog mdzes pa gsal bar gyur pa de yang med par gyur to snyam du shes so/ /dge slong dag ngas 'di snyam du bsams tephubadag gis de bas kyang zas chung tsu)ngu la nan tan bya'o snyam mo/ /dge slong dag ngas ⑩mngon par shes te/ ngas (1zas su 'bras 'bru gcig pu kho na ste/gnyis su med pa zos so/ /dge slong dag khyodarwa 'di snyam du de'i tshe'i 'bras che ba snyam du sems par gyur na de ltar mi blta ste/ de'i tshe 'bras kyang 'di nyid tsam mo/ /dge slong dag ngas zas su 'bras 'bru gcig zos pas lus myur du snga ma bzhin du gyur te/ e ma'o dge sbyong go ta ma nya mang ku ra'i mdog 'dra'o/ /sngon 'di'i mdog mdzes pa gsal 7bar gyur pa de yang med par gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge slong dag ngas 'di snyam du bsams te)/ bdag gis de bas kyang zas chung ngu nyid la nan tan bya'o snyam rdzo)/ /dge slong dag ngas mngon par shes te/ ngas zas su til 'bru gcig pu kho na ste gnyis su med pa zos pa nas/ de'i kha dog 'jam po med par gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge slong dag ngas 'di snyam du bsams te cho1/ dge sbyong dang bram ze gang dag kha cig zas mi za bas dag par sems te/ bdag gis kyang 46wa 305

thams cad kyinyethams cad du zas mi za bar nan tan bya'o snyam nas/ dge slong dag de nas zas mi za bar 'dug go/ /dge slong dag ngas zabasnyem zos pas lus shin tu skams7shing nyam chung ba dang rid par gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na sdumasabu a si ta sga'i tshigs pa dang / ka li ku'i tshigs pa bas kyang nyis 'gyuraphudang / sum 'gyur khyadang / bzhi 'gyurashedang / lnga 'gyurasnyedang ske/ bcu 'gyur gyis nga'i yan lag dang / nying lag skems par gyur te/'di lta ste rtsibarwa)logs ni srog chags kur ka ta ku'i rtsib logs dang / bzhon pa'i bres khang lta bur gyur tong/ /sgal tshigs ni lan bu blas pa lta bur gyur to/ /mgo'i thod pa ni ku byab kha bo lta bur gyur to/ /mig gi 'bras bu ni khron pa'i skar ma lta bur gyur to/ /dge slong dag nga legs par ldang ngo snyam nas lus kyis bskyod na/ skur por gyur te 'gyel to/ /sha thang ste langs nas rdul gyis lus yog pa/ lag pas phyis pa dang / ba spu rul pa thams cad lus las lhags so/ /gang sngon nga kha dog mdzes shing 'jam par gyur pa de yang 'di ltar bdag nyid spong ba rtsub por btang ba'i phyir med par gyur to/ /nga'i spyod yul gyi grong na gnas pa'i skye bo nyen kor5)ba rnams kyang / 'di ltar e ma'o dge sbyong gi ta ma ni gnag go/ /e ma'o dge sbyong go ta ma ni sngo bsangs so/ /e ma'o dge sbyong go ta ma ni nya mang ku 7ra'i mdog 'dra'o/ /sngon 'di'i kha dog mdzes pa gsal bar gyur pa de yang med par gyur to snyam du shes so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang ma yang nyin re zhing byang chub sems dpa'i drung du pho nya gtong ngo / /dge slong dag de ltar na tebyang chub sems dpa' snga ma bzhin du 'jig rten du rtebya ba rmad du byung ba bstan pa dang / bya ba nyams pa'i sems can 46—306

rnams las dang bya ba la gzud pa dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs rnams brjod pa dang / ye shes chen po'i yon tan bstan pa dang / bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams rnam par dbye ba'i phyir til 'bru gcig dang / rgya shug 'bru gcig dang / 'bras 'brushegacig gis lo drug gi bar du dka' ba spyod pa bstan te yid dman pa med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' lo drug gi bar du skyil mo krung bcas nas/ ji ltar 'dug pa bzhin du gnas te/ spyod lam nyamasalgepa med do/ /nyi mas bab nas kyang grib ma la ma song ngo / /grib ma las kyang nyi ma la ma song ngo / /rlung dang nyi ma dang char pa'i skyabs ma btsal to/ /sha sbrang dang /sbrang bu dang / sdig sbrul ma bskrad do/ /bshang ba dang / gci ba dang /mchil ma dang / snabs ma bor ro/ /bskum pa dang / sbyang bas ma byas so/ /glos phab pa'am/ khas bub 'amatsha/ gan rkyal ma yin par gnas pas gnas so/ /sprin chen po dang / yul ngan chen po dang / char pa dang / ser ba dang / ston dang / dpyid dang / dgun gang yin pa de dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i lus la ma phog go/ /tha na byang chub sems dpas lag pas kyang ma bskyabs so/ /dbang po yang ma bkag go/ /dbang po'i yul yang ma blangs so/ /gang dag der 'ong ba grong gi gzhon nu'am/ grong gi gzhon nu ma'am/ ba lang rdzi'am/ phyugs rdzi'am/ rtswa thun nam/ shing thun nam/4)lci thun de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' la rdul khrod kyi 'dre yin pa snyam du sems shing de la rtsen te/ de las sa skud do/ /der byang chub sems dpa' lo drug po de dag gis lus ngan pa dang / god pa dang rid par gyur te/ de'i rna ba gnyis su rtswa'am shing bal bcug nas sna'i bu ga gnyis su 'byin to63/ /46—307

sna'i bu ga gnyis su bcug nas rna ba'i bu ga gnyis su7'byin to/ /rna7ba'i bu ga gnyis su bcug nas khar 'byin to/ /khar bcug nas rna ba dang sna'i bu gar 'byin to/ /snar bcug nas rna ba dang / sna dngasakhar 'byin to/ /lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po gang dag byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan mngon sum du gyur pa de dag nyin mtshan du gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa byed do/ /smon lam yang 'debs so/ /de na byang chub sems dpa' lo drug gi bar du 3)dka' ba spyod pa ston cing lha dang mi khrag khrig phrag bcu gnyis tshang ba dag theg pa gsum la yongs su smin par byas so/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim byung ba/ /yon tan dag dang ldan pa de/ /sems can don dang phan pa'i phyir/ /thabs dang ldan pa'i bsam pa skyes/ /snyigs ma lnga yi dus kyi tshe/ /chos dma' mos pa'i 'jig rten po/ /las dang bya bor 'jig rten du/ /'dzam bu'i〈gling 'dir skyesalgepar gyur/ /mu stegs tshogs kyis rab tu gang / /ltad mo dang ni ltas su lta/ /lus la gnod pa bya ba byed/ /byis pa de dag dag par sems/ /g.yang sa me dang mya ngam 'jug /sgren mo sa dang lci bas skud/ /lus ni yongs su gdung ba'i phyir/ /gdung ba lnga la brtson dang ldan/ /lag pa brkyang ste rgyu ba dang / /mi mkhas kha cig lag pa ldag /bum pa khar gzhong las mi len/ /sgo dang ka bas chod mi len/ /gang na khyirwanyayod pa nas min/ /'dug ce'am tshur shog ces las min/ /khyim nas kha zas gcig len pas/ /bdag ni dag par 'gyur snyam sems/ /mar dang 'bru mar bu ram zho/ /nya dang sha dang 'o ma 46—308

spong | /ldam ldum sre da pad ma'i rtsa/ /gzegs dang ba lang lci ba za/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu lo ma zanyu/ /ku sha tshal bu la ba lpagasame/ /srel byed kha cig sgren mor rgyu/ /glen pa 'di bden gzhan brdzunasasnyam/ /lag pa sgreng bar byed pa dang //skra bsgreng ral pa bsgreng ba dag /lam las rab tu rnam par nyams/ /lamasamin gnas shing bde 'gro 'dod/ /rtswa dang gtun shing thal bar nyal/ /tsher mar nyal zhing tsog pur 'dug /kha cig rkang pa gcig pus7'greng / /gdong bstod nyi dang zla la ltakhya/ /chu mig mtsho dang lteng meka dang / /rgya mtsho chu bo nyi zla dang / /shing dang ri yi rtse mo dang / /rdza dang sa la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /glen pa de dag gnod mang gis/ /lus ni yongs su skomasapar byed/ /log par lta dang ldan pa dag /myur du ngan song rnams su ltung / /nga ni dka' thubashebartul zhugs dang / /dka' spyad gang zhig lha dang mis/ /spyad par nus pa ma yin pa'i/ /dka' spyad drag po rtsom snyam sems/ /bsam gtan gang zhig rang rgyal gyis/ /blta bar nus pa ma yin pa'i8/ /rdo rje lta bur brtan gnas pa/ /mkha' khyab bsam gtan bsam gtan byed/ /mu stegs brtul zhugs ngan pa yis/ /dga' ba'i lha mi 'di na yod/ /de dag yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /dka' spyad brtul zhugs drag po brtsams/ /sa steng /7ci yang ma bting bar/ /skyil mo krung ni bcas te 'dug /rgya shug til dang 'bras 'bru5nyegacig /za ba'i cho ga rnam par ston/ /dbugs dbyung rngub pa rnam par spangs/ /stobs dang ldan pa g.yo ba med/ /lo drug bar du bsam gtan mchog /nam mkha' khyab la bsam gtan byed/ /rtog dang rnam par rtog med pa/ /g.yo ba med cing sems rgyu med/ /nam mkha'i khams su khyab pa yi/ /mkha' khyab bsam 46—309

gtan bsam gtan byed/ /de ni nyin las grib mar ram/ /grib las nyi marashesong ma byas/ /lhun po lta bur mi g.yo ba'i/ /mkha' khyab bsam gtan bsam gtan byed/ /rlung dang char dang sha sbrang dang / /sdig sbrul sbrang bu skyob mi byed/ /rnam par ma 'khrugs spyod pa yis/ /mkha' khyab bsam gtan bsam gtan byed/ /bdag nyidashegacig pu'i don gyi phyir/ /mkha' khyab bsam gtan byed pa min/ /gzhan du snying rje sems kyis ni/ /'jig rten don mang ched du bsgos/ /grong gi byis pa ba lang rdzi/ /shing thun dag dang rtswa thun dag/de la rdul khrod 'dre snyam sems/ /de la sa yis skud byed cing / /mi gtsang ba yang 'thor0bar byed/ /de dag gnod pa mang byed kyang / /g.yo ba med cing 'khrugasasnyimed par/ /mkha' khyab bsam gtan bsam gtan byed/ /mtho ba med cing dma' ba med/ /lus ma bsrungasalgepar chos ma mereg /bshang ba mi byed gci mi byed/ /sgra yis mi 'jigs gzhan mi lta/ /sha dang khrag rnams skams7gyur te⑨/ lpags pa rtsa rgyus rus pa lus/ /skal tshigs dag ni lto bar snang / /lan bu blas pa ci5)bzhin no/ /gang dag lhag par byas lha dang / /lha min gnod sbyin dri za klu/ /yon tan ldan pa mngon sum bas/ /nyin dang mtshan du mchod pa byed/ /ji ltar mkha' 'dra'i sems ldan 'di/ /mkha' khyab bsam gtan bsam gtan byed/ /de 'drar bdag cag myur gyur ces/ /smon lam dag kyang 'debs par byed/ /snying rje'i blo yis 'jig rten gyi/ /don mang phyir byed ma gtogs par/ /bdag phyir ma yin bde blos min/ /bsam gtan ro ni myang phyir min/ /phas kyi rgol ba rab tu bcom/ /mu stegs blo nyams zil gyis mnan/ /mgo reg byang chub ga la yod/ /byang chub bskal 46—310

mang rnyed dka' zhes/ /'od srung la ni tshig smras pa'i/ /las dang bya ba rab tu bstan/ /skye bo dag ni dga' bya'i phyir/ /mkha' khyab bsam gtan bsam gtan byed/ /lha mi khrag khrig bcu gnyis tshangashe/ /theg pa gsum la rab tu btulas/ /de yi ched du blo gros bzang / /mkha' khyab bsam gtan bsam gtan byed/ /dka' ba spyad pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste/ bcu bdun pa'o// //dge slong dag bdud sdig can yang byang chub sems dpa' lo drug gi bar du dka' ba spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe phyi bzhin 'brang ste/ glags bltasakhuskabs btsal kyang nam yang glags cung zad kyang ma rnyed do/ /de glags ma rnyed nas yi chad de yid la gcags0bzhin du song ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ dgon pa nyams ni dga' ba dang / / nags tshal nyagel pa sgra med dang / /lteng rgyas kyi ni shar phyogs na/ /chu klung rna ran dzarmen der/ /spong ba'i phyir ni brtson par〈)byas/ /rtag tu mthu rtsal brtan pa po/ /grub dang bde ba thob bya'i phyir/ /brtson pas rab tu rtul de la/ /bdud ni 'jam zhing snyan pa'i tshig /smra bar byed cing 'ongs par gyur/ /kye srog gces kyis 'tsho bar gyis/ /gson nas /nyachos ni spyod par 'gyur/ /gson tshe bya ba gang yod pa/ /de dag byas na mya ngan med/ /khyod ni mdog nyams dman par gyur/ /khyod ni shi la thug cing 'dug /'chi ba'i cha ni stong snyed tsam/ /cha gcig tsam cigatsogason par zad//sbyin pa dag ni rtag tu byin/ /me yi sbyin sreg sbyin sreg cibyos/ /'on kyang bsod nams chen por 'gyur/ /spong ba yis ni ci zhig bya/ /spong ba'i lam ni sdug bsngal te/ /sems dul ba ni bya dka' zhes/ /de tshe bdud kyis de skad 46—311

tshig /byang chub sems dpa' de la smras/ /de skad smra ba'i bdud de la/ /byang chub sems dpas 'di skad smras/ /sdig can myos pa'i rtsa lag po/ /khyod ni rang gi don phyir 'ongs/ /nga la bsod nams chunganyezad kyang / /don du gnyer ba med do bdud/ /gang dag bsod nams don du gnyer/ /de la desaskad smra ba'i rigs/ /'tsho ba'i mtha' ni 'chi yin pas/ /mi 'chi snyam du nga mi sems / /tshangs par spyod la gzhol gyur pas/ /phyir ldog par ni mi bya'o/ /chu klung dag gi chu rgyun kyang / /rlung gis rnam par skemasashebyed na/ /spangs pa nyid kyi khrag tsam lta/ /'di yis༄ci phyir skams0mi 'gyur/ /khrag ni skams par gyur pa dang / /de yi 'og tu sha skams 'gyur/ /sha ni zad par gyur pa dang / /phyir zhing sems ni dang bar 'gyur/ /phyir zhing 'dun dang brtson⑧'grus dang / /ting nge 'dzin kyang gnas par 'gyur/ /nga ni de ltar gnas pas na/ /tshor ba dam pa thob gyur kyang / /lus dang srog la mi lta ste/ /sran thub dag par gyur la ltos/ /nga la 'dun pa yod gyur cing / /brtson 'grus dang ni shes rab yod/ /nga yi brtson 'grus bskyod nus pa/ /'jig rten de ni ngas ma mthong / /srog chad shi ba ches bla ste/ /'tsho ba ngan pa de lta min/ /g.yul ngor shi ba legs pa ste/ /pham nas gson pa de lta min/ /snar ma dpung las mi rgyal te⑨/ /dpa' bo dpung las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rgyal yang de ni zlas sems med/ /bdud khyod las ni myur rgyal bya/ /'dod pa khyod kyi dang po'i dpung / /mi dga' ba ni gnyis pa yin/ /khyod kyi gsum pa bkres dang skom/ /sred pa dpung tshogs bzhi pa yin/ /rmugs dang gnyid ni lnga pa ste/ /'jigs pa drug par brjod pa yin/ /khyod kyi the tshom bdun pa ste/ /khro dang 46—312

'chab pa brgyad pa yin/ /'thob dang tshigs bcad bkur ste dang / /log par grags pa gang thob dang / /bdag la stod 3)par byed pa dang / /gzhan la smod par byed pa dang / /de dag nag po'i rtsa lag tu/ /lhung ba'i bdud kyi dpung yin no/ /dge sbyong mizam ze kha cig ni/ /'di na glagasashelta 'khod par snang / /khyod dpung gang yin lhar bcas kyis/ /'jig rten 'di ni rab 'dul ba/ /so btang ma byas snod chus bzhin/ /shes rab kyis ni de dag gzhig /dran pa legs par nyer bzhag ste/ /shes rab legs par bsgomasatswabyas nas/ /shes bzhin du ni spyod par bya/ /blo ngan khyod kyis ci0byar yod/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / bdud sdig can sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde ste/ yikyi ma rangs nas yid la gcags bzhin du de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to// //'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bcu gnyis pa/ dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/dge sbyong dang bram ze gang dag kha cig 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i dus na bdag la gnod pa byed pa dang / lus la gdung ba byed de/sdug bsngal drag po tsha ba mi bzad du pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba myong bar byed pas de dag shin tu sdug bsngal ba ༅myong ngo snyam mo/ /dge slong dag ngas 'di snyam du bsams techo/ spyod pa 'di dang bsgrub /7 pa 'dis mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa/ 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par gang yang mngon du ma byas te 'di ni byang chub kyi lam ma yin/ lam 'di ni ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang 'chi 8ba 'byung ba nub par byed pa ma yin te/ byang chub kyi lam ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal 'byung ba nub 46—313

par byed pa gzhan zhig yod do snyam mo/ /dge slong dag ngas 'di snyam du bsams te༅/ ngas pa'i skyed mos tshal du shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma la 'dug ste/'dod pa rnams las dben pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams las dben pa/rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po nas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i bar du bsgrubs te gnas pa de byang chub kyi lam yin te skye ba dang / rga ba dang na ba dngasa'achi ba'i sdug bsngalatswa'abyung ba rnams nub par 'gyur ba yinasasnyam nas/ de byang chub kyi lam yin no snyam ste/ nga'i rnam par shes pa de'ikhurjes su 'brang bar gyur to/ /ngas 'di snyam du bsams te⑦/ 'di ltar nyam chung bar gyur pas ni lam de mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par bya'umi spunas so / /gal te nga 'di ltar lus ngan cing 7nyam chung bzhin du mngon par shes pa dang / ye shes kyi stobs kyis byang chub kyi snying por song na ni ngas phyi ma'i skye bo la snying brtse ba byas par mi 'gyur te/ 'di yang byang chub kyi lam ma yin gyis0/ngas kha zas rags pa zos la lus kyi mthupha stobs bskyed de/ de nas gdod byang chub kyi snying por 'gro'o snyam mo/ /dge slong dag de na lha'i bu gang dag nga la mos pa de dag gis nga'i sems kyi yongs su rtog pa sems kyis shes nas/ nga ga la ba der 'ongs te nga la 'di skad ces smras so/ /skyes bu dam pa zhal zas rags pa ma gsol cig /bdag cag gis ba spu'i khung bur mdangs stsal bar bgyi'o / /dge slong dag ngas 'di snyam du bsams te/ bdag ni zas mi bza' bar bdag nyid kyis dam bcas la/ bdag gi spyod yul gyi grong na gnas pa'i skye bo nyen kor ba rnams kyis kyang / 'di ltar dge sbyong go ta ma ni zas mi za 46—314

ba yin par yanganyeshes te/ nga〈snyel mos pa'i lha'i bu 'di dag gis nga'i bshespu'i khung bur mdangs bcug par gyur na/ /ngas7shin tu brdzun7smras par gyur to snyam stetsho/ de nas byang chub sems dpas brdzun dusmra ba spang ba'i phyir lha'i bu de dag gi tshig ma mnyan par kha zas rags pa bza' bar sems bcud do/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang mechub sems dpas lo drug gi bar du brtul zhugs dang dka' thub nyams su blangs nas/ stan de las langs te/ kha zas rags pa 'di lta ste bu ram gyi dbu ba dang / mon sran sde'u yi khu bcud dang / ha re rkyinu kha'i khu bcud dang / zan dang / 'bras chan rmo/skyedang / 'dren mar bza'o zhes tshig tu brjod do/ /dge slong dag de nas lnga sde bzang po dag 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong go ta mas tshalam 'di dang bsgrub 7pa 'dis mi'i chos bla ma las mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par gang yang mngon du byed ma nus na kha zas rags pa 'di zosapha te/ bsod nyams la sbyor bsgo dang ldan par gnas pas ci nus te mi gsal ba byis pa yin no snyam du bsams nas byang chub sems dpa'i gan nas song ste/ grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr tsho/)song nas drang srong lhung ba ri dgas kyi nags su gnas so/ /de na byang chub sems dpa' thog ma nyid du dka' ba spyad pa spyod pa na grong pa'i bu mo gzhon nu bcus blta tsho/rteb dang phyag bya ba'i phyir bsnyen bkur byas so/ /lnga sde bzang po de dag gis kyang rim gro byas shing rgya shug 'bru gcig dang / 'bras 'bru gcig dang / til 'bru gcig dbul ba yang phul lo/ /grong pa'i bu mo bcu ni bu mo stobs ldan ma zhes bya ba dang / stobs sbed ma dang / shin tu sdug dang / sde las rnam par rgyal dang / a ti mug ta ka'i phreng ba can dang / mdzes ma dang / rdza byed 46—315

ma dang / skra lcang lo rgyas dang / ral bu can dang / legs skyes ma zhes bya ba ste/ gzhon nu ma de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i tshod ma'i0rnam pa de dag thams cad byas te phul lo/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang de dag zos nas rim gyis spyod yul gyi grong du bsod snyoms spyad pas mdog dang / gzugs dang /stobs dang ldan par gyur to/ /de tshun chad byang chub sems dpa' la dge stong mdzes pa/ dge sbyong chen po zhes 'dzer to/ /dge slong dag de na byang chub sems dpa' dang po nyid du dka' ba spyad pa spyod pa na byang chub sems dpas brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub nyams 'og tu chud par bya ba dang / lus rtas par bya ba'i phyir grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas nyin gcig bzhin du/bram ze brgyad brgya ②zan byin zhing 'di skad du bdag gi ⑧zas zos pas byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar shog shig ces smon lam yang btab bo/ /dge slong dag lo drug 'das nas/ byangs 'di snyam du bsams tezhu/ gal te bdag gis 'doms duyog 'ga' zhig rnyed tson re stes snyam mo/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes ma'i bran mo grub ma zhes bya ba zhig shi nas de sha na'i ras kyis dkris te/ dur khrod du bor bar gyur pa'i phyag dar khrod pa de ngas mthong nas/ ngas phyag dar khrod pa de blang ba'i phyir rkang pa g.yon pas mnan te / dgus dunas lag pa g.yas pa brkyang pa dang / de nas sa bla'i lhas bar snang gi lha rnams la sgra bsgrags pa/ grogs po dag 'di ltar rgyal po chen po'i rigs su skyes pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid bor te/ phyag dar khrod pa la sems btud pa ngo mtshar te / grogs po dag 'di ni rmad du byung ba'o/ /46—316

bar snang gi lha rnams kyis sa bla'i lha rnams kyi sgra thos nas rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams la sgra bsgrags so/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris pas kyang sum cu rtsa gsum pa la'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pas kyang 'thab bral ba la'o/ /'thab bral bas kyang dga' ldan pa la'o/ /dga' ldan pas kyang 'phrul dga' ba la'o/ /'phrul dga' bas kyang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa la'o/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pas kyang tshangs ris pa'i bar du'o/ /skad cig de dang / thang cig nyade dang /yud tsam de la grogs po dag 'di ltar rgyal po chen po'i rigs su skyes pa/'khor losabasgyur ba'i rgyal srid bor te/ phyag dar khrod pa la sems btud cipa ngo mtshar te/ 'di ni rmad du byung ba'o zhes sgra gcig dang / brjod pa gcig 'og min gyi gnas kyi bar du grags par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpasasnyeyang 'di snyam du bsams te 57bdag gis phyag dar khrod pa ni rnyed na/gal te chu zhig rnyed na re stes snyam mo/ /de nas de nyid du lhas lag pa sa la brdabs pa dang / der rdzing bu zhig byung bar gyur te/ deng sang du'ang lag pa brdabs pa'i rdzing zhes grags so/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpas 'di snyam du bsams te0/ bdag gis chu ni rnyed na/ gal te phyag dar khrod pa 'di bkru ba'i rdo leb cig rnyed na re stes snyam pa dang / skad cig de nyid la brgya byin gyis der rdo leb bzhag nas/ de la byang chub sems dpas phyag dar khrod pa de bkrus so/ /de nas lha'i rgyal 8po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /skyes bu dam pa 'di kho bo la stsol cigatsa tshodang kho bos bkru'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas rab tu byung ba ni bdag nyid kyis bya bar bstan pa'i phyir brgya byin la ma byin par bdag nyid kyis bkrus so/ /46—317

de lus ngal te chad nas rdzing nas 'byung snyam pa dang / bdud sdig can phrag dog gi chos dang ldan pas rdzing bu gang ba mthon po zhig sprul to/ /rdzing de'i 'gram na shing sgrub byed ces bya ba chen po zhig yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten dang 'thun par bya ba dang / lha mo la phan gdags pa'i phyir shing de'i lha mo la smras pa/ lha mo shing gi yal ga smod cig /des kyang shing yal ga smad nas byang chub sems dpa' de la 'jus te byung ngo / /byung nas kyang shing sgrub byed de'i 77drung du phyag dar khrod pa chos gos snam sbyar du byas nas7drubs te / deng sang du'ang desaphyag dar khrod pa drubs pa zhes ming du grag rdza/ /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu 'od dri ma med pa zhes bya ba des/ lha'i gos ngur smrigashegi tshon du rtsibatsos pa rung ba dge sbyong gi tshul dang 'thun pa dag byang chub sems dpa' la phul lo/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang de dag blangs te/ snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos bgos nas spyod yul gyi grong du phyogs pa dang ske/ de na lha rnams kyis lteng ri rgyas kyi sde dpon gyi grong na dga' byed ces bya ba'i grong mi zhig yod pa'i bu mo legs skyes ma la nam phyed tsam na smras pa/ khyod kyis gang gi phyir mchod sbyin byas pa de brtul tshon)zhugs de nyams 'og tu chud nas de kha zas rags pa bzang po bza' bar sems kyis/ sngon khyod kyis bdag gi zas zos nas byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar shog shig 3ces smon lam btab pa gang yin pa'i khyod kyi bya ba de gyis shig /dge slong dag de nas grong mi dga' byed kyi bu mo legs skyes mas lha de dag gi tshig de thos nas myur ba myur bar ba stong gi 'o ma lan bdun du snying khur 7byas pa bzang po tsho/nyamachog tu 'gyur tshab snying po can 46—318

blangs te/ blangs nas kyang 'o ma de 'bras sar pa sar7)pa dag dang / phru ba sarasapar blugs nas thab sarashebar btsugs te/ kha zas de sgrub bo/ /de sgrub pa na snga ltas 'di dag snang ste/ 'o ma de'i nang na dpal be'u dang / bkra shis pa dang / g.yung drung 'khyil pa dang / pad ma dang / sdong ris la sogs pa bkra shis rnams snang ngo / /de nas des 'di snyam du bsams te no /ltas 'di lta bu 'di dag snang ba las na/ byang chub sems dpas zas zos nas byang chub 'thob par 'gyur du the tsom 5)med do snyam pa dang / rgya mtsho pa shes shing cho ga shes pa'i mtshan mkhan phyogs der phyin par gyur nas/ des kyang bdud rtsi 'thob pa nyid du lung bstan to/ /de nas legs skyes mas thug pa de tshos pa dang thang la bzhag ste/ me tog gis gtor/ spos chus gtor nas gus par stan⑧bting ste/ bran mo gong ma zhes bya ba la smras pa/ gong ma song la bram ze bos shig /ngas ni 'o thug sbrang rtsi can 'di blta'o1)/ /jo mo legs so zhes de'i ltar mnyan nas/ shar phyogs logs su song ba dang / des byang chub sems dpa' mthong ngo / /de bzhin du lho phyogs logs su song na 7yang byang chub sems dpa' mthong ngo / /de bzhin du nub dang byang phyogs logs su songamo/nyan yang de dang der des pabyang chub sems dpa' mthong ngo / /de'i tshe na gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis 8gzhan mu stegs can thams cad tshar bcad par gyur pas 'ga' tsam yang mi snang ngo / /de nas de slar57log ste jo mo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang dang gang du mchis kyang de dang de na dge sbyong mdzes pa gda' ba las/ dge sbyong ngam bram ze gzhan ni 'ga' yang mi gda'o/ /legs skyes mas smras pa/ de nyid bram ze yin te/ de'i phyir 'di 46—319

brtsams kyis/ gong ma song la de nyid bos shig /jo mo legs so zhes smras te/gong ma song nas byang chub sems dpa'i rkang pa gnyis latugatugs te legs skyes ma zhes bgyi bas spyan 'dren to zhes smras so/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpa' grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes ma'i khyim du song ste stan ②bting ba la 'dug go/ /dge slong dag de nas7grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas 'o thug sprang rtsi can gyis gser gyi snod chen po bkang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' la phul lo//de nas byang chub sems dpas 'di snyam du bsams te④/ legs skyes mas kha zas 'di lta bu 'di byin pa 'di bdag gis deng zos te/ the tsom ⑤med par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas zas de blangs nas grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe gser gyi snod chen po 'di ji ltar bya/ des smras pa/ khyod snoms shig /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/kho bo la ni snod 'di lta bu mi dgos so/ /legs skyes mas smras pa/ ci dgyes su mdzod cig /bdag ni snod ma mchis par su la yang zas mi stsol to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas zas de thogs te/ lteng rgyas nas byung nas dro la bab pa dang / klu'i klung chu bo rna ran dza'i na'i ngogs su song ste/ zas dang chos gos rnams phyogs gcig tu bzhag nas/ byang chub sems dpa' lus bsil bar byar1skaba'i phyir klung rna ran dza tshana'i nang du zhugs /nyaso/ /dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa' khrus byed pa'i tshe/ lha'i bu brgya stong du ma dag 'di lta ste/ 7byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir lha'i a ga ru dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / byug pa dag klung du sdugs shing lha'i me tog 46—320

kha dog sna tshogs dag kyang chu'i nang du 'thor ro/ /de'i tshe klung chen po ne+e ran dza na0lha'i spos rnams dang / me tog rnams kyis gang bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos chu gang gis khrus byas par gyur pa de lha'i bu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dag gis blangs te mchod rten du bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba'i phyir rang rang gi gnas su khyer ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i skra dang ag tshom gang yin pa de dag kyang grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas bkra shis pa yin no snyam nas/ mchod rten du bya ba dang / mchod par5gebya ba'i phyir khyer ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' klung nas byung nas ca'adug par 'dod de gling la lta'ozhus/ /de nas klung rna ran dza yina'i klu'i bu mo gang yin pa de sa'i 'og nas byung ste/yid las byung ba'i seng ge'i khri byang chub sems dpa' la phul nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de la 'dug ste/ grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes ma la snying brtse ba nye bar bzung nas/ ji tsam dgos par 'o thug sbrang rtsi can de 'thungs so/ /'thungs nas kyang gser gyi snod chen po de la ma chags par chur bor ro/ /bor ma thag tu klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos mchod pa'i thos yin no zhes dad pa dang gus pa bskyed de blangs nas rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de nas mig stong pa grong khyer 'jig pa nam mkha' lding gi gzugs su sprul nas kha rdo rje'i mchur bsgyur te/klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho las gser gyi snod chen po de dbrog tu brgal na ma nus nas rang gi gzugs kyis gus par byas te/ bslangs 1rinas mchod rten du bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba'i phyir sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su khyer ro/ /khyer nas kyang snod chen po'i dge 'dun gyi dus ston byas te/ deng sang du'ang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams lo gcig bzhin du snod chen po'i dus ston byed do/ /46—321

seng ge'i khri de yang klu'i bu mo de7nyid kyis mchod rten du bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba'i phyir khyer ro/ /dge slong dag du byang chub sems dpas zas rags pa zos ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams kyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs kyis skad cig de nyid la lus la snga ma'i kha dog bzang po rgyas pa dang ske/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad gecu dang / 'od 'dom gang ba yang byung bar gyur to/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ lo drug bar du brtul zhugs nyams 'og chud byas bcom ldan blo gros 'di snyam sems/ /gal te bdag ni 'di ltar rin bzhin bsam gtan mngon shes ye shes stobs ldan pa/ /shing gi rgyal po'i drung du song ste thams cad mkhyen nyid 'tshang rgyar bya na ni/ /de dag na yang bdag gis phyi ma'i skye bo dag la snying brtse ma byas 'gyur/ /bsod nams ngan ngon tsam dang ldan pa'i lha mi 'di dag ngan pas ye shes tshol ge/ /de dag lus ni nyam ༅chung gyur na bdud rtsi 'tshang rgya byed par mi nus pas/ /kha zas rags pa dam pa zos te lus kyi mthu stobs bskyed pa byas na dzhani/ /shing gi rgyal po'i drung du song ste thams cad mkhyen nyid 'tshang rgyar bya bar bsams( / /grong pa'i bu mo sngon chad spyod pa spyad pa legs skyes ma zhes bya ba de/ /'dren pa brtul zhugs grub par shog ces de lta'i yid kyis rtag tu mchod sbyin byed/ /de ni lha yis bskul ba thos nas de tshe 'o thug sbrang rtsi can blangs te/ /klung gi 'gram du song nas dga' ba'i yid kyis ne+e ran dza na'i sgyujogs na kyi'adug /bskal pa stong du spyod /nga pa spyad cing dbang po zhi la rab tu zhi ba de/ /lha dang klu yi tshogs dang drang srong dag gis bskor te rna ran dza nar 'ongasam/ /pha rol brgal nas sems can sgrol ba blo 46—322

gros ldan pa khrus byar bsams gas nas ni/ /thub pa dag pa dri med 'jig rten snying brtse phyir ni klung du zhugs te 'khru/ /bye ba phrag stong lha dag dga' ba'i yid kyis spos rnams dang ni phye ma dag /klung du 'thor zhing sems can dam pa bkru ba'i don du chu lashegang bar byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' dri med nges pa bkrus te ngogs na 'dug par shes gyur nas/ /lha stong rab tu dga' ste sems can dag pa bkrus pa'i chu de mchod phyir khyer/ /ngur smrig bzang po dri ma med pa'i gos dag lha yi bu yis de la byin/ /rung ba dag dang sham thabs bgos nas bcom ldan 'das ni chu klung ngogs na 'dug /klu yi bu mo dga' zhing rab tu mgu ba'i yid kyis seng ge'i khri yang bshams/ /de la 'jig rten dag gi mig byed yid kyang rab tu zhi ba de 'dug nas/ /blo gros ldan pa legs skyes ma des gser gyi snod du kha zas blugs te byin/ /rkang par phyag 'tshal nas ni de dag kha lo sgyur ba bdag gis gsol zhes byas/ /blo gros ldan pas ji byu1tsam dgos par zas kyang zos nas snod ni chur bor te/ /de ni grong khyer 'jig pa lha yi bla mas bdag gis mchod par bya zhes khyer/ /gang tshe rgyal bas kha zas rags pa dam pa zos pa de yi skad cig la/ /de yi lus kyi stobs dang gzi brjid dag dang dpal yang snga mkho ④bzhin du gnas/ /legs skyes ma dang lha rnams dag la chos gtam byas nas don kyang mang du byas/ /seng ge ngang pa'i stabs 5dang glang po'i dbang po'i 'gros po kyis byang chub shing drung chas/ /rna ran dza na'i le'u zhes bya ba ste/ bcwa brgyad pa'o// //dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' klung rna ran dza 8nar khrus byas 46—323

te/ zas zos nas lus kyi mthu stobs bskyed de/ bdud las rnam par rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir rnam pa bcu drug dang ldan pa'i sa phyogs shing gi rgyal po byang chub chen po'i drung ga la ba der skyes bu chen po'i stabs ganganyeyin pa'i stababasnyedes song ste/ mi bskyod pa'i stabs dang / dbang po'i mchod sdongasalta bu'i stabs dang / ri'i rgyal po lhun po ltar༄shin tu brtan pa'i stabs dang / mi dngom pa ma yin pa'i stabs dang / ya yo med pa'i stabs dang / 'tshe ba med pa'i stabs dang / rings pasnyem yin pa'i stabs dang / sdod pa med pa'i stabs dang / 'khrugs pa med pa'i stabs dang / 'khyor pa med pa'i stabs dang / 'drud du )pa med pa'i stabs dang / zhum pa med pa'i stabs dang / ha cang mi sdod pa'i stabs dang / mi g.yos pa'i stabs dang / rtab rtabashepo med pa'i stabs dang / tshul du shis pa'i stabs dang / dri ma med pa'i stabs dang / dge ba'i stabs dang / zhe sdang med pa'i stabs dang / gti mug med pa'i stabs dang / chags pa med pa'i stabs dang / seng ge'i stabs dang /ngang pa'i rgyal po'i stabs dang / klu'i rgyal po'i stabs dang / sred med kyi bu'i stabs dang / sa la mi reg pa'i stabs dang / rtsibs stongasnyedang ldan pa'i 'khor lo'i ri mo sa la snang ba'i stabs dang / sor mo dra bas 'brel cing sen mo zangs lta bu'i stabs dang / soshesma 'byin pa'i stabs dang / ri rdob pa'i stabs dang / mthon dman mnyam par byed pa'i rkang mthil gyi stabs dang /dra ba'i bar nas 'od dang skya'od zer phyung nas sems can la reg na bde 'gror 'gro ba'i stabs dang / pad ma dri ma med pa la gom pa 'dor ba'i stabs 7dang /sngon dge ba legs par spyad pa'i 'gros kyi stabs dang / sngon gyi sangs rgyas 46—324

seng ge'i khri la bzhud pa'i stabs dang / rdo rje ltar bsam pa brtan0zhing mi phyed pa'i stabs dang / ngan song ngan 'gro thams cad gcod pa'i stabs dang /bde ba thams cad skyed pa'i stabs midang / thar pa'i lam7ston pa'i stabs dang / bdud kyi stobs stobs med par byed pa'i stabs dang / ngan pa'i tshogs can gyi tshogs pas kyi byargol ba chos dang 'thun pas tshar gcad 90pa'i stabs dang / mun pa'i ling thog dang / nyon mongs pa sel ba'i stabs dang /'khor ba'i phyogs phyogs med par byed pa'i stabs dang / brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i stabs dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po na dpa' bo gcig pu'i stabs dang / rang byung zil gyis mnonal pa'i stabs dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par byed pa'i stabs dang / dran pa dang blo gros kyi stabs dang / bde 'gror 'gro ba'i stabs dang / rga ba dang 'chi ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i stabasakyi dang / zhi ba rdul med pa/ bdud kyi 'jigs pa med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'gro ba'i stabs te/ de 'dra ba'i stabs kyis byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying por chas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar klung rna ran dza namo/rnyedang / byang chub kyi snying po'i bar der rlung gi sprin gyi lha'i bu rnams kyis lam phyag dar byas par gyur to/ /char sprin rnams kyis spos chus chag chag btab bo/ /me tog kyang chal mar bkram mo/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di min shing ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad kyang shing byang chub ga la ba de 8logs su rtse mo 'dud par gyur to/ /gang dag de'i nyin par btsas pa'i gyis pa de dag kyang byang chub kyi snying po logs 46—325

su mgo bstan te nyal lo/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na ri rab la sogs pa ri gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba de logs su 'dud par gyur to/ /klung nai ran dza nam/tshanas bzung ste/ byang chub kyi snying po'i bar der 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis kha tshonamu rgyang grags tsam tshun chad kyi lam mngon par bkod par gyur to/ /lam de'i 'gram g.yas g.yos susa'ang rin po che sna bdun gyi stegs bu 'phang du shing ta la bdunasatsam du mtho ba/ steng du rin po che'i dra ba bres pa/ lha'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan ④gyis legs par brgyan parakyi sprul to/ /mda' rgyang gang tsam/ mda' rgyang gang tsam gyi ༅zhing rin po che sna bdun gyi shing ta la stegs bu de bas mtho ba mngon par sprul te/ shing ta la thams cad rin po che brgyus pas phan tshun 'brel bar 'dug go/ /shing tasnyil gnyis gnyis kyi bar du rdzing spos chus yongs su gang ba gser gyi bye ma bdal ba/me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po la sogs pas gang ba/ rin po che'i stegs bus bskor ba/ nor bu rin po che be+e drur+yas them skas brgyan pa/ chu sreg 4 dang / bya gar dang / ngang pa dang /ngur pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya sgra 'byin pa'i rdzing dag byas so/ /lam de na lha'i bu mo brgyad khri ni spos chus chag chag 'debs sotsha/ /lha'i bu mo brgyad khri ni me tog sil ma lha'i dri bsung dang ldan pa 'thor ro/ /shing ta la thams cad kyi mdun logs su rin po che'i mkha' rten bzhag go/ /rin po che'i mkha' rten thams cad la lha'i bu mo tsan dan dang / a ga ru'i phye ma'i phur ma thogs pa dang / dus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i bdug pa'i pog phor thogs pa brgyad khri 46—326

'khod par gyur to/ /rin po che'i mkha' rten thams cad la lha'i bu mo lha'i glu dbyangs len pa lnga khri 'khod par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' zhing rnams ni rab tu skyodami/ 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong ni 'byin/ sil snyan brgya stong ni sgrogasal/ me tog mang po'i char chen po ni 'bebs/ gos brgya stong gi g.yab mo ni 'dor/ rnga bo che brgya stong ni rdung /rta dang glang po che dang / glang khyu ba rnams ni sgra 'byin/ bya ne tso dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug dang / ka la ping kur dang / shang shang te'u dang /ngang pa dang / ngur pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya brgya stong ni bskor ba byed/ bkra shis brgya stong ni 'bul zhing lam gyi bkod pa rnam pa desalta bu des/byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying por song ngo / /gang gi nub mo byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'dod par gyur pa de nyid kyi nub mo stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i bdag po tshangs pa dbang sgyur zhes bya ba des tshangs pa'i 'khor chen po de la bos te/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po dag shes par gyis shig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen poshego cha chen po mnabs pa/ dam bcas pa chen po ma bor ba/ go cha sra ba7mnabs pa/ thugs yongs su mi skyo ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad tshar phyin pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu byon pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad la mnga' dbang brnyes pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i5 dbasam pa thams cad kyi bya ba shin tu mkhyen pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang po'i rjes su zhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba thams cad la shin tu zhugs pa tshobadud kyi las kyi lam thams cad las yang dag par 'das 46—327

pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ sems can thams cad la rab tu thar pa'i lam ston pa/ ded dpon chen por gyur pa/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa/ stong gsum na dpa' bo gcig pur gyur pa/ chos kyi sman thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs pa/ sman pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam par grol ba'i thabs thob pa/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po shes rab kyi 'od chen po gtong ba/ tog chen po'i rgyal po 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis ma gos pas pad ma chen po lta bu/ chos thams cad kyi gzungs ma bsnyel ba/ rgya mtsho chen po dang 'dra ba/ rjes su chags pa dang khong khro ba dang bral ba mi g.yo ba/ mi bskyod pa/ ri rab chen po lta bu/ shin tu dri ma med pa/ shin tu yongs su dag pa/ shin tu dkar ba'i blo dang ldan pa/ nor bu rin po che chen po dang 'dra ba/ chos thams cad la dbang bsgyuratub/ sems las su rung ba/ tshangs pa chen po lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' de bdud kyi sde rab tu 'dul ba dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tusamangon par rdzogs par byang chub par bzhed pa dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor ba dang / seng ge'i sgra chen po bsgragashepa dang / chos kyi sbyin pas sems can thams cad tshim par mdzad pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi chos kyi mig rnam par sbyang ba dang / pas kyisnyergol ba thams cad chos dang 'thun pas tshar gcadasnyepa dang / sngon dam bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa kun tu bstan pa dang / chos thams cad la dbang phyug gi 46—328

mnga' dbang brnyes par mdzad pa'i phyir byang chub kyi snying por bzhud kyis/ de la grogs po dag khyed byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba'i las thams cad la spro bar gyis shig /de nas tshangs pa chen po dbang sgyur gyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gang gi bsod nams dag dang gzi brjid dpal gyis byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms dang ni bsam gtan dag dang de bzhin mngon shes tshangs pa'i lam snang ba/ /bskal pa stong du spyod pa spyad pa de ni byang chub shing drung chas par gyur/ /thub pa de la bsam pa'i brtul zhugs sgrub par7byed pa'i mchod pa legs par bya/ /de la skyabs su song na ngan 'gro'i 'jigs dang mi phrad mi khom mi 'gyur te/ /lha yi nang du 'dod pa'i bde ba rnyed nas tshangs pa'i gnas yangs 'gro bar 'gyur/ /lo drug bar du dka' ba spyad pa spyad nas 'di ni byang chub shing drung bzhud/ /kun kyang dga' zhing rab tu mgu ba'i ②yid kyis de la mchod pa legs par gyis//de ni stong gsum rgyal po dbang phyug dam pa chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal po ste/ /brgya byin tshangs pasanyi zla'i grong khyer dag na de dang mnyam pa gang yang med/ /gang btsas tshe na zhing rnams bye ba khrag khrig rnam pa drug tu g.yos gyur pa/ /de ni de ring bdud kyi dpung las rgyal bar mdzad phyir shing chen mchog drung bzhud/ /gang gi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i gnas 'dir gnas kyang blta bar nus pa ma yin zhing / /gang gi sku la mtshan rab dam pa ldan zhing sum cu rtsa gnyis legs brgyan la/ /gang gi gsung 'dir yid du 'ong zhing snyan la rnar 'thad tshangs dbyangs sgra snyan cing / /gang gi thugs ni rab zhi khro dang bral ba de la mchodashepa byed du 'dong / /gang dag blo gros brgya byin tshangs pa'i gnas su bsam gtan bde 46—329

bas 'da' bya dang / /nyon mongs 'ching ba'i 'khri ①shing kun dang dra ba de dag gcod par byed 'dod dang / /gzhan las ma thos par ni rang rgyal byang chub zhi ba 'chi med 'thobasnye'adod dang / /gal te sa gsum dag na chasangs rgyas nyid 'dod de dag 'dren pa mchod par gyis/ /gang gis rgya mtshor bcas pa'i sa dang de bzhin rin po che rnams mtha' yas dang / /khang bzangs skar khung bsil khang mang ldan pa dang zung du sprel dngasnyibazhon pa dang / /me tog phreng ba shin tu mdzes pas brgyan pa0skyed mos tshal gyis rab brgyan dang / /rkang lag mgo dang mig rnams yongs su btang ba de ni byang chub snying por zhugs/ /dge slong dag de ltar stong gsum gyi ⑦rangs pa chen po de skad cig de la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir phyin te/ lag mthil ltar mnyam par gyur pa/ gyo mo dang rdo med pa dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang /bai drur+ya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byu ru dang / gser dang /dngul mang ba/ rtswa sngo zhing 'jam la dugayas su 'khyil cing g.yung drung7'khyil pa ka tsa lin di ma'i gos ltar reg na bde ba dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams khyab pa 'dir phyin to/ /de'i tshe rgya mtsho chen po thams cad sa lta bur gyur kyang chu napha/1rgyu ba'i sems can rnams la gnod 8pa cung zad kyang med do/ /'jig rten gyi khams de ltar brgyan pa 'di phyogs bcu'i brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyisalgemathong nas byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong legs par brgyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang ⑩lha'i dang mi'i las shin tu 'das pa'i mchod pa 46—330

bkod pa rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa brgyan par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad kyang bkod pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig lta bur snang bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi bar dag dang / ri nag po dang / khor lug dang / khor yug chen po dag kyang mi snang bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'od kyis gsal bar snang ngo / /byang chub kyi snying po yongs su skyong ba'i lha'i bu bcu drug yod de/ /'di lta ste/ lha'i bu ud ka li tshizhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu mud ka li zhes bya ba dang / skye dgu'i〈mibadag po dang / dpa' stobs dang / dpung rgyan stobs dang / rab brtan dang /sa 'dzin dang / snang byed dang / dri ma med dang / chos kyi dbang phyug dang /chos kyi tog dang / 'gro grub dang / mig thogs pa med dang / bkod pa chen po dang / tshul khrims rnam dag dri ldan dang / pad ma'i 'od de/ lha'i bu bcu drug po de dag ni byang chub kyi snying po yongs su skyong ba dag ste/ thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog pa'itha bzod pa thob pa sha stag go/ /de dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir byang chub kyi snying po brgyan te/dpag tshad brgyad cu khor yug tu rin po che sna bdun gyi (gestegs bu rim pa 3ribadun gyis ni bskor/ shing ta la'i phreng pi ba rim bdun dang / rin po che'i dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba rim 7bdun dang / rin po che brgyus pa rim pa —bdun gyis ni bskor/ 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi glegs bamasherin po che thams cad kyis spras pa dag dang / gser gyi tsong tsong tshadag dang / 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi pad ma dag gis ni khebs par byas/ snying po mchog gi 46—331

spos kyis ni bdugs/ rin po che'i dra bsheni bres so/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa dag na shing sna tshogs mngon par 'phags pa/ ②bzang ba mimangon du mchod pa/ lha yul ba dang / mi yul ba gang dag na yod pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub kyi snying po der snang bar gyur to/ /phyogs bcu dag na chu nas skye ba dang / thang las ⑤skye ba'i me tog rnam pa sna tshogs gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub kyi snying po der snang bar gyur to/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs tshad med pa'i bkod pa dag gis byang chub kyi snying po brgyan par byed pa de dag kyang byang chub kyi snying po der snang bar gyur to/ /de ltar lha'i bu byang chub kyi snying po yongs su skyong ba dag gis byang chub kyi snying por bkod pa de 'dra ba dag sprul par gyur te/ de dag lha dang —/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dag gis mthong nas rang rang gi gnas la dur khrod tsam gyi 'du shes skyed par gyur to/ /bkod pa de dag mthong nas shin tu ngo mtshar cher 'dzin te/ e ma'o bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa'i rgyu 'thun pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa legs so zhes ched du brjod pa'ang7ched du brjod do/ /byang chub kyi shing gi lha mo bzhi yod de'u'adi lta ste/ 'od ma dang / snyan ldan dang / yid bzangs dang / mdangs ldan ma ste/ byang chub kyi shing gi lha mo bzhi po de dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir byang chub kyi shing rtsa ba phun sum tshogs pa/ sdong po phun sum tshogs pa'i/ yal ga dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu sna tshogs phun sum tshogs pa/ khrun dang sboms phun sum 8tshogs pa mdzes 48—332

pa/ blta na sdug pa/ shin tu 'gel ba/ 'phang du shing ta la bdun0srid tsam du mtho ba/ de dang 'tsham par 'gel ba/ bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/yid du 'ong ba/ rin po che sna bdun ②gyi stegs bu rim bdun gyis bskor ba/rin po che'i shing ta la'i phreng ba rim pa nibadun dang / rin po che'i dril bu g.yer ga'i dra ba rim pas bdun dang / rin po che brgyus pa'i phreng ba rim pasabadun gyis kun nas bskor cing phyi rim bskor ba/ shing yongs 'du sa brtol dang 'dra ba/ mig gis blta bas mi ngoms pa bskyed do/ /gang du byang chub sems dpa' 'dug nas byang chub mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'dod pa'i sa phyogs de ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi du rdo rje'i dkyil te/ sra ba/ snying po yod pa/ mi phyed pa/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gnas par gyur pa'o/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba na lus las rnam pa 'di lta bu'i 'od 'gyed de/ 'od des ngan song thams cad zhi bar gyur to/ /mi khom pa thams cad bcad par gyur to//ngan 'gro'i tshor ba thams cad bskams par gyur to/ /sems can gang dag dbang po ma tshang ba de dag ni dbang po yongs su rdzogs pa thob par gyur to/ /nad kyis btab pa rnams ni nad sos par gyur to/ /mi bde ba thams cad ni bde ba thob par gyur to/ /'jigs pas nyen pa rnams ni dbugs phyin pa thob par gyur to/ /bcing bas bcings pa rnams ni bcings pa las grol bar gyur to/ /sems can dbul po rnams ni longs spyod dang ldan par gyur to/ /nyon mongs pas gdungs pa rnams ni yongs su gdung ba med par gyur to/ /bkres pa rnams ni sto 'grangs par gyur to/ /skom pa rnams ni sgom pa med par gyur 46—333

to/ /sbrum ma7rnams ni bde bar btsasalgepar gyur to/ /zhum pa nyamakhuchung ba rnams ni stobs phun sum tshogs par gyur to/ /de'i tshe sems can gang la yang 'dod chags dang zhe snang dang / gti mug dang / khro ba dang / chags pa dang ske/ tha ba dang / gnod sems dang / phrag dog gi gnod pa med par gyur to/ /de'i tshe sems can gang yang 'chi ba med/ 'pho ba med/ skye ba med do/ /de'i tshe sems can thams cad byams pa'i sems dang / phan ④pa'i sems dang ldan zhing gegacig la gcig pha mar 'du shes bskyed par gyur to/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ mnar med pa la thug pa'i bar/ /dmyal ba mi bzad snang ba yi/ /sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi(na/ /bde ba'i tshor ba thob par 'gyuras/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas sems can rnams/ /phan tshun gnod byed ji snyed pa/ /thub chen 'od kyis reg pas na/ /de dag byams pa'i sems kyang skyes/ /yi dgas 'jig rten yi dgas rnams/ /bkres skom nyen pa ji snyed pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzi brjid kyis/ /de dag zas skomanyernyed par gyur/ /mi khom thams cad chad gyur cing / /ngan 'gro rnams kyang skamasakyipar gyur/ /sems can thams cad bder gyur te/ /lha yi bde bas rab tu tshim/ /mig dang rna ba med pa dang / /gzhan yang gang dag dbang po nyams/ /de dag dbang po kun rdzogs shing / /yan lag thams cad mdzes par gyur/ /'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa'i/ /nyon mongs rnams kyis sems can gang / /gnod gyur de tshe nyon mongs kun/ /zhi bar gyur te bde dang hu)ldan/ /smyos pa dag ni dran ldan zhing / /dbul po dag kyang nor dang ldan/ /nad kyis btab pa nad sos shing / /bcing bas bcings pa grol bar gyur/ /ser sna med cing 46—334

dgra med de/ /gnod sems dang ni rtsod pa dag /phan tshun byed pa med gyur te/ /de tshe byams pa'i sems su gnas/ /pha dang ma dag bu gcig la/ /ji ltar phangs par sems pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems can phan tshun du/ /de tshe bu phangs bzhin du sems/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'od dra yis/ /phyogs bcu'i phyogs ni kun tu yang / /gang 〉gā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi/ /zhing rnams bsam gyis mi khyab gsal/ /ri bo nag po rnams dang ni/ /khor yug dag kyang mi snang gyur/ /rgya chen zhing rnams de dag kun/ /gcig po ji bzhin de ltar snang / /lag mthil lta bur gyur pa ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' mchod pa'i phyir/ /zhing rnams thams cad legs brgyan pas/ /thams cad rin chen nyid du snang / /byang chub snying po'i rim gro pa/ /lha ni de ltar bcu drug yod/ /dpag tshad brgyad cu'i sa khyon nang / /byang chub snying po brgyan par gyur/ /zhing rnams bye ba mtha' yas na/ /bkod pa chen po gang yod pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzi brjid kyis/ /de dag thams cad der yang snang / /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /mi 'am ci dang sto 'phye che/ /rang rang gzhal med khang rnams la/ /dur khrod tsam du shes par gyur/ /'dir ni bkod pa de mthong nas/ /lha dang mi rnams ngo mtshar rnyigyur/ /bsod nams gang gi rgyu 'thun 'dirali/ /phun sum 'di 'dra 'di legs 'tsharage/ /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyis/ /brtson par byed patsha med par 4)yang / /de yi yid la 'dod pa dang / /bsam pa thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /ji ltar bsam pa gzhan dag kyang / /sngon spyod tshe na rdzogs gyur pa/ /las de'i 7)rnam par smin pa yis/ /'di 'dra'i phun sum tshogs 'di byung / /byang chub shing gi lha mo 46—335

bzhis / /lha yi shing ni yongs 'du ba/ /de bas khyad par 'phags pa yis/ /byang chub snying por brgyan par⑥byas/ /byang chub snying po'i bkod pa gang / /lha yis mngon par 'dus byas pa/ /yon tan de dag tshig gis ni/ /thams cad brjod par ②yong mi nus/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i lus las 'od phyung ba rnam par dag pa/ dri ma med pa/ lus dang sems tshim par byed cing dga' ba skyed pa/ nyon mongs pa thams cad sel ba/ sems can la dga' ba dang / bde ba dang / dad pa dang / mchog tu dga' ba thams cad skyed pa des klu'i rgyal po nag po'i gnas snang bar byas par mthong nas/ de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po nag po rang gi 'khor gyi mdun du 'dug ste tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gang phyir bdag gi gnas 'di gser gyi 'od kyis brgyan par lha der gyur pa las/ /ji ltar 'khor ba 'jig gi 'od mdzes mthong zhing gser zhes bya bsnyemathong ba dang / /ji ltar 'od srung chos kyi rgyal po skyon med pa yi dri med 'od mthong ltar/ /mtshan mchog ldan zhing phan mdzad ye shes 'od ldan pa zhig 'byung du the tshomasremed/ /sngon chad nyes par byas pa'i las kyis bdagatsog khyim ni shin tu mun pas gang / /khyim 'di na ni nyi ma zla ba dag gis rgya cher 'od kyang yong mi snang / /me dang nor bu dag dang dri med glog dang skar ma rnams kyi 'od mi snang / /brgya byin 'od dang tshangs pa'i 'od dang lha min rnams kyi 'od kyang mi snang na/ /de ring khyim 'di'i nang du nyi ma'i 'od 'dra ba yi dge bas mdzes gyur la/ /sems kyang dga' ba skyed cing lus kyang bde bar gyur la lus ni bsil gyur tedu / /lus kyi steng du bye tshan 'bab pa de yang bdag la bsil bar gyur pa las/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por spyad pa byang chub shing drung 46—336

bzhud par shin tu gsal/ /klu yi me tog mdzes dang bzang la dri zhim gos dang mu tig do shal dang / /rgyan dang gdu bu dag dang phye ma rnams dang bdug pa mchog rnams myur thogs la/ /glu dbyangs dag dang rol mo'i0)dbyangs sgra sna tshogs gyis shig rnga dang rdza rnga bzang / /brdung zhing 'gro blakhukun gyis mchod 'os phan pa mdzad la mchod pa byed du 'dengashe/ /de ni langs te klu yi bu mo rnams dang lhan cig phyogs bzhir bltas pa dang / /de nas ri bo lhun po lta bur gzi brjid rnams kyis legs par brgyan pa zhig /lha dang lha min bye ba dag dang tshangs pa'i dbang dang gnod sbyin rnams kyis bskor/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis de la mchod byed shul ni 'di zhes ston cing 'dong ba mthong / /klu yi rgyalaphude rab tu dga' zhing mgu nas 'jig rten mchog la mchod byas te/ /gus dang bcas pas de yi rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal thub pa'i mdun du 'dug /klu yi bu mo rnams kyang dga' zhing mgu ba'i yid kyis thub la mchod pa byed/ /me tog rnams dang spos dang byug pa dag kyang 'thor zhing sil snyan rnams kyangasabyed/ /klu yi rgyal po rab tu dga' nas thal sbyar yang dag yon tan rnams kyis bstodabya//'dren pa ⑦'jig rten dam pa dgung zla nya ba'i zhal 'dra mthong bar gyur pa phuralegs/ /bdag gis sngon chad drang srong rnams kyi mtshan ma mthong ba khyod kyang de 'dra ste/ /de ring khyod kyis bdud kyi dpung rnams bcom ste bzhed pa'i go 'phang brnyes par 'gyur/ /gang gi don du sngan 7chad dul dang sbyin dang bsdams shing bdog pa kun btang la/ /gang gi don du dul dang tshul khrims byams dang snying rje ba dang bzod pa bsgoms/ /gang gi don du brtson 'grus brtan dang bsam gtan dgyes dang shes rab 'bar mdzad pa/ /khyod kyi smon 46—337

lam de dag thams cad rab tu rdzogs nas de ring rgyal bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar sngon shing lo ma me tog 'bras bur bcas pa byang chub shingashel 'dud/ /ji ltar bum pa chab kyis gang ba stong dag khyod ②la bskor ba rab bgyid cing / /ji ltar tsa sha'i tshogs rnams rab tu dga' ste snyan pa'i sgra skad 'byin pa dang / /ji ltar ngang pa khrung khrung tshogs kyang mkha' la〈kyemachi zhing tshul du shis ldan par/ /dang ba'i yid kyis drang srong la ni bskor ba bgyid las de ring dgra bcom 'gyur/ /ji ltar gser gyi kha dog lta bur mdzes pa'i 'od rnams zhing ni brgyar mchis te/ /ji ltar ngan song mtha' dag zhi bar bgyid cing skye dgu'i0sdug bsngal thar bgyid dang / /ji ltar nyi ma zla ba'i gnas kyi rgyun tshada'agebaser ma'ang dal bus ldang ba las / /srid pa gsum du skye dang rga ba thar mdzad pa yi ded dpon de ring 'gyur / /ji ltar lha rnams 'dod pa'i dga' ba spangs te khyod la mchod du lhags pa dang / /tshangs dang tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang lha rnams bsam gtan bde ba spangs pa dang / /gang yang srid pa gsum na dbang phyug dam pa mchis pa thams cad 'dir lhags las/ /srid pa gsum du skye rga thar ba mdzad pa'i sman pa'i rgyal po ⑥de ring byon/ /ji ltar lha rnams dag gis phyag dar bgyis pa'i shul de nas ni khyod gshegs la/ /bcom ldan 'khor ba 'jig dang gser zhes bgyi dang 'od srung dag kyang de nas gshegs/ /ji ltar pad ma bzang po dri ma ma mchis rnam dag dog sa brtol byung ste/ /de la stobs chen ldan pa zhabs kyi gom pa 'dor las de ring dgra bcom 'gyur/ bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag du ma'i gang gā tho klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bdud/ /de dag rnams kyis byang chub shing drung nas ni khyod la bskyod pa'am g.yos ma nus/ /mchod sbyin khrag khrig 46—338

phrag stong rnam pa du ma gang hā 7klung gi bye ma snyed/ /khyod kyis mdzad cing 'gro la phan phyir spyad pa des na 'diram ni rnam par mdzes/ /rgyu skar zla bar bcas shing skar ma nyi mar bcas pa mkha' las sar ltung gda'/ /ri mchog chen po rang gi gnas nas g.yo zhing rgya mtsho skamasamu par 'gyur yang gda'/ /skyes bu mkhas pa la las khams bzhi po dag re re nas ni ston nus gda'/ /khyod ni shing gi rgyal po'i drung du gshegs nas byang chub ma thob bzhengs mi gda'/ /gang gi slad du kha lo sgyur ba mthong zhing mchod bgyis yon tan brjod pa dang / /byang chub tu yang spro bas bdag gis rnyed pa 'phel ba rgya chen rnyed par gyur/ /bur bcas bdag dang klu yi bu mo thams cad skye gnas 'di las thar gyur cing / /glang po dregs pa'i stabs su bzhud pa khyod kyi stabs des bdag cag mchi bar bgyi/ /dge slong dag de ltar klu'i rgyal po nag po'i chung ma dam pa gser 'od ces bya ba klu'i bu mo rin po che'i gdugs sna tshogs thogs pa dang / sil snyan sna tshogs thogs pa dang / mu tig gi do shal sna tshogs thogs pa dang / nor bu rin po che sna tshogs thogs pa dang / lha'i ngudang mi'i phreng ba brgyus pa sna tshogs thogs pa dang / pog phor sna tshogs thogs pa dang / sil snyan dang glu dbyangs sna tshogs len pa rab tu mang pos yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ byang chub sems dpa'i gan du 'dong zhing rin po che'i me tog sna tshogs mngon par gtor te tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis kyang bstod do/ /'khrul pa mi mnga' mi bsnyengs sa mi 'dzem bag mi tsha/ /ma zhum mi dman rab tu dgyes par gdul dka' ba/ /ma chags mi snang ma rmongs brkam pa mi mnga' ba /chags bral rnam grol drang srong khyod la phyag 'tsha'/ lo/ /sman pa zug rngu bral ba 46—339

gdul ba 'dul mdzad pa/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal rnams las thar mdzad sman pa mchog /gnas dang skyabs ma mchis shing dman pa mkhyen nas ni/ /'jig rten gsum 'dir gnas dang skyabs su khyod byung ngo / /ji ltar lha tshogs rab tu dad cing dgaranyegyur te/ /me tog char pa chen po mkha' las 'bebs pa dang //'di dag ji ltar gos chen 'thor bar bgyid pa las/ /de ring rgyal bar 'gyur gyisasherab tu dgyes par mdzod/ /shing dbang drung du gshegs la bsnyengasalgepa mi mngar bzhugs/ /bdud kyi sde las rgyal mdzod nyon mongs dra ba drol/ /sngon gyi rgyal dbang rnams kyis ji ltar sangs rgyas ltar/ /byang chub zhi ba dam pa mchog tu ༅'tshang rgyar mdzod/ /khyod kyis gang gi don du bskal pa bye mang dudu/ /'gro ba sgrol0ba'i don du dka' ba spyad pa mdzad/ /khyod kyis dgongs pa rdzogs te dus la da gebab kyis/ /shing dbang drung du gshegs te byang chub mchog reg mdzod/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpas 'di snyam du bsams tenyu/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ci zhig la bzhugs nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs ⑩pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas snyam mo/ /de nas des yang 'di snyam du bsams teḥha/ rtswa bting nas bzhugs so snyam mo/ /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i tshogs brgya stong bar snang la 'khod pa dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi yongs su rtog pa sems kyis shes nas tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /de de bzhin no/ /skyes bu dam pa de de bzhin te/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa de dag rtswa bting ba la bzhugs nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /dge slong dag byang chub sems dpas tsolam gyi g.yas rol na rtswa 46—340

'tshong ①bkra shis pa zhes bya ba rtswa sngo ba/ 'jam pa/ shin tu gzhon pa/nyams dga' ba/ lcangakhulor 'khril bar 'dug pa/ g.yas su 'khyil ba/ rma bya'i mgrin⑧pa lta bu/ ka tsa lin da'i skyigos ltar reg na bde ba/ dri rab tu zhim pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ yid du 'ong ba dag brngasnyizhing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang byang chub sems dpas lam bor te/ rtswa 'tshong9)bkra shes pa ga la ba der song nas phyin pa dang / rtswa 'tshong bkra shis pa la snyan pa'i tshig gis smras te/ tshig de ni ri rikun shes par byed pa dang / rnam par shes par byed pa dang / rnam par gsal ba dang / mi chod pa dang / chags par byed pa dang / snyan cing 'jibs 1 pa dang / mnyan par 'os pa dang /snum pa dang / go bar byed pa dang / skul ba dang / tshim par byed pa dang /dga' bar byed pa dang / mi rtsub pa dang / sha sha 7bo ma yin pa dang / mi brlang ba dang / mi bskam pa dang / 'jam pa dang / snyan pa dang / rnar bde ba dang / lus dang sems shin tu dga' bar byed pa dang / 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug dang 'thab pa dang / rnyog pa sel ba dang /ka la ping ku'i sgra skad lta bu dang / bya ku na la dang / shang shang te'u la sogs pa sgra 'byin pa'i nga ro lta bu dang / rnga bo che dang / glu dbyangs kyi sgrar nyaskad kyi nga ro dang ldan pa dang / gnod pa med pa dang / bden pa dang / gsal ba dang / yang dag pa dang / tshangs pa'i sgra skad bsgrags pa'i gdangs lta bu dang / rgya mtsho'i sgra'i shugs lta bu dang / ri rdob pa'i sgra lta bu dang ldan pa dang / lha'i dbang po dang /8 lha ma yin gyi dbang pos mngon par bstod pa dang / zab pa dang / gting dpag dka' ba dang / bdud kyi stobs stobs 46—341

med par byed pa dang / phas kyi rgol ba'i smra ba 'joms pa dang / seng ge'i sgra'i shugs lta bu dang / rta dang glang po che'i sgra 'byin pa'i nga ro lta bu dang /klu sgra sgrog0)pa lta bu dang / 'brug zer ba'i sgra lta bu dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / 'dul ba'i sems can thams cad tshim par byed pa dang / rtab rtab porasem yin pa dang /'tshe ba med pa dang / mi shol50pa dang / 'tsham pa dang / rigs pa dang /dus su smra ba dang / dus las ④mi yol ba dang / chos brgya stong legs par brgyus pa dang / mnyen pa dang / thogs pa med pa dang / rgyun chad pa med pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa dang / skad cig gis skad thams cad sgrogasalgepa dang / bsam pa thams cad shes par byed pa dang / bde ba thams cad skyed pa dang / thar pa'i lam yang dag par ston pa dang / lam gyi tshogs smra ba dang / 'khor las mi 'da' ba dang / 'khor thams cad tshim par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa dang 'thun pa ste/ byang chub sems dpas de lta bu'i tshig gis rtswa 'tshong ⑥bkra shis pa la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bkra shis rtswa dag nga la myur du byin/ /de ring nga la rtswas ni don chen 'gyur/ /dpung dang bcas pa'i bdud ni bcom nas su/ /byang chub dam pa zhi ba reg par 'gyur/ /gang gi ched du nga yis bskal stong du/ /sbyin dang dul dang sdom dang gtong byas dang / /tshul khrims brtul57zhugs dka' thub rab spyad pa/ /de ni de ring nga yis thob par 'gyur/ /bzod pa'i stobs dang de bzhin brtson 'grus stobs/ /bsam gtan stobs dang de bzhin shes rab stobs/ /bsod nams dang ni mngon shes rnam thar stobs/ /de ni de ring nga 46—342

la 'grubanyepar 'gyur/ /shes rab stobs dang thabs kyi stobs dag dang / /rdzu 'phrul dang ni chags med byams pa'i stobs/ /so so yang dag rig dang bden pa'i stobs/ /de ni de ring nga la 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ring nga la rtswa sbyin byas na⑧ni/ /khyod la bsod nams stobs ni mtha' yas te/ /de ni khyod kyi ngan pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur/ /khyod kyang ston pa bla na med par 'gyur/ /bkra shis pas ni 'dren pa'i tshig snyan rab tu mdzes thos nas/ /dga' zhing mgu la yid rangasasherab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis ni/ /rtswa 'jam gzhon zhing bzang la reg par ldan pa spar gang thogs/ /mdun du 'dug nas rab tu dga' ba'i sems kyis 'di skad smras/ /gal te rtswa yis byang chub go 'phang dam pa 'chi med pa/ /mchog gyur zhi ba blta dka' sngon gyi rgyal ba'i lam 'thob na/ /yon tan chen po'i0rgya mtsho grags pa dpag med khyod bzhes shig sku /bdag gis go 'phang dam pa 'chi med thog mar 'tshang rgyar bgyi/ / byang chub sems dpas smras pa/⑥brtulakhuzhugs dka' thub rnam mang bya dka' bskal mang ma spyad par/ /bkra shes rtswa mchog bting bas byang chub 'di ni 'thob mi 'gyur/ /gang tshe blo gros ldan pa shes rab bsod nams thabs kyis 'phags/ /de nas rgyal ba thub pas rdul med 'gyur zhes lung ston to/ /bkra shis gal te byang chub skye bo gzhan la sbyin nus na/ /srog chags bsdu ba byas te sbyin par yid gnyis khyod ma za/ /gang tshe nga yis byang chub thob shes dzo ribadud rtsi rnam par dbyes/ /khyod 'ongs chos kyi dam pa nyon dang rdul dang bral bar 'gyur/ /'dren pas shin tu mchog tu 'jam pa'i rtsa0)ni spar gang blangs/ /seng ge ngang pa'i stabs kyis chas 3nya nas sa ni rab tu g.yos/ /lha klu tshogs rnams thal mo sbyar te rab tu dga' yid 46—343

kyis/ /deng 'dis bdud dpung bcom nas bdud rtsi reg par 'gyur snyam sems/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi shing drung du 'gro ba na lha'i bu rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' deng 'dir 'dug nas byang chub thob par 'gyur zhing mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur snyam ste/ byang chub kyi shing brgyad khri brgyan par gyur to/ /de nas7byang chub kyi shing kha cig ni me tog gi rang bzhin can la 'phangakhudu dpag tshad brgya pa yang yod/ byang chub kyi shing kha cig ni spos kyi rang bzhin can la 'phang du dpag tshad stong pa yang yod/ byang chub kyi shing kha cig ni tsan dan gyi rang bzhin can la 'phang du dpag tshad 'bum pa yang yod/byang chub kyi shing kha cig ni gos kyi rang bzhin can la 'phang du dpag tshad lnga 'bum pa yang yod/ byang chub kyi shing kha cig ni rin po che'i rang bzhin can la 'phang du dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu pa yang yod/ byang chub kyi shing kha cig ni rin po che thams cad kyi rang bzhin can la 'phang dushedapag tshad bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong pa yang yod rga/ /byang chub kyi shing de dag thams cad kyi drung na yang ji ltar 'dug pa'i seng ge'i khri lha'i ras bcos bu sna tshogs bting ba bshams par gyur to/ /byang chub kyi shing kha cig gi drung du ni pad ma'i khri stan bshams par gyur to/ /kha cig gi drung dusani spos kyi khri stan no/ /kha cig gi drung du ni rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyi khri stan no/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni rol pa bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rol pa bkod pa 'di la byang chub sems dpa' snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu de nas skad cig de nyid la byang chub sems dpa' mtshan dang 46wa 344
