dpe byad bzang pos legs par brgyan pa'i lus kyis byang chub kyi shing drung gi seng ge'i khri de dag thams cad la 'dug par kun tu snang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / lha'i bu so so'i yid la yang byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag nyid kyi seng ge'i khri la snyoms par zhugs shing 'dug gi gzhan gyi khri7la ni ma yin par shes so/ /ji ltar de dag gis shes pa de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rol pa bkod pa 'di nyid kyi mthus sems can dmyal ba pa dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa thams cad dang / lha dang mi thams cad dang / 'gro ba thams cad du skyes pa'i sems can thams cad kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' rji byang chub kyi shing drung na seng ge'i khri la 'dug par mthong ngo / /de lta mod kyi 'on kyang dman pa la mos pa'i sems can rnams kyi blo gros yongs su tshim par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rtswa spar gang thogs te/ byang chub kyi shing ga la ba der song nas phyin pa dang / byang chub kyi shing la lan bdun bskor ba byas te/ bdag nyid kyis rtswa'i rtse mo ni nang du bstan/ rtsasheb ni phyir bstan nas/ rtswa'i gding ba kun nas bzang po bting0ste/ seng ge lta bu dang / dpa' bo lta bu dang / stobs lta bu dang /brtan⑧pa lta bu dang / brtson 'grus lta bu dang / mthu lta bu dang / glang po lta bu dang / dbang phyug lta bu dang / rang byung lta bu dang / ye shes can lta bu dang / bla na med pa lta bu dang / khyad par lta bu dang / mngon par 'phags pa lta bu dang / grags pa lta bu dang / brjod pa lta bu dang / sbyin pa lta bu dang / tshul khrims lta bu dang / bzod pa lta bu dang / brtson 'grus lta bu dang / bsam gtan lta bu dang / shes rab lta bu dang / ye shes lta bu 46—345

dang / bsod nams lta bu dang / bdud phyir0rgol ba bcom pa lta bu dang /tshogs lta bur skyil mo krung bcas nas rtswa bting ba de la shar phyogs su bltas te 'dug nas/ lus drang por bsrang ste/ dran pa mngon du bzhag nas 'di 'dra ba'i yisadam brtan po byas so/ /stan⑧'dir bdag gi lus ni skams0kyang rung / /pagasaphupa rus pa sha rnams zhigashekyang rung / /bskal mang rnyed dka' byang chub ma thob par/ /stan 'di las ni lus bskyod mi bya'o/ /byang chub kyi snying por bzhud pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste/ bcu dgu pa'o// //'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bcu gsum pa/ dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa dang / 'dod pa na spyod pa'i ris ༅drug gi lha rnams byang chub sems dpa' la bar chad byed pa mi 'byung grang snyam ste/ shar duphyogs logs su gnas par gyur to/ /de bzhin du lho dang nub dang / byang phyogs kyang lha rnams kyis yongs su bsrungs par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' skul ⑨ba zhes bya ba'i 'od byung nas 'od des phyogs bcu kun tu grangs med dpag tu med pa/chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang bar gyur to/ /de nas shar phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams dri ma med par byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bde ba bkod pa zhes bya ba 'od des bskul bas byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis yongs su 46—346

bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi ༅phyir de'i tshe rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon 2par 'du bya ba de lta bu byas te/rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba de byas pas phyogs bcur nam mkha'i mthas gtugasashepa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad 'khor gyi khyams be+e drur+ya sngon po dgang las7byas pa zhig tu bstan to/ /'gro ba lngar skyes pa'i sems can thams cad kyi mdun du yang byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug par ( ri bstan to/ /sems can de dag kyang phan tshun du sor mo gcig gis ci kyibyang chub sems dpa' ston cing sems can tshul du shis pa'i gzugs 'di lta bu dang ldan pa 'di su zhig /'di ltar rnam par mdzes pa'i sems can 'di su zhig ces 'dzer to/ /sems can de dag gi mdun du byang chub sems dpa' des byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang sprul te/ de na byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs de dag gis tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /ci yang med pa'i 'dod chags zhe sdang rtog pa gang yin bag chags bcas bton pa/ /gang gis lus las 'od phyung phyogs bcu'i 'od pu skurnams thams cad 'od ni med par byas/ /gang gis bsod nams ting 'dzin ye shes tshogs ni bskal pa mang por kun spel ba/ /shākya thub pa thub pa chen po dam pa 'di ni phyogs rnams kun tu mdzes/ /de nas lho phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phro'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che bkod par byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che'i gdugs brtsegs pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba 'od des bskul bas byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis yongs su bskor cing 46—347

mdun du bdar te/ byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' la ①mchod pa'i las kyi phyir rin po che'i gdugs gcig gis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi khyams de bkab bo/ /de na⑧brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dag phan tshun 'di skad 'dzer te/ gang gi phyir rin po che'i gdugs bkod pa rnam pa 'di lta bu 'di snang bar gyur pa 'di su'i 'bras bu zhes 'dzer to/ /de nas rin po che'i gdugs de las tshigs su bcad pa 'di byung ngo /gang gis rin po che dang spos gdugs stong phrag bye ba khrag khrig dag /byams pa'i yid kyis do zla med parakhubazhugs dang mya ngan 'das la phul/ /de yis mtshan mchog ldan pa phan mdzad sred med bu yi mthu ldan pa/ /yon tan mnga' ba byang chub shing drung gshegs pa de la mchod pa byas/ /de nas nub phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa me tog gi phreng ba nags tshal gyi phreng ba me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon parasnyimakhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams me tog tsam pa ku'i kha dog tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dbang po'i dra ba can zhes bya ba 'od des bskul bas byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir rin po che'i dra ba gcig gis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi khyams de bkab bo/ /de nasaphyogs bcu'i lha dang / klu dang —/ gnod sbyin dang / dri za dag phan tshun du 'di skad 'dzer te/ 'od kyi bkod pa rnam pa 'di lta bu 'di su'i yin zhes 'dzer to/ /de nas rin po 46—348

che'i dra ba de las tshigs su bcad pa 'di byung ngo / /rin chen 'byung gnas 'jig rten gsum dga' rin chen tog /rin chen dam pa rin chen grags pa de chos dgyes/ /dkon mchog gsum po rgyun mi 'chad pa'i brtson 'grus brnyes/ /byang chub mchog brnyes 'gyur te de yi mchod pa 'di/ /de nas byang phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla zil du rlag par byed pa'i 'od dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams nyi ma 'khor bar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'od des bskul bas byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa ji snyed pa de snyed 'khor gyi khyams der kun tu bstan to/ /de na byang chub sems dpa' kha cig 'di skad 'dzer te①/ bkod pa rnam pa 'di lta bu 'di su'i yin zhes 'dzer to/ /de nas bkod pa de dag thams cad las tshigs su bcad pa 'di byung ngo / /gang gis bsod nams ye shes shin tu mang pos lus ni rnam sbyangs shing / /gang gis brtulakhuzhugs dka' thub dag dang bden pa'i chos kyis ngag sbyangs la/ /gang gis khrel yod mos pa byams dang de bzhin snying rjes sems sbyangs pa/ /de ni shing rgyal drung gshegs shākya khyu mchog de la mchod pa byed/ /de nas shar lho'i phyogs mtshams na de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gyi rgyal po snang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan gyi 'byung gnas su byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan gyi blo gros zhes bya ba 'od des 46—349

bskul bas byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'7ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir ②'khor gyi khyams der yon tan gyi bkod pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa mngon par sprul te khang pa brtsegs pa de las tshigs su bcad pa 'di byung ngo / /gang gi yon tan dag gis lha dang lha min dang / /gnod sbyin sto 'phye che dag rtag tu yon tan bgosage/ /yon tan can de yon tan ldan pa'i rgyal rigs skyes/ /yon tan rgya mtsho byang chub shing gi drung na bzhugs/ /de nas lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams na de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen srog shing gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che 'byung bar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che 'byung ba zhes bya ba 'od des bskul bas byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir 'khor gyi khyams der rin po che'i mkha' rten grangs med dpag tu med pa mngon par sprul te thu/ rin po che'i mkha' rten de dag las tshigs su bcad pa 'di byung ngo / /gang gis rgya mtshor bcas pa'i sa dang de bzhin rin chen rnam 5 dag dang / /khang bzangs skar khung bsil khang mchog dang zung dang bzhon pa mkha' rten brgyan/ /me tog phreng ba mdzes dang 'dun sa dag dang skyed mos tshal rnams dang / /rkang pa lag pa mgo dang mig btang ba de byang chub snying por po)'dug /de nas nub byang gi phyogs mtshams na de bzhin gshegs pa 46—350

'brug sgra rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams sprin dang ldan par byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sprin brtsegs 37'brug bsgrags dbyangs zhes bya ba 'od des bskul bas byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir dus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i a ga trīru'i sprin mngon par sprul te 'khor gyi khyams der tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i phye ma'i char mngon par phab bo/ /dus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sprin gyi dkyil 'khor de las kyang tshigs su bcad pa 'di byung ngo / /rig dang rnam par grol ba'i 'od kyi chos kyi sprin gyis srid gsum thams cad khyab/ /dam chos 'dod chags bral ba bdud rtsi mya ngan5ci'adas pa thob byed char pa 'bebs/ /'dod chags nyon mongs 'ching ba'i 'khri shing thams cad bag chags bcas te gcod par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan rdzu 'phrul stobs dang dbang po'i me tog rgyas pasadad par byed pa 'byin/ /de nas byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams na de bzhin gshegs pa rin po 5che'i gdugs mngon par 'phags pa snang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gser gyi dra bas khebs pa na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gser gyi dra bas brgyan ne pa zhes bya ba 'od des bskul bas byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir khang pa brtsegs pa de dag thams cad dang / rin po che'i mkha' rten rnams su byang chub sems dpa'i 46—351

gzugs mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa dag mngon par sprul te/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs de dag thams cad kyang lha dang mi'i me tog gi phreng ba thogs shing byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba de 1)logs su lus btud nas me tog gi phreng ba spyangasashete tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /gang gis sangs rgyas khrag khrig sngon bstod cing / /gus dang bcas pas dad pa che bskyed la/ /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs snyan⑧pa'i tshig smras pa/ /byang chub snying por byon la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /de nas 'og gi phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gzigs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu rnam par bltas par byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che'i snying po zhes bya ba 'od des bskul bas byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir be+e budrur+ya'i 'khorabagyi khyams der 'dzam bu'i gling gi gser gyi pad ma rnams mngon du byung bar bstan to/ /pad ma de dag gi snying po la bud med lus byed snang ba/ kha dog dang gzugs phun sum tshogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bstan te/ lag pa g.yas g.yon dun mgul gdub dang /gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / gser skud dang / mu tig gi do shal la sogs pa rgyan rnam pa mang po thogs shing me tog dang dar gyi lda ldi spyangs nas byang chub kyi snying po ga dzil ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba de logs su lus )btud de tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /gang zhig rtag tu sangs rgyas nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal dag dang bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /khrims ldan 46—352

rtag dran dga' la nga rgyal med/ /yon tan ldan pa de la 'dudakyi/pa byos/ /de nas steng gi phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs kyi dbang po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams tshogs kyi dam par byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' mdzod ces byachub 'od des bskul bas byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir nam mkha'i dkyil na 'dug bzhin du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na sngon ma mthong ma thos pa'i me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / bdug spos dang / gos dang / rgyan byadang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i khang pa dang / rin po che dang / nor bu dang / gser dang / dngul dang / mu tig dang / rta dang / glang po che dang / shing rta dang / dpung bu chung dang / bzhon pa dang / shing sngon pa dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang /'bras bu dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad nam mkha'i dkyil nas char chen po gamangon par phab ste/ thams cad dga' ba dang /bde ba skyed kyi sems can gang la yang 'jigs pa'am gnod par mi byed do/ /de bzhin du sbyar te de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /phyogs bcu de dag rnams nas 46—353

rgyal ba'i sras po gang / /phan par byed pa mchod par byang chub lhags gyur pa/ /'gro la phan pa de dag rnams kyi bkod rim dang / /rtsal dang rim pa mdzes pa dag gi dpe tsam nyon/ /kha cig do shal khrag khrig rab tu spyangs7byas te/ /nam mkha' las ni 'brug ltar shin tu sgrogs shingasalhags/ /kha cig mkha' las me tog gzhal med khang ston cing / /cod pan rin chen thogs la gtsug phud 'phyang zhing lhags/ /kha cig stong pa mtshan med smon med mchog brjodakhucing / /sa las seng ge lta bur shin tu sgrogs shing ④lhags/ /kha cig sngon chad ma mthong me tog mdzes 'thorabazhing / /khyu mchog ci 'dra de 'drar shin tu sgrogs shingakhulhags/ /kha cig rang gi lus kyi kha dog stong ston cing / /rma bya lta bur mkha' las shin tu sgrogs shing50lhags/ /kha cig bde gshegs sras kyi yon tan phreng brjod rin cing / /zla ba lta bur mkha' las shin tu rgyas shing lhags/ /kha cig nyi ma lta bur 'od zer rab 'gyed de/ /bdud kyi gnas rnams thams cad mog mog byed cing lhags/ /bsod nams tshogs bsags kha cig dbang po'i mchod sdong 'dra'i/ /dri med tog thogs shebyang chub snying po der yang lhags/ /kha cig mkha' las nor bu rin chen dra ba 'thor/rte/ /zla ba zla bzangs thang skyes rnam nyanyamadzes man dā 8ra/ /par sha tsam pa ka dang sna ma'i me tog phreng / /byang chub sems dpa' shing rgyal drung na bzhugs la 'thora'i/ /kha cig rkang pa gnyis kyis sa ni rab bskyod 0la/ /sa bskyod nas kyang skye bo dga' bar byed cing lhags/ /kha cig ri bo lhun po lag na thogs byed la/ /bar snang gnas te me tog skon bu 'thor zhing lhags/ /kha cig rgya mtsho bzhi po mgo la thogs nas ni/ /sa la spos chu 'thor te chag chag 'debs shing lhags/ /kha cig rin chen mchod 46—354

sdong sna tshogs thogs nas ni/ /rgyang ring 'dug ste byang chub sems dpa' ston cing lhags/ /kha cig tshangs pa lta bur zhi ba'i gzugs bsgyur te/ /yid zhi rab zhi gnas shing bsam gtan bsam gtan pa/ /de dag ba spu dag las byams dang snying rje dang / /dga' dang btang snyoms tshad med yid 'ong sgra 'byin0)lhags/ /kha cig brgya byin lha ltar stong phrag khrag khrig gi/ lha rnams dag gis mdun du bdar nas lhags gyur cing / /de dag byang chub shing drung phyin nas thal sbyar te/ /brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu rin chen sna tshogs 'thor//kha cig phyogs bzhi dag gi skyong ba ji lta bar/ /dri za srin po mi 'am ci yis yongs bskor te/ /glog ltar gsal ba'i me tog char pa 'bebs shing lhags/ /dri za mi 'am ci yi skad kyis brtan pa bstod(gyi/ /kha cig me tog rgyas pa'i ljon shing 'bras bur bcas/ /me tog bcas shing mchog gi dri ni rab 'byin la/ /lo mar sangs rgyas sras po lus phyed gnas thogs lhags/ /btud nas sa yi snying por me tog rnams kyang 'thor/ /kha cig pad ma ud pal pad ma dkar po rgyas/ /pad ma'i snying por sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan gnas/ /de 'drar me tog rgyas pa'i rdzing bu thogs te lhags/ /chags med yid ldan byang chub sems dpa' mkhas la tshibastod/ /kha cig lhun po lta bur lus chen bsgyur te lhags/ /bar snang gnas nas rang gi lus kyang rab tu 'dor/ /borang ma thag tu me tog phreng ba rnams su gyur/ /stong gsum dag gi rgyal ba'i zhing rnams khebs par byed/ /kha cig mig gnyis sreg pa'i bskal pa lta bu dang / /de bzhin chags pa dang ni 'jigangonapar ston cing lhags/ /de dag lus lasasho kyichos kyi sgo mo mang gragasheste/ /de dag thos pas sems can khrag khrig sred pa spong / /kha cig mchu 46—355

ni tham pa 'dra la bzhin mdzes shing / /kha bzhin rdzogs la mi'am ci 'dra'i sgra sgrogs7lhags/ /do shal sna tshogs legs brgyan bu mo chasalgepa 'dra/ /de la ltasagyibs lha yi tshogs rnams ngoms mi 'gyur/ /kha cig rdo rje lta bur mi phyed lus can de/ /rkang pas 'og gi chu yi phung po 'bog cing lhags/ /nyi ma 'dra zhing zla ltar bzhin rgyas snang byed la/ /'od byed nyon mongs skyon rnams bcom pa kha cig lhags/ /kha cig rin po ches brgyan lag na rin chen thogs/ /zhing mang bye ba stong dag khebs par byed cing lhags/ /sems can mang la phan dang bde dang tshim bya'i phyir/ /rin chen me tog dam pa dri zhim char pa 'bebs kha cigasnyigazungs chen rin po che yi mdzod gyur cing / /ba spu rnams nas mdo sde khrag khrig rab brjod5gel/ /spobs par ldan zhing blo gros ldan la blo mchog ldan/ /rgyags zhing rtsirab dregs skye bo rinartogs par byed cing lhags/ /kha cig ri bo lhun po rnga50ltar thogs nas ni/ /rab tu rdung zhing mkha' las yid 'ong sgra 'byin lhags/ /de yi sgra ni phyogs bcur bye ba'i zhing song ste/ /bdud rtsi ma thob ston pa do mod 'tshang rgyar sgrog1) /byang chub kyi snying por bkod pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste nyi shu pa'o// //dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dag gis byang chub kyi snying por bkod pa rnam pa de lta bu de dag mngon par byas par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyis kyang phyogs bcu dag gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na byang chub kyi 46—356

snying po'i rgyan bkod pa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi snying po der kun tu bstan to/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug nas 'di snyam du sems te/ 'dod pa'i khams 'di'i bdag po dbang phyug dbang sgyur ba ①bdud sdig can de la bdag gis ②ma spran par bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba de ni bdag gi mi chasas/ bdag gis bdud sdig can bskul bar bya'o/ /de las rnam par rgyal na 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha la sogs pa thams cad tshar bcad par 'gyur ro/ /'on tang bdud kyi 'khor na bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa 'khod pa dag gis nga'i seng ge rnam par rol pa mthong na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpas 7de ltar bsams nas de'i tshe smin mtshams kyi bar gyi mdzod spu nas bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gcig phyung ste/'od zer des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad kyi bdud kyi gnas thams cad snang bar byas nas mog mog por byas te rab tu g.yos par byas par yangs gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad kyang snang ba chen pos yongs su khyab par gyur to/ /bdud sdig can gyis 'od de las rnam pa 'di lta bu'i sgra 'di yang thos so /sems can shin tu dag pa bskal mang spyod spyad pa/ /zas gtsang sras pos rgyal srid dag ni rab spangs te/ /phan byed de ni bdud rtsi mngon par 'dod pas byung / /byang chub shing drung 'ongs kyis de ring bsgrim par7gyis/ /de ni 46—357

bdag kyang rgal la gzhan yang sgrol bar byed/ /de ni bdag nyid grol bas gzhan yang grol bar byed/ /de ni bdag kyang dbugs phyin gzhan dag dbugs kyang 'byin/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das nas gzhan dag mya ngan zlo/ /ngan song gsum po ma lus stongasalgepar byed par 'gyur/ /lha mi rnams kyi grong khyer gang bar byed par 'gyur/ /phan pa byed pa de ni bdud rtsi thob gyur nas/ /bsam gtan mngon shes bdud rtsi bde mchog sbyin par 'gyur/ /gang tshe rang byung nyid kyis chos char mngon phab tshe/ /nag po'i rtsa lag khyod kyi grong khyer stongs byed 'gyur/ /stobs med pas kyang stobs med 'gyur te dpung nyams 'gyur/ /phyogs ni phyogs min ci bya garakhu'agro shes mi 'gyur/ /dge slong dag de ltar bdud sdig can bskul duba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bskul nas rmi lam rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis rmis cu noso/ /rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bdag gi gnas mun pas khyab par rmis ④pa dang / rang gi gnas rdul gyis gang zhing gyo mo dang gseg mas gang bar rmis pa dang / bdag nyid sngangasakyiskrag nas phyogs phyogs su 'bros par rmisasnyo pa dang / bdag cod pan dang bral zhing rna cha lhung bar mis pa dang / bdag mchu dang gre ba dang / rkan skamasalgepar rmis pa dang / bdag snying kun tu gdungs par rmis pa dang / skyed mos tshal gyi lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu rnams nyis par mis pa dang /rdzing rnams skams 7te chu med par rmis pa dang / ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang ske/ rma bya dang / ka la ping ka dang / ku na la dang / shang shang te'u la sogs pa bya'i tshogs rnams 'dab gshog zegs par rmis pa dang / rnga dang /dung dang / rdza rnga dang / kharamo/1rnga dang / rgyud gcig pa dang / pi bang 46—358

dang / rgyud gsum pa dang / pheg dang / khar7ba'i sil khrol la sogs pa rol mo'i cha byad rnams chag grugs te sa la lhung bar rmis pa dang / 'khor sdug pas kyang bdud spangs te ngo 'dzum gnag cing phyogs gcig tu dong nas sems shing 'khod par mis pa dang / chung ma'i dam pa phreng ba can yang mal nas sa la lhung ste lag pa gnyis mgo la deb par rmis pa dang / bdud kyi bu gang dag shin tu brtson 'grus dang ldan pa dang / shin tu stobs dang ldan pa dang / shin tu gzi brjid dngasaldan pa dang / shin tu shes rab dang ldan pa de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam pa la 'dug pa la phyag 'tshal bar rmis pa dang / bdag gi bu mo rnams kyang kyi hud yab/ kyi hud yab ces chosange 'don par rmis pa dang / bdag lus la gos dri ma can gyon par rmis pa dang / bdag mgo rdul gyis gang la skya 3bo bseng bseng po dang / nyamasachung ba dang / mdangs nyams par rmis pa dang / bsil khang dang / khang pa brtsegs pa dang / skar khung dang / rta babs rnams kyang rdul gyis gang nas rdib par rmis pa dang / de'i sde 6dpon gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /grul bum dang / dri za'i bdag po gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang oms tshugs bcas te ngu zhing chos3ninges btab nas byer bar rmis pa dang / 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyi lha'i bdag po 'di lta ste/ yul 'khor srung dang /'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / rnam thos kyi bu dang / brgya byin dang / rab 'thab bral dang / yongs su dga' ldan dang / rab 'phrul dang / dbang sgyur la sogs pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang bdud la 8mi gus shing byang chub sems dpa' la phyogs par rmis pa dang / thab lhamo'i 46—359

nang na de'i ral gri shugs ①nas ma phyin cing bdag mi shis pa'i sgra 'byin par rmis pa dang / rang gi 'khor gyis bdag por bar rmis pa dang / bkra shis kyi bum pa sgor lhung bar rmis pa dang / bram ze mis byin gyi bu yang bkra mi shis pa'i sgra sgrogasalgepar rmis pa dang / sgo ba kun tu dga' byed kyang kun tu mi dga' ba'i sgra sgrogasalgepar mis pa dang / nam mkha'i dkyil mun pas khebs par rmis pa dang / 'dod pa'i gnas na gnas pa'i dpalasayang ngu bar rmis pa dang / bdag gi dbang yang dbang med par gyur par mis pa dang / rang gi phyogs kyang phyogs ma yin par mis pa dang / nor bu dang mu tig gi dra ba rnams kyang chad cing rnam par chad nas 'brulasabar mis pa dang / bdud kyi gnas thams cad kyang rab tu g.yos par mis pa dang / shing rnams kyang bcad cing ba gam yang lhung bar rmis pa dang / bdud kyi sde bkod pa thams cad kyang khasasasbub tu 'gyel bar mis pa ste/ dge slong dag de ltar bdud sdig can gyi rmi lam du rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di lta bu rmis so/ /de sad pa dang /'jigs skrag sngangasar nas nang mi thams cad bsogs te/ dpung dang bcas pa dang / 'khor dang sde〈 nadapon dang / sgo ba dang de dag 'dus par rig nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bdud des rmi lam de dag mthong nas nyam thag ste/ /sde dpon bdud po seng ge za 'gram zhes byashedang / /bu rnams dag dang 'khor rnams gang dag yin la smras/ /nag po'i rtsa lag de dag kun la yongs su dris/ /shākya'i nang du skyes pa mtshan mchog yan lag spras/ /lo drugebar du bya dka' brtul zhugs drag po spyad/ /byang chub shing drung 'ongs kyis rab tu sgrims shig ces/ /mdang sum bar snang las ni tshigs bcad de 46—360

skad grag① /byang chub sems dpa' de nyid rnam par sangs rgyas nas/ /sems can bye ba khrag khrig mang po rnams rtogs byed/ /gang tshe bdud rtsi thob ste bsil ba'i dngos reg tshe/ /des ni nga gnas ma lus stong gepar byed par 'gyur/ /dpung chen rnams dang lhan cig der ni rab dong ༅la/ /shing dbang drung 'dug dge sbyong gcig de gzhoms par bya/ /yan lag bzhi pa'i sde rnams myur du rab tu sgrims/ /gal te nga la sdug sems phyi shol55nom byed cig /dgra bcom rang sangs rgyas kyis 'jig rten gang gyur kyang / /mya ngan 'da' bas5nyabadag dpung nyam chung yong mi 'gyur/ /de yang gcig pu rgyal ba chos rgyal gyur na ni/ /bgrang las 'das pa'i rgyal ba'i rigs ni gzhal ༅mi 'chad/ /dge slong dag de nas ⑧bdud kyi bu ded dpon zhes bya bas bdud sdig can de la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ yab cig ci nongs zhal gyur cing ni zhal mdog nyams/ /thugs kyang 'phar la khyod kyi yan lag nying lag 'dar/ /khyod kyis ci gsan ci gzigs myur du bka' spyol cig /yang dag bsams 3)nas de bzhin sbyar ba 'tshal bar bgyi/ /nga rgyal med bdud smras pa bu cig nga la77nyon//ngas ni sdig pa'i rmi lam shin tu mi bzad /nyarmis/ /de ring 'khor 'dir de kun ma lus smras na ni/ /khyed rnams brgyal te sa la rab tu skyelamatshabar 'gyur/ /ded dpon gyis smras pa/ gal te 'thab dus bab ste rgyal na nongs ma mchis/ /gal te der ni /stobacom par gyur na nongs dang bcas/ /gal te khyod kyi rmi lam de 'dra'i ltas lags na/ /bzhag na dge ste g.yul ngor yongs su bstangs mi 'gyur/ /bdud kyis smras pa/ brtsal ba grub pa'i skyes bu g.yul ngor grags par 'gyur/ /gal te brtan la brten te legs byas bdag cag rgyal/ /kho bo 48—361

'khor dang bcas pa mthong nas langs nas su/ /kho bo'i rkang par mgos phyag mi 'tshal des mi nus/ /ded dpon gyis smras pa/ rgya chen dpung bdoganyekyang ni shin tu mthu chung ste/ /stobs ldan dpa' bo gcig pu mchis na g.yul las rgyal/ /gal te srin bu me khyer stong gsum gang gyur kyang / /nyi ma gcig pu'itsozil du brlag ste 'od mi bgyid/ /gzhan yang gang la nga rgyal gti mug mchis la dpyod ma mchis/ /mkhas dang mi 'thun bgyid pa de ni gso mi nus/ /dge slong dag de ltar bdud sdig can gyis ded dpon gyi tshig ma mnyan nas/ yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung chen po stobs che ba/ 'thabasremo la dpa' ba/ 'jigasasresu rung ba/ spu zing zhes byed nus pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyis sngon ma mthong ma thos pa/ bzhin bsgyur ba rnam pa mang po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma bsgyur ba'i rnam pa dang ldan pa/ rkang lag sbrul brgya stong gis dkris ༅pa dang ldan pa/ral gri dang / mda' gzhu dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang / sta re dang / rtse gsum kha gdeng dang / bong ba dang / gtun shing dang / be con dang / zhags pa dang / dbyug to dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang /rdo rje rtse gcig pa thogs pa dang myu/ lus la go cha bzang po bgos pa/ mgo dang —/ rkang lag dang / mig log par 'dug pa/ mgo dang / mig dang /gdong 'bar ba/ lto dang rkang lag dbyibs mi sdug pa/ bzhin gzi brjid drag po dang ldan pa/ shin tu bzhin bsgyur cing so gtsigs pa/ 'jigs su rung bar mchekhub gtsigs pa/ lce stug cing zheng che nyu)ba mang po 'phyang ba rtse 'bar 'bur can re lde dang 'dra ba/ mig me dang sbrul nag po dug gis rgyas pa'i mig ltar dmar ba dag char spubacug ste/ de la kha cig ni sbrul gdug skyug 46—362

pa/ kha cig ni nam mkha' lding gis rgya mtsho nas phyung ba bzhin du lag mthil du sbrul gdug pa bzhag ste za/ kha cig ni mi'i sha dang / khrag dang / rkang lag dang / mgo dang / mkhal ma dang / nang grol tu)dang / ngan skyugasam la sogs pa za rmikha cig ni gzugs sngo bsangs dang / kham pa po dang / sngon po dang / dmar po dang / ser por 'dug ste/ 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs sna tshogs can/ kha cig ni mig zhigs 0pa dang / mig khron pa lta bu dang /mig phyung ba lta bu dang / mig 'bar ba dang / mig bzur ba/ mi sdug pa/kha cig ni mig log pa dang / 'bar ba dang / mi 0sdug pa/ kha cig ni ri 'bar ba thogs te/ 'gying zhing ri gzhan la zhon te 'ong / kha cig ni shing rtsa thon byas te byang chub sems dpa'i ri logs su rgyug cing 'ong / kha cig gi rna ba ni phag rna lta bu dang / zhib ma lta bu dang / glang po'i rna ba lta bu dang /'phyang ba dang / phag rna lta bur 'dug pa/ kha cig ni rna ba med pa/ kha cig ni keng rus mang po sprul nas lus rid cing gsus pa che la sna zhom pa/ gsus pa bum pa lta bur 'dug pa/ rkang pa mgo'i thod pa ltar 'dug pa/ pags ri )pa dang / sha dang khrag skams tshopa/ rna ba dang / sna dang / rkang lag dang /mig dang / mgo bcad 7pa/ kha cig ni khrag 'thung 'dod pas gcig la gcig mgo gcod pa/ kha cig ni sgra sha sha po dang / sgra mi snyan pa dang /'jigs su rung ba dang / sgra rtsub pa dang /lhaldan pa/ hu hu pazhes bya ba dang /mchi 8zhes bya ba dang / hu lu hu lu zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin pa dang / sgyugs pa len pa dang / dge sbyong go ta ma cho'adi shing dang chos te 'on cig ces zer ba dang ske/ 'or cig ces 9zer ba dang / rgyob cig ces zer 7ba dang / rab tu 46—363

rgyob cigamo/)ces zer ba dang / chings shig ces zer ba dang / zung shigasheces zer ba dang / chod cigasheces zer ba dang / gtubs shig ces zer ba dang / gtogs shig ces zer ba dang / bab bab tu 'or cig ces zer ba dag go/ /kha cig ni wa dang / ce spyang dang / phag dang / bong bu dang /ba lang dang / glang po che dang / rta dang / rnga mo dang / rkyang dang / ma ho dang / ri bong dang / g.yag dang / bse dang / ri dgas ldang sko0ska la sogs pa'i kha gdongasnyisna tshogs 'jigs su rung ba sngangs par byed pa/ mi sdug pa dang ldan pa dag go/ /kha cig ni seng ge dang / stag dang / phag rgod dang / dred dang / spre'u dang / gzig dang / byi la dang / ra dang /lug dang / sbrul dang / ne'u le dang / nya dang / chu srin dang / chu srin byis pa gsod dang / rus sbal dang / bya rog dang / bya rgod dang / lug pa dang / nam mkha' lding lta bu'i lus dang ldan pa dag go/ /kha cig ni gzugs mi sdug pa dag go/ /kha cig ni mgo gcig pa dang / mgo gnyis pa nas mgo brgya stong gi bar dang ldan pa dag go/ /kha cig ni mgo med pa'o/ /kha cig ni lag pa gcig pa nas lag pa brgya stong gi bar dang ldan pa dag go/ /kha cig ni lag pa med pa dag go/ /kha cig ni rkang pa gcig pa nas rkang pa brgya stong gi bar dang ldan pa rtsodag go/ /kha cig ni rkang pa med pa dag go/ /kha cig ni rna ba dang / kha dang / sna dang / mig dang / lte ba'i khung bu nas sbrul gdug pasa'abyin to/ kha cig ni ral gri dang / mda' gzhu dang /mdung thung dang / rtse gsum kha gdeng dang / dgra sta dang / 'khor lo dang /mda' bo che dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / rdo rje dang / bong ba ⑨dang /46—364

mtshon rtse gcig pa la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs gsor zhing gar byed la/byang chub sems dpa' la sdigs mo byed do/ /kha cig ni mi'i sor mo bcad nas phreng bar brgyus0te thogs so/ /kha cig ni keng rus dang / thod pa dag phreng ba lta bur brgyus te thogs so/ /kha cig ni lus sbrul gdug pas dkris so/ /kha cig ni mgo la zhugs ling me can thogs te/ glang po dang / rta dang / rnga mo dang / ba lang dang / bong bu dang / ma he la zhon no/ /kha cig ni spyi'u tshugs su 'dug la khab lta bu'i spu can dag go/ /kha cig ni ba lang dang /bong bu dang / phag rgod dang / ne'u le dang / ra dang / lug dang / byi la dang / spre'u dang / spyang ki chodang / ce spyang gi spu lta bu dang ldan la/sbrul gdug pa skyug cing lcags kyi thu lum mid pa dang / me 'byin pa dang /lcags dang / zangs 'bar ba'i char 'bebs pa dang / lce 'bebs pa dang /rdo rje'i lce 'bebs pa dang / lcags kyi bye ma tshan mo'i 4)char 'bebs par dang /sprin nag po bsdus te rlung gi char 'bebs pa dang / mda'i sprin bsdus te char du 'bebs pa dang / mun gnag ston pa dang / sgra 'byin cing byang chub sems dpa'i logs su rgyug pa dag go/ /kha cig ni zhags pa skor ci phob dang /ri chen po rnyil bar byed pa dang / rgya mtsho chen po 'khrugs tshapar byed pa dang /ri chen po las mchong ba dang / ri'i rgyal po lhun sna po sgul ba dang / rgyug pa dang / 'bros pa dang / yan lag dang / nying lag 'thor ba dang / lus skor ba dang gad mo cher rgod lha pa dang / brang rdung ba dang / brang la deb r+shapa dang / mgo gsig pa dang / mgo 'bar zhing skra gyen du 'greng ba dang /phan tshun shugs phyung ste 8rgyug cing wa'i mig lta bus byang chub sems dpa' la 46—365

'jigs par byed do/ /bud med rgan mo dag kyang ngu zhing byang chub sems dpa'i gan du lhags te/ 'di skad du kyi hud bu/ kyi hud nga'i bu/ longs shig /longs la myur du bros shig ces 'dzer to①/ /srin mo'i gzugs dang /sha za mo'i gzugs dang / yi dgas long ba/ theng ponya/ rke ba/ bkres pas rid pa/ lag pa bsgreng ba/ kha gcusalgepa dag kyang ngu zhing 'jigs pa ston te/ sngangs par byed cing byang chub sems dpa'i mdun na rgyug go/ /bdud kyi dpung 'dus pa gernam pa de lta bu des dpag tshad brgyad cu kho ra khor yug tu gang bar gyur to0/ /bdud gcig gi ji lta ba de bzhin du stong gsum gyi stong chen po bye ba phrag brgyar gtogs pa'i bdud sdigashecan rnams kyi dpung dag gis thad ka dang / steng gang bar gyur to/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/gnod sbyin grul bum lto 'phye chen po'i gzugs/ /srin po yi dgas sha za'i gzugs dang bcas/ /'jig rten mi sdug drag gzugs ji snyed pa/ /thams cad sgyu yis derasnyeni sprul pa byas/ /mgo gcig mgo gnyis mgo gsum ldan pa nas / /mgo stong bar du ldan bzhin gnod sbyin mang / /lag gcig lag gnyis lag gsum ldan pa nas/ /lag stong bar du ldan pa rab tu mang / /rkang gcig rkang gnyis rkang gsum ldan pa nas/ /rkang stong bar du ldan pa gzhan yang mang / /kha bzhin sngo la lus ni ser ba dang / /kha bzhin ser la lus ni sngo ba dang / /kha bzhin dkar la lus ni gnag ༅pa dang / /kha bzhin gnag la lus ni dkar ba dang / /kha bzhin gzhan la lus kyang gzhan pa dang / /de 'dra'i phyag brnyan dag gi dpung rnams lhags/ /stagarwarnyedang sprul dang phag gi gdong can dang / /glang po rta dang bong bu rnga mo'i gdong / /spre'u dang seng ge 46—366

dred kyi gdong can dang / /de 'dra'i kha gdong ldan pa'i dpung rnams lhags/ /ral pa brjes la 'jigs pa'i gnod sbyin mang / /lug mgo rus pa 'bar 'bur sba ba can/ /lus ni mi yi khrag gis rab tu sbagasayo / /gnod sbyin de 'dra ba dag derasheyang lhags/ /rkang pa dag ni dgo50ba'i rkang pa 'dra/ /mig gi 'bras bu spre'u'i mig dang mtshungs/ /mche ba dag ni glang po'i mche ba 'dra/ /kha gdong de 'dra'i dpung rnams der yang lhags/ /lus kyi dbyibs ni chu srin 'dra ba ste/ /mig gi 'bras bu gnyis ni rab tu 'bar/ /rna ba dag ni ra yisarna ba 'dra/ /kha gdong de 'dra'i dpung rnams der yang lhags/ /kha cig dag ni lag na dbyig 0pa thogs/ /tho ba mdung thung rtse gsum lag na thogs/ /kha cig ri bo lhun po lag na thogs/ /'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs can gnod sbyin lhags/ /gshol thogs 'khor lo thogs shing mig sgyur dang / /ri rtse chen po lag na thogs pa dang / /rlung dang rdo dang gnam lcags rab 'bebs shing / /gnod sbyin 'jigs su rung ba der yang lhags/ /rlung ni rab tu gtong zhing char yang 'bebs/ /brgya phrag stong gi glog kyang rab tu 'byin/ /'brug gi sgra yang sgrog cing shing7ljon sgyel/ /byang chub shing gi lo ma tsam mi g.yo/ /char pa rab tu 'bebs shing rlung yang gtong / /chu bo 'bebs shing chu yis sa yang gang / /de ltar 'jigs su rung ba mtshan mo byung / /de yi nub mo sems med shing yang sgyel/ /thams cad dbyibs mi sdug cing gzugs mi sdug /'jigs pa'i gzugs ldan de dag mthong nas kyang / /yon tan mtshan dang gzi brjid ldan pa po/ /lhun po lta bur sems ni g.yo ba med/ /sgyu ma 'dra zhing rmi lam mtshungs pa dang / /sprin dang 'dra bar chos rnams kun la rtog /de ltar chos 46—367

kyi tshul la rtog pas ni①/ /legs gnas bsam gtan byed cing chos la gnas/ /gang zhig nga dang nga yi snyam sems shing / /dngos dang lus la yang dag mngon zhen pa/ /mi mkhas 'dzin par gnas des mthong nas ni/ /'jigs par gyur cing bdag kyang rab tu myos/ /shākya'i sras pos chos rnams rten mibyung ba/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i sems dang rab tu ldan / /dpung bcas gegayo sgyu mthong yang myos pa med/ /dge slong dag de ltar bdud sdig can gyi bu stong po de dag gi nang nas ded dpon la sogs pa bdud kyi bu gang dag byang chub sems dpa' la mngon par dad pa de dag ni bdud kyi g.yas rol tu 'khod par gyur to/ /gang dag bdud kyi phyogs byed pa de dag ④ni bdud sdig can gyi g.yon rol tu 'khod par gyur to/ /de na ④bdud sdig can gyis rang gi bu de dag la smras pa/ yu bu cag ci 'dra ba'i dpung gis byang chub sems dpa' gdul bar bya/ de na g.yas rol nas bdud kyi bu ded dpon zhes bya bas pha la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ klu yi dbang po gnyid log slong 'dod dang / /glang po'i dbang po gnyid tshulog slong 'dod dang / /ri dgas rgyal po gnyid log slong 'dod pa/ /de ni mi dbang legs gnas slong bar 'dod/ /g.yon rol nas bdud kyi bu blo gros ngan pa zhes bya ba des 'di skad ces smras so/ /bltas pa tsam gyis snying yang rab tu 'gas 'gyur la/ /'jig rten dag na snying po ldan pa'i shing chen 'gas/ /bdag gi 5 1lta bas phog na 'gro ba 'chis phogaloltar/ /'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i mthu ni de la ga la mchis/ /g.yas rol nas dbyangs snyan ces bya bas smras pa/ bltas pa tsam gyis shing yang 'gas na mi rnams la/ /bdag bsgrim 7ci dgos zhes smras snying po ga la yod/ /46—368

gal te bltas pas ri bo lhun po 'jig 'gyur yang / /de yi mdun du khyod ni mig 'byed yong7mi nus/ /gzhan yang mi gang rgya mtsho lag pa gnyis kyis rgal 'dod cing / /de yi chu ni brngubs te 'thung bar nus 'gyur gyi/ /de yi kha bzhin dri ma med la mngon sum du/ /lta ba de ni de bas sdug bsngal che zhes smras//g.yon rol nas lag brgya mipa zhes bya bas smras pa ci / bdag gi lus 'di lag pa brgya mchis pa/ /gcig gis kyang ni mda' brgya 'phang 4)bgyis te/ /dge sbyong de yi lus ni dbug par 3)bgyi/ /yab cig bder 'gyur ma shol khyod gshegs shig /g.yas rol nas blo bzang po zhes bya bas smras pa/ ba spu rnams kyang ci phyir lag pa min/ /lag pa brgya dang khyad par ci zhig yod/ /lag pa re rer de ltar mdung yod kyang / /de dag gis kyang de la ci mi nus/ /⑦ci'im )phyir zhe na/ des ni 'jig rten 'das pa'i byams pa bsgoms/ /byams ldan thub pa de yi sku la ni/ /dug dang mtshon 3)dang me yis mi tshugs te/ /mtshon cha 'phangs pa thams cad me tog 'gyur/ /gzhan yang mkha' dang sa dang chu la stobs ldan gang / /mi 'am gnod sbyin ral gri dgra sta mthogs/ /mi dbang bzod pa'i stobs ldan de drung phyin/ /stobs chen stobs ldan de kun stobs chung 'gyur/ /g.yon rol nas gzi brjid drag shul can zhes bya bas smras pa/ bdag ni de yi lus bzang gi/ /khong du zhugs te bsreg /stopar bgyi/ /'brog gi me ltar chung ngu yisatso/ /rkang dang bcas pa'i shing yang bskam/ /g.yas rol nas mi bzangs kyis 7smras pa/ /khyod ni ri rab sa yi nang zhugs te/ /thams cad ma lus bsreg 7par nus gyur kyang / /khyod dang 'dra ba gang gā'i 8bye snyed kyis/ /rdo rje'i thugs ldan de ni bsreg pami nus/ /gzhan yang ri bo thams cad 'gul 46—369

yang srid/ /rgya mtsho chen po zad kyang srid/ /nyi zla sa la lhunganyeyang srid/ /sa ni zhu bar 'gyur yang srid/ /'jig rten don du rtsom mdzad pa/ /thugs dam nges par mdzad pa po/ /byang chub dam pa ma thob par/ /shing chen drung nas bzhengs mi srid/ /g.yon rol nas lag rings kyisakhubasgyingasashete smras pa/khyod kyi gnas 'dir mchis bzhin du/ /bdag gis sug pas༄nyi ma dang / /zla ba skar ma rnams kyi gnas/ /thams cad rab tu mnye bar bgyi/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi po las/ /tshul du shis par chab kyang blang / /yab cig dge sbyong de bzung ste/ /rgya mtsho'i pha rol dor bar bgyi/ /yab cig dpung 'di gzhag tu gsol/ /khyod ni thugs ngan che ma mdzad/ /byang chub shing de drungs phyung ste//sug pas phyogs phyogs gtor bar bgyid/ /g.yas rol nas dad pa0thob pas smras pa/ gal te khyod ni dregs bsgyings te/ /lha dang lha min dri zar bcas/ /sa dang ri dang rgya mtshor bcas/ /de dag lag pas phyir rlog0kyang / /khyod dang 'dra ba stong phrag ni/ /gang gā'i bye ma snyed rnams kyis/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab can/ /de yi ba spu g.yos7mi nus/ /g.yon rol nas 'jigs byed kyis smras pa/ /dpung gi nang na bzhugs bzhin du/ /yab khyod ci slad rab tu bsnyengs/ /de la dpung grogs ga la mchis/ /ci slad khyod 'dir de la bsnyengs1)/ /g.yas rol nas blo gros rtse gcig gis smras pa/'jig rten dag na nyi zla dpung ma mchis/ /'khor los sgyur dang seng ge dpung ma mchis/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni dpung ma mchis/ /'on kyang gcig pus bdud ni gzhom par spyod/ /g.yon rol nas glags ltas smras pa/ mdung thung rtse gsum dbyug to7ral gri rta /rnye/ /glang po shing rta rkang tang ma mchis pa//46—370

dge sbyong gcig pu mchis pa de bdag gis/ /do mod dgum gyis0)cung zad ma bsnyengs yab/ /g.yas rol nas bsod nams brgyan gyis smras pa/ sred med bu ltar mi phyed mi shigs sku dang ldan/ /bzod stobs go mnabs brtson 'grus brtan pa'i ral gri mda'/ /rnam par thar gsum bzhon dzo — pa shes rab gzhu lags yab/ /bsod nams stobs kyis de ni bdud kyi dpung las rgyal/ /g.yon rol nas phyir mi ldog pas smras pa/ 'brog me rtswa la tshig pa phyir mi ldog/lobs pas 'phangs pa'i mda' yang phyir mi ldog /mkha' las rdo rje 'bab pa51phyir mi ldog /shākya'i bu las ma rgyal bdag gnas med/ /g.yas rol nas chos 'dod kyis smras pa/ gsher ba'i rtswa dang phrad na me yang ldog /brag gi rtse mor babasnyen mda' yang ldog /rdo rje sar bab de nas gang du 'gro/ /zhi ba bdud rtsi ma thob de mi ldog /ci'i phyir zhe na/ yab cig bar snang la ni ri mo bri bar nus kyang gda'/ /sems can ji snyed kun gyi shisems ni gcig bsdur nus kyang gda'/ /yab cig nyi zla rlung ni zhags pas bcing du nus kyang gda'//byang chub sems dpa' byang chub snying po las ni bskyod mi nus/ /g.yon rol nas nye bar ma zhi bas smras pa/ lta ba'i gdug pa chen pos lhun po bsreg par bgyi/ /rgya mtsho chen po rnams kyi chab kyang bskam par bgyi/ /bdag gis do mod de gnyis thal bar brlag par bgyi༄ / /yab cig byang chub dang ni dge sbyong gzigs su gsol/ /g.yas rol nas don grub kyis smras pa/ gal te dug gis 'di kun gang gyur la/ /stong gsum dam pa rab tu 'bar gyur kyang / /yon tan 'byung gnas kyis ni gzigs tsam gyis/ /dug ni dug ma yin par rab tu 'gyur/ /srid pa gsum na gdug pa drag po ni/ /'dod chags zhe sdang 46—371

de bzhin gti mug ste/ /de dag de yi sku dang thugs la med/ /mkha' la rdzab dang rdul ni med pa bzhin/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyang rab tu dag /sems can kun la byams pa'i thugs dang ldan/ /de la mtshon dang dug gis yong mi tshugs/ /de bas yab cig thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /g.yon rol nas dga' ba chags pas smras pa/ bdag gis sil snyan stong dag rab bgyis te/ /lha yi bu mo brgyan pa bye stong gis/ /chags par bgyis te grong khyer mchog tu bkri/ /'dod la dga' bar khyod kyi dbang du bgyi/ /g.yas rol nas chos dgas smras pa/ de 'dir rtag tu chos la dgyes pas dgyes①/ /bsam gtan dgyes shing bdud rtsi don la dgyes / /sems can thar bar mdzad dang byams la dgyesarig/ /'dod chags dga' la de ni dgyes mi mdzad/ /g.yon rol nas rlung gi shugs zhes bya bas smras pa/ bdag gi shugs kyis nyi zla mid bgyis 'kha/ /nam mkha' las ni rlung yang rab gtangasazhing / /yab cig do mod dge sbyong bzung nas ni/ /rlung gis ༅phub ma bzhin du gtor bar bgyi/ /g.yas rol nas bdud kyi bu blo gros mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba des 'di skad ces smras so/ /ji ltar khyod kyi shugs mgyogs drag pa ltar/ /gal te lha dang mi rnams de 'drar gyuradu ni / /de dag thams cad gcig tu 'dus pas kyang / /zla med gang zag de la gnod mi nus/ /g.yon rol nas tshangs pa'i blo gros kyis smras pa/ de 'dra'i 9)drag po phal cher gyur kyang ni/ /khyod kyi nga rgyal cung zad 'joms mi nus / /bgyi ba thams cad mang pos 'grub lags na/ /gcig pus khyod la ci bgyi smos ci 'tshal/ /g.yas rol nas seng ge'i blo gros kyis smras pa/ /sa la seng ge khyus 'khod sngon ma byung / /lta ba'i gdug pa dag kyang khyus mi 'khod/ /46—372

gzi ldan bden pa pha rol gnon7pa po/ /skyes bu khyu mchog rnams kyang khyus mi 'khod/ /g.yon rol nas thams cad du gdol pa zhes bya bas smras pa/ ji ltar khyod kyi sras po brtson 'grus dang / /shugs dang stobs dang ldan pa sgra sgrogasakhupa/ /tshig 'bar de 'dra yab kyis sngon gsan tam/ /myur du dge sbyong de ni gzhom du bzhud/ /g.yas rol nas seng ge sgra sgrogs50zhes bya bas smras pa/nags tshal dag gi khrod na wa mang pos/ /seng ge med pa de na sgra yang sgrogasasni / /seng gis sgra bsgrags 'jigs pa thos pa dang / /skrag nas phyogs phyogs dag tu rab tu 'bros/ /de ltar bdud bu mi mkhas 'di dag kyang / /mi mchog gsung ni ma thos de bar du/ /de dag spyi brtol 3 byed cing byung rgyal smra/ /mi yi seng ges gsung bsgrags 'bros par 'gyur/ /g.yon rol nas nyes par bsam pa sems pas smras pa/ bdag gis gang bsams pomyur du 'dir 'grub na/ /de ni ci slad dpung tshogs 'di mi lta/ /gang phyir langs te myur du mi 'bros pas/ /de ni glen pa cho ga ma 'tshal ba/ /g.yas rol nas don legs par bsam pa sems pa zhes bya bas smras pa/ de ni mi glen pha rol gnon pa ste/ /khyed cag glen zhing shin tu ma bsdams pa/ /khyed kyis de yi mthu rtsal yong mi shes/ /de yi shes rab stobs kyis thams cad pham/ /bdud kyi bu ni gang gā'i bye ma snyed/ /khyed cag rnams kyis de 'dra'i mthu nartsal can/ /de yi ba spu gcig kyang g.yos 4rimi nus/ /gsad par bsams /nyapa mi 'grub smos ci dgos/ /khyod ni de la yid kyis gnod ma sems/ /gus dang bcas par dad pa'i sems su gyis/ /'di ni srid gsum rgyal por gyur pas na/ /'thab 8mo ma byed par ni slar log shigati /de bzhin du sbyar te de ltar bdud kyi bu dkar po'i phyogs pa dang nag 46—373

po'i phyogs pa stong du tshang ba de dag thams cad kyis so so nas bdud sdig can la0tshigs su bcad de smras so/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyishesde dpon sde bzang po zhes bya ba des bdud sdig can la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ /gang dag khyod kyi rjes 'brang brgya byin dang / /skyong dang mi 'am ci yi tshogs rnams dang / /lha min dbang dang mkha' lding dbang po rnams/ /thal mo sbyar te de la phyag 'tshal na/ /khyod kyi rjes su 'brang ba ma lags pa/ /tshangs pa 'od gsal lha yi bu rnams dang / /gnas gtsang ris kyisalha rnams de dag kun/ /de la phyag 'tshal ba ni smos ci 'tshal/ /khyod kyi sras po shes rab can/ /stobs dang ldan zhing yid gzhungs pa/ /de dag byang chub sems dpa' la/ /snying dang 'thun gyur phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpag tshad brgyad cur khyab pa yi/ /gnod sbyin la sogs bdud dpung 'di/ /phal cher rab tu dang yid kyis/ /kun kyang nyes pa med la dzo/ /'jigs su rung zhing drag bsgyur ba/ /dpung tshogs mi bzadakyi'adi gzigs nas/ /ngo mtshar ma gyur zhum mi mnga' nges par do med 'di rgyal 'gyur/ /gang na dpung 'di gnas pa der/ /wa dang lug pa sgra 'byin la/ /bya rog bong bu sgra 'byin pas/ /myur du slar ni ldog pa'i rigs/ /byang chub snying por gzigs su gsol/ /pa ta kun ta ngang pa dang / /khu byug rma bya mngon skor ⑥bas/ /nges par do mod 'di rgyal 'gyur/ /gang na dpung 'di gnas pa der/ /rdul dang snag tsa'i char 'bab la/ /sa dkyil me tog char 'bab pas/ /bdag gi tshig bzhin ldog pa'i rigs/ /gang na dpung 'di gnas pa de/ / shang shongakhu gyur cing tsher mas gang / /sa dkyil dri med gser gyur pas/ /shes rab can dag ldog pa'i rigs/ /gal te mi 'dod sngar rmis 46—374

pa'i/ /rmi lam de dag mngon sum 'gyur/ /drang srong rnams kyi yul brlag pa/ /de bzhin dpung 'di thal bar rlos /rgyal po 'gro ba drang srong mchog /tshangs pas byin gyis khros byas pas/ /dan da ka yi nags tshal tshig /lo mang zhig tu rtswa ma skyes/ /drang srong brtul mizhugs spyod pa po/ /dka' thub ldan pa'i 'jig rten na/ /ji snyed 'khod pa kun gyi mchog /'byung po kun la mi 'tshe 'di/ /gang gi lus la mtshan rab 'bar/ /khyim nas kyang ni byung ba der//nyon mongs pham byas 'tshang rgya zhes/ /khyod kyis sngon chad ma gsan nam/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis mchod don du/ /'byor pa 'di 'dra 'di dag sprul/ /de bas nges par sems can mchog /sbyin bsreg skyedam pa len par 'gyur/ /'di yi mdzod spu dri med pa/ /bye ba khrag khrig zhing du mdzes/ /de yis bdag cag mog mog bgyis/ /bdud dpung nges ④bcom gdon mi 'tshal/ /srid pa'i rtse gnas lha rnams kyis/ /de yi spyi gtsug bltar mi nus/ /nges par gzhan gyis ma bstan par/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid thob par 'gyur/ /ji ltar lhun po khorasheyug dang / /nyi zla brgya byin tshangs pa dang / /shing ston rnams dang ri mchog kun/ /sa dkyil 7phyag 'tshal bgyid las na/ /bsod nams stobs can shes rab stobs/ /ye shes stobs can bzod pa'i stobs/ /brtson 'grus stobs dang ldan pa de/ /bdud phyogs stobs med mdzad par ༅nges/ /glang pos so ma btang snodango nodang / /seng shes ji ltar wa bcom dang / /nyi mas srin bu me khyer ltar/ /bde bar gshegs pas dpung bcom 'gyur/ /tshig de skad thos pa dang bdud kyi bu gzhan zhig shin tu khros nas mig dmar por gyur te smras pa/ khyod ni gcig pu de yi bsngags pa dag /shin tu dpag tu med par 48—375

rjod ①byed na/ /gcig pu des ni ci zhig bya bar nus/ /'jigs su rung ba'i dpung chen ma mthong ngam/ /de nas g.yas rol nas bdud kyi bu bdud rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya bas smras pa/ 'jig rten nyi zla seng ge dang / /'khor los sgyur la grogs byed med/ /byang chub bzhugs nas nges pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' grogs mi dgos/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas bdud mthu chung bar bya ba'i phyir gang mthong bas bdag gi dpung byang chub sems dpa'i kha'i nang du zhugs so snyam du sems shing bdud bros par gyur pa dang / bros nas kyang ci yang ma yin no snyam nas yang slar log ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs byang chub sems dpa'i steng du 'phen cing / ri rab tsam gyi ri de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i steng du 'phangs pa dang / me tog gi bla re kladang / gzhal med khang du gyur te gnas pa dang / gang dag mig gdug pa dang / myur du gdug pa dang / dbugs gdug pa rnams me lce gtong ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor de yang byang chub sems dpa' la 'od kyi dkyil 'khor lta bur gnas par bya ba'i phyir pad ma 'dab ③ma brgya pa rgyas pa lta bu'i bzhin bskyod do/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpas lag pa g.yas pas mgo la byugs pa dang / bdud kyis byang chub sems dpa'i lag na ral gri thogs par mthong nas lho phyogs su bros pa dang ci yang ma yin no snyam nas yang slar log go/ /slar log nas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i steng du mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs ral gri dang / mda' gzhu dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang / dgra sta dang / bong ba dang / gtun shing dang / rdo rje rtse byagacig pa dang dzha/ dbyug to dang / 'khor lo dang / tho ba dang / shing drungs gebyung 46—376

dang / pha bong dang / zhags pa dang / lcags kyi thu lum shin tu 'jigs pa du ma 'phen te/ de dag kyang 'phangs ma thag tu me tog gi phreng nyu)ba dang / me tog gi bla rerashegyur te gnas so/ /me tog sil mar yang gyur nas sa la 'thor ba dang / phreng ba'i chun por yang 'phyang bas byang chub kyi shing brgyan par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bkod pa 'byor pa de dag mthong nas bdud sdig can phrag dog dang ser snas sems la gnod de/ byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ kye rgyal bu gzhon nu bzhengs/ bzhengs/ rgyal srid la spyod cig /khyod kyi bsod nams de tsam gyis khyod kyis thar pa ga la 'thob/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas brtan la zab cing rgya che ba dang / 'jam zhing snyan pa'i tshig gis bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sdig can khyod kyis ni gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gcig gis 'dod pa'i dbang phyug thob tu zad do/ /ngas ni mchod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin byas so/ /lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / mig dang / mgo dag kyang bcad cing slong ba rnams la byin no/ /sems can rnams thar bar bya ba'i phyir khyim dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / mal cha dang / gos dang /'chags dang / skyed mos tshal rnam pa du mchadag kyang slong ba rnams la byin no//de nas bdud sdig can gyis tshigs su bcad de byang chub sems dpa' la slar smras pa/ sngon chad 5kho bos mchod sbyin kha na ma tho med/ /gtan pa med pa byas pa khyod 'dir dpang du yod/ /khyod la 'di na dpang po gang yang yod min pas/ /smras kyang phan pa ci yod khyod ni pham par gyur/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ sdig can sa 'di ni nga'i dpang yin no/ /de nas byang chub 46—377

sems dpasatubadud sdig can dang bdud kyi 'khor la byams pa dang snying rje sngon du 'gro ba'i sems kyis khyab par byas nas/ seng ge ltar mi 'jigs mi skrag la bag tsha ba med cing mi dman la ma zhumasapa dang / ma 'khrugasalgepa dang / ma rtogs ④pa dang / 'jigs pa dang / spu zing zhes byed pa med par lag mthil na dung dang / rgyal mtshan dang / nya dang / bum pa dang / bkra shes pa dang / lcags kyu dang / 'khor lo'i mtshan ma yod pa/ sor mo bar dra bas 'brel ba/ sen mo shin tu mdzes shing zangs kyi mdog ltar 'dug pas brgyan pa/'jam zhing mnyen la shin tu gzhon pa/ bskal pa dpag tu med par dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs bsags pas grub pa'i lag pa g.yas pas lus thams cad la byugs nas tshul du shis par sa la brdabs te de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang smras so/ /sa 'di 'gro ba kun gyi gnas yin te/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu snyoms shing nye 'khon gemed/ /'di ni bdag gi dpang ste bdag brdzun0med/ /'di la khyod ni bdag gi dpang byos shig /byang chub sems dpas sa chen po 'di la reg ma thag tu rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos so/ /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu chem chem mo/ /'di lta ste dper na/ yul ma ga d+ma'i ⑦brdab khar sgra 'byung zhing sgra rgyun ring ba de bzhin du sa chen po 'di yang byang chub sems dpa'i nalag pas bsnun ma thag tu sgra byung zhing sgra rgyun ring du byung ngo // //'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bcu bzhi pa/ de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na sa'i lha mo brtan ma zhes bya ba sa'i lha stimo'i 'khor bye ba phrag brgya dang ldan pa gang 46—378

yin pa des sa chen po thams cad g.yos par byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu sa brtol te/ lus rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa phyed phyung nas byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba0)de logs su lus btud de thal mo sbyar nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /de de bzhin no/ /skyes bu chen po de de bzhin no/ /khyod kyis ji skad gsungs pa bzhin te/ 'di ni bdag la mngon sum mo/ /de lta lags mod kyi/ 'on gyis kyang bcom ldan 'das nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi dbang du gyur pa dang / tshad mar gyur pa dam pa lags so/ /sa'i lha mo chen mo brtan mas de skad ces smras nas/ rnam pa du mar bdud sdig can gyi glags ni med par byas/byang chub sems dpa' la ni bstod de/ rang gi mthu rnam pa mang po bstan5nyanas 'khor dang bcas te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /g.yon can dpung bcas sa sgra de thos nas/ /nags su seng shes sgra bsgrags was thos dang / /bya rog rdo 'phangs mod la 'byer ba bzhin/ /sngangs skrag snying gsalathams cad rab tu byer/ /de nas bdud sdig can sdug 0bsngal zhing yid mi bde ste/yi ma rangs la skyengs bzhin du nga rgyal gyi zil gyis non pas ma song la phyir yang ma log cing bros kyang ma bros te phyir bltas nas yang dpung rnams la smras pa/khyed lhan cig 'dus te cung zad cig sdod cig /rnam pa 'di lta bu'i sems can rin po che glo bur du chud mi gzan par kho bos rjes su 'chags pas 'di bslang bar nus sam mi nus sad par bya'o/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis rang gi bu mo rnams la smras pa/ bu mo khyed dengaposte byang chub kyi snying por song la spubyang chub sems dpa' 'dod chags dang bcas pa'am/ 'on te 'dod chags 48—379

med/ ci gti mug can nam/ 'on te shes rab can/ ci ldongs pa zhig gam/'on te phyogs shes pa zhig gam/ 'on te dpung gnyen med pa zhig gam/dman pa zhig gam brtan pa zhig yin pa bgoms shig /tshig de thos nas bdud kyishebu mo de dag byang chub kyi snying po ga la bshedang / byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du 'khod de / bud med kyi sgyu rnam pa sum khucu rtsa gnyis nye bar bstan to/ /rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de'i nang nas kha cig ni bzhin phyed 'gebs pa dang / kha cig ni nu ma mkhrang zhing 'bur ba ston pa dang / kha cig ni cung zad 'dzum pas so'i phreng ba ston pa dang / kha cig ni lag pa brkyang ste bya skyangs byed cing mchanas)khung ston pa dang / kha cig ni shing thog bim pa ltarang )dmar ba'i mchu ston pa dang / kha cig ni mig phyed btsums te cubyang chub sems dpa' la lta zhing / bltas nas myur ba myur bar 'dzums pa dang /kha cig ni nu mashephyed g.yogs te ston pa dang / kha cig ni gos snyil bar byas te / gser gyi phag ska dang bcas pa'i rked 7pa ston pa dang / kha cig ni gos du /nyaku la srab mo gyon te/ gser gyi phag ska dang bcas pa'i rked pa ston pa dang —/ kha cig ni rkang gdub sgra masil sil 'byin pa dang / kha cig ni nu ma'i bar nas phreng ba gcig nye bar ston pa dang / kha cig ni brla byed tsam brjes pa nye bar ston pa dang / kha cig ni mgo dang phrag pa dag la bya 'dab sbed dang /ne tso dang / ri skegs 'dug par nye bar ston pa dang / kha cig ni byang chub sems dpa' la mig zur gyis lta ba dang / kha cig ni gos legs par bgos kyang bgo ma legs pa lta bur bcos pa dang / kha cig ni rked pa dang / gser 46—380

gyi phag ska skyod7pa dang / kha cig ni 'khrul ba ltar 'chos shing sgeg ste phan tshun 'chag pa dang / kha cig ni gar byed pa dang / kha cig ni glu len pa dang /kha cig ni bsgegs shing ngo tsha ba ltar yang 'chos pa dang / kha cig ni chu shing rlung gis bskyod pa ltar brla sgul ba dang / kha cig ni brjid pa'i sgra 'byin pa dang / kha cig ni seng ras bgos te gser gyi phag ska dril bu can bcings nas dgod cing 'chag pa dang / kha cig ni gos dang rgyan rnams sa la 'dor zhing ngo tsha ba ltar slar yang len pa dang / kha cig ni gsang ba dang / gsal ba'i rgyan thams cad nye bar ston pa dang / kha cig ni lag pa spos kyis bskus pa ②ston pa dang / kha cig ni mkhur ba bskus shing rna cha yang ston pa dang / kha cig ni mgo yang g.yogs shing bzhin yang g.yogs la skad cig tsam gyis ston pa dang /kha cig ni sngon rgod rgodasapa dang / dga' dga' ba dang / rtse rtse ba phan tshun dran par byed cing yang ngo tsha ba ltar 'dug pa dang / kha cig ni gzhon nu'i gzugs dang / bu ma btsas pa'i gzugs dang / na chung tshad la bab pa'i gzugs ston pa dang / kha cig ni 'dod pa dang ldan pas byang chub sems dpa' la sgugs pa dang / kha cig ni byang chub sems dpa' la me tog sil mas 'thor ba dag ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du 'dug nas byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa la rtog cing gdong du yang bltabaste/ 'di ci chags pa'i dbang pos blta0 'am 'on te mig rgyang ring du blta me'am/ g.yo'am mi g.yo zhes bltas na/ byang chub sems dpa'i bzhin dag cing dri ma med la sgra gcanashelas thar ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur 'dug pa dang / nyi ma thog ma shar ba lta bu dang / gser gyi mchod sdong lta bu dang / pad ma 'dab ma stong pa rgyas 46—381

pa lta bu dang / gtor bar bya ba gtor ba'i me lta bu dang / lhun po ltar mi g.yo ba dang / khor yug ltar mngon par 'phags pa dang / dbang po shin tu bsrungs pa dang / glang po ltar sems shin tu dul bar mthong ngo / /de nas bdud kyi bu mo de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' shin tu chags par bya ba'i phyir glu dang gar du sbyar ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /dus kyi dam pa sos ka bzang la bab/ /zhugs shing me tog rgyas kyis dgyes par rol/ /khyod kyi gzugs ni gzugs bzang mdzes pa ste/ /mtshan gyis spras pa'i dbang du bdag cag 'gyur/ /bdag cag skyes pa legs skyes dbyibs legs te/ /lha mi bde ba'i rkyen du bdag cag byung / /byang chub rnyed dkas thugs ni slar sgyur la//myur du bzhengs te dar la bab pa spyod/ /khyod kyi ched du chas nas rab tu brgyan te lhagasam/)gyur pa/ /lha yi bu mo legs par brgyan pa 'di dag rnams la gzigs / /gzugs 'di bltas nas shing rul lta bur srog tsam lus pa yang /chags par 'gyur na chags pas dga' ba su zhig chags mi 'gyur/ /skra 'jam shin tu dri zhim dri dang ldan/ /cod pan rna cha 'dab ris bzhin rgyas la/ /dpral ba legs shing legs byugs bzhin dang ldan/ /pad ma rgyas pa lta bur mig yangs legs/ /kha bzhin zla ba nya ba lta bu ste/ /shing tog bim pa smin ②'dra'i mchu dang ldan/ /dung dang kun da kha ba dkar so ldan/ /sdug pa dga' la chags pa rnams la gzigs/ /nu ma shin tu mkhrang zhing rgyas la 'bur/ /lto ba'i rked na gnyer gsum shin tu mdzes/ /rked pa 'khor sa dulta bur yangs shing mdzes/ /na chung shin tu mdzes la mgon po gzigs/ /glang po'i sna 'dra ba yi brla ldan zhing / /lag pa gdu bus chal par gang ba can/ /rked pa 46—382

gser gyi phag ska nyurab mdzes brgyan/ /khyod kyi bran mo 'di la mgon po gzigs/ /ngang pa'i stabs rigeldan dal gyis mchi bgyid pa/ /'jam zhing yid 'ong 'dod ldan mdzes smra ba/ /rnam pa 'di ltar shin tu legs brgyan la/ /lha yi dga' ba rnams la shin tu mkhas/ /glu dang rol mo'i dbyangs sgra gar rab bslabs③/ /dga' ba'i ched du mdzes pa'i gzugs can skyes/ /'dod la rab dga' gal te mi bzhed na/ /'jig rten dag na khyod ni shin tu bslus/ /mi glen nor gyi bde ba mi shes 'ga' // /gter mthong nas ni 'bros par bgyid pa ltar/ /khyod kyang 'dod chags mi mkhyen rang lhags pa/ /na chung rnams la mi spyod de dang 'dra/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpa' mig mi 'dzums shipar 'dzum dmul te/ bzhin gyi 'dzum phyung phyirazhing / dbang po rnam par ma 'khrugs pa dang / lus ma bcos pa dang / brjid pa dang /ma chags pa dang / mi snang ba dang / ma rmongs pa dang / ri'i dbang po ltar mi g.yo ba dang / ma zhum pa dang / ma gyur pa dang / 'dzem pa med pa//blo shin tu legs par gnas pa dang / nyon mongs pa rnams shin tu spangs pa'i phyir rang gi kha na las pa'i ye shesa'i kyi sgo dang / 'jam zhing snyan pa'i tshig dang / tshangs pa las lhag pa'i nga ro dang / bya ka la thang sga'i sgra dbyangs dang / snyan pa dang / yid du 'ong bas bdud kyi bu mo de dag la tshigs su bcad pas slar smras pa/ 'dod pa sdug bsngal mang po stsogs shing 9sdug bsngal rtsa ba ste/ /mi mkhas rnams la bsam gtan rdzu 'phrul dka' thub nyams par byed/ /bud med 'dod pa'i yon tan chog pa med ces mkhas pas smras/ /nga ni mi mkhas rnams la shes rab chog par byed par 'gyur/ /'dod pa bsten na 46—383

srid7pa phyir zhing rnam par 'phel 'gyur te/ /dper na mi 'ga' la la tshukhuchu 'thungs par gyur pa bzhin/ /de la zhugs pa bdagashegi don min gzhan gyi don kyang min/ /nga ni bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don la spro ba yin/ /khyod kyi gzugs ni chu bur dag dang dbu ba mtshungs shing 'dra/ /sgyu ma'i tshon ltar rang gi blo yis rnam par bsgrubs pa ste/ /rmi lam dag na rtse ba lta bur mi brtan mi rtag kyang / /byis pa mi mkhas rnams kyi sems ni rtag tu rmongs par byed/ /mig ni chu yi chu bur mtshungs shing 'dra ste pags pas g.yogs/ /khrag brlangasamakhrang zhing 'bur ba dper na nad kyi 'bras dang mtshungs/ /lto ni gcin dang phyi sa sogs te shin tu mi gtsang ba/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor las dang nyon mongs pa las yang dag byung / /byis pa'i blo can dag ni rmongasashegyur phyin ci log pa yis/ /lus gang la ni sdug par rtog pa mkhas pa de lta min/ /sdug bsngal rtsa bar gyur pa'i 'khor bar yun ring 'khor byed na/ /sems can dmyal ba rnams su sdug bsngal mi bzad mang po myong / /rked pa nas ni rab tu yid mi 'ong ba'i dri can 'dzag⑨ /brla dang byin pa rkang pa dag ni 'khrul 'khor lta bur gnas/ /nga yis khyed la yang dag brtags na sgyu ma ji bzhin te/ /phyin ci log gi rgyu dang rkyen las byung bar gyur pa yin/ /'phags pa'i ye shes lam las gol ba phyin ci log /nyegyur pa/ /me dang dug gi lo ma 'dra zhing sbrul chen khros 'dra ba/ /'dod pa'i yon tan yon tan min zhing yon tan nyams mthong na/ /de la byis pa bde ba'i 'du shes skyed cing brgyal bar gyur/ /mi gang 'dod pas bud med rnams kyi khol por gyur pa dang / /gang zhig chos kyi dga' ba bor te 'dod pas dga' byed cing / /dga' la brkam pa de ni tshul khrims lam las 46—384

gol gyur cing / /bsam gtan lam gol blo nyams ye shes las ni rab ring gnas/ /nga ni 'dod chags zhe snang lhan cig gnas pa ma yin te/ /rtag dang sdug dang bdag dang lhan cig gnas par0)byed ma yin/ /mi dga' ba dang dga' dang lhan cig gnas pa ma yin la/ /nga yisasems ni rab tu grol te mkha' la rlung dang 'dra/ /gal te khyed mi'adra'i 'gro ba kun gyis 'dir ni gang gyur la/ /bskal par de dag rnams dang lhan cig 'dre zhing gnas kyang ni/ / nga la tha ba med cingasachags med gti mug mi 'gyur te/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs ni nam mkha' mtshungs shing 'dra phyir ro/ /lha dang lha mo shin tu dri med la/ /khrag dang rus pa med cing rab da bzang ba/ /de dag kun kyang 'jigs pa cher gnas te/ /rtag dngos bral zhing ther zug med phyir ro/ /de nas bdud kyi bu mo bud med kyi sgyu rnams shin tu bslabs pa de dag de bas kyang cher 'dod chags dang / rgyags pa dang / dregs pa bskyed de/ steg pa bstan nas lus rnams brgyan te/ bud med kyi g.yo nye bar bstan nas byang chub sems dpa' la rngod do/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ bu mo'i nang na gces mchog sred dang dga' dngashedaga' can lhan cig tu/ /bdud kyis btang ba shin tu tshul du shis par rings par lhags gyur te/ /shing gi lhug ma gzhon nu lo mar bcas pa rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /gar byed cing ni rgyal po'i sras po shing drung 'dug la rngod khyapar byed/ /dus kyi nang na dam pa mchog tu bgyi ba sos ga'i dus 'di ste/ /skyes pa dag dang bud med dga' bar bgyid cing mun pa rdul yang bcom/ /khu byug dang ni ngang pa rma bya sgra 'byin bya tshogs rnams kyis gang / /'dod pa'i yon tan dga' ba myong bar bgyi ba'i dus la da bab bo/ /46—385

bskal pa stong du tshul khrims dga' zhing brtul zhugs dka' thub spyad gyur pa/ /ri yi rgyal po lta bur mi g.yo nyi ma shar ma thag pa'i gzugs/ /'brug bsgrags lta bur sgra snyan ri dgas dbang po sgra bsgrags 'dra ba po/ /'gro la phan pa byed pa de yis don dang ldan pa'i tshig smras pa/ /'dod pa rtsod dang dgra dang 'thab dang nyon mongs bcas dang 'jigs byed pa/ /byis pa'i skye bos nye bar bsten gyi mkhas pa'i skye bos rtag spangs pa/ /gang du bde gshegs rnams kyis bdud rtsi brnyes pa'i dus la bab gyur gyis4)/ /do mod ②bdud las rgyal te stobs bcu rnams dang ldan pa dgra bcom 'gyur/ /sgyu rnams bstanasnyenas smras pa zhal ras pad ma 'dra ba gsan du gsol/ /khyod ni rgyal po dbang phyug dam pa sa bdag stobs dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bud med dam pa'i tshogs kyis sil snyan stong dag rab tu bgyid 'gyur na/ /thub pa'i cha byad kyis ni ci bgyis spongs la dga' ba bsten du gsol/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ nga ni srid pa gsum na dbang phyug lha dang mi rnams kyis mchod la/ /chos kyi 'khor los 'gro zhing stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /slob dang mi slob bu rnams khrag khrig rtag tu 'dud pa mngon du byed/ /chos kyi dga' bas dga' yi yul la nga yi yid ni dga' ma yin/ /de dag gis smras pa/ re shigashedar la bab pa ma yol dang po thor bur gyur pa dang / /khyod ni re shigashesnyan gyis ma btab mi shis bgres par ma gyur dang / /ji srid dar la bab cing bdag cag grogs kyang dar la bab gyur pa/ /de srid bar du 'dzum pa'i zhal gyis 'dod pa'i dga' ba spyad du gsol/ /byang chub sems dpas ༅smras pa/ ji srid do mod dal ba dam pa 'chi med dkon pa rnyed pa dang / /ji srid lha dang lha min grong khyer mi 46—386

khom sdug bsngal spangs pa dang / /ji srid rga dang na dang 'chi ba'i dgra yis dkrugs7par ma gyur pa/ /de srid nga ni 'jigs med grong khyer 'gro ba'ikhulam mchog bsgom par bya/ /de dag gis smras pa/ lha yi gnas na sum cu rtsa gsum bdag po lha mos bskor ba dang / /'thab bral 'thab bral rab dang dga' ldan rab dang bdud kyi grong khyer na/ /lha mchog bstod pa bzhin du bud med dbang du gyur nas 'dod dga' la/ /rol cing spyod la bdag cag rnams dang lhan cig dgyes pa rgya chen mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/'dod pa rtswa rtse'i zil thigs bzhin du myur la ston na'i sprin dang mtshungs/ /klu yi bu mo khro ba lta bur shin tu 'jigs par byed pa yin/ /brgya byin 'thab bral rab lha dga' ldan pa dag bdud kyi dbang du song / /'phags min rnams kyis 'dod pa sdug bsngal ldan pa 'di la su zhig dga'/ /de dag gis smras pa/shing mchog 'di dag lo ma gzhon dang ldan zhing me tog rgyas gyur la/ /shang shang te'u dang khu byug sgra 'byin bung ba sgra 'byin ldan pa gzigs/ /sa las bsre'akhrungs rab sngo 'jam zhing snum la lcang lo can mchis pa/ /nags mchog mi ci tshogs kyis bsten par na chung rnams dang dgyesam par mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ lo mar bcas pa'i shing rnams 'di dag dus kyi dbang gis me tog rgyas/ /bung ba dag kyang bkres dang skom pas nyen nas me tog rnams su lhags/ /gang zhig dus na sa las skyes pa rnams kyang nyi mas skamasalgepar 'gyur/ /nga 'dir sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis spyad pa bdud rtsi nges par spyad / /bdud kyi bu mo rnams kyis smras pa/ zla 'dra'i zhal mnga' gzigs shig pad ma sar ⑦pa 'dra ba'i kha bzhin can/ /snyan cing yid du 'ong ba'i tshig ldan 46—387

so ni dngul dang kha ba 'dra/ /'di 'dra lha yi gnas na dkon na mi yi gnas na ga la mchis/ /gang dag lha mchog rnams kyis rtag tu 'dod par bgyi ba khyod kyis brnyes/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ lus ni ngan skyugasanyemi gtsang srin bu'i rigs kyis gang ba shig shig po/ /myur du 'gyes shing 'jig pa bde ba ma yin ②rnams dang ldan par mthong / /rgyu bar bcas dang mi rgyu ba yi 'grosal bde ba mchog byed pa/ /go 'phangasre'achi 'pho med pa skye bo mkhas pas mchod pa de thob bya/ /de dag 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi myong bar gyur pa ste/ /rkang gdub gser gyi phag ska 'khrol zhing gos kyang shig shig byas nas ni/ /'dod pa'i mda' yis phog pa rgyags pa 'dzum zhing 'di skad smras/ /jo jo khyod la nongs pa ci zhig bgyis na 'di dag bsten limi bgyi/ /srid pa kun gyis nyes pa rig nas rdul dang bral bas 'di skad smras/ /'dod pa ral gri mdung thung rtse gsum sbrang rtsi can gyi spu gri 'dra/ /sbrul gyi mgo dang me mur 'dra bar ngas 'dir rab tu rig pas na/ /bud med yon tan 'phrog pas de phyir nga yis bud med tshogs rnams spangs/ /bud med yon tan rnam pasamang po khrag khrig bye bshede dag gis/ /gang gi tshe na glang po'i phrulamagu'i stabs can de brjod ma nus tshe/ /ngo tsha skyengs nas thub pa'i rkang pa gnyis la rab tu phyag 'tshal te/ /dga' zhing mgu ba bskyed nas phan pa byed pa de la bstod pa byas/ /pad ma dri ma med pa'i snying po 'dra zhing ston zla lta bu'i zhal/ /mar gyis sbyin bsregashibagyis pa'i 'od 'phro me 'dra gser gyi ri 'dra ba/ /srid pa brgya nas spyad cing dgongs dang smon lam btab pa grub gyur cig /bdag nyid rgal nas sdug bsngal dag dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba bsgral du gsol/ /de dag rnams kyis dong 46—388

na'i shing dang tsam pa ka 'dra rnam ①mang bstod/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i ri7ltar mi g.yo ba la bskor ba byas nas ni/ /song ste pha yi rkang la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 'di skad tshig kyang smras/ /yab cig lha dang mi yi bla ma de la khong khro spangs na legs/ /bzhin ni 'dzum par gyur nas pad ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba'i mig gis lta/ /de ni chags pas skye bo mi lta desal khro gnyer mchis ma lags/ /lhun po g.yo zhing rgya mtsho skamasaphul nyi zla ltung bar 'gyur yang gda'/ /srid pa gsum gyi nyes mthong de ni bud med rnams kyi dbang mi 'gyur/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis tshig de skad thos nas de bas kyang cher sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde la/yi ma rangs shing tshig pa za ba'i yid kyis rang gi bu mo de dag la smras pa/ kye mi shes shing glen te/ khyed kyi gzugs dang da rod ma mthong ngam/ ji ltar gyur na de byang chub kyi snying po las bslang bar ma nus/ de nas bdud kyi bu mo de dag gis rang gi pha la tshigs su bcad pas slar smras pa/ snyan cing 'jam por smra yang chags pa ma mchis te/ /gsang ba chen po lta yang sdang ba mchis ma lags/ /spyod lam dag dang spyod pa lta yang rmongs ma mchis/ /lus rnams thams cad rtogs kyang bsam pa shin tu zab/ /bud med nongs pa rgya chen the tshom ma mchis rtogs/ /'dod las dben pa'i yid ldan 'dod chags chags ma mchis/ /gang zhig de yi sems dang spyod pa yongs 'tshal ba/ /lha yul mi yul 'di na lha mi de ma mchis/ /de la bud med sgyu rnams gang lags bstan na yab/ /chags bcas gang lags de yi snying zhu 'gyur rigs na/ /de dag mthong yang de yi sems ni gcig ma g.yos/ /ri dbang rgyal po bzhin du de ni mi g.yo g.yo mkhumachis/ /bsod nams gzi brjid brgyas bltamarkuyon tan gzi brjid rdzogs/ /46—389

bskal pa bye ba mang por tshul khrims brtul7zhugs spyad/ /lha dang tshangs pa sems can gzi brjid rnam dag dge/ /de dag de yi rkang par mgos gtugasakhuphyag kyang 'tshal/ /sde dang bcas pa'i bdud rnams bcom nas sngon chad kyi/ /rgyal bas bzhed pa byang chub dam pa 'thob 'gyur nges/ /yab cig bdag cag g.yul ngor 'thab pa mi 'tshal te/ /stobs ldan dag dang 'thab par sbyor 'di tshegs rab che/ /yab cig mkha' la nor bu rin chen gtsug phud can/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig gus par gnas/ /rin chen 'byung gnas yan lag me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /stobs bcu mnga' bas mchod phyir 'dir btang rnams la gzigs/ /gang dag sems pa ma mchis gang dag sems ma mchis/ /shing ri lha dbang gnod sbyin mkha' lding dbang po dag /yon tan ri bor mngon par 'dud cing phyogs pa las/ /yab cig do med slar log na ni legs pa 'dra/ /gzhan yang gang gi pha mthar mi phyin der ni rkyalasami bgyi/ /gang zhig rtsa nas mi phyin de ni bsko mi bgyi/ /gang la bzod pa yang gsol de ni dkrug mi bgyi/ /gang gis yid mi bde bar 'gyur ba de mi bgyi/ /dge slong dag de nas de'i tshe shing gi lha mo brgyad la 'di lta ste/ dpal ldan dang /'phel mo dang / dka' thub dang / dge ma dang / mkhas ma dang /mdangs stobs dang / bden smra dang / ldan ma ste/ de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' la yang dag par mchod nas dpal rnam pa bcu drug gis byang chub sems dpa' 'phel bar byed/ mngon du stod9)par byed de/ sems can dam pa khyod ni dgung zla yar gyi ngo ltar mdzes pa'o/ /blo rnam par dmasapa khyod ni gdugaso dang po shar ba ltar lhang nge ba'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni chab kyi 46—390

nang na pad ma ltar rab tu rgyas pa'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni nags dang nags 'dabashin rgyu ba'i seng ge ltar sgrogs zhupa'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni rgya mtsho'i dbus na ri'i rgyal po ltar mdzes pa'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni khorasheyug gi ri ltar mngon par 'phags pa'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni rgya mtsho ltar rin po ches bltams shing rigating dpag dka'ardzogeba'o/ /'jig rten gyi mgon po khyod ni nam mkha'53ltar thug pa ma mchis shing thugs kyi rgya che ba'o/ /sems can rnam par dag pa khyod ni dog sa ltar sems can thams cad kyi 'tsho bar gyur cing thugs shin tu brtan pa'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni mtsho ma dros pa ltar rtag tu dang zhing thugs rnyog pa mi mnga' ba'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni rlung mar ltar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la rtag tu mi chags shing thugs gnas ma mchis pa'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni gzi brjid kyi rgyal po ltar rlom sems can 90thams cad spangs shing bsnyen par dka' ba'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni sred med kyi bu ltar thul bar dka' zhing stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi mgon po khyod ni byang chub kyi snying po las mi bzhengs pas dam bcas pa brtan pa'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni dbang po'i lag gis 'phangs pa'i rdo rje ltar slar mi ldog pa'o/ /sems can dam pa khyod ni ring por mi thogs par stobs bcu dang ldan par byon pas brnyes pa legs par brnyes pa'o/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub kyi shing gi lha mo rnams kyisashedapal rnam pa bcu drug gis byang chub sems dpa' 'phel bar byed do/ /dge slong dag de na gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis rnam pa bcu drug gis bdud nyams dmas 7par byed de/ rnam pa bcu drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sdig 46—391

can khyod ni khrung khrung rgan po ltar sems khong du0chud cing dmasalgepa'o/ /sdig can khyod ni glang po rgan po 'dam du bying ba ltar nyam chung ba'o/ /sdig can khyod ni dpa' bor khas 'ches pa pham pa ltar gcig pur gyur pa'o/ /sdig can khyod ni nad kyis nyen pa 'brog tu bor ba ltar gnyis su med pa'o/ /sdig can khyod ni glang bu khal gyis nyon mongs pa ltar stobs med pa'o/ /sdig can khyod ni shing rlung gis btab pa ltar sgyel ba'o/ /sdig can khyod ni 'dron⑧pa lam stor ba ltar lam ngan par gnas pa'o0/ /sdig can khyod ni mi dbul po bu lon can ltar dman pa bas kyang dman pa'o/ /sdig can khyod ni bya rog byung rgyal ba ltar mu cor smra ba'o/ /sdig can khyod ni ma dul ba byas pa mi gzo ba ltar nga rgyal gyis zil gyis non⑧pa'o/ /sdig can khyod ni seng ge'i sgras wa 'bros pa ltar deng 'bros par 'gyur ba'o/ /rig can khyod ni rnam par 'thor rlung gis gtor ba'i bya bzhin du deng 'dar bar 'gyur ba'o/ /sdig can khyod ni sprang po bsod nams zad pa ltar dus mi shes pa'o/ /sdig can khyod ni snod chag0pa rdul gyis gang ba ltar deng rnam par spang bar 'gyur ba'o/ /sdig can khyod ni sngags la dpa' ba sbrul la bab pa ltar deng tshar chod par 'gyur ba'o/ /sdig can khyod ni mi rkang lag bcad pa ltar stobs thams cad dang bral ba'o zhes bya ba'o⑦/ /dge slong dag de ltar gnas getsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis rnam pa bcu drug gis bdud sdig can nyam smad byapa byas so/ /dge slong dag de la byang chub kyi bsnyen bkur ba'i lha rnams kyis rnam pa bcu drug gis bdud sdig can zlog par byed de/ bcu drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sdig can khyod ni dpa' bos pha rol gyi sde bcom pa ltar byang chub sems dpas do mod pham parashebyas par 46—392

'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni gyad stobs chung ngu la0)rgyad stobs chen po bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas tshar bcad par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni srin bu me khyer la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas zil gyis non par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni phub ma spar bshegang la rlung mar btabashepa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas gtor bar 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni wa la seng ge bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas sngangasasnyipar byas par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni shing sākel chen po rtsa bshenas bcad pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas sgyel du )bar 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni mi mdza'akhuba'i grong khyer la rgyal po chen po bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas brlag par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni ba rjes kyi chu la nyikhutshan chen po bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas yongs su zad par byas par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni mi g.yon can gsad 7par bya ba shor ba ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas 'bros par byed par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni me'i tsha bas bung ⑩ba'i khyu ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas mgo 'khor bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni chos kyi rgyal po rgyal srid nyams pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas mya ngan byed du bcug par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni khrung khrung rgan po 'dab ma bregs pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas sems khong du bcug par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni 'brog dgon par lam rgyags chad pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas phongs par byas par 'gyur ro//sdig can khyod ni rgya mtsho chen por gru zhig pa ltar do med byang chub sems dpas smre sngags 'don du bcug par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni sreg pa'i bskal 46—393
