pas rtswa dang nags tshal ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas nyis par byas par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyod ni ri'i rtse mo la rdo rje bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas brnyil ②bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'o/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub kyi bsnyen bkur ba'i lha'i bu rnams kyis rnam pa bcu drug gis bdud sdig can zlog par byed kyang bdud sdig can phyir ma log go/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste / lha yi tshogs kyis yang dag bskul ba thos kyang bdud ni phyir log ma gyur te//slongs shig rgyob shig mi'adi ni brlag par gyis shig srog kyang sbyin par ma byed cig /'di ni rang nyid rgyal nas nga yi yul nas gzhan yang sgrol bar byed par 'gyur / /langs te bros pa ma gtogs dge sbyong 'di la thar gzhan cung zad med ces smras/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ ri yi rgyal po lhun po gnas nas g.yo srid 'gro ba thams cad med 'gyur srid/ /skar ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad zla ba bcas par mkha' shulas sa la thong yang srid/ /sems can kun gyi bsam pa gcig byed 'gyur srid rgya mtsho chen po skam srid kyi/ /nga 'dra shing gi rgyal po'i drung na 'dug pa la ni g.yo ba yong mi srid/ /bdud kyis smras pa / kho bo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug 'jig rten 'di kun dbang / /lha dang lha min tshogs bcas mi dang dud 'gro rnams/ /kho bos khyab ste thams cad kho bo'i dbang du 'gyur/ /kho bo'i yul na 'dug pa longs la tshig bzhin gyisadu/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ gal te 'dod dbang khyod yin gsal bar khyod dbang min/ /yang dag nga ltos nga yang chos kyi dbang phyug yin/ /gal tesnyingan 'gror mi 'gro khyod ni 'dod dbang phyug /dbang med khyod ni lta bzhin byang chub ngas thob 'gyur/ /bdud kyis smras pa/ dge sbyong bdag nyid gcig pu 46—394

dgon par ci zhig byed/ /khyod kyis gang btsal de dang phrad 3par sla ma yin/ /rab 'gro shes ldan la sogs dka' thub rab bsgrims kyang / /go 'phang mchog de ma thob mir gyur khyod ci smos/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ khro ba'i ②zil non blo dang lha yul 'dod pa dang / /bdag la rtag dang mi rtag snyam du gnas pa dang / /yul du 'gro bas gnas pa thar snyam gnas pa yi/ /drang srong mi shes sngon du 'gro bas dka' thub spyad/ /de dag yang dag don gudang bral zhing skyes bu smras/ /khyab dang phyogs gcig ches 5chodang kha cig rtag ces smra / /lus can lus min yon tan min dang yon tan can/ /byed pa po dang byed po min zhes gzhan dag 'dzer/ /stan 'dir 'dug ste nga rgyal bcom pas sde 33dpung bcas/ /khyod pham byas te byang chub rdul named deng thob nas/ /'gro ba 'di la 'byung dang byung dang mya ngan 'das/ /sdug bsngal zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po bstan par bya/ /bdud ni khros shing 'khrugs te tshig pa zos nas mdun du rtsub pa'i tshig tu smras pa dge sbyong 'di zung shigazu /gcig pu dgon par bor bar gyur pa 'di ni nga yi mdun nas zung tshal song ste myur du dbang du gyis/ /nga yi khyim du myur du song la shing sgrog dang ni lcags sgrog phrugs su chug ste sgo ba byed du chug /sdug bsngal nyen nas ku co rnam pa mang po 'don cing lha yi khol po yin par bdag gis bdag mthong byos/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ nam mkha' la ni ri mo rnam pa sna tshogs cha cha ris /7ris phye ste so sor bri bar nus kyang skusrid/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 'gro ba'i shugs can rlung ni mi yis rab tu bsgrims te zhags copas bcing du nus kyang srid/ /nyi ma zla ba mun pa rab rib med dbyed mkha' las sa la 7ltung bar byed pa nus srid kyi/ /46—395

khyod dang 'dra ba rab tu mang po bgrang las 'das pa dag gis shing drung nas ni nga bskyod nus mi 'gyur/ /bdud dpung stobs dang ldan pa langs te ha zhes zer/ /dung dang rnga dang rdza rnga mchog gi sgra 'byin langs/ /bdud dpung shin tu 'jigs pa 'di dag mthong nas ni/ /kyi hud bu sdug khyod cis ma rung gyur ces zer/ /'dzam klungashegaser dang tsam pa'i snying po 'dra bar ser/ /shin tu gzhon nu lha mis bstod cing mchod pa'i 'os/ /khyod deng g.yul ngo chen porasherab tu brlag 'gyur te③/ /dbang pos lha min lta bur bdud kyi dbang du 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ka la ping ku'i sgra skad kyis/ /bde bar gshegs pas gnod sbyin srinasatshogs de la smras/ /mi mkhas gang zhig nam mkha' skrag par byed 'dod pa/ /de ni shing mchog drung nas nga 'dra slong bar 'dod/ /gang zhig stong gsum chen po bshig nas rdul 'grang dang / /gang zhig ba spu yis ni rgya mtsho chu 'byin dang / /skad cig gis ni rdokhurje'i rang bzhin ri 'thor ba/ /des kyang shing drung 'dug pa nga la 'tshe mi nus/ /bdud khros sems kyis gnya' shing gang gis bar tsam 'dug /shubs nas phyung ba'i ral gri rnon0po lag na thogs/ /dge sbyong myur longs nga yis bsam pa bzhin du song / /'od ma'i myu gu sngo ltar do mod bcad da re/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ gal te stong gsum sa rnams 'di dag thams cad bdud kyis rab tu gang gyur la/ /kun gyi lag na ri bo lhun po mchog 'dra ba yi ral gri thogs gyur kyang / /de dag nga yi ba spu bskyod par mi nus nga la gnod byed smos ci dgos/ /sun 'byin ma rings shig dang de'u reshebatags te nga yis brtan por dran par bya/ /rnga mo ba lang glang chen mgo dang 'jigs mig dang / /myur 46—396

gdug sbrul dang mig gdug mi bzad7'dra ba dag /me 'bar kha dog rtse mor bcas pa'i ri 'phen cing / /rtsa bar bcas pa'i shing dang zangs dang lcags rnams 'phen/ /sprin ltar langs te phyogs bzhi dag tu sgra sgrog5gecing / /rdo rje'i lce dang lcags kyi thu lum char pa 'bebs/ /ral gri mdung thung rno dang dgashesta dug can 'bebs/ /sa ni rtol gyibar byed cing shing dag rab tu 'joms/ /kha cig lag pa brgya dag gis ni mda' brgya 'phen/ /kha nas myur du gdugatso pa'i sbrul dang me yang 'thor/ /chu skyes chu srin la sogs pa dag mtsho nas len/ /kha cig nam mkha' lding du bsgyur nas klu yang 'phen/ /kha cig khros nas lcags kyi thu lum ri rab tsam/ /me 'bar kha dog rtse mor bcas pa rnams kyang 'phen/ /sa la lhags nas sa ni rab tu 'khrugs skyepar byed/ /'og gi chu yi phung po'i chu yang rnam par 'khrug /kha cig de yi mdun dang de bzhin rgyab tu mchong / /kye ma bu zhes g.yas dang de bzhin g.yon du mchong / /rkang pa lag pa log par 'dug cing mgo 'bar la/ /glog ltar rab tu 'bar bar mig nas mngon du 'byin/ /bdud kyi dpung ni bsgyur ba mi sdug byas mthong nas/ /sems can dag pa sgyu ma byas pa ji bzhin rtog / 'di la5༷ bdud med stobs med 'gro med bdag kyang med/ /chu zla'i tshul 'dra ba yi 'jig rten gsum po 'khor/ /mig dang skyes pa bud med med cing bdag gi med/ /rna ba sna dang de bzhin lce dang de bzhin lus/ /chos 'di byed pa po dang tshor ba po dang bral/ /brten nas skyes te nang yang stong zhing phyi yang stong / /bden tshig gang gis 'dir chos shin tu stong zhe na/ /'dul 'thun gnod sbyin des pa gang yin de dag gis/ /lag pa'i mtshon cha me tog phreng bar mthong gyur ces/ /rtag tu bden smras de yis 46—397

bden pa'i tshig byas te/ /de yis lag mthil g.yon pa dra0)ba mchog sprasalgepa/ /sen mo zangs mdog rab mdzes rtsibs stong 'khor lo can/ /'dzam klungakhugaser 'bar dang 'dra bsod nams dges bsten pas/ /tshul du shis par mgo nas rkang pa'i bar du byugs/ /mkha' las glog 4)'dra bar ni lag pa brkyangasabyas nas/ /tshig tu smras pa sa 'di nga yi57dbang yin te⑦/ /ngas ni sngon chad mchod sbyin khrag khrig sna tshogs byas/ /slong la mi sbyin snyam ste don med gzharasnyem byin/ /chu dang me dang rlung ni nga yi dbang yin te/ /tshangs pa skye dgashebadag dang skar bcas nyi zla dang / /gang dag phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /bdag khrims brtul 0zhugs byang chub yan lag 'phags pa dpang ske/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims de bzhin bzod pa nga yi dpang / /brtson 'grus de bzhin bsam gtan de ltar shes rab dang / /tshad med bzhi dang de bzhin mngon shes nga yi dpang / /rim gyis byang chub spyod pa thams cad nga yi dpang dzha/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sems can mtha' dag ji snyed pa/ /de dag rnams kyi bsod nams tshul khrims ye shes dang / /gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin byas pa bsdoms kyang ni/ /de dag nga yi ba spu'i57brgya yi char mi phod / /de yis tshul du shis par lag pa sa la brdabs/ /khar ba'i snod ltar sa 'di sgra yang byung bar gyur/ /bdud kyisasgra thos nas ni sa la sgyel gyur te/ /nag po'i rtsa lag rgyob shig zung shig 8sgra yang thos/ /lus las thul byung gzi brjid nyams shing bzhin mdog gyur/ /rga bas bcom par bdud de nyid kyis mthong bar gyur/ /brang rdung cho nge 'don cing 'jigs nyen mgon yang med/ /bdud kyi yid 'khrul gyur cing sems ni myos gepar gyur/ /glang po rta dang 46—398

bzhon pa shing rta sa la lhung / /srin po grul bum dag dang sha za sngangasapha1)shing rgyug /mgo rmongs lam mi rnyed cing gnas med skyabs kyang med/ /rlung btab nags mes byas7ltar bltas nas song bar gyur/ /pha ma bu dang sring mo dedzaXbazhin phu nu dag /gang na mthong zhing gang du dong zhes 'dri bar byed/ /de yi rkyen gyis de dgashephan tshun 'thab cing rtsod/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal gyur te 'tsho ba'i skabs kyang med/ /bdud dpung brgya che mang ba mi 'khrugs snyed po de/ /thams cad rnam par 'thor cing tha dgur tri gyes gyur te/ /zhag bdun 'das kyi bar du phan tshun phrad ma gyur/ /mthong nas smras pa gal te gson na dga' zhes 'dzer/ /shing gi lha mos de tshe de la snying rje byas/ /chu yi bum pa thogs te nag po'i rtsa lag gtor/ /myur du longs la phyi sholam ma byed skyen 87du song / /bla ma'i tshig ma mnyan pas de ltar gyur pa yin/ /bdud kyis smras pa/ bdag gi bu yi snyan tshig phan pa ma mnyan te/ /sems can shin tu dag la nyes pa byas pas na/ /sdug bsngal 'jigs phongs mya ngan brlag dang brnyas pa dang / /cir mi rung ba'i sgra dang dman nyid bdag gis thob/ /lha mos smras pa/ mi mkhas gang zhig nyes pa med la nyes byed pa/ /de ni nyes dang sdug bsngal ba dang phongs pa dang / /cir mi rung zhes bya ba'i sgra dang dman nyid dang / /gsad 3dang bcing dang nyes pa du ma rnyed par 'gyur/ /lha dang lha min mkha' lding mi tshici srin po'i dbang / /tshangs pa brgya byin gzhan 'phrul 'og min bcas pa dag /'di ltar khyod kyis 'di 'dra'i bdud kyi dpung bcom pas/ /'jig rten dpa' bo rgyal zhes de yisal rgyal ba brjod/ /rgyan phreng chun po zla ba gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan 'bul/ /me tog a ga ru dang rgya spos tsan dan phye char 'bebs/ /46—399

sil snyan dag kyang rab tu dkrol ba byed cing tshig brjod7pa/ /dpa' bo dgra tshogs rgyal rnams khyod la dgab pasnyemadzad par 'gyur/ /stanasamachog 'dir ni byams pas g.yon can bdud kyi phyogs/ /rgyasachen pham mdzad dpa' bo do mod byang chub brnyes⑤/ /stobs bcu ma 'dres so so yang dag rig pa dang / /sangs rgyas yul rnams thams cad do med brnyes par 'gyur/ /bdud gdul0ched du 'dir ni g.yul ngor rab tu zhugs/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i stobs rtsal sus mthong ba/ /bye ba sum cu drug dang khrag khrig nyi shu bzhi/ /de dag sangs rgyas byang chub mchog tu yid kyis smon/ /bdud btul ba'i le'u zhes bya ba ste/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' bdud phyir rgol ba bcom pa/dgra btul ba/ g.yul ngorashegayul las rnam par rgyal ba/ gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng bas 'dod pa rnams las dben pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams las dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de rtog pa dang dpyod pa dang bral zhing nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas rtog pa med pa/ dpyod pa med pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang bral bas btang snyoms la gnas shing / dran pa dang shes bzhin can yin te/bde ba lus kyis myong la/ 'phags pa rnams kyis gang de dran pa dang ldan pa 46—400

bde ba la gnas pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba med pa bsam gtan gsum pa rdzogs par byas0)te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs te/ snga nas sdug bsngal bsngo yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang yid mi bde ba yang nub pas bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa btang snyoms dang dran pasnyeyongs su dag pa skyibasam gtan bzhi pa rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de lta bur tsa)snyoms par zhugs pa'i sems yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ 'od gsal ba/ nyon mongs pa med pa/nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang bral ba/ mnyen pa/ las su rung bar gnas pa/mi g.yo bar gyur pas nam gyi cha stod la lha'i mig las ye shes mthong ba'i rig pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir sems mngon par sgrub cing mngon par gtod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lha'i mig yongs su dag pa mi'i las shin tu 'das ⑧pas sems can 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dang / kha dog bzang po dang /kha dog ngan pa dang / bzang po dang / ngan pa rnams mthong ngo / las ji lta ba bzhin du 'gro ba'i sems can rnams kyang borab tu shes te/ kye ma sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis nyes par spyad pa dang ldan pa/ ngag dang yid kyis nyes par spyadarwanyepa dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa rnams la skur pa 'debs pa/log par lta ba dag ste/ de dag log par lta ba'i las yang dag par blangs pa'i rgyus lus zhig ste shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par nyung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ba dag go/ /sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis legs par spyad pa dang ldan pa/ ngag dang yid kyis legs par spyad pa dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa rnams la skur pa mi 'debs pa/ yang dag par lta ba 46—401

dag ste/ de dag yang dag par lta ba'i las yang dag par blangs pa'i rgyus lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha'i nang du skye bar 'gyur ba dag go zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /de ltar lha'i mig rnam par dag pa mi'i las shin tu 'das pas sems can 'chispyi'apho ba dang / skye ba dang / kha dog bzang po dang / kha dog ngan pa dang / bde 'gror song ba dang / ngan 'gror song ba dang / ngan pa dang / bzang po dag dang / las ji lta ba bzhin du 'gro ba rnams mthong ngo / /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' nam gyi cha stod la rig pa mngon sum du byed do/ /mun pa sel to/ /snang ba bskyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de lta bur snyoms par zhugs pa'i sems du ༄yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ 'od gsal ba/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang bral ba/ mnyen pa/ las su rung bar gnas pa/ mi g.yo bar gyur pas nam gyi gung thun la sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i ye shes mthong ba'i rig pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir sems mngon par sgrub gcing mngon par gtod do/ /de bdag dang sems can gzhan dag gi sngon gyi gnas rnam pa du ma rjes su dran te/ 'di lta ste/ skye bsregacig dang /gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / bcu dang / nyi shu dang /sum cupo dang / bzhi bcu dang / skye ba lnga bcu dang / skye ba brgya dang / skye ba stong dang / skye ba brgya stong dngas/ skye ba brgya stong phrag du ma dang / skye ba bye ba dang / skye ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / skye ba bye ba phrag stong dang / skye ba bye ba brgya stong dang / skye ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang / skye ba bye ba brgya phrag du ma dang / skye ba bye ba stong phrag du ma dang / skye ba bye ba brgya stong phrag du ma 46—402

dang / skye ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma nas/ 'jig pa'i bskal pa dang / 'chags pa'i bskal pa dang / 'jig pa dang 'chags pa'i bskal pa dang / 'jig pa dang 'chags pa'i bskal pa du ma dag kyang rjes su dran no/ /bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba zhig tu gyur te/ ming 'di zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rus ni 'di zhes bya'o/ /rigs ni 'di zhes bya'o/ /kha dog ni 'di lta bu'o/ /kha zas ni 'di lta bu zhig za za'o/ /tshe'i tshad ni 'di tsam zhig thub bo/ /yun ni 'di srid cig gnas gnas so/ /bde ba dang sdug bsngal ni 'di lta bu 3zhig myong ngo / /bdag de nas shi 'phos nas che ge mo zhes bya ba zhig tu skyes so/ /de nas shi 'phos nas kyang che ge mo zhes bya ba zhig tu skyes so/ /de nas shi 'phos nas 'dir skyes so zhes rnam pa dang bcas/ yul phyogs dang bcas par bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sngon gyi gnas rnam pa du ma rjes su dran no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de lta bur snyoms par zhugs pa'i sems yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ 'od gsal ba/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang bral ba/ mnyen pa/ las su rung bar gnas pa/ mi g.yo bar gyur pas nam ②gyi cha smad skya rengs sbyo )'char ba'i dus kyi tshe rnga brdung ba'i nam tshod tsam na sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba nub par bya ba dang /zag pa zad pa shes pa mthong ba'i rig pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir sems mngon par sgrub cing mngon par gtod de/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma 'jig rten 'di ni 'di lta ste/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang zha 'chi ba dang /'chi 'pho ba dang / skye bas sdug bsngal bar gyur pa yin na0/ 'on kyang rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' 46—403

zhigatu'adi las 'byung bar bya ba mi shes te/ e ma'o rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig ②'di thams cad zad par bya bar shes na ci ma rung snyam nas/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas rga ba dang 'chi ba byung / rga ba dang 'chi ba'i rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams tezhu/ skye ba yod pas rga shi byung ste/ rga shi'i rkyen ni skye ba yin no snyam mo/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas skye ba byung / skye ba'i rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams teX/ srid pa yod pas skye ba byung ste/ skye ba'i rkyen ni srid pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas srid pa byung / srid pa'i rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams te/ len pa yod pas srid pa byung ste/ srid pa'i rkyen ni len pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas yangasnyebyang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas len pa byung / len pa'i rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams te0/ sred pa yod pas len pa byung ste/ len pa'i rkyen ni sred pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas sred pa byung /sred pa'i rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams te⑦/ tshor ba yod pas sred pa byung ste/ sred pa'i rkyen ni tshor ba yin no snyam mo/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas tshor ba byung /tshor ba'i rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams tenyu/ reg pa yod pas tshor ba byung ste/ tshor ba'i rkyen ni reg pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas 46—404

yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas reg pa byung /reg pa'i rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams tenyu/ skye mched drug yod pas reg pa byung ste/ reg pa'i rkyen ni skye mched drug yin no snyam mo/ /de nas yangasabyang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas skye mched drug byung / skye mched drug gi rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/des 'di snyam du sems7te/ ming dang gzugs yod pas skye mched drug byung ste/skye mched drug gi rkyen ni ming dang gzugs yin no snyam mo/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas ming dang gzugs byung /ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams te'u/rnam par shes pa yod pas ming dang gzugs byung ste/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen ni rnam par shes pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas rnam par shes pa byung / rnam par shes pa'i rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams te0/ 'du byed yod pas rnam par shes pa byung ste/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen ni 'du byed yin no snyam mo/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang yod pas 'du byed byung / 'du byed kyi rkyen ni gang yin snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams te⑦/ ma rig pa yod pas 'du byed byung ste/ 'du byed kyi rkyen ni ma rig pa yin no snyam mo/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis〈 )'du byed rnams/ 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug /skye mched drug gi rkyen gyis reg pa/ reg pa'i rkyen 46—405

gyis tshor ba/ tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa/ sred pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/ len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/ srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen ①po 'ba' zhig 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /dge slong dag sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams la kun 'byung kun 'byung ③zhes tshul bzhin yid la byed cing mang du byed pas byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes skyes/ mig skyes/ rigasnyipa skyes/ mang po shes pa skyes/ yid gzhungs pa skyes⑤/ shes rab skyes so/ /snang ba byung ngo / /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/gang med pas rga shi yimed par 'gyur/ gang 'gags pas rga shi 'gag ༅snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams te2no/ skye ba med na rga shi med par 'gyur te/skye ba 'gags pas rga shi 'gag go snyam mo/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang med pas skye ba med par 'gyur/ gang 'gags pas skye ba 'gag snyam nas/ des 'di snyam du bsams te⑨/ srid pa med na skye ba med par 'gyur te/ srid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gag go snyam mo/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gang med pas zhes bya ba nas rgyas par sbyar te/ 'du byed med par 'gyur/ gang 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag snyam pa'i bar du'o/ /des 'di snyam du bsams te⑩/ ma rig pa med pas 'du byed med par 'gyur te/ ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag go/ /'du byed 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gag go zhes bya ba nas/ skye ba 'gags pas rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / the sngags 'don pa dang / sdug 46wa 406

bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'gag par 'gyur te/de ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig hu 'di 'gag par 'gyur ro snyam pa'i bar du'o/ /dge slong dag de ltar sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams la tshul bzhin yid la byed cing mang du byed pas byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes skyes/mig skyes/ rig⑧pa skyes/ mang po shes pa skyes/ yid gzhungs pa skyes/shes rab skyes so/ /snang ba byung dngo / /dge slong dag ngas de'i tshe 'di ni zag pa sdug bsngal lo zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /'di ni zag pa'i mikun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni zag pa 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni zag pa 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /'di ni 'dod pa'i zag pa'o/ /'di ni sredasapa'i zag pa'o/ /'di ni ma rig pa'i zag pa'o//'di ni lta ba'i zag pa'o/ /'dir zag pa ma lus par 'gag go/ /'dir zag pa ma lus par mi snang bar 'gyur zhing thunub par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni ma rig pa'o/ /'di ni ma rig pa'i kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni ma rig pa 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni ma rig pa 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo zhes yang dag par ⑦ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /'dir ma rig pa ma lus par mi snang bar 'gyur te nub par 'gyur ro zhes bya bar de bzhin du sbyar ro/ /'di dag ni 'du byed rnams so/ /'di ni 'du byed kyi kun bu'abyung ba'o/ /'di ni 'du byed 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni 'du byed 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so//'di ni rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni rnam par shes pa'i kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni rnam par shes pa 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni rnam par shes pa 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /'di ni ming dang 46—407

gzugs so/ /'di ni ming dang gzugs kyi kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni ming dang gzugs 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni ming dang gzugs 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /'di ni skye mched drug go/ /'di ni skye mched drug gi kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni skye mched drug 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni skye mched drug 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /'di ni reg pa'o/ /'di ni reg pa'i kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni reg pa 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni reg pa 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /'di ni tshor ba'o/ /'di ni tshor ba'i kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni tshor btu'agog pa'o/ /'di ni tshor ba 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo/ /'di ni sred pa'o/ /'di ni sred pa'i kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni sred pa 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni sred ②pa 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo/ /'di ni len pa'o/ /'di ni len pa'i kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni len pa 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni len pa 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo/ /'di ni srid pa'o/ /'di ni srid pa'i kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni srid pa 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni srid pa 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo/ /'di ni skye ba'o/ /'di ni skye ba'i kun 'byung ba'o / /'di ni skye ba 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni skye ba 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo/ /'di ni rga ba'o/ /'di ni rga ba'i kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni rga ba 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni rga ba 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo/ /'di ni 'chi ba'o/ /'di ni 'chi ba'i kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni 'chi ba 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni 'chi ba 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /'di dag ni mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde 46wa 408

ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams te/ de ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhigatu'adi 'byung bar 'gyur ba nas/ 'gog par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /'di ni sdug bsngal lo/ /'di ni sdug bsngal gyisakun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes so/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems sridapas nam gyi cha smad skya rengs ba'achar ba'i dus kyi tshe nga0brdung ba'i nam tshod tsam na skyes bu dang / skyes bu dam pa dang / skyes bu mchog dang / skyes bu chen po dang / skyes bu khyu mchog dang /skyes bu glang po dang / skyes bu seng ge dang / skyes bu skyes mchog dang / skyes bu dpa' bo dang / skyes bu rtul phod yidang / skyes bu cang shes dang / skyes bu pad ma dang / skyes bu pad ma dkar po dang / skyes bu ljid khyer ba dang /skyes bu kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pas 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis shes par bya ba dang /khong du chud par bya ba dang / thob par bya ba dang / blta bar bya ba dang /mngon du bya ba gang ci yang rung ste/ de thams cad sems kyi skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i ④byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas rig pa gsum thob bo/ /dge slong dag de nas lha'i bu rnams kyis smras pa/ grogs po dag bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyis melatog gtor cig ces byas so/ / de nas7lha'i bu gang dag sngon gyi sangs rgyas mthong ba de dag 'dus nas de dag gis de dag la smras pa/ grogs po dag sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang brda mdzad cing brda /tshonyamangon par sprul pa mdzad kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 46wa 409

brda 37ma mdzad kyi bar dusame tog ma gtor cig /dge slong dag de nas de bzhin gshegs pas lha'i bu de dag yid gnyis su gyur par mkhyen nas/ shing ta la bdun tsam du nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te/ der bzhugs nas lam gyi rgyun ni chad do/ /rdulam ni nye bar zhi'o/ /zag pa ni skamasasate yang mi zag go/ /lam ni chad de yang mi 'jug go/ /'di ni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' zhes bya'o zhes ched du rjod sa)pa ched du brjod do/ /de nas lha'i bu de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la lha'i me tog gis gtor te/ de nas lha'i me tog pus mo nub tsam du bkram par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ mun pa mun nag dang ni bral/ sred pa ni rnam par sbyangs/ lta ba ni bzlog /nyon mongs pa rnams ni rnam par dkrugs/zug rngu ni phyung / mdud pa ni bkrol/ nga rgyal gyi rgyal mtshan ni bsnyal/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni bsgreng / bag la nyal rnams ni bton/ chos kyi de bzhin nyid ni mkhyen/ yang dag pa'i mtha' ni thugs su chud/ chos kyi dbyings ni yongs su mkhyen/ sems can gyi khams ni rnam par bkod/ yang dag pa nyid du nges pa'i phung po ni bsngagasaskyo/ log pa nyid du nges pa'i phung po ni smad/ma nges pa'i phung po ni yongs su bzung / sems can gyi dbang po rnams la ni rnam par gzigs/ sems can gyi spyod pa ni yongs su mkhyen/ sems can gyi nad gso ba ni thugs su chud/ bdud rtsi'i sman sbyar ba ni grub/ sman pa'i rgyal por ni byung / sdug bsngal thams cad las rab tu thar bar mdzad pa por ni gyur/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba la 'jog pa por ni gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi rgyal po'i khri chen po la ni 46—410

bzhugs/ rnam par grol ba'i thabs ni brnyes/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong khyer du ni zhugs/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang yang dag par ni 'dres/chos kyi dbyings thugs su chud pa las dbyer med par ni gyur to/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa ngas 'dir thog ma med pa'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mthar phyung ngo zhes zhag bdun pa dang po la byang chub kyi snying po de nyid na bzhugs so// //'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bcwa lnga pa/ dge slong dag byang chub sems dpas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob 3)ma thag tu de nas skad cig de nyid la phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad skad cig de dang / thang cig de dang / yud tsam de la mchog tu bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang snang ba chen pos snang bar byas nas/ 'jig rten gyi bar sdig pa sdig pas khyab pa mun nag ces bya ba snga ma bzhin no/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos so/ /ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg go/ /'gul/ rab tu 'gul/kun tu rab tu 'gul to/ /'khrugs/ rab tu 'khrugs/ kun tu rab tu 'khrugs so/ /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu chem chem mo/ /'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa tshimangon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ chos kyi dgab pa dag kyang skur ③ro/ /chos kyi dgab pa de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 46—411

rin po che'i gdugs gcig gis khebs par gyur te/ rin po che'i gdugs de las kyang rnam pa 'di0lta bu'i 'od zer gyi dra ba byung ste/ de dag gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgye khams grangs med dpag tu med pa dag snang bar byas nas phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / lha'i bu rnams kyang kun dga' ba'i sgra rjodashepar gyur te/ sems can mkhas pa'i pad ma ye shes kyi mtshokhulas byung ba/ 'jig rten gyi chos rnams kyis ma gos pa byung ngo / /thugs rje chen po'i sprin yang dag par 'phags te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas khyab par mdzad nas/ 'dul ba'i skye bo'i sman gyi chos kyi char/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sa bon thams cad kyi myu gu skyed pa/ dad pa'i myu gu rnams rnam par 'phel bar byed pa/ rnam par grol ba'i 'bras bu rnams 'byin par byed pa'i char 'bebs par 'gyur ro zhes 'dzer to/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ skyes bu seng ge de yis dpung bcas bdud btul te/ /ston pas bsam gtan bde ba mngon du mdzad nas ni/ /gang tshe stobs bcus rig pa gsum po mnyes gyur tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing mang bye ba g.yos par gyur/ /chos 'dod byang chub sems dpa' gang dag yongs lhags pa/ /zhabs la gtugs ༅te 'di skad tshig smras ma bumanyel tamartso/ /bdag cag mngon sum ci 'dra shin tu 'jigs dpung de/ /shes rab bsod nams stobs dang brtson 'grus stobs kyis bcom/ /khrag khrig zhing nas sangs rgyas rnams kyis gdugs rnams bskuradu/ /des pa skyes bu chen po bdud kyi sde rnams btul/ /khyed kyis gnas mchog 'chi 8med mya ngan med pa brnyes(me/ /srid pa gsum du dam chos char pa myur du phob/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can snying po rnams kyis phyag brkyang 46—412

stetsho/ /ka la thang ku'i sgra yi gsung du brjod pa ni/ /bdag cag ji du ciltar byang chub thob ltar khyod sangs rgyas/ /dper na mar dang mar gyi snying khukhumatshungs 'dra bzhin/ /dge slong dag de nas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu mo dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa mngon par shes pa brnyes pa dang / brnag pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba dang /bdud phyir rgol ba pham par mdzad pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ba dang / dpa' ba dang / rgyal ba 'phags pa dang /skyes bu dang / skyes bu chen po dang / sman pa'i mchog dang / zug rdu0)'byin pa chen po dang / seng ge ltar mi bsnyengs shing spu zing zhes byed pa mi mnga' ba dang / glang po ltar thugs shin tu dul ba dang / dri ma gsum spangs pas dri ma mi mnga' ba dang / rigatsonapa gsum brnyes pas mkhyen pa po dang / chu bo bzhi las brgal bas pha rol tu byon gepa dang / rin po che'i gdugs gcig 'dzin pas rgyal rigs su gyur pa dang / sdig pa'i chos spangs pas 'jig rten gsum gyi bram zer gyur pa dang / ma rig pa'i sgo ringa'i sbubs bcom pas dge slong du gyur pa dang / chags pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das pas dge sbyong du gyur pa dang / nyon mongs pa bsal bas gtsang sbra can du gyur pa dang / rgyal mtshan ma bsnyal bas dpa' ba dang / stobs bcu mnga' ba'isheshin tu stobs dang ldan pa dang / rin po che'i 'byung gnas ltar chos rin po che thams cad yongs su rdzogs par rig nas byang chub kyi snying po logs su phyogs te tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /'di ni shing gi rgyal drung du/ /bdud sde mngon du pham mdzad nas/ /ri rab lta bur mi g.yo bzhugs/ /46—413

bsnyengs pa mi mnga' 'bros mi mdzad/ /'dis ni bskal pa bye mang du/ /sbyin dang dul dang sdom pa yis/ /byang chub dam pa yang dag bsgrubs/ /des na 'dir 3)ni do mod mdzes/ /byang chub dam pa tshol ②ba na/ /'di yis bskal pa bye mang du/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs nodaka' thub kyis/ /brgya byin tshangs pa zil du brlagami /'di yis bskalam pa bye mang du/ /bzod pa'i stobs kyi go mnabs te/ /sdug bsngal rnams ni dang du blangs/ /des nasagaser mdog 'od dang ldan/ /'di yis bskal pa bye mang du/ /brtson 'grus stobs dang rtsal gyis ni/ /gzhan dag phyir bsnyil mdzad mdzad de/ /des na bdud kyi sde las rgyal/ /'di yis bskal pa bye mang du/ /bsam gtan mngon shes ye shes kyis/ /thub pa'i dbang po yang dag mchod/ /des na do mod 'di la mchod/ /'di yis bskal pa bye mang du/ /shes rab dang ni gsan pa bsags/ /sems can bye ba tho/phan yang btags/ /des na byang chub myur du brnyes/ /'di ni phung po'i〈9bdud las rgyal/ /'chi bdag nyon mongs bdud las rgyal/ /'di ni lha yi bdud las rgyal/ /des 'di mya ngan mi 'da'o/ /'di ni shin tu lha yi lha / /lha rnams kyis kyang mchod pa'i mtho/ /'jig rten gsum na mchod pa'i 'os / /bsod nams don du gnyer ba'i zhing / /'chi med 'bras bu sbyin mdzad pa/ /'di ni sbyin gnas dam pa ste/ /'di la sbyin pa btang na de/ /byang chub dam pa thob bar du/ /bar ma dor ni chud mi za/ /'di yi tshamadzod spu mdzes pa yis/ /zhing mang bye ba gsal bar bgyid/ /nyi zla dag kyang zil du rlag11 /sems can rnams la snang bar gyur/ /'di yinegazugs ni gzugs mdzes te/ /gzugs kyi dam pa legs pa'i gzugs/ /mtshan mchog mnga' 46wa 414

zhing phan pa bzhed/ /'jig rten gsum na mchod pa'i 'os/ /'di spyan shin tu rnam dag ste/ /zhing rnams dang ni sems can tshogs/ /sems dang ldan dang sems med pa/ /mang po dag la rang byung gzigs/ /'di snyan shin tu rnam dag ste/ /lha yi dag dang mi yi dang / /rgyal ba rnams kyi chos kyis/tshodang / /mtha' yas pa yi sgra rnams gsan/ /'di yi ljags tshani yangs pa ste/ /ka la ping ka 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'chi med rab tu zhir 'gro ba'i/ /chos ni 'di las bdag cag mnyan/ /bdud kyi sde rnams gzigs gyur kyang / /de yi thugs ni 'khrugs mi mnga'/ /lha yi tshogs rnams gzigs gyur kyang / /shin tu thugs gzhungasashedagyes mi mnga'/ /'di yis rimatshon dang mda' rnams kyis/ /bdud kyi sde las rgyal ma lags/ /bden pa brtul zhugs dka' thub kyis/ /snang ba'i gyad las 'di rgyal lo/ /gdan las ma bskyod bzhin du ni/ /de yi sku la gnod ma byung / /de yi skabs su byams mi mnga'/ /zhe snang gyur pa'ang ma lags so/ /gang dag khyod las chos thos nas/ /sgrub pa bgyid par 'tshal ba yi/ /lha dang mi rnams de dag ni/ /rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa lags⑤/ /rgyal ba bsod nams gzi mnga' ba/ /khyod la bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /mi yi zla ba khyod 'dra bar/ /kun kyang myur du 'gyur bar shog /skyes bu khyu mchog 'dren pas byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /khrag khrig zhing rnams bskyod cing bdud kyang pham mdzad de/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ka la ming ku'i sgra skad kyis/ /'dren pas thog mar tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /bsod nams rnam smin bde ste sdug bsngal 0thams cad sel/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi gebasam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /bdud bcom nas ni byang chub 46wa 415

myur du reg par 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po thob①/ /de bas bsod nams bya bas chog par su zhig 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi chos mnyan pas kyang chog par su zhig 'dzin/ /skye bo med pa'i nags gnas chog par su zhig 'dzin/ /sems can don bya bas kyang chog par su zhig 'dzin/ /byang chub sems dpas lag pa brkyang ste du natshig brjod pa/ /mchod pa byas kyis rang rang dag gi zhing du deng 57/ /kun gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /sna tshogs bkod pas rang rang dag gi zhing du dong / /dpung rnams phan tshun chen po byung ba de gzigs nas/ /bde bar gshegs pasatshul du shis parabarnam par rol/ /dpung bcas bdud las rgyal te bdud rtsi reg shog ces/ /sems can rnams kyis mtshungs med sems kyis byang chub smon/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi shing drung na seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ skad cig de la sangs rgyas kyi55)rnam par rol pa dpag tu med pa mdzad de/ de dag ni bskal par yang bstan par sla ba ma yin no/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sa ni lag mthil lta bur mnyam par gnas par gyur/ /'dabs ma brgya pa rgyas pa 'od dang ldan pa byung / /lha rnams brgya stong byang chub snying por rab tu 'dud/ /seng ge sgra yi mtshan ma dang po 'di 'dir mthong / /stong gsum shing brgya dag dang ri rnams du ma dang / ri yi rgyal po lhun po byang chub snying por 'dud/ / stobs bcu'isnyigan du song ste brgya byin tshangs pa 'dud/ /'di yang mi yi seng ge byang chub snying por rol/ /sku las 'od zer brgya stong dag ni rab bkye ste/ /rgyal ba'i zhing mchog khyab nas ngan song gsum po zhi/ /de nas skad cig yud tsam mi khom 46wa 416

skams7par gyur②/ /sems can gang la'ang tha ba rgyags snang gnod pa med/ /'di yang mi yi seng ge gdan la bzhugs pa'i rol/ /nyi zla nor bu me dang glog dang lha yi 'od/ /'od dang ldan pa'i rlabs kyis zil mnan lam0)me min/ /'gro ba gang gis kyang ni ston pa'i gtsug mi mthong / /'di yang mi yi seng ge gdan la bzhugs pa'i rol/ /phyag gi mthil gyis reg nas sa yang rnam drug g.yos/ /de yi bdud kyi sde rnams shing bal bzhin du dkrugs/ /bdud ni mda' thogs sa la ri mo gang 'dri bsad/ /'di yang mi yi seng ge gdan la rol pa lags/ /mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la bskor ba byas te/ lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma'i char mngon par phab nas/ tshul dang 'thun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bstod do/ /'jig rten gsal bar mdzad pa byung / /'jig rten mgon po 'od mdzad pa/ /'jig rten sdongs par gyur pa la/ /nyon mongs spangs pa mig sbyin pa/ /khyod ni g.yul las rnam par rgyal/ /bsod nams dag gis dgongs pa rdzogs/ /dkar po'i chos rnams kun du rdzogs/ /khyod ni 'gro ba tshim mdzad 'gyur/ /sdig pa mi mnga' 'dam las rgal/ /go ta ma ༅ni thang la bzhugs/ /sems can gzhan dag rlung0 chen gyis/ /khyer ba rnams kyang sgrol bar 'gyur/ /shes rab chen po khyod 'phags te/ /'jig rten dag na zla ma mchis/ /'jig rten chos kyis khyod mi gosaspu/ /chab na mchis pa'i 46—417

pad ma bzhin/ /'jig rten ring nas gnyid log 'di/ /mun pa'i phung pos gtibs pa la/ /khyod ni shes rab sgron me7)yis/ /rab tu sad par mdzad pa spyod/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten ring nas ni/ /nyon mongs nad kyis gzir ba la/ /nad rnams kun las thar mdzad pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal po yang dag byung / /'jig rten mgon po khyod byung bas/ /mi khom rnams ni stongs7par 'gyur/ /lha rnams dang ni mi dag kyang / / bde ba gyirnams dang ldan par 'gyur/ /skyes bu khyu mchog des pa khyod/ /lta bar gang dag 'dong bgyid pa/ /de dag bskal pa stong rnams su/ /nam yang ngan 'gror mchi mi 'gyur/ /gang dag chos nyan 'gyur ba rnams/ /de dag mkhas shing nad med dang / /zag0dang phung po zad pa dang / /'jigs pa med pa rnams su 'gyur/ /nyon mongs bcings pa bcad nas ni/ /kun kyang len pa ma mchis par/ /myur du rab tu grol 'gyur te/ /dge ba mchog gi 'bras bu 'thobartse/ /de dag 'jig rten sbyin gnas te/ /sbyin pa rnams ni blang ba'i 'os/ /de dag yon phul mi chung ste/ /kun kyang mya ngan 'das rgyu lags/ /dge slong dag de ltar gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas 'od gsal gyi lha'i bu rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa la me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rnam pa sna tshogs rnams kyis cho ga bzhin du mchod nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /thub pa thugs zab gsung ni 46—418

shin tu snyan/ /thub mchog tshangs dbyangs glu ltar gsung snyan mchog /byang chub rab mchog shin tu dam pa brnyes/ /dbyangs kun mthar phyin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod skyabs khyod gling khyod ni dpung gnyen te/ /khyod ni 'jig rten mgon po byams thugs mdzad/ /khyod ni sman pa'i dam pa zug rngu 'byin/ /gso ba phan mdzad khyod ni dam pa mchog /mar me mdzad pa gzigs ma thag tu khyod/ /byams dang thugs rje'i sprin gyi dra ba bsgrubs/sna/ /mgon po bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi char phob la/ /lha mi rnams kyi gdung ba zhi bar mdzod/ /khyod ni srid gsum mi gos pad ma 'dra/ /khyod ni mi g.yo mi bskyod lhun po 'dra/ /khyod ni thugs dam mi g.yo rdo rje bzhin/ /yon tan mchog kun mnga' ste zla ba 'dra/ /dge slong dag de ltar 'od gsal ba'i 5lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lamamimangon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas lha'i bu rab tshangs pa la sogs pa tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa la nor bu rin po che bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas spras pa'i rin po che'i dra bas bkab ste lan gsum bskor ba byas nas tshul dang 'thun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /dge ba dri med shes rab 'od dang gzi brjid ldan/ /mtshan gyi dam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mchog mnga' ba/ /dran dang ldan zhing blo gros ldan pa ye shes mnga'/ /mnyel ba mi mnga' khyod la mgordzogabos phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri gsum dri mi mnga' ba dri med dri ma bral/ /'jig rten gsum du grags shing rig pa gsum brnyes pa/ /rnam par thar pa dam pa gsum gyi mig sbyin pa/ /spyan gsum dri ma mi mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus ngan 46—419

rnyog pa bsal zhingasherab tu zhi thugs ldan/ /thugs brtse thugs rjes 'phags pa 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /thub pa dgyes pas 'phags pa thugs ni rab zhi ba/ /khyod ni yid gnyis grol bar mdzad pa btang snyoms dgyes/ /brtul zhugs dka' thub 'phags pa 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rang spyod rnam par dag cing spyod pa'i pha rol byon/ /bden pa bzhi po ston pa rnam thar dgyes pa po/ /grol bar gyur nas 'gro ba gzhan yang grol mdzad pa/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus ldan pa'i bdud po 'dir lhags pa/ /shes rab brtson 'grus de bzhin byams pas pham mdzad nas/ /khyod kyis go 'phangasadam pa 'chi ba med pa brnyes/ /g.yon can dpung rnams bcom pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge slong dag de ltar lha'i bu rab tshangs pa la sogs pa tshangs risasakyi lha rnams7kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas bdud kyi bu dkar po'i phyogs pa de dag de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / rin po che'i gdugs dang / bla re'uchen po rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa ⑥mngon par bkab nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la tshul dang 'thun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do//khyod stobs shin tu rgya che ba dang bdud dpung drag po bdag cag mngon sum ste/ /bdud dpung rab 'jigs chen po de yang khyod kyis skad cig gcig la pham par mdzad / /khyod ni bzhengs par ma gyur sku yang mi g.yo gsung yang brjod pa ma mdzad de/ /thub pa don kun 'grub pa 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod pa khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bdud kyi bu mo bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag du ma gang gā'i bye 46—420

ma snyed/ /de dag rnams kyis byang chub shing mchog drung nas khyod ni bskyod cing g.yo ma nus/ /mchod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag du ma gang gā'i bye ma snyeda'umadzad de/ /byang chub shing drung bzhugs pa des na de ring khyod ni rnam par mdzes pa lags/ /byang chub spyad〈mipa dam pa spyod mdzad tshe na shin tu sdug pa'i btsun mo dang / /phangs pa'i sras dang bran pho 2bran mo de bzhin skyed mos tshal dang grong khyer dang / /yul 'khor grong rdal dag dang rgyal srid rnams dang btsun mo'i 'khor dang glang po dang / /dbu dang spyan dang ljags dang de bzhin zhabs btang des na de ring rnam par mdzes/ /nga ni sangs rgyas 'gyur te bsam gtan rdzu 'phrul blo yi go bgos nas/ /sems can bye ba khrag khrig mang po sdug bsngal rgya mtshos khyer bar gyur pa rnams/ /dam chos gru yis nyid kyis bsgral bar bya zhes khyod kyis lan mang gsung brjod pa/ /khyod kyis smon lam de ni grub lags srog chags rnams kyang sgrol bar mdzad par 'gyur/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog 'jig rten mig sbyin mdzad pa khyod la bstod pa'i bsod nams de/ /bdag cag thams cad dga' mgu yid gyur thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du smon lam 'debs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab bsngags byang chub dam pa mtshungs med yang dag bsgrubs nas ni/ /de ltar bdud sde 'khor de bcom nas thams cad mkhyen⑧nyid 'tshang rgyar 'gyur bar ༅shog /dge slong dag de ltar bdud kyi bu rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la dzimangon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas lha'i bu gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor te/mdun du bdar nas de bzhin gshegs pa la 'dzam bu klungaku gi gser gyi pad ma 46—421

dag gis mngon par gtor te/ spyan snga nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /gsung ni dpyas ma mchis shing ma 'khrul rnam par ma 'khrugs pa/ /mun rdul bral zhing 'chirka med rtogs par thugs su chud par gyur/ /lha yul mi yul pa yi dpal dang bgyi ba gzhal med 'os/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i blo gros ldan la mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /dka'akhrub mdzad pa nyon mongs spong ba rdul dang dri ma sel/ /shin tu dga' ba'i gsung gis lha dang mi rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /sku mchog 'od zer rgyas pa dri ma shin tu mi mnga' bas/ /lha dang mi yi bdag po bzhin du 'gro ba 'di las rgyal/ /pha rol tshogs rnams rab tu 'joms pa gzhan gyi spyod mkhas pa/ /lha dang mi yi srid par dga' ba gzhan gyi blo sel ba/ /shin tu mkhas pa blo ldan gzhan gyi spyod pa rnam par phye/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba gshegs pa'i lam 'dir rnam par rgyu ba mdzod/ /srid pa 'dzin dang sdug bsngal log 'dzin rgya chen 'dor sel te/ /lha mi blo gros 'dul ba ji lta bzhin du 'dul ba mdzod/ /zla ba bzhin du mkha' las phyogs bzhi dag tu rnam rgyu ba/ /srid pa gsum 'dir rmad byung mig dang dpung gnyen gyur par shog /lha dang mi yi srid pa dga' 4yang yul la 'khrul mi mnga'/ /'dod pa'i dga' dang bral zhing dge ba'i dga' la dgyes pa po/ /'khor la sgrogs555pa 'jig rten gsum na khyod dang mtshungs ma mchis/ /khyod 'dir 'gro ba rnams kyi ne mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen lags/ /dge slong dag de ltar lha'i bu dbang sgyur la sogs pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon parabastod nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas lha'i bu rab 46—422

'phrul rab 'phrul gyi ༅lha'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/de bzhin gshegs pa la dar gyi lda ldis g.yogs nas spyan snga nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /dri ma rnam gsum spangs gepas khyod ni chos kyi snang ba yang dag 'phags/ /gti mug dang ni lta dang ma rig 'joms pa mdzesashedang dpal gyis rgyas/ /log pa'i lam la dga' ba'i skye bo 'di dag 'chi med 'god mdzad pa/ /'jig rten 'dir byung mchod rten lha yul ba dang mi yul bas mchod pa/ /khyod ni gso ba'i sman pa mkhas pa bdud rtsi bde ba sbyin pa po/ /lta dang nyon mongs pa dang ma rig bsags pa sngon gyi bag la nyal/ /lus can rnams kyi nad kun sngon gyi rgyal ba'i lam gyis sel ba ste/ /de bas sman pa dam pa 'dren pa khyod ni sa la rnam par rgyu/ /nyi zla'i 'od dang skar ma rnams dang me dang de bzhin nor bu dang / /brgya byin tshangs pa'i 'od rnams dpal stug spyan sngar lam me ma lags te/ /shes rab snang ba mdzad dang 'od mdzad ④'od dang dpal gyis rab tu rgyas/ /khyod kyi ye shes rmad byung mngon sum gyur pas mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par 'dren pa snyan pa'i gsung ldan bden dang bden min gsung ba dang 3/ /dul ba thugs zhi dbang po thul ba rab tu zhi ba'i thugs ldan pa/ /ston pa lha dang mi yi 'khor la 5bstan par bgyi ba ston mdzad pa/ /shākya thub pa mi yi khyu mchog lha mis mchod la phyag 'tshal lo ye shes mnga' ba ye shes bka' mchid mchog can srid gsum go mdzad pa/ /dri ma gsum bsal rig pa gsum dang rnam par thar gsum ston pa po/ /thub pa blo gros ji ltar gdul ba skal dang skal med rab mkhyen pa/ /stong gsum rmad du byung ba lha mis mchod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge slong dag de ltar lha'i bu 46—423

rab 'phrulatu'akhor dang bcas pas de bzhin gshegs pa lakhumangon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas lha'i bu yongs su dga' ldan dga' ldanasaris kyi lha'i bu dang lhan cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ lha'i gos kyi dra ba chen pos byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lakyimangon par bkab ste/ spyan snga nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /khyod ni dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs tshe der ni khyod kyis rgya chen chos kyang bshad/ /khyodasakyis bstan pa de ni da dung lha yi bu rnams chos spyod rgyun mi 'chad/ /khyod la blta bas ngoms par mi 'gyur chos mnyan0pas kyang ngoms pa rnyedakhumi 'gyur/ /yon tan rgya mtsho 'jig rten sgron ma khyod la mgo dang yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni dga' ldan gnas nas 'phos te de tshe khyodashekyis mi khom thams cad sbyangs/ /gang tshe byang chub shing drung bzhugs tshe 'gro ba kun gyi nyon mongs rab tu zhi/ /gang gi ched du rgya chen byang chub btsal ba brnyes te bdud kyang pham par mdzad/ /khyod kyi smon lam de ni rab tu rdzogs kyis 'khor lo rgya chen myur du skor6)/ /chos 'tshal ba dag chos mnyan bgyi zhes te/ /srog chags stong phrag mang po sdod cing mchis/ /'khor lo rgya chen myur du bskor du gsol/ /srog chags stong rnams srid las bsgral du gsol/ /dge slong dag de ltar lha'i bu yongs su dga' ldan 'khor dang bcas pas de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas lha'i bu rab 'thab bral la sogs pa 'thab bral gyi lha rnams bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas/46—424

me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byugs 4)pa sna tshogs kyis ③byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod de/ spyan snga nas tshul dang 'thun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin de bzhin shes rab kyis/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa ma mchis ga la lhag /mos dang rnam par grol la mkhas pa po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /byang chub snying por ri rilha yis gang bgyis pa/ /bkod pa mdzes pa de dag mthong lags te/ /ji ltar khyod la lha dang mis mchod pa/ /de ni gzhan gang la yang 'os ma lags/ /khyod byung don ma mchis pa ma lags te/ /gang gi don du dka' ba mang po spyad/ /shin tu g.yon can sde dang bcas las rgyal/ /khyod kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub brnyes/ /phyogs bcu dag tu snang ba mdzad par gyur/ /shes rab sgron masam 'jig rten gsum po gsal/ /khyod ni rab rib sel bar 'gyur ba ste/ /'gro la bla na med pa'i mig sbyin pa/ /khyod la bstod pa bskal par brjod kyang ni/ /khyod kyi ba spu'i khung bu mtha' ma mchis/ /yon tan rgya mtsho 'jig rten rnam par grags/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar lha'i bu(perab 'thab bral la sogs pa 'thab bral gyi lha'i bu de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin sum cu rtsa gsumadza ris kyi lha rnams dang lhan cig tu me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bkod pa rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par 46—425

bstod do/ /thub pa ma 'khrul kha na ma tho mi mnga' rtag tu legs bzhugs lhun po 'dra / /phyogs bcu dag tu ye shes 'od grags bsod nams dag dang gzi brjid ldan pa po/ /thub pa khyod kyis sngon chad sangs rgyas brgya phrag mtha' yas yang dag mchod pa mdzad/ /de yi yul de yis ni byang chub shing drung bdud kyi sde las rgyal bar gyur/ /tshul khrims dang ni thos dang ting 'dzin shes rab 'byung gnas ye shes rgyal mtshan tog /rga shi 'joms par mdzad pa sman pa dam pa 'jig rten dag la 3)mig sbyin pa/ /thub pa dri ma gsum dang tha ba spangs shing dbang po zhi la thugs zhi ba/ /shākya khyu mchog 'gro ba dag gi zhu ri chos kyi rgyal po khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /khyod kyis brtson 'grus mthu yis 'phags pa'i byang chub spyod pa mtha' yas gyur lags te/ /shes rab stobs dang thabs dang byams pa'i stobs dang bsod nams stobs rnams dang / /stobs rnams de dag bcom ldan 'das khyod byang chub bzhugs pa'i tshe na mtha' yas te/ /stobs dang ldan pa de ring byang chub snying por bzhugs nas stobs bcu mnga' bar gyurage/ /dpung tshogs mtha' yas mthong nas dge sbyong rgyal po byang chub snying por bzhugs pa de/ /nyams par mi 'gyur grang cizhes lha rnams thams cad rab tu sngangasasashing skrag par gyur/ /khyod ni 'byung po rnams kyis bsnyengs par ma gyur sku yang g.yo ba mi mnga' ste/ /khur lci phyag gis brdabs nas kun tu g.yos te bdud kyi sde las rgyal bar gyur ci/ /ji ltar snga ma rnams kyis seng ge'i khri la byang chub dam pa brnyes gyur pa/ /de ltar khyod kyis rjes su sangs rgyas mtshungs shing mnyam ste gzhan du gyur ma lags/ /yid kyang mnyam zhing sems kyang mnyam ste khyod bdag nyid kyis thams cad mkhyen nyid brnyes/ /des na khyod ni 'jig rten dam pa 46—426

rang byung 'gro ba rnams kyi bsod nams zhing / /dge slong dag de ltar lha'i dbang po brgya byin sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang lhan cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ me tog a ti mug ta 3)ka dang / tsam pa ka dang /sna ma'i me tog dang / bar shi du ka dang / dha nus gyika ri'i phreng ba dang /chun po thogs te/ lha'i bu mo brgya stong gis bskor nas lha'i glu dbyangs len pas de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa byas te/ tshul dang 'thun pa'i tshigasam su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /shin tu gsung snyan dbyangs ni yid du mas)/ /zla ltar rab tu zhi mdzad thugs dang ba/ /'dzum pa'i zhal ldan ljags ni rab yangs pa/ /thub mchog dga' mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal 4)lo / /lha mi rnams kyi snyan cing dgar 'gyur ba/ /sgra skad gang dag 'jig rten mchis pa kun/ /khyod kyi 'jam pa'i gsung ni phyung bas na/ /mi yi sgra skad thams cad zil gyis non/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nyon mongs zhi/ /mi min dga' ba rnam par dag pa skyed/ / rtog pa ci tshom mchis snying gis chos thos nas/ /de kun 'phags pa'i rnam par grol ba thob/ /khyod ni mi mkhas rnams la brnyas mi mdzad/ /mkhas pa'i rgyags pas nams kyang rgyags ma gyur/ /khyod ni 'gying ba mi mnga' zhum mi mnga'/ /rgya mtsho'i dbus nas ri mchog 'phags pa bzhin/ /de 'dra'i sems can 'jig rten byung bas na/ /mi rnams 'dir ni rnyed pa legs par rnyed/ /pad ma dpal ltar nor rnams sbyin pa po tsho//46—427

de ltar 'jig rten kun la mchod7sbyin mdzad/ /de ltar rgyal po chen pokhubazhi la sogs pa rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas bar snang gi lha rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du lhags te/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir bar snang thams cad rin po che'i dra ba dang /dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba dang / rin po che'i gdugs rnams dang / rin po che'i ba dan rnams dang / rin po che dang dar gyi lda ldi dang / rin po che'i me tog rna rgyan dang / mu tig gi chun khor dang / me tog gi lda ldi sna tshogs rnams lus phyed phyung ba'i lha rnams kyis bzung ba dang / zla gam rnams kyis legs par brgyan nas de bzhin gshegs pa la phul lo/ /phul nas kyang spyan snga nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /thub pa mkhas la bdag cag mchis nas ni/ /'gro ba'i spyod kun ji bzhin gsal bltas shing / /sems can dag pa khyod kyi spyod bltas na/ /de ltar khyod kyi thugs gcig 'khrul ma mthong / /mchod phyir byang chub sems dpa' gang lhagasalgepa/ /mi yi 'dren pa de dag nam mkha' khyab/ /'di ltar de dag nam mkha'i lus lags pas/ /gzhal med khang rnams la yang gnod ma mchis/ /bar snang nas ni me tog char bab pa/ /stong chen byur bur rab tu gang gyur pa/ /de dag ma lus khyod kyi skur bab kyang / /'bab chu rgya mtshor bab pa bzhin du gyur/ /gdugs dang me tog rna rgyan ④me tog phreng / /me tog tsam pa ka yi gelda ldi dang / /rgyan phreng zla ba zla gam rnams kyang 'thor/ /lha yis gtor kyang 'dres par gyur ma mchis/ /46—428

bar snang thams cad lha yis gang gyur te/ /'di la skra tsam gzhag pa'i gnas ma mchis/ /rkang gnyis mchog la mchod pa bgyid kyang ni/ /khyod la rgyags pa'am ngo mtshar 'gyur mi mnga'/ /de ltar bar snang gi lha rnams kyis byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas sa bla'i lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir sa gzhi 0)thams cad legs par phyags te byugs nas spos chus chag chag btab ste/ me tog gis chal bar bkang nas ras bcos 2bu sna tshogs kyi bla re bres ④te de bzhin gshegs pa la phul nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /stong gsum rdokhurje lta bur mi shigs gnas par gyur/ /nga 'dir pags pa sha dang rus pa rkang skams〈ne kyang / /byang chub ma reg nga ni 'di nas mi ldang zhes/ /rdo rje'i gnas kyis de ni byang chub snying por bzhugs/ /gal te mi yi seng ge khyod kyis stong gsum kun/ /byin gyis ma brlabs na ni gang dag rkang mthil gyis/ /bye ba'i zhing rnams bskyod pa ri/de ltar shugs che ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' lhags tshe ma lus zhig 8par 'gyur/ /sa phyogs gang du sems can dam pa 'chag pa ni/ /sa yi lha yis rnyed spupa rgya chen legs par rnyed/ /'jig rten rdul rnams ji snyed khyod kyis snang bar mdzad/ /stong gsum mchod rten gyur na khyod sku smos ci 'tshal/ /'og gi chu yi phung po brgya stong ji snyed dang //sa yi steng na 'gro ba'i 'tsho ba ji snyed pa/ /stong gsum sa rnams thams cad bdag cag gzung bar bgyi/ /khyod la kun 'bul ji ltar bzhed bzhin spyad du gsol/ /gang du khyodamo/nyeni bzhugs sam 'chagatsogam mnal ba dang / /go tamatsha/rte46wa 429

bde bar gshegs pa'i sras po nyan thos gang / /chos gtam smra dang gang yang de dag mnyan 3)pa dang / /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /de ltar sa bla'i lha rnams kyis byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /mngon par bstod pa'i le'u zhes bya bsheste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //dge slong dag de ltar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lha rnams kyis bstod cing skyil mo krung ma bshig /spyan mi 'dzumasalgepar shing gi rgyal po la gzigs shing bsam gtan dang dga' ba'i zas kyiphubade ba myong bar byang chub kyi shing drung du zhag bdun 'das par gyur to/ /de nas zhag bdun 'das pa dang / 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams spos chu'i bum pa khri thogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba der lhags so/ /gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyang spos chu'i bum pa khri thogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ byang chub kyi shing dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la 5spos chus 45bkrus so/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding rmodang / mi 'am ci dang /lto 'phye chen po bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la phog pa'i spos chu des rang rang gi lus la bskus so/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang sems bskyed do/ /lha'i bu la sogs pa de dag rang rang gi gnas su phyin kyang spos chu de dang ma bral bar gyur te/ spos gzhan la 46wa 430

'dod pa mi skyed do/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs pa la gus par 〉yid la bya tsho ba las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba des bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de nas lha'i bu kun nas me tog ces bya ba 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur pa des de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs gnyis la gtugs te/ thal mo sbyar nas de bzhin gshegs pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin gang dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa la dgung bdun du skyil mo krung ma bshig par bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin de'i ming ci zhes bgyi/ dge slong dag de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa des rnyilha'i bu de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lha'i bu ting nge 'dzin 'di'i ming ni dga' ba'i zas bkod pa zhes bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin 'di dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa 5zhag bdun du skyil mo krung ma bshig par bzhugs so/ /dge slong dag de nas lha'i bu kun nas me tog gis de bzhin gshegs pa la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /zhabs ni 'khor los khyab pa po/ /pad 'dab rdul med stong gzi ldan/ /lha yi cod pan zhabs gtugs pa/ /dpal stug gzhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de tshe lha bu de sems dga'/ /lha min rab tu zhi byed pa/ /yid gnyis sel ba'i tshig 'di smras/ /shākya'i rigs la dgyes skyed pa/ /chags sdang gti mug mthar 'byin pa/ /zhus pa rnams kyang mthar 'byin pa/ /lha mi'i ci 7dogs pa bsal du gsol/ /dpag med thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas stobs bcu ci slad nadu/ /rgyal ba dog sa'i snying por ni/ /dgung bdun skyil mo krung ma bshig /'dab brgya rgyas 46—431

pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ /ci zhig gzigs na dgung bdun du/ /mi yi seng ge rnam dag spyan/ /spyan mi 'dzums 3)par gzigs pa mdzad/ /gang gis shing rgyal drung du ni/ /skyil krung ma bshig dgung bdun bzhugs/ /smon lam 'di ni khyod kyi 'am/ /smra ba'i seng ge kun gyi lags/ /tshemasasheni mnyam zhing rnam dag pa/ /stobs bcu'i zhal ni dri rab gda'/ /ma nor legs par bka' stsol te / /lha dang mi rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /zla 'dra'i zhal gyis bka' stsal pa/ /ngas bshad lha yi bu nyon cig /ngas ni dris pa de yi lan/ /cung zad tsam zhig bshad par bya/ /dper na rgyal po phyogs gang du/ /gnyen gyi tshogs kyis dbang bskur ba/ /zhag bdun bar du sa phyogs de/ /mi 'dor0rgyal po'i chos nyid do/ /de bzhin stobs bcu mnga' ba yang / /gang tshe smon rdzogs dbang bskur ba/ /sa yi snying por risnyezhag bdun du/ /rgyal ba skyil mo krung mi 'jig /dper na dpa' bo dgra tshogs rnams/ /ma lus pham byas lta ba ltar/ /byang chub snying por sangs rgyas kyang / /nyon mongs bcom nas gzigs pa mdzad/ /gti mug byung ba'i 'dod dang khro/ /de dag 'gro ba'i dgra 'dra ste/ /chom po chas nyani bzang 'dra ba/ /de dag ma lus ngas 'dir bshig /ngas 'dir nga rgyal rnam dgu dang / /gnas med rlom sems rab tu bcom/ /zag pa thams cad rab tu spangs/ /nga yi ye shes dam pa skyes/ /ngas 'dir sred pa'i srid rgyu dang / /ma rig bya min byed pa de/ /bag nyal bcas rtsa dra ba rnams/ /ye shes gsal ba'i me yis bsregs/ /ngasashe'adir nga dang nga yi 1༄dang / /nyes zhags ring 'gro rtsa zug pa/ /sgrib pa'i mdud pa dam popha rtode/ /ye shes mtshon gyis bcad par gyur/ /ngas 'dir ring nas nga'i 46—432

ldan pa/ /slu ba tha ma rnam 'jig pa/ /len ①par bcas pa'i phung po de/ / ye shesasakyis ni yongs su shes/ /gnyis su rmongs pa log 'dzin pa/ / tha mar dmyalasa'agyur de dag rnams/ /ngas 'dir ma lus bsal byas te ri/ /phyin chad nam yang skyer mi 'gyur/ /ngas 'dir dge ba'i rtsa ba yi/ /me yis sgrib pa'i nags tshal bsregs/ /phyin ci log ni rnam bzhi yang / /nga yis ma lus nges par bsregs/ /'du shes skud pas brgyus pa yi/ /rnam rtog phreng ba gnod byed pa/ /ngas 'dir byang chub yan lag go)/ /phreng ba sna tshogs rnams kyis bzlog /bgrod dka' drug cu rtsa lnga dang / /gti mug sum cu dri dum can//sdig pa dag ni bzhi bcu ngas/ /sa yi snying po 'dir bsal te⑦/ /sa yi snying por 'dug nas ngas/ /sdom pa ma yin bcu drug dang / /khams ni rnam pa bcwa brgyad dang / /khyab pa nyi shu rtsa lnga bsal/ /nyon mongs chu bo nyi shu dang / /'gro ba 'jigs pa nyi shu brgyad/ /brtson 'grus mthu dang brtul ba yis nga 'dir de dag shin tu 'das/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas bsgyings sgrog pa/ /lnga brgya ngas 'dir yang dag rtogs/ /brgya phrag stong du tshangasho ba yi/ /chos rnams nga yis yang dag rtogs/ /ngas 'dir bag nyal ma lus pa/ /dgu bcu rtsa brgyad rtsarashebacas mtha'/ /kun nas ldang ba'i lo ma rnams/ /ye shes me yis nges par bsregs/ /dogs dang yid gnyis kun 'byung ba/ /lta ba'i chu yis gang gyur pa/ /mi dge ngogs can sred pa'i klung / /shugs drag ye shes nyi mas bskamasang/ /tshul 'chos pa dang kha gsag lha spangs/ /sgyu dang ser sna phrag dog snang / /nyon mongs dgon pa ding pa'adir bcad/ /'dul ba'i me yis rab tu bsregs/ /'dir ni rtsod pa'i rtsa ba de/ /ngan 'gro / nyam ngar 'dren byed pa/ /46—433

'phags la 3)skur pa 'debs pa'i tshig /ye shes mchog gi sman gyis bskyugasal/ /ngas 'dir ye shes yon tan dang / /ting 'dzin thob nas ngu ba dang / /cho nge 'don dang mya ngan dang / /smre ba ma lus mtha' mar phyin/ /ngas 'dir bden tshul ting nge 'dzin/ /thob nas chu bo sbyor ba dang / /mdud pa mya ngan zug rngu dang —/ /rgyags dang bag med kun las rgyal/ /ngas 'dir nyon mongs gzings pa yi / /srid pa'i ljon shing rtog rtsa brtan/ /dran pa'i sta res ma lus par/ /bcad nas ye shes me yis bsregs/ /ngas ④'dir nga snyam nga rgyal te/ /khams gsum dbang byed stobs che ba/ /g.yon can ye shes ral gris bcom/ /lha min dbang la dbang po bzhin/ /dra ba ma lus sum cu drug /'jug pa sa yi snying po 'dir/ /shes rab ral gri stobs ldan pas/ /bcad nas ye shes me yis bsregs/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba bag nyal bcas/ /sdug bsngal mya ngan 'byung de dag /ngas 'dir shes rab dam pa yi/ /thong lcags kyis ni ma lus bton/ /rang bzhin gyis dag sems can gyi/ /shes rab mig 'dir nga yis sbyangs/ /ye shes mig sman chen 5po yis/ /gti mug ling tog rgya chen bsa'akha/ /'byung khams bzhi po rgyags pa yi/ /chu srin gyis dkrugs sred yangs pa/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho dran pa dang / /zhi gnas nyi ma'i 'od kyis bskams/ /ngas 'dir yul gyi shing gi tshogs/ /rnam rtog dud 'thul chags chen med/ /rab tu 'bar ba rnam thar chu/ /bsil ba'i khu bas bsad par gyur/ /ngas 'dir bag la nyal ba'i sprin/ /ro myang glog 'dra rnam rtog 'brug /brtson 'grus stobs kyi rlung shugs kyis( / /'das 7te kun du gtor bar gyur/ /ngas 'dir dran pa tsho/nyadri med pa'i/ /ting 'dzin thob nas sems spyod dgra/ /srid pa'i khon rgyud ma 16wa 434

lus par/ /shes rab ral gri'i ri stobs kyis bcad/ /ngas 'dir rgyal mtshan mchog 'chang ba/ /shing rta glang napo gartas mtho ba/ /gzugs bsgyur bdud dpung brtson pa'i sde/ /byams pa thob canas rnam par bcom/ /mi sdug ting nge 'dzin thob nas/ /ngas 'dir dbang po drug gi rta/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas rtas nipa/ /rtag tu rgyags yan phyirim lus btags/ /smon med ting nge 'dzin thob nas/ /ngas 'dir rjes su chags pa dang / /khong khro ba dang 'thab pa dang / /rtsod spang ma lus mtha' mar phyin/ /stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob nas/ /ngas 'dir phyi dang nang dag gim/ /rlom sems kun dang rtog pa dang / /rnam par rtog0 pa yongs su zad/ /mtshan 1med ting nge 'dzin thob nas/ /lha mi srid pa'i rtser4thug pa'i/ /bde ba thams cad ma lus par/ /nga yis 'dir ni yongs su btang / /ngas 'dir rnam thar gsum thob nas/ /ngas 'dir shes rab stobs kyis ni/ /srid pa dag gi 'ching ba kun/ /ma lus kun las grol bar gyur/ /ngas 'dir rgyu mthong gyur nas ni/ /rtag dang mi rtag 'du shes dang / /bdag dang bdag med bde sdug bsngal/ /rgyu yi 'du shes gsum las rgyal/ /ngas 'dir las kyi rnam pa dang 11/ /skye mched drug rtsa kun 'byung las/ /byung ba thams cad shing dbang drung / /mi rtag pa yis bsnun te bcad / /ngas 'dir ye shes nyi ma yis/ /gti mug mun pa'i rnyog pa dang / /lta gyur rgyags dang khros gang ba/ /yun ring mun pa bsal snang byas/ /ngas 'dir brtson 'grus stobs kyi pagrus/ /'dod dang chags pa'i chu srin can/ /ngar 8'dzin lta ngan sred rlabs chu/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las rgal/ /gang rtogs chags dang gti mug dang / /sems kyi rnam par rtog bsregs te/ /phye 46—435

lebanyenags mer lhung 'dra ba/ /ngas 'dir de ni rjes su rtogs/ /nga 'dir ring nas song ba yi/ /bskal pa dpag med bye khrag khrig /'khor ba'i lam gyis nyon mongs pa/ /gdung ba med nas ngal yang sos/ /'jig rten phan phyir rga shi dang / /mya ngan sdug bsngal mthar phyin pa/ /pas rgol kun gyis ma thob pa/ /bdud rtsi de ni ngas 'dir rtogs/ /sred las byung ba'i skye mched kyis/ /sdug bsngal phung pos sdug bsngal ba/ /phyis mi 'byung ba 'jigs med kyi/ /grong khyer 'dir ni ngas phyin to/ /ngas 'dir nang gi dgra chen po/ /khyab pa de dag rjes su rtogs/ /rtogs nasaphurab tu bsregs te ngas/ /de dag yang byung gnas7med byas/ /bdud rtsi'i don du bskal pa ni/ /bye ba khrag khrig rang gi sha/ /mig dang rin chen mang btang ba/ /de 'dir nga yis rjes su rtogs/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba dpag med pas/ /gang sangs rgyas de ngas 'dir rtogs/ /gang gi snyan pa nyams dga' ba/ /sgra ni 'jig rten rnams su grags/ /rten nas byung ba'i 'gro ba stong / /sems kyi skad cig gcig la 'jig /smrig rgyu dri za'i grong khyer 'dra/ /de 'dir nga yis rjes su rtogs/ /gang gis lag pa'i mthil du ni/ /shing tog mi bzhag bzhin 'jig rten khams//thams cad mthong ba'i mig mchog de/ /nga yis 'dir ni dag par byas/ /sngon gyi gnas ni ngas 'dir dran/ /rig pa gsum yang thob par gyur/ /bskal pa khrag khrig dpag med pa/ /gnyid kyis log las sad bzhin dran/ /lha mi nor zhing 'du shes log /phyin ci log gyur gang 'bar ba/ /de yang de bzhin ma nor bar/ /ngas 'dir bdud ༅rtsi'i snying khu 'thungasaX/ /gang gi don du stobs bcu po/ /sems can kun la byams pa bsgoms/ /byams pa'i 46—436

stobs kyis rgyal gyur nas/ /ngas 'dir bdud rtsi'i snyingashekhu 'thungs/ /gang gi don du stobs bcu po/ /sems can kun la snying rje bsgoms/ /snying rje'i stobs kyis rgyalasagyur nas/ /ngas 'dir bdud rtsi'i snying ③khu 'thungs/ /gang gi don du stobs bcu po/ /sems can kun la dga' ba bsgoms / /dga' ba'i stobs kyis rgyal gyur nas/ /ngas 'dir bdud rtsi'i snying rinakhu 'thungs/ /gang gi don du stobs bcu po/ /bskal pa khrag khrig btang snyoms bsgoms/ /btang snyoms 'di yi stobs kyis rgyal/ /ngas 'dir bdud rtsi'i snying〈 khu 'thungs/ /stobs bcu gang gā'i bye ma bas/ /rab tu mang bas gang gsol pa/ /sngon rgyal seng ges sngon gsol pa/ /bdud rtsi'i snying tshon)khu ngas 'dir 'thungs/ /rga shi mtha' mar ma phyin par/ /skyil mo krung ni mi gzhig ces/ /sder bcas pa yi bdud mdun 'dir/ /nga yis tshig ni gang smras pa/ /ye shes rdo tsho)rje brtan 'bar bsabya/ /nga yis ma rig pa yang bcom/ /stobs bcu nyid ni thob par gyur/ /de lta bas na skyil krung gzhig /nga yis dgra bcom nyid thob ste/ /nga yi51zag pa ma lus zad/ /bdud kyi sde yang bcom par gyur/ /de lta bas na skyil krung gzhig /sgrib pa lnga yi sgo glegs rnams/ /nga yis 'dir ni thams cad bcag /srid pa'i khri 7shing rnams kyang bcad/ /nga 'dir skyil mo krung gzhig tshigo/ /de nas mi yi zla ba dem/ /dal gyis gdan las bzhengs nas su/ /dbang bskur chen po bzhesasngo nas ni/ /seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ /lha tshogs rnams kyis rin chen snod/ /steng nas spos chu sna tshogs kyis/ /stobs bcu yon tan mthar phyin pa/ /'jig rten rtsa lag sku yang bsil/ /bye ba khrag khrig lha rnams dag /lha mo khrag khrig lhan cig tu/ /kun nas rol mo 46—437

stong dag gis/ /mchod pa gzhal du med pa byed/ /de ltar lha yi bu dag ni/ /sa yi snying po ha)zhag bdun du/ /rgyal ba'i skyil krung ma bshig pa/ /rgyur bcas rkyen bcas gzhi 2dang bcas/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa ngas 'dir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /ngas 'dir thog ma med pa'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mthar phyung ngo zhes zhag bdun pa dang po la gdan bde nyid la bzhugs so/ /zhag bdun pa gnyis pa'i tshe ni de bzhin gshegs pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar du rgyang ring du 'chags pas 'chag mego/ /zhag bdun pa gsum pa'i tshe ni de bzhin gshegs pa ngas 'dir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas thog ma med pa'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mthar phyung ngo zhes byang chub kyi snying po lalaspyan mi 'dzums par yigazigs so/ /zhag bdun pa bzhi pa'i tshe ni de bzhin gshegs pa shar gyi rgya mtsho nas nub kyi rgya mtsho'i bar du mi ring ba'i 'chagasar kyipas 'chag go// //'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bcu drug pa/ de nas bdud sdig can de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba der song ste phyin nas / de bzhin gshegs pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dpa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus la bab lags kyis/ bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' shebar gsol/ dge slong dag de skad ces gsol pa dang / de 46—438

bzhin gshegs pas bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sdig can nga'i dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan/ dul ba/ gsal ba/ byang ba/bag tsha ba med pa/ mang du thos pa/ chos kyi rjes su 'thun pa'i chos la zhugs pa/ bdag nyid slob dpon du sgrogs 1pa dang / phas kyi tshirgol ba byung ba rnams chos dang 'thun pas tshar bcad de dad par byas nas cho 'phrul dang bcas pa'i chos ston par nus pa dag ma byung gi bar /de srid du nga yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da'o/ /rig can ngas 'jig rten du sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra bzhag par ma gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par ma gyur gyi bar ④de srid du zhu nga yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da'o/ /sdig can nga'i 'khor bzhi po dul ba/ gsal ba/ byang ba/ bag tsha ba med pa nas cho 'phrul dang bcas pa'i chos ston pa'i bar du nus pa dag byung ba ma gyur gyi bar de srid du nga yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da'o/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis tshig de skad thos nas sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde ste/ phyogs gcig tu song nas 'dug ste mgo smad nas mdas sa la ri mo 'dri nazhing bdag gi yul las 'das so snyam du sems par gyur to/ /de nas bdud kyi bu mo dga' ma 1)dang /mi dga' ma dang / sred ma gsum gyis bdud sdig can la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ yab cig ji ltar thugs mi dgyes/ /mi tshagang lags pa ha bka' 455 dang ske/ /'dod chags zhags pas de bcings nas/ /glang po bzhin du dgug par bgyi/ /bkug nas de ni myur du yang / /khyod kyi dbang du 'gyur bar bgyi / /de lamatshathugs ngan 'o brgyal 'or/ /dgyes pa rgya chen brnyes par sku46wa 439

'gyur/ /bdud kyis smras pa/ 'jig rten dgra bcom bde bar gshegs/ /'dod chags dbang du de mi 'gro/ /nga yi7yul las shin tu 'das/ /de bas nga ni mya ngan che/ /de nas de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu byang chub sems dpa'ikhumadzad pa snga nas kyang shes mod kyi/ bud med kyis dumi brtan pas pa'i tshig ma mnyan te/ bu cigashogebatsas tsam gyi na tshod kyis0dar la bab par sgyur nas/ mig gis59mi rtsol bar bya ba'i las kyi phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gan du dong ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pas de dag yid la mkhumadzad par de dag rga bas 'khogs spupar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas de dag pha'i gan du song ste/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /de ni chags pas mi bkri ste/ /nga yi yul las shin tu 'das/ /de bsru mya ngan nga che zhes/ /yab kyis bdag cag gsungs pa mdapya/ /go ta ma ni brlag pa'i phyir/ /bdag cag rnams kyis〈lhagang sprul pa/ /gzugs la gal te de lta na/ /de yi de snying 'gas par 'gyur/ /yab bdag cag gi lus rga bas 'khogs pa 'di ma mchis par mdzad du gsol/ /bdud kyis smras pa/ gang zhig sangs rgyas byin gyis brlabs ni gzhan du sgyur bar byed nus pa/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu dag gi 8'jig rten dag na mi de ngas ma mthong / /myur du song ste thub pa de las rang byas nyes pa shogs shig dang / /de ni khyod kyis bsam pa bzhin du sngon gyi lus su sgyur bar 'gyur/ /de nas de dag dong ste bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das la sku brnyas bgyi bar bsamasam pas/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byis pa rnams dang /ji ltar glen pa rnams dang / ji ltar mi gsal ba mi mkhas shing ma 'tshal ba rnams ltar bdag cag tshanongs pa can du gzung du gsol/ bde bar gshegs 46wa 440

pa bdag cag nongs pa can du gzung du gsol/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa la bzod par gsol to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pas de dag la tshigs su bcad pas bka' stsal pa/ /sen mos ri la bru ba dang / /so yis lcags ni bca' ba dang / /mgosheyis ri ni dbug pa dang / /gting mi dpogs dul dpog par 'dod/ /de lta bas na bu mo khyed/ /nyes pa can du ngasashegazung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang nyes pa la nyes par mthong nas 'chags shing phyin chad kyang sdom par byed pa de ni 'phags pa'i chos 'dul ba la 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag zhag bdun pa lnga pa la bzhag bdun yul ngan chen po byung ba'i tshe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i rgyale po btang bzungapo)gi gnas na bzhugs so/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po btang bzungadza bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la grang ba dang rlung gis phog tu 'ong ༅zhes rang gi gnas nas byung ste/ lus kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la lan bdun du dkris 3byenas mgo'i gdengs ka rnams kyis bkab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la grang ba dang rlung gis phog tu 'ong ngo zhes shar phyogs nas kyang klu'i rgyal po gzhan mang du lhags te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la lus rnams kyis lan bdun du dkris 7nas mgo'i gdengs ka rnams kyis bkab bo/ /shar phyogs nas ji lta ba bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la grang ba dang rlung gis phog tu 'ong ngo zhes lho dang nub dang byang phyogs nas kyang klu'i rgyal po rnams lhags nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la lus tsho/1rnams kyis lan bdun du dkris te mgo'i gdengs ka rnams kyis bkab bo/ /klu'i rgyal po'i phung po de ni ri'i dbang po lhun po ltar mthonapha por gnas par gyur to/ /klu'i rgyal po de dag gis kyang ji ltar nyin bdun mtshan bdun du de bzhin 46wa 441

gshegs pa'i sku de 33la reg par gyur pa de lta bu'i bde ba de dag gis sngon nam yang ma rnyed do/ /de nas zhag bdun 'das nas klu'i rgyal po de dag gis ②yul ngan med par shes te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku las lus bkrol nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan gsum bskor b.lobyas nas/ rang rang gi gnas su dong ngo / /klu'i rgyal po btang bzung7yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan gsum bskor ba byas nas rang gi riganas su zhugs so/ /zhag bdun pa drug pa'i tshe ni de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i rgyal po btang bzung phyogi gnas nas shing n+ya gro dha ra 0skyong gi drung du bzhud do/ /klu'i rgyal po btang bzung58)gi gnas dang shing n+ya gro dha ra spuskyong gi bar du rlung tshan ran dza na'i 1ngogs su spyod tshapa pa dang / kun tu rgyu dang ske/ nyan thos rgan po dang / gi ta ma dang / gcer bu pa dang / kun du 'tsho ba pa la sogs pas de bzhin gshegs pa mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das go ta mas zhag bdun pa yul ngan chen po'i dus 'di bde bas bde bar 'das par byas sam zhes 'dzer to/ /dge slong dag de nas de bzhin gshegs pas 7de'i tshe ched du rjod gepa 'di ched du brjod do/ /chos thos pa dang mthong ba dang / /dben par dga' ba bde ba yin/ /srog chags 'byung po rnams la bsdams/ /gnod pa mi byed 'jig rten bde/ /sdig pa rnams las marab 'das pa/ /'dod chags bral ba 'jig rten bde/ /nga snyam nga rgyal gang 'dul ba/ /de ni mchog tu bde ba yin/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pas skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang ske/ sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams kyi tsha46wa 442

'jig rten kun du 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar bar gzigs nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ched du rjod 3)pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /sgra reg ro dang gzugs dang dri rnams kyis/ /'jig rten 'di ni kun du gdungs par gyur/ /srid pas 'jigs kyang srid pa'i sred pa yis/ /phyir zhing sred 5pa tshol ribar byed pa yin/ /zhag bdun pa bdun pa'i tshe ni de bzhin gshegs pa shing sgrol rgyu'i drung du bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe byang phyogs pa'i tshong pa ga gon dang bzang po zhes bya ba mkhas pa gsal ba spun gnyis rnyed pa chen po rnyed nas/ zong rnam pa mang po thogs te/ 'gron pa buphal po che dang / shing rta shin tu gang ba lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu lho phyogs nas byang phyogs su dong ngo / /de gnyis la glang bu cang shes legs skyes dang grags pa zhes bya ba gnyis yod do/ /de gnyis la thogs pa'i 'jigs rinapa med de gang du glang bu gzhan mi thar ba der de gnyis gtong ngo / /gang du mdun rol na 'jigs pa yod pa der de gnyis phur pa la btags pa du )bzhin du 'dug go/ /de gnyis la lcag gis mi 'ju'i me tog ud pa la spar gang ngam/ sna ma'i me tog gi phreng bas de gnyis ded lnga do/ /shing sgrol rgyu dang nye ba zhig tu shing 'o rin)ma can gyi nags na gnas pa'i lha mos byin gyi spyorlabs kyis byin gyis brlabs pas/ de dag gi rkashing rta de dag thams cad mi 'gro ste/ 'breng pa la sogs pa shing rta'i 1cha rkyen pathams cad kyang chad grugs so/ /shing rta'i 'phang lo rnams kyang lte ba la thug par sa'i nang du nub ste/thams cad kyis rab tu bsgrims sna kyang shing rta de /midag 'gro bar ma gyur nas/kha cig ngo mtshar dang skrag par gyur te/ shing rta 'di dag thang la yang thogs par gyur pa 'di la rgyu ni ci zhig yod/ 'di'i 'gyur ba ni ci zhig yin snyam nas/46wa 443
